dkon brtsegs/ 9mi (42)0077 'phags pa yab dang sras mjal ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 3dang po/ rgyal po mngon par dad par byas pa'i le'u/ 3gnyis pa/ rgyal po gshegs pa'i le'u/ 36gsum pa/ rgyal po 'dun par byas pa'i le'u/ 40bzhi pa/ lha ma yin lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 47lnga pa/ sngon byung ba 'od srung chen pos zhus pa'i le'u/ 67drug pa/ nam mkha' lding lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 80bdun pa/ klu'i bu mo lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 86brgyad pa/ klu lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 95dgu pa/ grul bum lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 102bcu pa/ dri za lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 107bcu gcig pa/ gnod sbyin lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 1151

bcu gnyis pa/ mi'am ci lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 120bcu gsum pa/ phreng ldan glang po can lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 121bcu bzhi pa/ rgyal chen bzhi'i ris lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 125bco lnga pa/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 140bcu drug pa/ 'thab bral ba lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 147bcu bdun pa/ dga' ldan pa lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 154bco brgyad pa/ 'phrul dga' ba lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 161bcu dgu pa/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 167nyi shu pa/ tshangs pa lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 17 nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ 'od gsal ba lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 183nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ dge rgyas ris lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 192nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ 'bras bu che ba pa lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 202nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ gnas gtsang ma pa'i le'u/ 228nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ mu stegs can lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 28 nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ shākya lung bstan pa'i le'u/ 305rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī len dra bo dhe dang / dzi na mi tra dang / tā na shī la dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus ṭ+wāṃ // gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan bsdur mchan/(405) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(go5)0078 'phags pa gang pos zhus pa zhes bya ba'i theg pa chen po'i mdo / dzi6dang po/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i le'u/ go6gnyis pa/ mang du thos pa'i le'u/ 5052

gsum pa/ phyir mi sdog pa'i le'u/ 512bzhi pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ldan pa'i le'u/ 552lnga pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyi le'u/ 586drug pa/ thugs rje chen po'i le'u/ 594bdun pa/ brgal ba'i lan gdab pa'i le'u/ 623brgyad pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gang po'i le'u/ 638bsdur mchan/(642) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(682)0 79 'phags pa yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 683rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shrī la dang / mu ni wa dang / zhu chen gyi lo ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing nus te/ skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(756) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(7770080 'phags pa khyim bdag drag shul can gyis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 775rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo rnyi dang / mu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(852) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(868)3

bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/7sa༅na / 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa chen po chos kyi rnam grangs le'u stong phrag brgya pa las le'u bcu drug pa ste/ 'phags pa yab dang sras mjal ba zhes bya ba de kho na nges par bstan pa/ bam po dang po/༷ rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya 5pi tā 4phu tra sa mā ga ma na nā 3ma ma hā yā na sru 6)tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa yab dang sras mjal ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/tsusangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa 3dus gcig na / bcom ldan 'das grol ba grol ba'i 'khor dang ldan pa/ dul ba dul ba'i 'khor dang ldan pa/ zhi ba zhi ba'i 'khor dang ldan pa/ rgal ba rgal ba'i 'khor dang ldan pa/ pha rol du phyin pa pha rol du phyin pa'i 'khor dang ldan pa/thang la phyin pa 9thang la phyin pa'i 'khor dang ldan pa/ dbugs phyin pa nya 42—3

dbugs phyin pa'i 'khor dang ldan pa/ dge slong dge slong gi 'khor dang ldan pa/nyon mongs pa bcom pa nyon mongs pa bcom pa'i 'khor dang ldan pa/ dge sbyong dge sbyong gi 'khor dang ldan pa/ sdig pa bsal ba sdig pa bsalarkaba'i 'khor dang ldan pa/ tshangs pa tshangs pa'i 'khor dang ldan pa/ sdig bsal ba'i chos can sdig bsal ba'i chos rican gyi 'khor dang ldan pa/ rig pa can rig pa can gyi 'khor dang ldan pa/ khrus byas pa khrus byas pa'i 'khor dang ldan pa/sgrogasastodapa po sgrogs 5pa po'i 'khor dang ldan pa/ nyon mongs pa byang ba nyon mongs pa pobyang ba'i 'khor dang ldan pa/ yan lag lnga rnam par bsal ba yan lag lnga rnam par bsal kluba'i 'khor rjedang ldan pa/ sgrib pa dang rnam par bral ba sgrib nyapa dang 2rnam par bral ba'i 'khor tsho/snyedang ldan pa/ yid rnam par dang ba yid rnam par dang ba'i 'khor chedang ldan pa/ yan lag drug dang ldan pa yan lag drug dang ldan pa'i 'khor skudang ldan pa/ bsnyen bsring dang bral ba bsten bsring dang bral ba'i 'khor dang ldan pa/ bsrung ba gcig pa bsrung ba gcig pa'i 'khor dang ldan pa/ dran pa'i sgo srungasardzo/nyephun sum tshogs pa dran pa'i sgo srungs /9phun sum tshogs pa'i 'khor dang ldan pa/ rton pa bzhim rmedang ldan pa rten pa bzhi ri dang ldan pa'i 'khor 22dang ldan pa/ nyi tshem ba'i bden pa bsal ba nyi tshe ba'i bden pa bsal ba'i 'khor dang ldan pa/ btsal ba spangs pa btsal ba spangs pa'i 'khor dang ldan pa/ mthar phyin pa mthar rtephyin pa'i 'khor dang ldan pa/ don gyi mthar thug pa don gyi mthar thug pa'i 'khor dang ldan pa/ bdag nyid bsgoms pa bdag nyid bsgoms pa'i 'khor dang ldan pa/ kun tu rtog pa'i rnyog pa 0medam pa kun tu rtog pa'i rnyog pa0 med 42—4

pa'i 'khor dang ldan pa/ rnam par rtog pa yongs su chad pa rnam par rtog pa yongs su chad pa'i 'khor dang ldan pa/ lus kyi 'du byed rab tu bsal 〉 ba lus kyi 'du byed rab tu bsal 3ba'i 'khor dang ldan pa/ mi g.yo rib la mngon par mos pa mi g.yo ba la mngon par rimos pa'i 'khor dang ldan pa/sems shin tu rnam par grol ba sems shin tu rnam par grol ba'i 'khor dang ldan pal/ shes rab shin tu rnam par grol ba shes 5skurab shin tu rnam par grol ba'i 'khor dang ldan pa/ 'phags pa 'phags pa'i 'khor dang ldan pa/ yal ga dang / lo ma dang / 'dab snyom dang / lcug ma dang / shun phrags kyi skyon dang bral ba/ dag pa/ snying po la gnas pa/ shākya'i 7yul na52ser skya'i gnas / shing n+ya gro dha'i tshokun dga' ra ba na lnga sde dang / grags byin tshadang /'char ka dang / lteng rgyas 'od srung dang / ga ya 'od srung sna dang / chu klung 'od srungamatshadang / 'od srung mchen po dang / shā 7ri'i bu dang / mod gal gyi bu la sogs (3pa/ dge slong stong nyis brgya 39lnga bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang thabs cig matu bzhugs te/ thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ dbang dang ldan par gyur pa/ sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ shes rab shin tu rnam par grol ba/cang shes pa/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas pa/ byed pa byas pa/5nya khur bor ba/ bdag gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid par kun tu sbyor ba/ yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ semasam thams cad kyi dbang gi dam pa'i pha rol du phyin pa sha stag dang thabs cig ste/ de'i tshe nam gyi tho rangs ri 2kyi res la bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis 42—5

yongs su bskor cing dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis mdun gyis0bltas te/ bla gab med pa na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bar thams cad dang ldan pa'i ridage slong gi dge 'dun cang mi smra ba la gzigs so/ /thams cad dang ldan pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun la gzigs nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag dge slong gang gis rgyal po zas gtsang ma rimangon par dad par 'gyur ba de lta bu 'ga' zhig tshol cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun shes kau ḍi n+ya stan pyalas langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu sagazar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga nes la btsugs lke te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 8logs su thal mo lha sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis rgyal po zas gtsang ma mngon par dad par bgyi'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun shes kau ḍi 7rgya la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ / kau ḍi ( nyargya khyod ni 7bla ma bla mar bya ba'i chos dang ldan par bya ba yin gyis 7'dug shigs /de bzhin du tshe dang ldan pa rlangs papa dang / ming chen dang / grags byin tshadang ske/ lteng rgyas 'od sung 7dang / chu klung 1snye'od srung dang / ga ya lha 'od srung dang / 'od srung chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa shām ri'i bu dang /mod gal gyi bu chen pos kyang bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis rgyal po zas gtsang ma mngon par dad par bgyi'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa med gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal pas / mod gal gyi bu khyod kyang bla ma bla mar 2 bya ba'i chos dang ldan par bya ba yin gyis 24'dug shiga'i /de nas tshe dang 42—6

ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po 'di snyam du sems te/ rgyal po zas gtsang ma mngon par dad par byed pa'i dge slong gang zhig bcom ldan 'das bzhed 3)snyam ste / de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen pos ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam pa de lta bu la snyumanyam par bzhag ste/ de ltar mnyam par bzhag gepa'i sems kyis bcom ldan 'das kyis snodagongs pa tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la gnas shing dge slong 'char zhuka 'di ༅rgyal po zas gtsang ma mngon par dad par byed do zhes dgongs pa shemathong ste 'di lta ste/ dper na khang pa brtsegs pa 'am/ 1)khang pa77brtsegs pa'i khyams sgo byang phyogs su lta ba'i / shar phyogs kyi skar khung nas nyi ma'i 'od zer 'byung ste/ nub phyogs kyi rtsig pangos la shar ba de bzhin du de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa med gal gyi bu chen pos bcom ldan 'das kyimatshadagongs pa tshe dang ldan pa 'char 8ka la shar cing dge slong 'char ka 'di rgyal po zas gtsang ma mngon par dad par byed do zhes dgongs pa mthong ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po ting nge 'dzin de las langs 7te/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka ga la ba der song nas tshe dang ldan pa 'char : ka la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka bcom ldan 'das ni khyod la dge slong 'char gas rgyal po zas gtsang ma mngon par dad par sna bya bar nus so zhes dgongs shing bzhedam)do/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka de lta yin gyis nya/ khyod kyis rgyal po zas gtsang ma mngon par dad par bya bar dad pa skyed 2cig /de skad ces smras pa dang —/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas tshe dang ldan pal med gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa med gal gyi bu chen po rigs rnams ni dad param bya bar shin tu dka'am ste/ rgyal po'i rigs ni lhag par dka'o/ /42—7

de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyal po rgyal rigs nyu1spyi bo tshanas dbang bskurasheb rnams ni mgu 4bar dka' ba ri riste/ tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po 'di lta ste/dper na shing khur bcu'am/ nyi shu'am/ sum cu'ayo no/ bzhi bcu'am/ lnga bcu'am / shing khur brgya yang rung ste/ gsher thobag med cing skam la lo mang du lon pa zhig yod la nade la mi la la zhig gis me btang na me'i phung po chen poshe 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /de la yang khul la zhig gis 3nyamar ram/ 'bru mar zhig gis sna gtor na me'i phung po de bas ches che bar ( rte'abar te/ de'i steng ngam drung gi 'khor midu 'gro ba ni shin tu dka'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po de bzhin du rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur tsob rnams ni mgu bar dka' ba'os/ /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po 'di lta ste/dper na glang po che mche ba can kha gdangs pa'i so phrag tu 'gro ba ni shin tu dka'o / /tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po de bzhin du rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur 〉ba rnams kyang mgu bar dka'o/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa med gal gyi bu chen pos tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka de ni de lta mod kyi/ 'on kyang khyod ni dge slong 'char ka 'dis rgyal po zas gtsang ma /snyemangon par dad par bya bar nus so zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs shing sna bzhed pa yin no/ /smras pa / tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi bu chen po bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag lab : rgyal pos zas gtsang ma dad par byed par dgongs sam/ smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka de de bzhin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong 'char ka ni rgyal po zas gtsang ma dad par byed do zhes dgongs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 42—8

'das nyid kyis tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la bka' su55 pa/ 'char ka rgyal po zas gtsang ma dad par gyis shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'char ka rgyal po zas gtsang ma ni yang na ngas0dad par bya yis/ yang na khyod kyis dad par bya'o/ /'char ka nga'i nyan thos ji snyed cig yod pa de dag gi nang na khyod ni 'di ltar rigs dad par byed pa'i mchog yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la tshigs su bcad pa de bka' stsal pa/ 'char ka bzang po nga las mnyan 0par byos/ /khyod ni rigs dad byed mchog rab yin gyis( ci/ /shākya'i rigs rnams dga' ba skyed pa yi/ /rgyal po'i 3)dam pa myur du 9)dad par byos/ /rgyal po'i rab de dad par byas na 7ni/ /rigasapha/gebu 8lha dag dang ni 7mi rnams la/ /mtha'atsha dbus med pa'i legs pa 'byung 'gyur gyis8/ / mi yi dam pa myur du dad par byos/ /da :lta na ni shākya'i bdagatshwa po de/ /mngon pa'i nga rgyal rtog 3/pas dkrugs du shing nyams/ /ri yi ngos nas rbab 'dril ji stobazhin du/ /brtson 'grus rtsol ba sa thams cad btang —rteste gnas/ /dbang phyug nyams pa rjes su dran byed pas/ /yid la cuganod gyur sems dang yid kyang stor/ /dper na tshong pa nor dang bral ba dag /rjes su dran zhing nyon mongs gnas pa bzhin/ /lha yi gnas nas lha dag shi 'phos shing / /lha rdzas 'dod rtepa rjes su dran pa bzhin / /rgyal ba'i bstan pal snamangon par mi shes shing / /rgyal po bde nyamasang snying rje smre sngags 'don 2/ /ngam yi rin po che ni sna bdun dang / /mi yi phun sum tshogs pa bzhi po dang / /longs spyod dag ni rjes su dran byed cing / /sa bdag de ni snying rjer chusmre sngags 'don/ /mdangs 'phrog byed pa'i srin po stobs can gyis/ /ji ltar mi zhig yongs su 42—9

non gyur na/ /bdag kyang mi shes gzhan yang mi shes ltar/ /sa yi bdag po de yang de bzhin no/ /ti se'i gangs kyi ri bos bsgribs gyur na/ /ji ltar mi dag blta bya mi mthong ba/ /de bzhin nga rgyal chen pos bsgribs pas na/ /rgyal pos blta bar bya ba mi mthong ngo / /gnyid kyis log gam shi bas myos 'gyur ba'i // /mis ni rang gi sems kyang mi shes te/ /de bzhin nga rgyal chen pos samyos gyur pas / /rgyal po des kyang dge ba mi shes so/ /dper na khyim thab shi bas myos pa yi/ /bud med snying rjer smre sngags 'don byed pa/ /de bzhin nga rgyal chen pos myos gyur pas/ /rgyal po de yang snying rjer 5the sngags 'don/ /de lta bas na 'char ka thabs mkhas pa / /khyod kyis 'dir ni rgyal po dad par gyis3/ /nga rgyal rgyal mtshan rab tu bsnyal bar byos/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan 7ridam pa bslang bar gyisapa/ /'char ka khyod ma gtogs par srid /nyapa yi/ /'gro ba dag na skal 'thun 7spyad med pas/ /rgyal po'i sems ni rab tu dad bya bar/ /gang gis nus pa'i dge slong gang yang med/ /'char ka sngon gyi dus na byung ba ni / /'das pa'i dus na sa yi : bdag po zhig /ming ni bden pa 'phel zhes bya ba ste/ /sa skyong byed pa tsharnam par grags pa byung / /de ni chos kyi rgyal po chos dang ldan/ /srog chags bye ba khrag khrig rnams kyis mchod/ /rgya mcho1re mtha' 15mar thug pa'i sa 'di ni/ /chos dang ldan pa'i rgyal po des kyang bskyangs / /grong dang grong khyer dag kyang 'dab nye pazhing / /bza' shing 'bras bu me tog rgyas pas gang / /'phags pa'i skye bo dag dang shed las skyes/ /sdig dang bral ba rnams kyis rab tu gang / /dri za brgya mang dag gis gang ba ste/ /sdong dum tsher ma rtswa nashing ngan pa med/ /'jam zhing dge sbyong gnas :tshekyi tshogs 42—10

kyis spras/ /chu klung 1'bab stegs bde bas rab tu brgyan/ /drang srong tshogs brgya rjes su rgyu ba ste/ /skye bo'i dkar spre chos rnams kyis 4kun tu bsgrubs/ /ngan song lam ngan rnams ni rab 5tu bcad/ /de nas sems can thams cad lha gnas 'dod/ /rgyal po de la bu dag yod pa ni/ /sngon gyi posangs rgyas byung ba mthong ba ste/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba dag ni bskyed pa can/ /yon tan 7mang pos bsgos pa'i blo gros ldan/ /ming ni blo gros 9snying po zhes bya ste/ /srog chags bye ba khrag khrig rnams kyis mchod/ /'dod pa rnams la skyon 7du lta ba can / /mi bdag khyim na gnas kyang dben la dga'/ /rgyal po bden pa 'phel zhes bya ba des/ /lha yi pho brang 'dra ba'i khyim mchog 'dir/ /na chung tshogs kyis kun nas mdun bdar te/ /'dod pa'i yon tan bzang la spyod ces smras / /bu yi dam pa khyod la nga yis ni/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i bya ba gang ma byas//'dod pa rnams la khyod yid ci yi phyir/ /ma mos nga la bu khyod myur du smros/ /srid pa'i 'gro ba'i yon tan mkhas gyis 1 te/ /bu khyod rin chen khyim la dga' ba skyed/ /bud med rin chen 'khor dang 'grogs gyis ’ te/ /yul la dga' zhing mos pa bskyed par gyis ri/ /dkan thub nags na 'khod pa'i drang srong dag /de btang nas ni phyir yang 'di dag na/ /dka' thub btang zhing 'dod pa'i dga' la spyod/ /'dod pa de dag bu gcig khyod la bstabasa'i/ /de lta bas na 'dod pa'i dga' la spyod/ /nga dang rgyal srid thams cad khyod dang 'thun / /rnam thos bu 7yi gnas dang 'dra ba yi/ /gzhal med khang gi rgyan lacan khyim 'dir spyod/ /'di dag rnams kyang mchog gi gzugs ldan ’ zhing / /lha mo 'dra la sgyu rtsal tshar phyin pa/ /rol mo'i sgra yi tshul dang glu la mkhas/ /42—11

bsnyen bkur snyoms shing yon tan yid kyang 'phrog /mig ni pad ma'i lo ma 'dra ba ste/ /tham pa'i mdog 'dra mchu mdzes yid du 'ong / /so dang bzhin mdog dri ma med cing bzang / / dpral ba 〉smin ma legs shing mgul pa sdug /brla ni glang po tsho che yi sna yang 'dra/ /phrag so shas rgyas thal gong legs dang ldan / /lag dang rkang pa'i mthil 4ni zangs kyi mdog /sor mo byin pa phra bar 5legs dang ldan/ /lce ni zangs mdog 'dra ba srab 6cing dag /tshig ran 'jam par smra ba'i tshul dang ldan/ /so ni thags bzang so rnams zad rod med/ /mche ba rab dkar mchog gi rgyan medang ldan/ /lto ba phyang nger 'dug cing lte ba sdug /sta zur yangs shing rked pa rdo rje 'dra/ /byin pa glang po che yi so 'dra zhing / /mda' rgyu snying po legs par skyes pa bzhin/ /dregs bcas glang chen 'dra ba'i 'gros dang ldan / /gzhan du mi sems yid kyis khyod la lta/ / rtse ba 'dod 7cing dar la bab dang ldan/ /gzhon nu snying rje ltos la brtse bar 11byos/ /bu cig khyod dang bud med 'di dag gis/ /mdog bzang ba dang dar la bab pa yang ske/ /shing gi rtse rtemo'i me tog bzhin ltung gegis/ /nga rgyal thong la 'dod pa bsten par gyisa'i/ /blo gros sasnying po ldan des smre 7ba yi/ /pha dang 'khor rnams kun la 'di skad smras 8/ /yab cig khyod ni mad par gsung ba dzolags/ /gang dag tshig gis grags pa ma smad mad nya/ /yon tan rnams la mos pa bdag gi tshig / bsams te 2 gtan la bab la rgyal po gson/ /ji ltar rmi lam na yang 'dod la bdag /sems mi dga' zhing ma mos de 'dra gson/ /sa yi bdag pos bka' 455 'di dag ni/ /mkhas pa rnams la mdzes pa ma lags te//mi mkhas skye bo dag gis muyang dag bsams sku/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis de dag 42—12

rtag tu smad①/ /long ba ma lags ci yi rgyu zhig gis/ /long ba'i tshig gis lam gol rngo ri'adzin par bgyid/ /thang la gnas pa su zhig ji ltar na/ /mgon med chus khyer ba la 'dod pa skyed/ /grol ba ji lta bur na bcings pa yi tshig gis btson par der ni 'jug par bgyid/ /sa mnyam gnas shing ma 'khrul 5ji ltar na/ /nyam ngar phyoganas la 'dod pa skyed par bgyid/ /sa bdag 'dod pa rnams la chags bcas shing / /'dod pa'i longs spyod dag gi 7chus khyer ba/ /long ba chus khyer btson 3rar gnas pa dang / / nyam ngar 9gnas 'drar bdag ni de snyam bgyid/ /mi yi bdag po khyod ni long ba bzhin/ /bdag ni mig can khyad par mthong ba lags / /khyod ni 'dod pa'i chu bos khyer ba lags / /bdag ni 'dod pa rnams las rnam par smod/ /'dod pa dag ni dug gi lo ma bzhin/ /sbrul gyi mgo 'dra sdug bsngal bgyid pa ste/ /rtse gsum pa dang ral gri timadung thung 'dra/ /me yi phung po shin tu 'bar ba lha bzhin/ /blo gros snying po ldan pas de skad du/ /smre sngags 'don pa'i pha dang 'khor la smras/ /rin chen sna tshabadun dag la skum bltas lapar/ /rgyal srid rnam par spangs te rab tu byung / /sbrul gyi lpags rnying rjes ’ pa ci 'dra dang / /ngar snabs rngus /snyepa'i thal ba bzhin spangs te/ /blo gros 19snying po ldan pa chags med par/ /sdig dang rnam par bral te rab tu byung / /gzhon nu de ltar rab tu byung gyur nas / /blon po'i bu 1zhig rjes su rab byung ba/ /ming ni zla bas byin zhes bya ba ste / /blo gros snying po'i rjes su rab tu byung / /gzhon nu de ltar rab tu byung gyur nas/ /tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi po bskyed nas ni/ /grogs dang bcas pas mngon par shes pa lnga/ /ma lus mtha' dag bskyed par byas par gyur/ /42—13

'dod pa rnams la skyon du lta bas na/ /mi yi seng ge de ni 'dod khams 'das/ /tshangs pa yang dag nyid ni thob bya'i 1phyir/ /tshangs pa'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba byas/ /de ltar gzhon nu rab tu byung bas na/ / pha de bu la ma dad gyur pa dang / /zla bas byin pa de yi gan song nas/ /legs par bshad pa'i tshig gis dga' bar byas/ /'char ka khyod ni de la ji snyam sems/ /de tshe blo gros snying po gzhan snyam 'am/ /nga nyid de yi tshe na der gyur te/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod don du gnyer ba med/ /'char ka khyod ni de la ji snyam sems/ /bden pa 'phel ba gzhan zhig yin snyam 'am/ /mi bdag zas gtsang 'di nyid de yi tshe/ / rgyal po bden pa 'phel zhes bya bar gyur/ /'char ka khyod ni de la ji snyam sems/ /rjes su rab byung zlas byin gzhan snyam 'am / /khyod nyid de tshe de yi dus na ni/ /bden pa 'phel ba dad par byed pa yin/ /de lta bas na 'char ka khyod kyis 'dir/ /rgyal po zas gtsang dad pa mngon skyed cig /sa 5skyong byed pa 'di ni dad gyur na/ /skyid pa chen po phun sum tshogs par 'gyur //de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas bcom ldan 'das la mi smra bar 7khas blangs so//de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka 8zhag de 'das nas snga dro'i dus kyi tshe chos gos dang sham thabs bgos/ lhung bzed thogs te9/ ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen por song ngo / /de'i tshe rgyal po zas gtsang ma btsun mo'i 'khor gyi mdun na shākya stong tsam zhig dang 7/ dgos pa zhig gi ched du 'dus shing 'khod do/ /rgyal po zas gtsang mas kyang bcom ldan 'das ser skya'i gnas su byon cing /ser skya'i gnas 'di nyid na shing n+ya gro dha'i dzikun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so zhes thos nas de 'di snyam du sems rite/ gzhon nu de rab tu byung bas bdag ni 42—14

dbang phyug gi longs spyod chen po las nyams par byas so/ /gal te gzhon nu de khyim na gnas na 'khor los sgyur 1ba'i rgyal po mtha' bzhir rnam par rgyal ba/chos dang ldan pa/ chos kyi rgyal po rin po che sna bdun dang ldan par 'gyur te/de'i rin po che sna bdun 'di dag ste/ 'di ltar 'khor lo rin po che dang /glang po rin po che dang / rta rin po che dang / nor bu rin po che dang / bud med rin po che dang / khyim bdag rin po che dang / blon po rin po che ste 'di bdun no/ /de la bu dpa' ba / rtul phod 5pa/ yan lag mchog gi gzugs dang ldan pa/ gzhan gyi sde rab tu 'joms 7pa stong yang tshang bar 'gyur ba zhig /des gling chen po bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di yang chad 9pa med cing mtshon 7gyis bda' ba med la mnyam ste/ mi mnyam pa med cing chos dang 'thun pas legs par phab nas bskal pa rdzogs par legs par 11bskyangs par 'gyur ba zhig ste/ de ltar gyur na bdag cag kyang 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid la dbang phyug gi dbang dang ldan zhing rim gro byas pa dang /bkur sti 2byas pa dang / bste stang du byas pa dang / mchod par byas pa dang /dbang phyug gi dbang chen po yang rnyed par 'gyur ba zhig na da 5ltar bdag cag ni gzhon nu de rab tu byung bas de lta labu'i longs spyod kyi dbang chen po dang bral bar lagyur to snyam mo/ /des de snyam du bsams nas shākya rnams la bsgo ba/nga'i bu de la blta ’ ba'am/ bsnyen bkur byed par su yang ma 'gro shig 9 /la la zhig nga'i bu de la blta ba'am bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir 'gro na de'i lus la gnod pa'i chad pas bcad 2do/ /de'i tshe shākya'i bu dga' ba'i bzhin 22zhes bya ba zhig 'khor de nas byung nas song bar gyur te/ shākya'i bu dga' ba'i bzhin 42—15

gyis tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka rgyang ring po nas 'ong ba mthong lhanas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka ga la ba der song ste/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la geyang dag par mgu bar byas nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka tshur spyon/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka byon pa legs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka yun kyang ring zhig nas nga byon to/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka bcom ldan 'das la snyun mi mnga' 'am/stobs dang ldan nam/ bde bar 5bzhugs sam/ mi bde ba phyomi mnga' 'am/de la nyam nga ba ci yang mi mnga' 'am/ bcom ldan 'das bde bar byon tam/shin tu ma mnyel tam/ bsod snyoms kyis 7'o ma brgyal tam/ de skad ces smras pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas shākya'i bu dga' ba'i ri bzhin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /dga' ba'i bzhin de de bzhin te/ bcom ldan 'das la snyan mi mnga'o/ /stobs dang ldan no/ /bde bar bzhugs so/ /mi bde ba mi mnga'o / /de la nyam nga ba ci yang mi mnga'o/ /bde bar byon to/ /mnyel ba med do/ /bsod snyoms kyis 'o brgyal ba 9med do/ /shākya'i bu shin tu legs par sad kyis kyang shākya'i bu dga' ba'i bzhin tshe dang ldan pa :nya'achar ka dang lhan cig 2dben pa na 'khod pa mthong 12nas 'khor de nas byung ste/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka ga la ba der song nas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la yang dag par mgu bar byas te/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka tshur spyonas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka byon pa legs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka yun kyang ring bzhig nas pabyon to/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka bcom ldan 'das la 7skun mi mnga' 'am/stobs dang ldan nam/ bde bar bzhugs sam/ mi bde ba mi mnga' ha 'am/de la nyam nga ba ci yang mi mnga' 'am/ bcom ldan 'das bde bar byon tam/42—16

shin tu ma mnyel tam/ bsod snyoms kyis 'o ma brgyal 〉tam/ de skad ces smras pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas shākya'i bu shin tu legs par sad la 'di skad ces smras so/ /shin tu legs par sad de de bzhin te/ bcom ldan 'das la snun mi mnga'o/ /stobs dang ldan no/ /bde bar bzhugs so/ /mi bde ba mi mnga'o / /de la nyam nga ba ci yang rimi mnga'o/ /bde bar byon to/ /mnyel ba med do/ /bsod snyoms kyis 'o brgyal ba med do/ /shākya'i ltabu mya ngan med dang / mya ngan bral gyis kyang tshe dang ldan pa 'char 0ka dang /shākya'i bu dga' ba'i bzhin dang / shākya'i bu shin tu legs par sad sgyuganas dben pa na 'khod pa mthong nas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka ga la ba der song ste/tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la yang dag par mgu bar byas nas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka tshur spyon/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka byon pa legs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka yun kyang ring zhig nas byon to/ /tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka bcom ldan 'das la snyan mi mnga' 'am/ stobs dang ldan nam/ bde bar bzhugs sam / mi bde ba mi mnga' 'am/ de la nyam nga ba ci yang /mi mnga' 'amatsha/bcom ldan 'das bde bar byon tam/ shin tu ma mnyel tam/ bsod snyoms kyis 'o ma brgyal tam/ de skad ces smras pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas shākya'i bu mya ngan med dang / mya tshangan bral la 'di skad ces smras so/ /mya ngan med dang / mya ngan bral ribacom ldan 'das la snyun mi mnga'o/ /stobs dang ldan no/ /bde bar bzhugs so/ /mi bde ba 7mi mnga'o/ /de la nyam nga ba ci yang mi mnga'o / /bde bar byon to/ /mnyel ba med do/ /bsod snyoms kyis 'o brgyal ba med dol/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar rgyal po chen po 7bzhi 42—17

dang —/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa dag bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i phyir brtson par byed do/ /de skad ces smras pa dang ske/ shākya'i bu de dag gis tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa 'char ka bdag cag ni bcom ldan 'das la blta ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya bar 'dod na bdag cag gis de ltar mi 1nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/'di ltar rgyal po zas gtsang rims nga'i bu la blta ba'am bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir su yang ma 'gro shig /la la zhig de la blta ba'am/ bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir song na lus la gnod pa'i chad pas gcad 5do zhes bka' stsal to/ /de bas na 'phags pa 'char ka de ltar bdag cag phyirgyal pos 'jigs pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'am bsnyen bkur byed du 'dong bar mi nus so/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ma rgyal po zas gtsang ma 'di ni shin tu yang 7nga rgyal gyis non par gyur na ji ltar bdag gis de'i drung du 'gro bar bya snyam nas des 'di snyam du bsams so / /'on tang 9bdag gis nam mkha' la rdzu 'phrul gyis shing ta 7la bdun srid du 'phags la steng gi bar snang la naskyil mo krung skabacas te rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i gan du 'gro bar bya'o cisnyam nas/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam pa de lta bu la mnyam par bzhag ste/ sems mnyam par bzhag dpa des nam mkha' la shing ta la bdun srid du 'phags nas bar snang la skyil mo krung tshobacas te/rgyal po zas gtsang ma ga la 7ba der song ngo / /rgyal po zas gtsang mas kyang tshe dang ldan pa na'achar ka rgyang ring po nas nam mkha' la shing ta 9la bdun srid du 'phags te rdzu 'phrul gyis bar snang la skyil mo krung 2bcas shing 'ong ba mthong 42—18

nas de la thal mo sbyar te tshigs su bcad nyanas smras pa/ tshon 2bsgyur gos can khyod ni gang nas 'ongs/ /khyod la ci dgos myur du smra bar byos/ /khyod la gang dgos de yang myur du sbyin/ /brtul zhugs grub pa mthong bar shin tu dka'/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char kus rgyal po zas gtsang ma la tshigs su bcad de slar smras 4pa/ rgyal po bdag ni khyod kyi sras kyi bu/ /bdag la chos dgos 5rgyal po phyogang na bzhugs/ /bdag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i bshos skyel te/ /bde bar gshegs pa skyob pa'i bshos bskur 7ro/ /yul 'khor bdag po che /ba'i dpal mnga' ba/ /khyod la mi mchog sras mnga' grags pa thob/ /gzi brjid kyis ni phyogs rnams kun tu 'bar/ /ston gyi nyi ma'i 9gung gi 'od dang 'dra/ /ji ltar sprin med nam mkha'i nyi ma ni/ /phyogs rnams kun tu 'od byed mngon par 'bar/ /de bzhin rgyal po glang po khyod kyi sras/ /ye shes mnga' bas phyogs rnams kun tu snang / /ji ltar ston gyi nyi ma shar ba na//srin bu me khyer zil gyis mnan cing snang / /de bzhin rgyal po glang po khyod kyi sras / /mu stegs gzhan rnams kun bcom lam mer bzhugs/ /ji ltar nyi mas 7zil non skar ma 11rnams/ /nyin par 'od stor 2lam mer mi rung ba/ /de bzhin byurgyal po glang po khyod sras kyis snye/ /zil gyis mnan pas mu stegs gzhan mi snang / /ji ltar nyi mas zil non 7zla ba ni/ /nam mkha'i dbyings nas d+ku'od stong 7nyid mi snang / /de bzhin khyod sras zil mnan mu stegs rnams/ /nyi mas gzil non zla bzhin gsal ba med/ /seng ge'i nga ro thos nas phra mo rnams / /shugs kyis rmongs nas bsam pa ji bzhin du/ /ri sul gseb tu byer nas 'khra zhing gnas/ /stag gi nga ro gzhan gyis bzod par dka'/ /42—19

de bzhin rgyal po 〉drang srong chen po'i gsung / /bdagashemed nga roshes stegs gzhan thos nas / /shes rab dman pa srid pa'i rtser phyin kyang / /gsung thos pas ni thams cad 'jigs par 'gyur/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten long ba la/ /spyan dang ldan pa des ni mig kyang stsal/ /snang ba mdzadapo)cing rdul kyang rnam par sbyangs/ /ye shes snang ba'i dkyil 'khor mngon par sharasti/ /bde dang mi bde'i nalam gnyis rab tu bstan/ /lam dang gol ba'i lam yang rgyal bas bstan/ /lam stor skye bo rnams ni lam du btsudapo)/ /'dam du bying ba rnams kyang thang la bton / /ji ltar skom dzo/〉pa'i sa la sprin gyis ni/ /sgang dang gshong tshabacas char gyis ngoms par byed/ /de bzhin rgyal po glang po khyod kyi sras/ /'gro ba lhar skubacas chos kyis ngoms par mdzad/ /ji ltar char gyis ngoms pa'i ri sul genags/ /rtswa gdang gel pa nags tshal shing rnams dang / /'khri 7shing sdong po sman gyi rnam pa dang / /me tog sna tshogs rnams kyis sa mdzes tshepa 8/ /de bzhin stobs bcu mi 'jigs mnga' ba dang / /ma 'dres bcu /tshocabargyad chos mnga'i pasdong po la/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes me tog dang / /'bras bus spras pasang rgyal po'i sras mdzes so/ /ji ltar rgya mtsho'i dbus na lhun po'i ri/ /lha yi gnas gyur mi sgulam rnam par mdzes/ /de bzhin rgyal po glang po khyod kyi sras/ /dge sbyong rgya mtsho'i nang na rnam par mdzesazhi / bde sogs byukhyim thab brgyasabyin lha dbang po/ /lha yi stan la 'dug na mdzes pa ltar / /de bzhin rgyal po glang po khyod kyi srasas/ /dge sbyong tshogs kyi dbus na rnam par mdzes / /byams pa'i stobs can zab mo'i 'brug bsgrags te/ /thugs rje chen po'i glog phreng rterir ldan pas/ /dran pa nyer gzhag 9char rgyun 42—20

'dab 'khrigs7te/ /rgyal ba klu mchog de ni chos char na'abebs yongs dag dkyil 'khor tshul khrims rab kyi gzer / /ting 'dzin nyon mongs lha min rab 'joms shing ba/ /ye shes nyi rigazer srid pa'i srid pa skems / /rgyal ba'i nyi chen 'gro bar rnam par mdzes/ /ting nge na'adzin dang 9tshul khrims gzings dang gru chen te/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i 7nor bu rin chen tshogs/ /byang chub yan lag rin chen tsho/)'byung gnas7bsam gtan rlabs/ /thar pa 'dod pas sangs rgyas rgya mtsho bsten par bya8/ /tshul khrims rnam dag rtsa ba brtan par zug /ting 'dzin lo ma dran pa yal ga 'dab/ /byang chub yan lag me tog stong pa'i sdong / /bdag med grib ldan rgyal ba'i sdong po stena'i/ /tshul khrims nags mtha' sten 7pa'i stobs chen po/ /tingasna 'dzin zhi ba'i ri khrod phug na gnas/ /stong pa mtshan /smyo med smon med spyod //yul can/ /rgyal ba stobs can seng ge khyod kyi sras/ /thub patshwanyemi gnas gnas pa lharnam par ston/ /rgyal ba khyu mchog brjid pa'i stabs bzhud pas( na/ /byis pa so so sumu stegs gzhan bsngags te/ /khyod kyi sras ni khyu mchog sgra yang 'byin/ /tshul khrims gter dang yon tan dbyig gis brgyan/ /bsam gtan dang ba'i zhi gnas nye bar bskyabs gnye/ /ye shes kyis bsrungs thar pa'i spyod yul can/ / rgyal ba snyotshong dpon gtso bo nor gtongam mdzad/ /dge ba yongs su bzungam bas sdig bcom sto / /nyon mongs zhir mdzad dge bstenam bka' stsol pas lha/ /lha dang lha min bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /rgyal po khyod kyi srasam mchog rnam par mdzes/ /tshul khrims mchog sprin blo grosam glog 'byin cing / /yan lag brgyad lam char chen rlan gyis spengs du)/ /thub pa gces pa'i lo tog 'bras bu stsol/ /42—21

khyod kyi sras ni klu chen 'brug sgra sgrogs1/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gang zag mchog de bde bar 'ongs sam ci/ /bsod snyoms rgyu bas 'dren pa ma ngal lam / /de yi lus la ngal bas dub med dam/ /thang gnas 5ud pa cal bzhin ma rnyis sam ske/ /'char gas smras pa/ rdzu 'phrul stobs mnga' bsam gtan spyod yul can / /dgyes shing bde bas yan lag yongs rgyas 0te/ /thub pa zhi ba'i snyoms 'jug gnas bcas pas / /gser gyi pad ma lta bur rgyal mi rnyis / /rgyal pos smras pa/ sngan 7chad rdza rnga rnga bran sgras bskul zhing / /gling bu'i sgra snyan pang ros bskul byas te/ /bud med glu yi dbyangs kyis bslang bslang nas / /da 7ltar sad na sdug skabasngal mi myong ngam/ /'char gas smras pa/ bsam gtan dgongs pas ting 'dzin zhi skeyul can/ /ting 'dzin bsgrub 7pa'i tshul la mkhas pa ste/ / mnal tam bzhengs sam bzhud dam bzhugs pa na/ /sdug bsngal mi mnga' rgyal ba rtag tu dgyes/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ che ba'i rkyen 'os 19mal mchog bshams pa la/ /me mar sdong pos kun nas mtha' bskor te/ /bud med tshogs kyis bskor cing nyal nyal na/ /da ltar 21mun par nyal na cis 2mi mongs/ /'char gas smras pa/ thub chen 2'phags pa gzims mal 2 rigazims pa ni/ /byams pa'i gdan bting thugs rjes bde bar bzhengs/ /dga' ba'i riganas pas dgyes dang ldan pas na/ /srid med btang snyoms can la rmongs mi mnga'/ / 0rgyal pos smras pa/ shākya dpa' bos de rtag mdun du bdar / /bstan bcos mkhas dang rtse zhing dga' byas te/ /gzhal med khang 'dra'i khyim du dga' /byas na/ /nga yi bu de nags mthar 9ji ltar dga'/ /'char nas smras pa/ chos kyis byungs ba zhi sems ldan rnams kyis/ /zhi ba'i 42—22

thugs mnga' de rtag mdun du bdar/ /zhi ba'i dgon par zhi ba bsten nyamadzad pas / /ston pa 'jigs bral nade ni der dgyes so/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ sngon chad gzhon nu khyim na gnas pa'i tshe/ /yan lag spos kyi 'bru mar zhim byugs te / /rgyal po'i rkyen du 'os pas khrus byas na/ /nags kyi mtha' na thub 5pa su yis bkru/ /'char kus smras pa/ khrims gtsang 'bab stegs 0chos chu rdzing bu ste / /thub pa des bkrus gzhan yang bkru ba mdzad/ /sku la mi gsher sras 9dang bcas su 7'bog /rang yang rgal la skye bo phal cher ’ sgrol/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ gser gyi skud 12pa nor bu'i phreng 1 bas brgyan/ /rgyal po'i rkyen 7'os gos tshamachog bzang po pagyon/ /tsan dan zhim 7pos shing 'dab ’ legs par bris/ /nags chen de gseb thub pa su yis brgyan 9/ /'char mas smras pa / tshul khrims spos byugs yon tan phreng bas brgyan/ /khrel yod na bza' ting 'dzin bsam gtan rgyan 1/ /mngon shes rig pa rnam thar brgyan pa'i sku/ /rnam grol gzi mnga' thub pa nags na mdzes ri/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ rtse gnyis mtshon dang ral gri mtshon thogs pa'i/ /dpa' bo g.yul du 'ongs pas lus bsrungs te/ /bla re byugadugs kyis rtag tu dgab dgab pa lha/ /gcig pu lanags na 'dug na 2 su yis bsrung / /'char gas smras pa/ byams pa'i stobs kyis thub pa yongs bsrungs 0te/ /de dpung ye shes nyan thos zhabs 'bringam g.yog /yon tan tshogs la nges pasam 'jigs mi mnga'ar / /stobs bcu dgyesam pa mnga' zhing mi 'jigs brnyes / /rgyal pos smras pa/ nga yi bu yi yon tan khyod kyis smras/ /chos legs spyod cing dub med brjod pa thos/ /khyod kyang zan zo bsod snyoms bkur bar gyis / /bdag kyang mi yi dbang po 42—23

ltar nyi'agro'o/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char nas rgyal po zas gtsang ma la na'adi skad ces smras so/ /rgyal po chen po bcom ldan 'das de ni tshogs kyi slob dpon/ tshogs kyi mchog /dge sbyong gi tshogs yongs su sdud pa/ drang srong chen po ste / dge sbyong gi tshogs kyi nang na bzhugs na 3dge sbyong phyogi rgyal po lam 7me lhan ne salhang nge'o/ /rgyal po chen po 'di lta ste/dper na/ zla ba yar gyi ngo tshes bcwa 95lnga la 6zla ba nya ste yongs su rgyas pa'i tshe skar ma'i tshogs kyis kun nas bskor ba ni lam /1me lhan ne lhang nge'ong/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das de yang 1snyedage sbyong gi batshogs kyi nang na bzhugs na lam 7me lhan ne lhang nge'o/ / borgyal po chen po 8'di lta ste/ dper na nyi ma ni ston ku'i ’ dus na shin tu lamatsha18me lhan ne lhang nge'o/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das de yang dge sbyong gi tshogs kyi nang na bzhugs na shin tu lam nya/me lhan ne lhang nge'o/ /tshe 'di lta ste/ dper na ri'i rgyal po ri rab rgya mtsho'i 2glenang na 'dug pa ni lam 2 me lhan ne lhang nge'o/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das de yang dge sbyong gi tshogs kyi nang na bzhugs rten lam 24me lhan ne lhang nge'o/ /'di lta ste / dper na lha'i dbang po brgya byin ni gachos bzang 0lha'i mdun 2 sa na gnas na lam me lhan ne lhang nge'o0/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das de yang dge sbyong gi tshogs kyi nang na bzhugs na lamang me lhan ne lhang nge'o/ /'di lta ste/dper na lha'i bu rabab 'thab bral dang / lha'i bu yongs su dga' ldan dang /lha'i bu rab 'phrul dga' dang / lha'i bu gzhan 'phrul dbang byed lha'i tshogs kyi nang na gnas na lamang me lhan nem lhang nge'o/ /de bzhin dus bcom ldan 'das kyang dge sbyong gi tshogs kyi nang na bzhugs na lams/me lhan ne lhang nge'o/ /'di 42wa 24

lta ste/ dper na mi mjed 3kyi bdag po tshangs pa ni tshangs pa bye ba phrag stong gis bskor na lam geme lhan ne lhang nge'o/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das de yang dge sbyong gi tshogs kyi rinang na bzhugs na lam 4me lhan ne lhang nange'o/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang mas pobacom ldan 'das kyi 7yon tan de lta bu brjod pa 'di thos nas 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ni 8bcom ldan 'das de'i nyan thos su zad na 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che 9zhing 'di ltar mthu che la 'di ltar dbang che bar grags na/ bcom ldan 'das thog ma btsas pa nyid kyi tshe sa chen po 'di rnam khopa drug tu g.yos/ rab tu g.yos/’ kun tu rab tu logayos/ 'gul rab tu 'gul/ kun tu 1lharab tu 'gul/ ldeg rab tu ldeg /kun tu rab tu ldeg /chem chem rab tu chem chem/ kun tu rab tu ’ chem chem/ 'ur 'ur rab tu 'ur 'ur/ kun tu rab tu 'ur 'ur/pa 'khrugs rab tu la'akhrugs/ kun tu rab tu 'khrugs shing snang ba dpag tu med pa byung ba lta ci smos/ btsas ma thag tu sus kyang ma brten 7par sa la gom pa bdun bor ba dang / steng gi bar snang las tsho/5chu'i rgyun grang dro rnam pa 19gnyis byung ste/ de gnyis kyis khrus byas pa dang / de'i dī lha'i khri bzang po dbus gser las byas pa byung ba nyadang /steng gi bar ri 2snang las lha'i gdugs 2rnga yab dang bcas pa byubyung ba lta naci smos/btsas ma thag tu lha thams cad phyag 'tshal bar gyur pa sadang / gang gi tshe btsasal nas gang gi tshe mngon par byung ba de'i bar du nam yang 'khrul pa med pa/rtag tu dam bcas pa la brtan pa/ ji skad smras pa de ltar byed pa/ rtag tu rgyun mi gcod par brtson 'grus brtan pa snye/ yang dag par smra ba/ slu ba med pa lta ci smos/ gang gi tshe 9bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 42—25

mngon par rdzogs par 3 sangs rgyas te/ rgal —nas bsgral bar bya'o zhes smras pa lta ci smos sasnyam ste/ des de ltar bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpar gyur pa'i dam bcas pa de dran nas tshigs su bcad pa 4'di dag smras so/ /blo mchog ldan pa gang zhig bltam bum thag /nor ba med pa'i gsung ni brjod gcimadzad de/ /gang zhig la ni bden pa'i gsung mnga' ba/ /de la mkhas chub su zhig yid mi ches/ /gang zhig bltam par gyur ma thag nyid du/ /'jig rten gtso bor 'gyur bar 9bya'o zhes/ /mgon pos mnyam 7pa med pa'i gsung brjod pa / /de la mkhas papa su zhig yid mi ches/ /su zhig rmang palam rmi ba'i dus na yang / /brdzun chegyi tshig ni nam 5yang ma gsungs te/ /ji skad tregasungs pa de ltar 7mdzad mdzad pa/ /de la mkhas pa su zhig yid mi ches/ /gser gyi phung po gangs ri nyamanyam pa yis / /gang zhig chags par bya bar ma nus shing / /gang zhig chags las 2rnam par 'das gyur pa/ /de la mkhas 2pa su zhig yid mi ches/ /mtshon rnon 'dra ba'i ngag rtsub tshig rnams kyis/ /gang zhig khro bar bya bar ma 34nus shing / /zhe sdang dngos po las 5ni rab 'das pa/ /de la mkhas pa su zhig yid mi ches/ /chags par 'gyur tshodang zhe snang rmongs 'gyur bas / /gang zhig thul bar nus par ma gyur te/ /shes rab rgyal po dang ni ldan gyur pa/ /de la mkhas pa su zhig yid mi ches/ /'dod pa'i dga' dang bde rnams du ma dang / /longs spyod dag la rtog pa'i rnam pa yis/ /gang zhig bcing bar nus par ma gyur pa/ /de la mkhas pa su zhig yid mi ches/ /rmad du byung ba rnam pa brgyad dag gis/ /ngo mtshar /'dzin gzhug sngonam yang ma nus te / /dpalam stug ldan zhing rtagam tu mi ngam pa/ /de la mkhas pa su zhigs 42—26

yid mi ches/ /mkhas pa dag gis brjod pa'i tshig snyan pa/ /rnam pa sna tshogs du ma'i tshig gis 3 kyang / /gang zhig bcing bar nus par ma gyur pa/ /de la mkhas pa su zhig yid mi ches/ /don gyi tshul la brtson dang ldan pa dang / /chos dang 'dod la nges pa'i tshig rnams kyis/ /gang zhig bcing bar nus par ma gyur pa/ /de yi gsung la su zhig yid mi ches/ /dri ma 4med stobs 5 mtha' yas ldan gyur pa/ /gang zhig grong khyer mchog nenas 'byung ba'i tshe/ /dpung rnams kyis ni thub par ma gyur pa/ /de yi gsung la su zhig yid mi ches/ /byang chub dam pa mngon par bzhed pa'i phyir/ /gang zhig 'dod pa'i bde ba spangs nas su/ /'chi med rgyu phyir ri dgas spyod mdzad pa/ /de yi gsung la su zhig yid mi ches/ /byang chub dam pa mngon par bzhed pa'i 9phyir/ /zhen 7pa ma yin sems can gang zhig gis/ /lo drug bar du dka' thub drag spyad pa//de yi gsung la su zhig yid mi ches/ /'jig rten la ni phan dang bde ba'i phyir/ /byang chub dam pa don du gnyer ba na/ /lo drug lon pa'i tha mar tshod khu skugasol / /de yi gsung la su zhig yid mi ches/ / gang la lo drug bar du bdud kyis ni/ /rtag tu phyi bzhin 'brengs te glags btsal kyang / /de la glags ni rnyed par ma gyur pa/ /de yi gsung la su zhig yid mi ches/ /12gang zhig 'dod chags zhe snang bral gyur cing / /su la cung 5zad tsam yang mi slong la/ /'jig rten dag gi don ni mdzad gyur pa/ /de yi gsung la su zhig yid mi ches/ /gang zhig gzhan la gsan pa skum mdzad par/ /rtogs par dka' 7ba rab tu zhi ba yi/ /byang chub bla med mngon 7rdzogs sangs rgyas pa / /de yi gsung la su zhig yid mi ches/ /gang zhig tshangs pa nyid kyis gsol btab pas 9/ /42—27

bcom ldan 'das kyis 3de yi tshig gsan te/ /nyid kyis chos ni rab tu bshad pa na/ /de yi gsung la su zhig yid mi ches/ /gang zhig bdag la thugs brtse don gyi phyir/ /shākya'i grong khyer 2khyim du byon gyur te/ /shākya'i tshogs rnams grol bar mdzad pa na/ /de yi gsung la su zhig yid mi ches/ /rgal ribar gyur pa'i bcom ldan 'das gang gis/ /sngon gyi thugs dam bcas pa cadagongs mdzad de/ /bdag cag srid pa'i rgyun las /sgrol mdzad na / /de yi gsung la su zhig yid mi ches/ /de dus da bab ༄ tshode ltar dus mkhyen pas/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de yi dus mkhyen te/ /'dren sepa dus su thugs brtse mdzad pa potho/ /de yi gsung la su zhig yid mi ches/ /mi yi 'dren 7pa yi ni sku mchog la/ /blta ’ ba'i don du bdag ni 'gro bya zhes/ /rgyal po des ni rang gi sems kyis su / /de snyam du ni rjes su bsam pa /2byas/ /de nas 2rgyal po zas gtsang mas de ltar ring zhig tu sgorjes su bsams tshanas/ tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la smras pa / dge slong khyod la ci zhig dgos/ de skad ces smras pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas rgyal po zas gtsang ma sngu gyel tshigs su bcad de slar sna smras pa/rgyal po khyod kyi don du bsam /8byas te/ /khyod nyid dad par bya phyir bdag 'dir 'ongs/ /stobs bcu mnga' la dad pa'i sems bskyed na/ /skyes pa 33 bud med dag kyang mtho ris 'dong / /stobs bcu mnga' zhings yon tan tshad med ldan/ /drang srong chen po shākya dga' mdzad pa/ /'dir byon 3 rgyal po thugs dad skyed cig dang / /khyod kyi grags pa tshad med 'jig rten 'byung / /khyod kyi sras ni mi dbang dam pa ste/ /stobs bcu thugs rje thugs brtse che mnga' ba / /chu khrod pad ma ji bzhin chags med par 2/ /stobs bcu chags med 42—28

thugs mnga' spyod pa mdzad/ /srid pa'i chu bo bzhi las rgal 1gyur nas/ /'gro ba mang po chu bo che las sgrol/ /rkang gnyis gtso (bo mi 'jigs thang 'don gyisal / /'dren pa mi mchog la ni dad pa skyed/ /srid pa'i zug rngu bzhi po kun bton te / /sman pa'i gtso bo skye dgu'i 5zug rngu 'byin / / gso ba byed 7pa mkhas pa dam pa'i mchog /'dren pa mi mchog la ni dad pa skyed / /bdud kyi sde chen dpag med pham mdzad de/ /nag po'i phyogs rnams sder bcas yongs 9mnan nas/ /mchog tu zhi ba'i byang chub brnyes gyur gyis / /'dren pa mi mchog la ni dad pa skyed/ /'gro ba dgrol 11zhing chos kyang pabastan pa dang / /'chi med zhi ba mi la :snyebashad gsol zhes / /mi dbang la ni lha dbang gsol 'debs kyisam/ /'dren pa mi mchog la ni dad pa skyed/ /pas kyi sargol ba'i tshogs rnams zil mnan te/ /ston pa dpag yas 'khor lo rab bskor nas/ /sems can bye ba tshad med 'dul 7mdzad kyis snye/ /'dren pa mi mchog la ni dad pa skyed/ /rnam dag spyan mnga' de ni 'gro ba dag /mun pa rab rib stug pos bsgribs /pa yi/ / mig sbyongs rab rib sel cing gsal mdzad kyis 1/ /'dren pa mi mchog la ni dad pa skyed/ /rga dang 'chi ba'i 'jigs pas 2nyon mongs la/ /rgas shi med mchog mi la ston mdzad cing / /'chi med gnas su sems can 'donasalamadzad kyis ge/ /'dren pa mi mchog la ni dad pa skyed/ /me chen gsum gyis bsregs pa'i 'jig rten 'di/ /mes tshig sa la sprin chen char pa bzhin/ /bzhing gnyis dam pa'i sprin gyis char 'bebs kyis snye/ /'dren pa mi mchog la ni dad pa skyed/ /dri gsum dri ma spangs shing skyon bsal 0te/ /dri ma gsum las skye bo 'grolas mdzad cing / ti stobs bcu rnam par snang ba skyedang 42—29

mdzad kyis1/ /'dren pa mi mchog la ni dad pa skyed/ /skye dgu — kun la pha bzhin thugs brtse bas/ /stobs bcu thugs rje mnga' ba byams par dgongs/ /thugs rje thugs brtses sems can 'grol ngamadzad kyis / /'dren pa mi mchog la ni dad pa skyed/ /bcom ldan 0de ni ma dul sems can 'dul/ /thugs rje mnga' ba ma zhi zhi mdzad cing / /rgod pa rnams kyang tshiston mongs zhi mdzad kyis ske/ /'dren pa mi mchog la ni dad pa skyed/ /skye bo rnams kyi /srid pa'i rgya mtsho skems / /rgya mtsho las ni lha bus 11ji lta bar/ /stobs bcu thugs rje che mnga' sgrol mdzad kyisapa/ /'dren pa mi mchog la ni dad pa skyed/ /tshad med yon tan ritshogs kyis mdzes 'gyur pa/ /thugs rje chen po dad pa'i skuthugs kyis spyod/ /yun ring la'akhrugs pa'i skye bo dad mdzad kyis / /'dren pa mi mchog la ni dad pa skyed/ /nor bu rin chen chu dang ’ byed pa bzhin/ / rgyal ba skye bo dang bar spyod mdzad cing / /mi yi 'thab rnyog rab tu dang mdzad kyis/ /'dren pa mi mchog la ni dad pa skyed/ /nor bu rin chen rang bzhin yongs dag pa / /mkhas pa'i skye bo dga' ba yongs su skyed/ ///rgyal ba de bzhin skyon bsal dag pa'i thugs/ /mkhas pa'i skye bo dga' ba yongs su skyed/ /'jig rten gtso la dad pa thob gyur na/ /lha dang mi dag sdug bsngal khur yang 'dor/ /srid pa'i rgyud spangs zhi ba mchog tu 'dod/ /'dren pa mi mchog la ni dad pa skyed / /bdag gis nyayon tan phyogs gcig brjod pa ni/ /nam mkha'i dbyings la mkha' lding rjes bzhin te/ /bdag ni rgyal ba'i 2yon tan mthar phyin min/ /'dren pa mi mchog la ni dad pa skyed/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang mas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka las 2legs par bshad pa yang thos 4 bcom 42—30

ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' 1mdzad pa'i yon tan de lta bu yang nyid kyis mngon du mthong / sngon bdag rgal nas skyes bu khyu mchog khyod kyang bsgral bar bgyi'o / /zhes dam bcas pa yang rjes su dran nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das la dad pa thob par gyur to/ /de ltar dad pa thob pa'i sems kyis tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la 'di skad ces smras so/ /dge slong khyod ni nga'i bu'i chos las ciskyes pa'i bu yin na/ khyod bdag zan zo la bcom ldan 'das kyi bshos khyer te song shig /nga yang bcom ldan 'das la blta sgruba'i phyir phyi bzhin 'ong ngo /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'char gas de ltar rgyal po zas gtsang ma mngon par dad par byas nas zan zos te bcom ldan 'das kyi phyobashos khyer nas song ngo / /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rgyal po zas gtsang ma ni dge slong 'char gas dad par byas te / deng naskye bo phal po che'i 9don du 'gyur ro/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka bcom ldan 'das kyi ོbshos khyer te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song nas bdag gis byas pa rnams bcom ldan 'das la gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka la legs so zhes bya ba tshaganang ste/ 'char ka legs so legs so / /de ring rgyal po zas gtsang ma dad par byas pas khyod kyis bsod nams snyemang du bskyed do/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de ring dge slong 'char mas rgyal po zas gtsang ma mngon par dad par byas pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po bskyed pa de la/ gal te gzugs shig yod na ni phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i 6klung gi bye ma snyed /dkyi 'jig rten gyi 7khams su yang bsod nams kyi phung po de mi shong ste/42—31

bsod nams kyi phung po de ni de tsam du nyadapag tu med do// //ribam po gnyis pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das bshos gsol nas phyag bcabs lhung bzed cabakrus te/ mtshan ma'i rnam pa 'di lta bu mdzad do/ /mtshan ma'i rnam pa de lta bu 5mdzad pas rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu gnod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gis 7yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar nas 'di lta ste/ dper na skyes bu stobs dang ldan pas lag pa bskum 7pa las brkyang pa'am/ brkyang pa las bskum pa tsam gyis rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu rang gi gnas nas mi snang bar gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug par gyurwa te / des 9bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas byang phyogs su brten te/ steng gi bar snang la sngaganod sbyin gyi tshogs kyis bskor nas thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la mchod cing 'dug par gyur to/ /rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung nya yang dri za bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar nas snga tsham bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug par gyur te/rte/ des bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas shar phyogs logs su brten skate/ steng gi bar snang la dri za'i tshogs kyis bskor nas thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la mchod cing 'dug par gyur tos/ /rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po yang grul bum bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas yongs su bskor cing mdun du bdar nas snga ma bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug par gyur te / des sna bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas lho phyogs logs su brten te rte/ steng gi bar snang la grul bum gyi tshogs kyis 42—32

bskor nas thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la mchod cing 'dug par gyur to/ /rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang yang klu bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas yongs su bskor 1cing / mdun du bdar nas snga ma bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug par gyur te/ des ribacom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas nub phyogs logs /su brten gi te/steng gi bar snang la klu'i tshogs kyis bskor nas thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das dang zhedage slong gi dge 'dun la mchod cing 'dug par gyur to/ /lha'i dbang po brgya byin yang sum cu rtsa gsum ris kyi lha'i bu bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas yongs su bskor cing snyomadun du bdar nas 7snga ma bzhin du steng gi bar snang la thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das dang dge slong 9gi dge 'dun la mchod cing 'dug par gyur to7/ /de bzhin du lha'i rgyal po rab ① 'thab bral dang / yongs su tshadaga' ldan dang / rab 'phrul dga' dang / lha'i rgyal tshapo gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang / mi mjed ngakyi bdag po tshangs pa dang /lha'i rgyal po pa'od gsal dang / dge rgyas dang / 'bras bu che tshadang /gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu rnams kyang gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i 7ris nas mi snang bar gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khod par gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyi snyezhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ steng gi bar snang la re re zhing yang g.yog lha'i bu bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la mchod cing 'dug par gyur to/ /lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags zangs 9ris kyang lha ma yin khrag khrig phrag drug cu dang lhan cig tu 'di lta ste/ dper na skyes bu stobs dang ldan pa'i lag pa 42—33

bskum pa las brkyang ba'am/ brkyang ba las bskum pa tsam gyis lha ma yin gyi 1dbang po thags rngazangs ris lha ma yin gyi gnas nas mi snang bar gyur te/bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug tsho par gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la mchod cing 'dug byupar gyur to/ /bya'i rgyal po 'dab bzangs sgrubargyad khri drug stong yang rang rang gi gnas nas phyomi snang bar gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khod par gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la mchod cing 'dug par gyur to/ /gzhan mu stegs can kun tu rgyu rgyal po'i khams tha dad pa nas lhags pa bye ba phrag brgyad cu yang 'dus par gyur to/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ nam mkha' yongs su dag pa'i dbyings dkyil 9du/ /ma lus rdzogs gyur zla ba nya ba yis/ /skar ma'i tshogs rnams zil gyis mnan nas ni/ /nam mkhar 7zla ba bzhin du rnam par mdzes/ /zla ba dri med dkyil 'khor zhal mnga' ba/ /mun pa rab rib sel cing dri gsum 'joms 7/ /rtog ge can tshogs zil gyis mnan nas ni/ /mkha' la skar ma'i bdag po dibazhin du mdzes / /nyi ma 2'od zer —brgya yi lus 'dzin dpa/ /ston gyi dus na mun sel rnam mdzes shing / /lha min tshogs rnams zil gyis mnan nas ni / /nyi ma de ni pad ma'i 7kha yang 'byed/ /nyi ma'i /'od zer brgya 'dra'i sku mnga' bas/ /stong gsum po dag zil gyis mnan nas ni/ /mi yi nyi ma rnam par mdzes gyur cing —/ /nyan thos pad ma'i tshal mchog kha yang 'byed/ /lha yi rgyal po dbang po brgya byin ni/ /mdun ci rtesar lha yi tshogs kyis yongs bskor ba/ /lha yi 'khor 42—34

rnams zil gyis rimanan nas ni/ /bde sogs khyim thab sbyin ldan rnam par mdzes / /rkang gnyis dbang po dpal stug stobs bcu yang / /dge sbyong tshogs kyis mdun bdar stong gsum na / /rtog ge'i 5tshogs rnams zil gyis mnan nas ni/ /dge sbyong tshogs kyi dbus na rnam par mdzes/ /lha yi dbang dzipo 'thabartso bral dbang byed pa / /'thab 9bral bzang po lhas mchod btsun 7byas pa/ /'thab ’ bral bzang po lha tshogs nang zhugs lote/ /'thab : bral rnams kyi nang na 'dug pa mdzes/ /gzi 7brjid mtha' yas stobs bcu mnga' ba yang / /lam ngan ngan 'gror 'dong ba gzil mnan nas/ /yan lag brgyad pa rab tu ston lamadzad cing / /stobs bcu yon tan 7rnams kyis rab tu mdzes / /lha yi rgyal po yongs su dga' ldan de/ /dga' ldan gnas na lha yi tshogs ha kyis bskor/ /lha tshogs mang po zil gyis mnan nas ni/ /sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa 19bas rab tu mdzes/ /de bzhin lha dang lha min bla ma yang / /lha dang lha min tshogs kyis bla mar byas/ /'khor brgyad po dag zil gyis mnan nas ni//skyes bu seng ge dam pa 'jig rten mdzes/ /lha yi dbang po bdag po rab 'phrul ni/ /lha tshogs mang po zil gyis mnan nas su/ /rang gi bsod nams mthu yis lha gnas na/ /gnas shing de ni rab tu rnam par mdzes/ /de bzhin nyon mongs rnams las rnam grol zhing / /stobs bcu rimanga' ba nyon mongs bral ba po/ /ma dul 'dul mdzad 'dul ba'i rgyal po yang / /skye bo zil gyis mnan nas rnam par mdzes/ /lha yi rgyal po dbang sgyur byed pa ni/ /lha 5gnas 'dug cing lha tshogs sazil mnan te/ /sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i gzi brjid kyis/ /rnam par mdzes par gyur pa ji bzhin du/ /de ltar rgyal ba (42—35

stobs bcu'i spyod pa dag /sngon chad spyad pas lha mi nyu)zil mnan te/ /sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i gzi brjid kyis/ /rgyal po mede ni rab tu rnam par mdzes/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten na ni tshangs pa yang / /tshangs pa'i 'khor rnams rang gis rizil mnan te/ /shin tu snyan pa yan lag brgyad ldan dag /yongs su rjod par byed 4cing mngon du mdzes3/ /de ltar rgyal ba tshangs pa 'drar gyur pa / /dge sbyong rgyal po dge sbyong tshogs rnams kyis/ /mdun ne du bdar te bden pa'i gtam gsung zhing le/ /'jig rten gsum po dag na tshomimangon par mdzes ske/ /nyan par 'dod pa tshalha dang mi rnams dang /7/ /lto 'phye mchen po dag ni 'dus tshamakhyen nas/ /skyes bu khyu mchog yan lag brgyad ldan gyi / /gsung rnams kyis ni rab tu ston par tshamadzad/ /bya lam nam mkha' dpag par nus kyang srid/ / rgya mtsho bum pas gzhal du rung yang srid/ /7ri rab srang brgyar gzhal 〉du rung yang srid/ /sangs rgyas yon tan mtha' rtogs mi nus so / /rgyal po mngon par dad par byas pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'char ka song nas ring po ma lon par rgyal po zas gtsang mas shākya rnams la bsgo ba/ grogs po dag 'di lta ste/ dper na nyi ma 'char ba'i snga ltas 9ni gangs 'di dmar ring 2 'char ba'o/ /dmar ring ༷ 1shar na nyi ma 'char bar shes so/ /grogs po dgam de bzhin du du srudage slong 'char da ka yang bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa'i snga ltas yin te/ dge slong 'char gas yon tan gang brjod pa de dag ni nges par thams cad mkhyen pa'i yon tan yin no/ /grogs po dag de lta bas na bzhon pa'i mchog rnams stod de sta gon 42—36

gyis shig / de ci'i 1phyir zhe na de ring kho na bdag cag bcom ldan 'das mchog tu blta na sdug pa de lta 5zhing 'dong ngo / /lha legs so zhes gsol nas shākya rnams kyis rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i ltar mnyan te/ theg pa'i mchog rnams myur du bstad 5do/ /de'i tshe rgyal po zas gtsang mas ser skya'i phyoganas dang /n+ya gro dha'i ri tshokun dga' ra ba'i bar de nadag thams cad rgyal po'i rtegashegs shul du mnyam par byed du bcug cing bye ma gtsang ma bdal du bcug 7ste/ nyams dga' ba dang / me tog sil mas gang ba dang / dar gyi lda ldi dang / phreng ba mang pos brgyan /1te/ skabs skabs su gar mkhan dang / glu mkhan dang /gyad dang / bum rnga thogs pa dang / sil snyan dang / rol mo dang / glu'i cha spyad tshadang / yo byad thams cad /thogs pa dag bkod 7par gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang ma bzhon cipa'i mchog dang chas 7pa rnams dang /bdag nyid kyang bzhon pa'i mchog la zhon te/ ser skya'i 7gnas kyi grong khyer chen po nas 13byung nas n+ya gro dha'i 9kun dga' ra ba ga la ba der song ngo / /de'i tshe shākya la la'i bzhonam pa'i mchog ni rnam pa 'di lta bu 2ste/ 'di ltar shing rta dag kyang thams cad 2 sngo la rta sngon po rnams kyis drangs shing / rgyan rnyarnams kyang sngo la dril bu g.yer ga'i dra bas brgyan pa/ 'khor rgyanang sngon po can gyis bskor ba/ gdugs dang / ral gri sadang / thod 2 dang / nor bu can gyi rngam yab dang / lham rgyan can sngon po dang ldan pa/ kha tshar 0ma bcad pa'i ras sngon pos gyon zhings rgyan sngon po thogasam pa'i zhal ta ba rnams zhal ta byed pa/ rgyanas sngon po can gyi lcag thogs pasacadang / khrid pa du ma dang ldan pa/rgyal mtshanam sngon po bsgreng ba sha stag ste/ shing rta re re zhing yang rgyan sngon po 42—37

can gyi mi brgya phrag re res bskor bar gyur to/ /shākya la la'i bzhon pa —1rnam pa 'di lta bu ste/ 'di ltar shing rta dag kyang thams 5cad du ser ba nas thams cad du dmar ba dang / thams cad du dkar ba dang / thams cad du bkra lab dang / shing rta re re zhing yang rgyan khra bo can gyi mi brgya phrag re res bskor ba'i bar du snga ma bzhin no/ /shing rta de dag re re'i 5phyi bzhin du yang glang po che brgyad khri gser gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ gser gyi rgyal tshimatshan can/ gser gyi dra bas g.yogs pa sha stag bshams te / glang po che brgyad khri po de dag gi nasteng du rin po che sna bdun gyi khang ba brtsegs pa bkra ba/ blta na sdug pa brgyad 9khri bzhag nas 'dong bar gyur to/ /glang po che 7brgyad khri po de dag gi phyi bzhin rta gser gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ gser gyi dril bu g.yer ka dbargyus pa/ rin po che sna bdun gyi rgyan dang ldan pa brgyad khri bshams te 'dong bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po zas gtsang ma dang / shākya rnams rgyang ring po snyenas 'ong ba gzigs nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag khyed gang dag gis sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha skyed mos tshal du 'dong ba ma mthong ba mude dag gis shākya ser skya'i gnas nas 'ong ba 'di dag la ltos shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge slong dag shākya rnams ser skya'i dganas nas byung lab de dag ni ’ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha skyed mos tshal snyedu 'dong ba dang rjes su 'thun pa'o 9//de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ ser skya zhes bya'i grong khyer dam pa nas ha/ /rgyal po zas gtsang mi yi 2khyu mchog de 2/ /'khor dang bcas te ji ltar 'ong rugyur pa / /de ltar bstan gyis khyed rnams 5de nyon cig /shing rta brgya stong mchog dang bcas pa dag /legs par brgyan gcing mdzes par spras nas ni/ /ser 42—38

skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer dam pa nas/ /mi yi dbang po dam pa byung bar gyur1/ /shing rta sngo zhing rgyan kyang sngo ba dang / /rta yang sngo zhing sngo ba'i 'khor dang bcas / /mtshan ma lnga po dag kyang sngo ba ste/ /de bzhin gos kyi dam pa dag kyang sngo/ /lcag kyang sngo zhing thag srad rnams kyang sngo/ /dril bu g.yer ku'i 4dra ba rnams dang bcas/ /mi rnams kyang ni 5sngon po'i gos can te/ /rgyal mtshan po sngon po bsgreng bas mdzes par byas/ /shing rta ser zhing rgyan kyang 7ser ba dang / /rta yang ser zhing ser po'i 'khor dang bcas/ /mtshan ma lnga po dag kyang na ser po ste/ /de bzhin gos kyi dam pa dag kyang ser/ /lcag 9kyang ser zhing thag srad rnams kyang ser/ /dril bu g.yer ku'i dra ba rnams dang bcas/ /mi rnams tsho/1kyang ni ser po'i gos can te/ /rgyal mtshan dziser po bsgreng bas mdzes par byas/ /shing rta dmar zhing rgyan kyang dmar ba dang / /rta yang dmar zhing dmar po'i 'khor dang bcas/ /mtshan ma lnga po dag kyang dmar po ste / /de bzhin gos kyi dam pa dag ha kyang dmar/ /lcag 7kyang dmar zhing thag srad rnams 7kyang dmar/ /dril bu g.yer ku'i skodra ba 7rnams dang bcas/ /mi rnams kyang ni dmar po'i gos can te/ rgyal mtshan dmar po bsgreng 9bas mdzes par byas/ /shing rta dkar zhing rgyan kyang dkar ba dang / /rta yang dkar zhing dkar po'i 'khor dang bcas/ /mtshan ma lnga po dag kyang dkar po ste / /de bzhin gos kyi dam pa dag kyang dkar/ /lcag kyang dkar zhing thag srad rnams kyang dkar/ /dril bu g.yer ma'i dra ba 2 rnams dang bcas/ /mi rnams kyang nim dkar po'i gos can te snye/ /rgyal mtshan dkar po bsgreng bas mdzes par byas/ /shing rta bkra 5zhing rgyan kyang bkra lab dang / /rta yang bkra :42—39

zhing bkra ba'i /'khor dang bcas/ /mtshan ma lnga po dag kyang bkra 3ba ste/ /de bzhin gos kyi be dam pa dag kyang bkra / /lcag 55kyang bkra zhi zhing thag srad rnams kyang bkra / /dril bu g.yer ku'i dra ba rnams dang bcas/ /mi rnams kyang ni bkra 8ba'i gos can te/ /rgyal mtshan ṇi khra bo bsgreng bas mdzes par byas / /shing rta de dag tsharnams kyi phyi bzhin du/ /glang po brgyad khri tsho/1tshang bar ⑫bshams pa nisko/ /gser gyi rgyal mtshan 8rnams kyis legs par brgyan/ /glang chen rnams ni pagaser gyis tshal 7par brgyan/ /de dag steng du rin chen sna bdun gyi/ /khang pa brtsegs pa dag ni bzhag stunas su/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan pa yi/ /shing rta rnams kyi :5phyi bzhin :/'brang bar bshams/ /de bzhin rta mchog stong phrag brgyad cu yang / /rin chen sna bdun rgyan gyis dga' bar brgyan/ /rgyal po'i chas gosam rgyal po 'cham stabs ri 2can/ /glang po de 2snyedag rnams nim phyi bzhin 'brang 25/ /rab tu dri zhim kha dog lnga pa yi/ /me tog sil sam rgyal po'i lam du bkram/ /dar gyi lda ldi dag kyang rab tu bres/ /bdug spos snod rnams kyis ni legs par brgyan/ /glu mkhan gar mkhan rnams dang gyad rnams dang / /bum rnga thogs pa rnams kyis mdzes byu /par byas/ /rol mo rnam pa sna tshogs byed pa yang phyo/ /rab tu dga' zhing rgyal po'i phyi bzhin 'brang —/ /rgyal po gshegs pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas rgyal po zas gtsang ma dang / shākya rnams rta babs sa'i bar du bzhon pa dang dong ste phyin nas bzhon pa lasang babs te/ rkang thangs gi 'khor gyis yongs su 2bskor cing 8 mdun du bdar 4te n+ya gro dha'i cigakun dga' phyor 42wa 40

bar dong ngo 33/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po zas gtsang ma nga rgyal che bar mkhyen nas mi gang 2lhag tsam gyi steng gi bar snang gi nam mkha' la rgyal po zas gtsang ma rimangon par dad par bya sgruba'i phyir 'chag cing bzhugs par gyur to / /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das de ltar 'chag phyopa'i 7g.yas phyogs nas mi mjed 2kyi bdag po tshangs pa zhabs 9'bring du 'chag 7cing : 'gro'o/ /g.yon phyogs nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin zhabs sna 'bring du 'chag cing 'gro'o/ /de ltar bcom ldan 'das 'chag : pa'i zhabs 1 'bring du lha'i rgyal po rab 'thab bobral dang / yongs su tshadaga' ldan dang / rab 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rnams bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa 7bya ba'i phyir gdugs 'dzin cing bsil nya yab kyis g.yob par gyur to/ /rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu dang / yul 'khor srung gnyis kyang bcom ldan 'das 'chag pa'i shar phyogs logs kyi thog ma la ( /bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga'atshamad nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de / bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal zhing 'khod par gyur to/ /rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po dang / mig mi bzang gnyis kyang bcom ldan 'das 'chag pa'i nub phyogs logs kyi 2thog ma la 2bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar 24te/pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga smad nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal zhing 'khod par gyur to/ /de'i tshe rgyal05chen stobazhi'i ris kyi 2 lha'i bu rnams dang / sum cu rtsa gsum dang /'thab bral dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i bu rnams kyang bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa 8bya ba'i phyir 42—41

steng gi bar snang la gnas te/ lha'i me tog ud pa la dang / pad ma dang /ku mu da medang / pad ma dkar po ridang / lha'i man dā ra ba dang / man dā ra ba chen po dang / lha'i spos kyi phye ma rab tu 'thor bar gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa 5bya ba'i phyir lha'i rol mo tsisil snyan dang / glu dbyangs dag kyang steng gi bar snang las 4sgra 'byin par gyur to/ /mi'i nalas 'das pa'i glu'i nga ro yang steng gi 9bar snang las byung bar gyur to/ /sprin las spos kyi char zam zim yang 'bab par 7gyur to/ /lha'i me tog ud pa :nyal dang /lha'i tsan dan gyi phye ma'i char yang bab dpar gyur to/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam pa gang mngon par mdzad pas lha dang mi rnams kyang 1 gcig gis gcig mthong bar 'gyur ba 7de lta bu'i brdzu 'phrul mngon par samadzad do/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang mas lha de dag bcom ldan 'das 7la mchod pa /byed pa yang mthong / lha'i rin po che sna bdun gyi rgyu las grub pa'i 19khang pa brtsegs pas kyang bar snang rtogang bar mthong nas de 'di snyam du sems te / ji tsam du bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par gsungs pa de 22ni ngo mtshar che ste snye/ sngon bcom ldan 'das gzhon nur gyur pa'i tshe 'di skad du nga la ni gling chen po bzhi'i dbang phyug la dbang bar 'gyur ba ngo mtshar mi che ste/ ngas ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su lha dang mi'i nang du chos kyi dbang phyug la dbang bar bya'o zhes gsungs na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 5chos kyi dbang phyug la dbang ba de ni 'di 4yin pa lta ste/ bdag ni mi'i 'khor can du zad/ bcom ldan 'das ni lha dang mi'i 'khor can du gyur to snyam mo/ /de nas rgyal po zas gtsang mas /bla gos phyogs gcig tu bgos te/ pus mo g.yas 42—42

pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la spyi 1bos phyag 'tshal te tshig 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das bltam ma thag tu sus kyang ma brten par sa rduchen po la gom pa bdun bzhud de/ phyogs bzhir gzigs nas gsung brjod pa/ nga ni 'jig rten na mchog /nga ni 'jig rten na gtso bo /nga ni 'jig rten na rab ste/ ngas skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang /sgru'achi ba mthar dbyung ngo zhes gsungs pa de'i tshe yang bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos gtugs te yiphyag bgyis so/ /gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das zhing pa'i grong du bzhud 7nas 'dzam bu'i nagrib ma bsil ba la bzhugs pa'i tshe nyi ma yol yang 'dzam bu'i /grib mas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku sna ma btang ste/ lha'i bu gzhon nu drug thal mo sbyar nas phyag 'tshal zhing 'khod par gyur pa de'i tshe yang bdag gis bcom ldan 'das la phyag bgyis so/ /da yang bcom ldan 'das la 'di dang lan gsum du phyag 'tshal lo zhes smras nas de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag kyang 1 smras so/ /gang tshe rkang gnyis gtso bo khyod bltams tshanas/ /sa chen 'di la gom pa bdun bzhud de/ /nga ni 'jig rten na ni rmo mchog ces gsungs/ /de tshe mkhas pa khyod la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /gang tshe thub chen zhing pa'i grong bzhud tshe'i/ / 'dzam bu'i 'grib mas bzhugs pa ma btang zhing / /lha bu gzhon sanu drug gis btud gyur pa/ /de tshe mchod 'os khyod la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /nga 7yang 'di dang khyod la lan gsum du/ /thub pa khyod kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje 1 che mnga' lha mis mchod pa gtso / /khyod 'dra 'jig rten ma mchis lhag ci smos/ /mtshan ni don grub lags zhes 9sngon brjod pa/ /pha dang ma yis bsams te /btags pa lags/ /42—43

khyod kyi /bsam rdzogs bdud rtsi brnyes pas na/ /don grub lagasalgepar bdag gis da gdod ga'atshal/ /de nas 'dod pa 'chin spyod pa'i lha rnams kyis de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi seng ge'i khri lha'i 7yid bzhin gyi ras bcos bu0bting ba rnam 9pa sna tshogs su spel ba bshams so/ /thams cad dang ldan pa'i n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ’ ra bar yang lha'i yid bzhin gyi ras bcos bus 37yog par bting 8ngo dzha/ /steng du yang skulha'i yid bzhin 7gyi ras bcos bu'i bla res rnyibres so/ / de nas 7bcom ldan 'das bar snang gi 'chag sa de nas babs te/ gdan khri bshams pa la bzhugs so/ ///rgyal po zas gtsang ma yang 'khor dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos / phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha rnams dang gzugs na spyod pa'i lha rnams kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te bar snang la 'khod par gyur to/ /'di la 'di ni chos nyid yin te de la 'di skad ces bya'o/ /ser skya nya zhes bya grong khyer dam pa yi/ /n+ya gro dha yis ra ba nyams dga' bar/ /rgyal po zas gtsang de dang gang gi tshe/ /'jig rten mgon po phrad pa de yi tshe/ /skye bo mang po dag ni 'dus gyur te/ /lha ma yin dang mkha' lding dbang po dang / /klu tshogs rnams dang de bzhin grul bum dang / /dri za'i stergyal po rnams kyang 'dus par gyur/ /de bzhin gsang ba'i bdag po rnams 'dus te/ /mi 'am ci'i tshogs dang mi rnams dang / /de bzhin 'dod pa dag na spyod pa'i lha/ /rab tu dga' ba rnams kyang 'dus par gyur/ /de bzhin gzugs kyi khams su gtogs pa yi/ /tshangs pa rnams dang tshangs pa'i ris rnams dang / /'od gsal ba dang dge rgyas pa dag dang / /'bras bu che bar gtogs dang gnas 42—44

gtsang 'dus/ /dge sbyong dag dang de bzhin bram ze dang / /spyod pa can dang kun tu rgyu dag dang / /gcer bu pa dang mu stegs gzhan mang po/ /log lam rjes su 'brang ba rnams kyang 'dus/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyi gzi 1brjid dam pa yis/ /rgyal po chen po zas gtsang〈mide yi sems/ /yongs su smin par bya ba'i don gyi phyir/ /de yi tshe na 'dus pa chen por gyur/ /sngan chad bcom ldan 'das kyis legs bshad pa'i/ /tshig gis 'khor rnams yongs su tshim par mdzad/ /da ni rgyal ba rgyal po zas gtsang la/ /rgyal ba'i 5mthu ni rab tu bstan par bzhed47/ /bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po zas gtsang gis/ /gzhon nu khyod ni sa bdag chen po57yi/ /rgyal por 'gyuram zhes mkhas pas lung bstan gyisasti/ /khab nas ma byung shig77ces sngon gsol pa/ /gling bzhir dbang ba'i 'khor los sgyur ba ste/ /srog chags bye ba khrag khrig rnams kyis mchod/ /rin chen sna bdun dag dang ldan par nyi 'gyur/ /'byor ba bzhi po dang yang ldan par 'gyur/ /chos la gnas shing sa yang skyong ba ste/ /gling bzhi dbang bar rgyal rigs rgyal chen 8'gyur/ /mi yi bdag dang mi yi tshamachod par 'ong lto 'phye ches mchod 'gyur zhes gsol ba btab/ /de nas de mtshe byang chub sems dpa' des/ /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig dpag med nas/ /bdag ni rtag tu bdenas pa'i tshig smras kyis/rte/ /rgyal po bdag gi tshig la gson ces gsungs/ /'di ltar gling bzhi pa yi rgyal srid lha kyis/ /bdag la slu ba mdzad par bzhed pas na/ /de lta'i tshul las rgyal po chen po khyod/ /bdag la cung zad tsam yang thugs mi re/ /rgyal po chen po57sngon tshe byungs ba ni/ /rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyis rum sbal gcig cig 'phangs/ /rgya mtsho'i rlabs ni phyir log gyur pa dang / /42—45

ru 1sbal de ni khron pa'i nang du lhung 5/ /de la khron pa'i nang gi ru sasbal gyis/ /rgya mtsho'i ru casbal gang 5nas 'dir 'ongs kwa'ephyo/ /nga 7yi the tshom skyes pa bcad 1pa'i phyir/ /myur du nga la thos zhes de skad smras/ /khron pa'i nang gi ru t+t+waṃsbal de nyid la/ /rgya mcho'i ru ha sbal blo chen des smras pa/ /nga ni rgya mtsho'i rlabs 12kyis bkur bkur te/ / /khron pa 'dir ni de ring bor bar gyur / /rgya mtsho'i rlabs dachen de ni phyir log song / /nga ni slar log 'gro bar ma nus te / /nga ni rlabs dang 7bral bar gyur pas na/ /ru 7sbal khyod kyi 1 khron par gnas 'cha'o 9/ /de la khron pa'i nang gi ru 7sbal gyis/ /rgya mtsho de ni khron pa 'di tsam 'am / /'on te khron pa 'di bas che ba zhig /dris lan nga la myur du smros zhes smras/ /rgya mtsho'i ru 2sbal blo rgya chen snyepo des/ /khron pa'i ru du sbal de la tshig smras pa/ /khron pa'i ru 2 sbal khyod ni byis pa ste/ /blo rgya chung zhing shes pa rab tu zhan 0/ /nga ni lan tshwa can gyi chu der btsas/ /yun ring dus na de na skye skye yang / /rgya mtsho'i mtha' ma shes par ma 2snyenas na/ /dbus lta shes pa 0ga la nus zhes smras/ /de ltar mi yi bdag po khyod kyis kyang / /bdag gi mthu ni thugs su ma chud de/ /gling bzhi pa yi mchod pa rnams kyis ni/ /khyod kyis bdag la slu bas mdzad par bzhed nya/ /bdag ni chos can chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur/ /chad pas mi gcad mtshon chas bda'ang med par/ /stong gsum 'jig rten khams 'di bskyang b.ram bya/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i mchod pa thob par 'gyur/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs bsgoms pa yi bdag nyid can/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sngon tshig sbyang byubazhed nas/ /de phyir 'khor chen po ni de dag dang //sems can rnams la thugs kyis dgongs pa mdzad lha/ /rgyal po zas gtsang 42—46

sems ni mgu bya'i tsho phyir / /thugs kyis yongs su bskul ba mdzad pa dang / /'jig rten gsum po mtha' dag ma lus par/ /de yi tshe na der ni 'dus par gyur / /rgyal po 'dun par byas pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags zangs ris bcom ldan 'das la mchod par 7bya ba'i sems thog mar skye bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i mtshan ma mdzad nado/ /de nas lha ma yin gyi 9dbang po thags zangs ris lha ma yin lakhrag khrig phrag drug cu dang / lha ma yin gyi bu mo khrag khrig phrag drug cu dang nyabacas pas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa thog mar byas te/ de nas 7rgya mtsho chen po'i nang na rin po che'i rin thang ’ yod pa dang / rin thang —med pa ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad bcom ldan 'das la mchod par bya ba'i 'phyir phul lo/ /rin po che gzhan rgya mtsho chen po de na med pa dag kyang mngon par sprul pa byas te mchod par tshephul lo/ /rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin can gyi shing rta khrag khrig phrag 7drug cu yang mngon par sprul to/ /shing rta de dag re re zhing yang rta cang shes khrag khrig phrag drug cu drug cu 19mngon par sprul te / rta de dag kyang rin po che sna bdun gyi dril bu g.yer ma'i 21dra ba can la rkang 2lag gi 2rgyan gser las byas pa/ rin po che sna bdun gyis spras pa dang ldan pa/ rin po che sna bdun las 4byas pa'i 'phyar 'dab can lha/ gser gyi rgyan sagyis brgyan pa sha stag go/ /rta cang shes de dag gi rgyan du bya ba'i phyir rin po che sna bdun gyi bla re dag kyang mngon par sprul to0/ /shing rta de dag kyangang gser gyi rgyal mtshanam can gser gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa sha stag go/ /yid 42—47

bzhin gyi nor bu'i bla re de 1 dag kyang steng gi bar snang las shing rta de dag gi phyi bzhin du 'brang bar gyur 5te/ shing rta de dag 'dong na ni rjes su 'dong /shing rta de dag sdod na ni sdod pa sha stag go/ /yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i bla re de dag la yang mdzes par bya ba'i phyir rin po che sna bdun gyi phreng ba'i lda ldi mngon par spyangs sor/ /yid bzhin gye gyi nor bu'i bla re de sgyudag kyang ririn po che sna ‘bdun gyi dril bu g.yer ku'i dra ba dang ldan par mngon par 'isprul to/ /shing rta'i rgyan rta dang / rta'i rgyan dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i bla re'i 8rgyan de dag rlung : gis bskyod na sgra snyan cing yid du 'ong sgol mnyan na bde ba sha stag 'byung bar gyur gete/ 'di lta ste/ dper na rol mo sil snyan yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa lamakhas pas sgra phyung na sgra ’ snyan cing yid du 'ong ba dang / mnyan na bde bar sna 'byung ba de tsho bzhin du shing rta'i rgyanang de dag dang / rta'i rgyan nyade dag dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i bla re'i rgyan 2de dag rlung gis bskyod na sgra snyan cing yid du 'ong la mnyan na bde ba sha stag 'byung bar gyur to snye/ /shing rta de dag gi 'phang gis 2 kyang steng gi bar snang la dpag tshad drug cu bsgribs te 'khod par gyur to/ /shing rta de dag gi phyi bzhin snyeyang rol mo sil snyan sna tshogs rjes su 'brang bar gyur to/ /shing rta de dag thams cad la yang lha ma yin gyi bu mo rgyan stethams cad kyis brgyan pa dag 'khod des / /bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa snyebya ba'i phyir la la ni rol mo byed/ la la ni sil snyan dkro'akho/ la la ni glu len/ la la ni gar byed/ la la nine tsan dan dang ud pa la'i phye mas 'thor / la la ni a gang ru dang ta mas la'i lo ma'i phye mas 'thor/ la la ni lha ma yin gyi lhas rdzas kyi phye mas 'thor/ la la ni gser dngul gyi phye mas 'thor/42wa 48

la la ni man dā 3)ra ba dang / man dā ra ba chen po dang / man dzu ṣa ka dang ske/ man dzu ṣang ka chen po dang / pa 5ru ṣa 0ka dang / pa ru ṣa 7 ka chen po dang / mdog dkar dang / mdog dkar chen po dang / skya snar dang /skya snar chen po dang —/ skya snar khra bo dang / skya snar bkra chen gyi me tog mngon par sprul cing bcom ldan 'das la mngon par 'thor ro/ /la la ni gser gyi me tog dang / dngul gyi me tog dang / shel gyi me tog dang / be+e drur+ya'i tsho me tog dang / spug gi me tog dang / mu tig dmar po'i me tog dang / rdo'i snying po'i me togam gis mngon par 'thor ro / /la la ni rin po che sna bdun dang dbyig gis snyim pa bkang zhing bcom ldan 'das la mngon par 'thor ro/ /la la ni na bza' dang / rgyan 'bul lo/ /la la ni 7sku rags :snyedang /zhabs kyi rgyan ṣ+ṭhatshodang / phyag gi rgyan tshadang / sor gdub tshadang / gdu 7bu dang ske/ gdu bu tham pa dang /:snye dbu rgyan 17rtse gsum pa dang / dpung rgyan dang —/ cod pan dang / gser 2 skud 22dang / mu tig gi do shal dang /nor bu'i do shal dang / se 2mo do dang / gya byudo dang / mgul rgyan cig tshogs 'thor bar gyur to/ /la la ni tsong tsong gshibs sapa/ la la ni mgo rgyan / la la ni rna cha tsho snyegadub kor/ la la ni gser gyi phreng ba rin po ches spras pa / la la ni rin po che'i phreng ba gser gyis spras pa/ la la ni snyogaser gyi dra ba / la la ni gser gyi phreng ba dang /sa nor bu'i phreng ba dang / mu tig gi phreng ba thogasam tshoso/ /la la ni gser gyi gdugs dang / dngul gyi gdugs dang —/ be+e drur+ya'i gdugs dang / shel gyi gdugs dang / spug gi gdugs dang ske/ rdo'i snying po'i gdugs dang / mu tig dmar po'i gdugs dang /42wa 49

rin po che sna bdun gyi gdugs dang / rin po che'i rgyal mtshan 1sna tshogs tha dad pa dang / rin po che 5thams cad kyi ba dan kha dog sna tshogs dang /tshon sna tshogs can mang po thogasam so/ /la la ni 5spos chu'i char 'bebs shing 'khod par gyur to/ /la la ni bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad 0pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod ④par gyur to/ /mi mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi phul khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rkang gnyis gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod la do zla yong nam mchis/ /'jig rten gsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal dang ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon tan 9rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs sel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /7spyod dag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems dag 11khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnas pa mi mnga' zhum mi mnga'/ /le lo mi mnga' rgod mi mnga' /brtson 'grus brtsams shing rtul ba panyid/ /nges par rtogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin po che'i pho brang gi me rdal blta na sdug pa/ mdzes 〉pa/ rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin can khrag khrig phrag drus cu drug cu tshayang mngon par sprul tel / rin po che'i pho brang gi rdal de dag re re zhing yang bzhugs sa khrag khrig phrag drug cu drug cu yang :snyemangon par sprul to rte/ /bzhugs sa de dag re re zhing yang ba gam bkra ba/ blta na sdug 1pa/ rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin can brgya phrag drug cu drug cu mngon par sprul to/ /ba gam de dag re re la yang khang pa brtsegs pa bkra ba blta na sdug pa/ rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin can khrag khrig phrag nadrug cu drug cu mngon par sprul to/ /khang pa brtsegs pa de dag re re zhing yang lhakhyams bkra ba blta na sdug napa/ rin po che sna bdun gyi 42—50
