rang bzhin can khrag khrig phrag drug cu drug cu mngon par sprul to/ /de la gser gyi khyams rnams kyi gdung phyam 1ni dngul/ gral bu dang sgo 'phar ni be+e drur+ya/them pa dang kha khyer ni shel/ ka ba ni spug /ka zhu rini mu tig dmar po/sa gzhi ni rdo'i ri snying po'i rang bzhin can sha stag go/ /dngul gyi khyams rnams 5kyi gdung phyam ni gser/ gral bu dang sgo 'phar ni be+e drur+ya/ them pa dang kha phyokhyer ni shel/ ka ba ni spug /ka zhu ni mu tig dmar po / sa gzhi ni rdo'i snying po'i rang bzhin can sha stag go/ /be+e drur+ya'i khyams rnams 9kyi gdung phyam ni shel/ gral bu dang sgo 'phar ni gser/ them pa dang kha khyer ni dngul/ ka ba ni spug /ka zhu ni mu tig dmar po/ sa gzhi 7ni rdo'i snying po'i rang bzhin can sha stag go/ /shel gyi khyams rnams kyi 1gdung phyam ni be+e drur+ya/ gral bu dang sgo 'phar ni spug /them pa dang kha lokhyer ni rdo'i snying po ri/ ka ba ni gser/ka zhu ni dngul/ sa gzhi lani mu tig dmar thupo'i rang bzhin can sha stag go/ /spug gi khyams rnams kyi gdung phyam ni rdo'i snying po/ gral bu dang sgo 'phar ni mu tig dmar po/ them pa dang kha lakhyer ni gser/ ka ba ni dngul/ ka zhu ni shel / sa gzhi 7ni be+e drur+ya'i rang bzhin can sha stag go/ /mu tig dmar po'i khyams rnams kyi gdung phyam ni spug /gral bu dang sgo 'phar ni rdo'i snying po/them pa dang kha 18khyer ni dngul/ ka ba ni gser/ ka zhu ni be+e drur+ya/ sa gzhi 9ni ke ke ru'i rang bzhin can sha stag go/ /rdo'i snying po'i khyams rnams kyi gdung phyam ni mu tig dmar po/ gral bu dang sgo 'phar ni gser/ them pa dang kha khyer ni dngul/ ka ba ni be+e drur+ya/ ka zhu ni ke ke ru/ sa gzhi 2 ni shel gyi rang bzhin can sha stag go/ /khyams de dag tu yang seng ge'i khri rin po che sna 42—51

bdun gyi rang bzhin can 7lha ma yin gyi lha rdzas kyi gos sna tshogs bting ba/ ka tsa lin di'i nasteng g.yogs can/ mtha' gnyis su rten mim bzang po bkod pa khrag khrig phrag ngadrug cu drug cu mngon par sprul to/ /seng ge'i khri de dag gi rkang rten rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin can dag la paras bcos bu 6nisna tshogs 'di lta ste/ shing bal las byas patre /shin tu phra ba dang / srin bal lasams byas pa ḍashin tu phra ba dang / zar ma'i shun pa las byas pa 7shin tu phra ba dang / shun phrags me las byas pa shin tu phra ba dang / ka shi ka las byas pa shin tu phra ba bye tshab phrag drug cu drug cu bting bar gyur to/ /seng ge'i khri de dag skore re'i ngos gnyis su yang lha ma yin gyi bu mo rgyan 8thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i bsil yab thogs pa 8gnyis gnyis mngon par sprul te/seng ge'i khri de dag la lha ma 7yin gyi bu mo gzhon nu 'khod pa dag la g.yob bo/ /khyams de dag re re zhing yang rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i stugadugs khrag khrig phrag nya drug cu drug cu mngon par sprul to/ /khyams de dag re re zhing yang rin po che sna bdun gyi rgyal mtshan khrag khrig phrag 9drug cu drug cu mngon par sprul to / /de la gser gyi khyams rnams su ni rgyal mtshan sngon po la yu ba ser po shel gyis spras pa dag btsugs 3/ dngul gyi khyams rnams su ni rgyal mtshan ser po yu ba dmar po gser gyis spras pa dag btsugs tsā/ be+e drur+ya'i khyams rnams su ni rgyal mtshan dmar pos yu ba ser po shel gyis spras pa dag btsugs cu/ shel gyi khyams rnams su ni rgyal mtshan dkar po yu ba be+e drur+ya gser gyis spras pa dag btsugasaci / rin po che sna tshogs kyi khyams rnams su ni rgyal mtshan khra bo gser gyi yu ba be+e drur+yas spras pa dag btsugs0 so/ /de la rgyal mtshanam sngon po rnams 42—52

ni tog ser po rgyal mtshan ser po rnams ni tog /sngon po/ rgyal mtshan dmar po rnams ni tog dkar po/ rgyal mtshan dkar po rnams ni tog dmar po/rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan rnams ni tog rin po che sna bdun pa sha stag go//rin po che'i tsho —nopho brang gi rdal de dag bar snang gi nam mkha' la lding zhing bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum skor ba byed par gyur to/ /de 'di lta ste/ dper na sum cu rtsa gsum gyi pa lha rnams kyi glang po che sa 5sung gi bu ni bar snang gi nam mkha' las 'gro zhing sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams skyed mos tshal yongs 'du sa brtolatswadu nye bar 'jog go / /de bzhin du pho brang gi rdal de dag kyang bar snang gi nam mkha' la lding zhing bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum skor 9ba byed do//rin po che'i pho brang gi rdal de dag dang / ba gam de dag dang /tsha bzhugs sa de dag dang / khang pa brtsegs nyapa de dag dang / pakhyams de dag dang /seng ge'i khri de dag dang / gdugs de dag dang / rgyal mtshan 7de dag dang /ba dan de dag las lha'i tsan dan khudang / ud pa la dang / a ga ru'i 'phye ma'i char babamasapar gyur to/ /me tog man dā skor ba dang / man dā 18ra ba chen po dang / mdzi ṣa sna ka dang / mdzi ṣa 2 ka chen po dang / pa ru gtso ka dang ske/ pa ru ṣa02ka chen po dang / mdog dkar dang / mdog dkar chen po dang / skya snar dang / skya snar chen po dang / skya snar khra bo dang / skya snar bkra chen gyis char yang mngon par bab 24par gyur to/ /gser dang / dngul dang / bai drur+ya dang / shel dang / spug nadang / rdo'i snying po dang / mu tig dmar po dang / rin po che thams cad kyi me tog dang / dbyig dang /gser dang / yid bzhin gyi ras bcos bu'i 4char yang mngon par bab par 42—53

gyur to/ /yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i bla re 1de dag gi mthus lha ma yin gyi bu de dag rin po che gang dang gang gi char 'bab par 'dod pa de dang de dag las mngon par bab par gyur to/ /de'i tshe ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen po nas khor yug tu ni dpag tshad drug khri 'phang du yang dpag tshad drug khrir lha ma yin gyi mchod pa de lta bus rgyas par gang bar gyur to/ /rin po che'i pho brang gi rdal 4de dag gis kyang bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khod par gyur to/ /ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen po yang mi 'greng bdun tsam du me tog man dā par bas rgyas par gang bar gyur to/ /spos chus kyang rdzab 6tu gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi mthus stong gsum gyi 7stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyang spos chu'i rdzab kyi sedri des khyab par gyur to/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i sems can gang dag gis spos chu'i rdzab kyi dri de tshor ba de dag 9thams cad kyang 7bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur te/byang chub tu sems dang po bskyed pa dag ni smos kyang mi dgos so/ /de nas lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags zangs ris rin po che sna bdun gyi shing rta la zhon te lan gsum bskor ba byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das la tsan dan gyi phye mas mngon par gtor te/ tshigs su bcad pa dag gis mngon par bstod papa/ byang chub dam pa don du gnyer slad du/ /skyabs kyi skadam pa rab tu mi sgul cib/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten mi 'jigs stsol ba po/ /khyod la bdag ni skyabs su nye bar mchi/ /gang la dga' ba'i yid kyis skyabs song na'i/ /log ltung dag tu ltung bar mi 'gyur ba/ /de la bdag ni skyabs su nye bar mchi/ /dpe samed 42—54

byang chub 'tshal ba'i slad du'o/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dag ni bshig bcom zhing ske/ /mya ngan las rgal 1nyon mongs dag gyur la/ /'dren pa gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog pa / /khyod la bdag ni skyabs su nye bar mchi/ /rga dang 'chi bas nyen par 4gyur pa yi/ /lha dang mi rnams 'dren pa 5bcom ldan 'das/ /gang la skyabs song phyis kyang mi skye ba/ /khyod la bdag ni skyabs su nye bar mchi/ /de nas lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags zangs ris kyis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas pa'i tshe rta'i rgyan de dag dang / shing rta'i rgyan pode dag dang ske/ lha ma yin gyi rgyan 7de dag dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang /ba dan gyi rgyan de dag dang / bla re dang dril bu g.yer ku'i rgyan de dag rlung gis bskyod pa las /sgra snyan cing yid du 'ong la mnyan na dga' ba 'di lta bu dag byung labar gyur te/ 'di ltar :hadaper na rol mo sil snyan yan lag brgyad papa mkhas pas sgra phyung ba bzhin no/ /de ltar lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags zangs ris kyis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor rib byas pa'i tshe steng gi bar snang las 〉lha'i tsan dan dang / ud pa la dang /sku ma ga 7ru dang / ta ma la'i lo ma'i phye 7ma'i char mngon par bab 18par gyur to/ /lha ma yin gyi spos kyi phye ma rnam pa sna sna tshogs du ma'i char mngon par bab par gyur to/ /lha'i me tog man dā tshor ba dang / man dā 2ra ba chen po dang / mdzi ṣa naka dang / mdzi ṣa /ka chen po dang / pa ru ṣa ka dang / pa ru ṣa ka 2 chen po dang / mdog dkar dang / mdog dkar chen po dang / skya snar dang / skya snar chen po dang / skya snar khra bo dang / skya snar bkra chen gyi me tog rnams dang /sprul pa'i me tog sna tshogs kyi char mngon par bab bo/ /steng gi bar snang las 42—55

gser dang / dngul dang / be+e drur+ya dang / shel dang / spug dang / rdo'i snying po dang / mu tig dmar po dang / rin po che thams cad kyi me tog gi char yang 1mngon par bab bo/ /lha (gedang lha ma yin gyi spos chu'i char yang mngon par bab bo/ /spos chu'i charang de bab capas ser skya'i gnas kyi sagrong khyer chen po nas khor ༷ yug tu dpag tshad drug cu tshun chad spos chu'i gerdzab tu gyur to/ /spos chu'i rdzab kyi dri des kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rgyas par gang bar gyur to/ /sems can gang dag gis0 spos kyi dri de tshor bar gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /de ltar lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags zangs ris kyis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum skor 7ba byed 7pa'i tshe/bar snang las lha ma yin gyi lha rdzas kyi sil snyan gyi sgra dag byung ngo / /sil snyan de dag gi sgras kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su grag tsho/7par gyur to/ /theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa'i sems can gang dag gis tshasgra thos par gyur pa de dag thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ / de ltar 7lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags zangs ris kyis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas pa'i tshe lha ma yin gyi bu mo brgya stong dag bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa labya ba dang / lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags zangs ris kyi 'khor bya 15ba'i phyir la la ni glu len/la la ni sil snyan byed/ la la ni gar byed/ la la ni lus kyi tshul sgyur/ la la ni tsan dan dang / ud pa la dang 7/ a ga 7ru dang / ta ma la'i lo ma'i snyephye ma 'thor/ la la ni 19lha'i me tog man rās ra ba dang nya/ man dā rang ba 42—56

chen po dang / man dzu ṣa (ka dang / man dzu ṣa ka chen po dang / pa ru ṣa rika dang / pa ru ṣa 4ka chen po dang / mdog dkar dang / mdog dkar chen po dang / skya snar dang / skya snar chen po dang / skya snar khra bo dang / skya snar bkra chen chedang / sprul pa'i me tog rnams cadang / gser dang / dngul dang / be+e drur+ya dang / shel dang / spug 7dang / rdo'i snying po dang / mu tig dmar po dang rin po che 8thams cad kyi me tog rnams 'thor zhing bcom ldan 'das la mngon par 'thor ro/ /la la ni na bza' dang / rkang gdub dang ske/ sku rags cadang / phyag gi rgyan 7dang / sor gdub :rmodang / gdu skubu dang / gdu 8bu tham pa dang / dbu rgyan rtse gsum pa tshadang / dpung rgyan dang / cod pan dang d+ku/ gser skud tshadang / mu tig gi phreng ba 7dang /nor bu'i do shal dang / se 8mo do dang / gya do dang / mgul rgyan sna /tshotshogs dang / rna cha dang / rna cha gdub kor dang / tshong tshong gshibs pa 21dang / mgo rgyan dang / phreng ba'i lda ldi dang / spos kyi lda ldi dang / nor bu'i lda ldi dag 'thor zhing me tog gi bla re dang / spos kyi bla re dang / nor bu'i bla re dag thogs so/ /la la ni spos chu'i char 'bebs so/ /la la ni phye ma'i char 'bebs so/ /la la ni mu tig dmar pos snyim pa bkang ste/ bcom ldan 'das la mngon par 'thor na ro/ / snyel la ni rin po ches snyim pa bkang byu/la la ni gser gyis snyim pa bkang ri ci ste/ bcom ldan 'das la mngon par 'thor rol/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'di yang smras so/ / gang brten gang la gnas bcas nas/ /gang zag mchog la mchod 'gyur ba snye/ /de 'dra ba yi grogs po dang ske/ /rtag par rgyun du phrad par shog /lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags zangs 42—57

ris kyis ji ltar byas pa de bzhin du lha ma yin gyi dbang po rab sim gyis kyang bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa ha byas nas rin po che sna bdun gyi shing rta la zhon te ske/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum skor cib byed cing tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod pa/ stobs bcu brtson bden khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi 'jigs 'jigs bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos la ma 'dres 3nges par gyur pa po / /'gro ba'i 'dren pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun sbyor 'ching ba gcod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'khor rgyud mi gnas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtsomathar phyin thang gnas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba bying ba sgrol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can 'grogs kyang rgod pa mi mnga' zhing / /'gro ba kun la 9thugs ni rnam grol te/ /pad ma chu 7yis mi :nyagos 'dra ba po/ /blo zab bsam mi khyab la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas thub pa khyod kyis stong nyid mkhyenatsha/ /rnam pa kun tu mtshan ma thams cad bshig /khyod ni gang du'ang smon pa yong mi mnga'/ /mi gnas nam mkha' mnyam chol phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha ma yin gyi dbang po rab pasim gyis ji ltar byas pa de bzhin du lha ma yin gyi dbang po shing rta bzang gis kyang / bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas nas rin po che sna bdun gyi shing rta la zhon te/tsha bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum skor 7ba byed cing gser phye :snyedag gis gtor nas tshigs su bcad pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod 39pa/ sa dang bar snang dang ni lha'i yul na'ang / /bde 2 gshegs khyod mnyam ma 2 mchis lhag ma mchis/ /mtshan mar gzung nas 2 phyin ci log zhugs pa'i/ /'gro ba smig rgyu 2/'dra bar khyod kyis mkhyen/ /'di na 25byed pa satshor ba sems can med/ /gang zag med 42—58

cing bdag gir bya ba med/ /chos kun stong zhing byed pa kun las 1dben/ /rang bzhin med cing g.yo med zhi zhes bstan / /su zhig bde rigashegs bstan pa 'dir gemos te/ /chos kun byas pa med pa'i rjes 'brang ba/ /de 'dir 'dren pa'i sras su gyur pa ste/ /ji ltar bstan pa de bzhin yab ltar spyod/ /rnam 'dren khyod la bdag bstod 5bsod nams gang skyes de / /ji ltar rgyal ba mkhyen pa yis ni mkhyen 7gyur pa/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de kun ma lus mtha' dag 'dir / /'gro la stsal nagyis thams cad sangs rgyas grub 9par shog/ //bam po gsum pa/ lha ma yin gyi dbang po shing rta bzang gis ji ltar byas pa de bzhin du lha ma yin gyi dbang po stobs ldan gyis kyang / bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas te rin po che sna bdun gyi shing rta chal zhin nas bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum skor ’ ba byed cing dngul gyi me tog rnams kyis gtor te/ tshigs su bcad pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod pa/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho lochu las pha rol rnams rgal rta ba/ /rgal nganas skye bo rgyun gyi cirjes 'gro sgrol mdzad cing / /bde gshegs pha rol thang bde 'jigs lapa med 'jog pa/ /spyan mdzes bde bar gshegs pa khyod kyi zhabs la gtugs :/ /blo mchog khyod kyis 'gro ba thams cad kun tu mkhyen/ /phyin ci log lta thibs por rab zhen /tshoblo ldan te/ /'khrul pa smig rgyu lta bur ma shes gyur rnams la/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i thugs rje bskyed nas rtogs par mdzad/ /mi mchog khyod kyis chos rnams thams cad sgyu ma dang / /smig rgyu 'dra zhing mig yor mtshungs zhes rab tu bstan / /thub pa dam pa khyod kyis chos kyi sras mchog bskyed/ /srid pa gsum po dag ni 2mi chags spyad pa spyod/ /dngos po log pa'i don gyur rang 42—59

bzhin bral ba dang / /gzhan gyi dngos pos stong par mi dbang khyod kyis mkhyen//gyis pa 1rmongs pa'i blo gros rmi lam dga' milta bur/ /mi dbang khyod kyishesras kyis tshal na gaspyad pa spyod/ /lha ma yin gyi dbang po stobs ldan gyis ji ltar byas pa de bzhin du lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan bgyis kyang / bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas nas rin po che sna bdun gyi shing rta la zhon te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum skor phyob byed cing me tog skya snar khra bo rnams kyis gtor te tshigs su bcad pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod pa/ mi mchog khyod kyi sku yis tsho ni/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten 'di zil mnan/ /ri rab kyis ni yungs 'bru dang / /rgya mtshos bamo/7rjes chu bzhin no/ /gzugs mdzes mtshan gyis rab matu brgyan/ /gzugs kyis gzugs kyi dam pa dang / /gzugs rnams thams cad zil gyis mnan/ /dper na nyi mas me khyer bzhin/ /gzi brjid phung po gzi brjid kyis/ /sems can gzi 8ldan zil gyis mnan/ /zil mnan de dag lam me min/ /nyi mas me khyer zil brlag bzhin/ /ye shes rgya mtsho ye shes kyis/ /'jig rten gsum kun zil gyis mnan/ /zil mnan de dag lam me minas/ /nyi mas zla 'od zil brlag bzhin/ /lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan rtegyis ji ltar byas pa de bzhin du/ lha ma yin gyi dbang po bde mchog gis 19kyang / bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa dī byas nas rin po che snam bdun gyi shing rta la zhon te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan rtegasum skor rteb byed cing me tog skya snar khra bos sa mngon par gtor te tshigs su bcad pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod pa/ 'dren pa blo gros zhi ba poX/ /zhi gnas dgyes pas 'gro ba yi/ /'dod snang du )gti mug rdul zhi mdzad/ /char 42—60

pas rdul rnams zhi bgyid bzhin/ /'bar zhing chos tshul 'bar bar mdzad// / blugs sbyinasagyis ni me bzhin no/ /nags btang nags mes shing sregs ltar/ /de bzhin nyon mongs dra ba sreg④ /bskalasapa bye ba khrag khrig ni/ /dpag tu med par dge rtsa 'dzin/ /nyon mongs thams cad 'joms 0mdzad de/ / bdud rtsis lus byugs dug bzhin no/ /༅mun pa5nyamun nag 9sel mdzad de/ /mun khung sgron ma 'bar ba bzhin/ /chos kyi tshul yang ston mdzad de/ /nor mkhan rin chen yon tan bzhin/ /lha ma yin gyi dbang po bde mchog gis 11ji ltar byas pa de bzhin du lha ma yin gyi dbang po g.yul la mngon par dga' bas kyang / bcom ldan 'das la mchod pasabyas nas rin po che sna bdun gyi shing rta la zhon te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum skorapha/lheb byed cing rin po che'i 7me tog rnams kyis gegator nas tshigs su bcad pa dag gis4bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod pa/ gdul dka' mi bzad lha sems ni khyod kyis btul rte//g.yul la dpa' bas g.yul ngor dpa' bo bzhin ri / /shin tu tshar bcad rang gis dbang du mdzad/ /thugs dul mi bstengs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod kyis5)dbang po thul cing dgra yang bcom/ /gang du'ang nami bsnyengs mi bskyod bde ba brnyes / /khyod ni nyon mongs rnams kyis yang mi 'khrugs/ /rnam pa kun tu dug ni ma lus bcom/ /mthu chen khyod kyis byams pa legs bsgoms te//khyod kyi thugs ni dgra dang byams la mnyam/ /thub pa khyod kyis sems can blo gros bshig /'gro ba kun du khyod ni bzhud mi mnga'/ /shes rab rnam grol srid pa'i sred pa bskams / /shes rab rnam dag khyod kyi thugs kyang dag snye /chos rnams kun yol thugs ni chags mi mnga'/ /thams cad zil mnan thub 42—61

mchog 1khyod 'dra med/ /lha ma yin gyi dbang po g.yul la mngon par dga' bas ji ltar byas pa de bzhin du lha ma yin gyi dbang po mig bzangs kyis 2kyang /bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas nas rin po che sna bdun gyi shing rta la zhon te/bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum skor 2ba byed cing bcom ldan 'das la gter chen po yang phul nas tshigs su bcad pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod pa/ dpa' bo chen po khyod kyis ni/ /chos rnams yang dag mtshan nyid mkhyen/ /gang 'di chos zhes brjod pa yang / /de ni brdar btags citshige tu zad/ /chos rnams chos kyi ngo bo yis/ /rnam pa kun tu mi dmigs so/ /gang 'di chos shes brjod pa yang / /de ni ming tsam zad ces gsungs/ /ming ni ming gis dben pa ste5/ /mtshan nyid kyang ni de bzhin no/ /chos rnams mtshan nyid med pa ste/ /ming yang med ces khyod kyis 0bshad/ /rab tu bshad ces bgyi ba yang / /bshad pa ci yang ma mchis te/ /gang gis kyang ni ma bshad cing / /su la'ang 7bshad pa ma mchis so/ / khyod kyi sras po 8)mi mchog rnams / /chos rnams de ltar 'tshal nas ni/ /chos rnams la yang mi chags par / /rnam par spyad tsho do thub pa che/ /lha ma yin gyi dbang po mig bzangs kyis 7ji ltar byas pa ha de bzhin du lha ma yin gyi dbang po 'jig rten gsum rnam par gnon dpas kyang / bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa 'byas nas rin po che sna bdun gyi shing rta la zhon te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum skor chib byed cing bcom ldan 'das la mu tig gi do shal yang skaphul nas tshigs su bcad pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod dzipa/ dgra zla ma mchis khyod la bdag bstod 7do/ /tshul khrims dang ni gzugs dang ye shes stobs/ /de snyeni 42—62

'jig rten gsum na mtshungs ma mchis/ /de phyir khyod ni dgra thul mtshungs ma mchis / /khyod kyi gzugs ni chos kyis bskyed pas na/ /gzugs kyi stobs kyis khams gsum zil gyis mnan/ /sbyin pa'i stobs kyis mtshan ni 1phun sum tshogasami / / dpe byad phun sum tshogs shing gzugs kyang dag /tshul khrims stobs kyis khyod pa ni mi bskyod do / /skye bo mkhas pas so sor bsam mi lang / /khyod ni tshul khrims ldan zhing thugs kyang dag /mi yi seng ge mdzad pa thams cad 'byor / /shes rab stobs kyis 7khyod mtshungs na'aga' ma mchis/ / de na 9 mi bsnyengs 'jig rten gsum btul nas/ /'khor du seng ge lta bur sgra bsgrags te / /rtog ge tshogs kyi blo gros zil gyis mnan/ /lha ma yin gyi dbang po 'jig rten gsum rnam par gnon pagyis ji ltar byas pa de bzhin du lha ma yin gyi dbang po rnam mapar snang byed kyis kyang / bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa 7byas nas rin po che sna bdun gyi shing rta la zhon te/ bcom ldan 'das la skalan gsum skor tshab byed cing rin po ches sna snyim pa bkang ha ste gtor nas 9tshigs su bcad pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod pa / thub pa chen po skye bo'i du 1tshogs pa 'di 2/ /dang ba'i yid kyis khyod kyi zhal du lta ri/ /kun gyis rgyal ba mdun na byubazhugs par mthong / /de ni rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas ma 'dres mtshan / /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsung gcig brjod pa la/ /skye bol bsam pa ji bzhin so sor 'tshal/ /thub pa khyod kyis gsung de de ltar 'byung / /de ni rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas ma 'dres mtshan/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsung gcig brjod pa la snye/ /'khor gyis yotha dad gsung du rnam 'tshal cing / /'gro bas rang don cim lta bzhin du'ang 'tshal/ /de ni rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas ma 'dres 42—63

mtshanasna / /gsung gcig rab tu brjod pa mdzad pas ni / /gcig la 'jog gi gzhan ni dgag par jimadzad/ /'dren pa su dag ma bslabs rtog 5par mdzad / /de ni rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas ma 'dres mtshan/ /lha ma yin gyi dbang po rnam par snang byed kyis ji ltar byas pa de bzhin du lha ma yin gyi dbang po btang bzung gis 4kyang / bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa 7byas nas rin po che sna bdun gyi shing rta la zhin te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum skor ba byed cing mu tig dmar pos snyim pa bkang ste gtor nas tshigs su bcad pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das la 9mngon par bstod lapa/ rgyags dang nga (rgyal sdig pa'i lta ba spyod pa gang / /yid dga' rab tu dang bas mi dbang bde gshegs kyi/ /blo la mngon par dga' ba de dag bag 12mchis te/ /mtshungs / med bsnyen bkur —bgyid pa de dag ston pa'i 8sras/ /chos rnams 'di dag ngo bo nyid kyis ma mchis te/ /rmi lam dga' ba thams cad tshad ma ma tshalags 'dra / /rmi lam dga' spyod ma mchis kyang ni 'du shes mchis/ /de ltar rgyal bas chos rnams thams cad rab tu gzigs/ /ston ma'i sna sprin dang mtshungs shing chu yi / zla ba 'dra/ /byis pa'i blo ldan 2 rnams kyi lke 7yid ni rmongs par bgyis2/ /gang dag rtag tu bag mchis bde gshegs blo mnga'ab ba/ /mkhas pa'i skye bo dag la 'di ni rmongs mi bgyid/ /rgyal ba khyod kyi bstan du shel rtag tu bag mchis gang / /mi mchog dam pa de dag mi dal yongs mi mchis/ /chos rnams thams cad rmi lam 'dra bar rnam brtags nas/ /yang dag mthong ba de dag ting 'dzin thob par gyur / /de nas thags zangs ris la sogs 0pa lha ma yin gyi dbang po bye ba phrag drug cu po de dag gis mchod pa rnam pa0 'di lta bu byas nas byang chub la 42—64

gzhol 〉ba'i sems kyis tshim zhing mgu la yi rangs te rab tu dga' nas/dga' ba dang / yid /bde ba skyes cate thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das nyid 5la phyag 'tshal zhing / bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khod 0par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha ma yin gyi dbang po'i mchod pa de dag kyang gzigs/ lha ma yin tshode dag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa yang thugs su chud nas de'i tshe 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos nyid de gang gi tshe 'dzum pa mdzad pa de'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal gyi sgo nas 'od zer /kha dog sna tshogs kha dog 7du ma 'di lta ste/ sngon po dang /ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / le brgan dang / shel dang ske/ dngul gyi kha dog lta bu dag byung nas de dag gis thams cad dang ldan pa'i ’ 7'jig rten snang bas rgyas par bkang ste phyir log panas/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ha ba byas nas ’ bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug tu nub po/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rta thul stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu mgazar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs tetsha/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 〉logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i don tshigs su bcad de 19zhus pa/ 'jig rten phan bzhed rgyus zhig ma mchis par/ /mi yi seng ge 'dzum pa mi mdzad na/ /drang srong chen po ci slad 'dzum nyapa mdzad/ /skyes bu mchog gis 'dzum 2pa'i rgyu yang gsungs na / /lha min mchod pa rgya chen gzigs gyur nas/ /'jig rten phan bzhed khyod ni 'dzum mdzad na/ /lha min 5rnams la lung bstan bka' stsal dzigasol / /de thos bdag cag rnams ni dga' bar 'gyur/ /de ring su yis 42—65

dogs med rgya chen sems/ /'khor 'dir yang dag bskyed par gyur cig gu// /de bzhin gshegs pas gang gi gubasam mkhyen nas/ /mi yi seng ge ga'adzum pa mdzad par gyur / /de ring yongs su dag pa'i yid kyis su/ / mi yis gcimachog la dad pa gang gis bskyed/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gang gi bsam mkhyen te / /yid du 'ong ba'i 'dzum pa mdzad par gyur/ /bde gshegs zhal nas 'dzum pa de mthong nas/ /'di ltar bde gshegs 'dzum pa mdzad pa 'di/ /su yi podapung bcas bdud ni deng sgyu bcom zhes/ /'khor 'di de ring the tshom 'tshal bar gyur / /drang srong chen po rgyal ba dgra las rgyal/ /the tshom 'tshal ba'i som nyi bcad 9du gsol/ /mi mchog khyod kyis de ring 'gro ba yi/ /the tshom sgyur 7te legs par bcad 1du gsol/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rta thul gyis zhu ba zhus pa'i lan bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad de tshe dang ldan pa rta thul la slar bka' stsal pa/ rta thul khyod kyis dri ba legs par dris/ /'jig rten phan phyir 'dzum pa ngas byas pa/ / de yis pa'abras bu ma lus bstan par bya/ /bstan pa de ni rtse gcig yid kyis nyon/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub 'dod pa'i phyir/ /lha min rnams kyis nga mchod 1 'di byas te/ /de dag sems ni ci la'ang chags med pas/ /nam mkha'i ngos la lag mthil chags med bzhin / /lha min tshogs kyis dad pa'i yid byas te/ /de dag nga la mchod pa 'di byas pas/ /blo can de dag lha min ris bor te/ /mtho ris gedong nas yun ring dga' bar 'gyur/ /de dag phyi dus rgyal ba mi'i paseng ge/ /gang gā'i klung gi bye ma bye ba snyedal/ /bsnyen bkur byas nas yid 'ong bskal pa la / /de dag thams cad mtshan 'thun rgyal bar 'gyur/ /de tshe bde gshegs 42—66

khrag khrig drug cu'i 17rnams/ /'jig rten sgron ma phyogs su grags 3 pa ste/ /de dag mi gnas chos ni ston mdzad cing / /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'grel snepar 'gyur/ /'jig rten mkhas pa de dag rnams kyi zhing / /shin tu yangs shing snyigs ma med par 'gyur/ /de tshe khrag khrig drug cur tshangs patre yi/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis ri stong gsum sbyong bar phyo'agyur/ /de dag ngan song thams cad sel bar mdzad/ /de dag zhing der dga' bar spyod par 'gyur/ /brtan pa de dag mi khom thams cad sbyong 7/ /bla na med pa'i theg pa ston par 'gyur/ /de dag tshe yi tshad du gyur pa nani/ /bskal pa khrag khrig drug cu 9tshang bar yang //rnam par 'dren pa de dag 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /chags pa med pa'i chos kyang ston par mdzad/ /thub pa de dag mya ngan 'das gyur te/ /'jig rten mkhas pa rab tu zhi gyur nas/ /bskal pa khrag khrig drug cu tshang bar ni/ /rang byung rnams kyi dam chos gnas par 'gyur/ /bde bar gshegs pa de dag 'gro ba'i tshogs / /gang gā'i bye ma snyed kyi skye bo 'dul/ /dgra las rgyal ba'i rgyal bar mtshan 'thun 'gyur/ /zhing dang tshe tshadang chos gnas 'gyur ba'ang 'thun/ /bde gshegs de dag khrag khrig drug cu yi / /skyes pa bud med yongs su smin mdzad de/ /bla na med pa'i theg pas 'dems par 'gyur/ /mkhas pa de dag rgyal ba'i gdung yang 'dzin snye/ /rgyal bas 7lha min de dag lung bstan pa/ /'jig rten phan phyir drang srong chen pos gsungasarnyi/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten de thos nas/ /yi tsharangs gyur cing stobs kyang skye bar gyur/ /lha ma yin lung bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //42—67

de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung0)chen pos lha ma yin gyi mchod pa rnam pa de lta bu 'di rimathong nas ngo mtshar du gyur te/ 'di snyam du de bzhin gshegs pas sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe dge ba'i rtsa ba ci lta bu zhig mngon par 'du mdzad na 'di lta bu'i rnam par smin pa 'ugrub snyam nas/ de'i tshe sems ji ltar mnyam par bzhag ne pas bskal pa shigrangs med pa yang rjes su dran zhing / bcom ldan 'das kyis srid pa'i rgyud de dang der 'chi 'pho dang skye ba na dge ba'i rtsa ba gang dag mngon par 'du mdzad pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba gang dag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yang dag par bsgrubs pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba gang natshogis phyir mi ldog pa brnyes 9par gyur pa de dag thams cad rjes su dran par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag 7go/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung :nyachen pos bcom ldan 'das kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba bdag nyid chen po rjes su dran par gyur nas 'di snyam du sems te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi tshadage ba'i rtsa ba bdag nyid chen po de lta bu mdzad na de'i thugs bskyed pa gcig la yang 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi lha bye ma snyed na sems can gang ji snyed cig 'khod pa de dag thams cad mi'i lus thob par gyur gete/ lha ma yin gyi mchod pa ji snyed pa de snyed du sems can re res bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du mchod pa : byas kyang de dag gi ① thugs bskyed pa gcig la yang lan lon par mi nus so snyam mo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung 7chen po ting nge 'dzin de las langs te/ ngo mtshar 1snyedang dad pa thob par gyur nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de mngon par bstod 9pa/ thub pa byang chub gzhol ba yi/ /thugs bskyed pa ni re re la'ang //42—68

lha ma yin gyi mchod pa 'dis/ /cha tsam mi spyod mi'i 1seng ge/ /de lta'i yon tan mthar phyin te/ /lha dang mi yis mchod gyur pa/ /tsan dan phur ma ri rab tsam/ /mi mchog khyod la mchod par 'os/ /mi yi seng ge 0khyod la ni/ /gang gā'i bye ma chesamadu rimang ba'i/ /rgya mtsho rab tu bkang ba yi/ /spos chu dag pa gis mchod par 'os/ /yon tan nechen po mnga' ba la/ /gang gā'i bye ma ches mang ba'i/ /me tog tshogs ni ri bo mchog /khor yug chen po mnyam mchod 'os / /rgyal ba sgron ma rang byung nab/ /mar me'i snying po ri rab tsam/ /'bru mar rgya mtsho'i chu snyed kyi/ /mar me rnams kyis mchod par 'os/ /mthu chen mnga' ba de lta bur/ /yon tan pha rol phyin gyur pa/ /gang gā'i bye ma ches mang ba'i3)/ /me tog mchod rten mchod par 'os/ /mi dbang mchod pas thugs brtse ba/ /rin chen gdugs ni che 7rnams kyis/ /bskal pa khrag khrig rnams su yang / /sems can mchog la mchod par 'os/ /yon tan mtha' yas mnga' ba khyod/ /rin po che yi rgyal mtshan gyis/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bkang ste/ /bskal pa bsam yas mchod par 'os/ /mi yi seng ge khyod la ni/ /bskal pa khrag khrig dpag med par/ /gang gā'i bye ma ches mang ’ ba'i / /ba dan tshogs makyis mchod par thos/ /drang srong chen po smra ba'i stag /lha rnams dang ni mi dag dang / /gzhan yang sems can gang tshogs pa/ /brtag bzung bodape la gsan du gsol/ /gal te gang gā'i bye snyed kyi/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams kyi/ /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas su/ /mi mchog stobs bcu'i stobs ldan la/ /de dag re re'i mgo bo yang / /gang gā'i bye ma snyed gyur te/ /mgo bo de lidag re re zhing / /de snyed kha dang ldan 42—69

gyur la/ /kha rnams de dag re re zhing / /lce dang kha yi 1grangs mnyam la/ /gang gā'i klung gi bye snyed kyi/ /bskal par bstod par 2bgyis kyang ni/ /rgyal ba de dag spobs mi bas ri/ /khyod kyi yon tan mthar mi phyin/ /rgyal ba de lta'i yon tan gyi/ /pha rol tu ni phyin par gyur ci/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag legs so legs so/ /nga'i nyan thos rnams ni drang por gyur pa/ ye shes dang ldan par gyur pa/ chos su gyur pa/ dpang du gyur pa/ tshad mar gyur pa sha stag gnas te/ de dag ni nga'i yon tan gyi tshogs la 'jug pa sha stag go/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa ni yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa ste/ yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa 5dang ldan pa'o/ /dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs cani bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o ske/ /dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan rnams gzugs can zhig yin na ni sems bskyed pa re re'i yon tan gyi tshogs kyang 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi nabye ma snyed du shong bar mi 'gyur te/ sems bskyed pa re re'i 9yon tan gyi tshogs kyang de bzhin gshegs pa tshogang gā'i klung gi / bye ma snyed kyis bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du gang 'di grangs kyi 2tshad gzung pabar brjod kyang brjod par mi nus/ bsams kyang bsam gepar mi nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe sems bskyed pa gang yang sems can 'du bsdu bar bsdus pa 7sems can gang ji snyed cig yod pa'i sems can de dag thams cad skol phan pa dang 42—70

bde ba'i don du ma bskyed pa gcig kyang med de/ sems can gyi khams ni tshad med pas sems can gyi khams ji snyed pa de snyed kyi 1bsod nams de bzhin gshegs pa'i sems bskyed pa re re las 'byung ngo / / sems can gyi khams ni mi zad pa ste/ sems can gyi khams ji ltar mi zad pa de ltar mi zad pa'i bsod nams de bzhin gshegs pa'i sems bskyed pa re re las 'byung ngo / /5sems de ni sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don du skyes pas sems can thams cad kyis mchod kyang lan lon par mi nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jig rten pa'i mchod pa ni zang zing dang bcas pa yin la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don du 'byung ba 5ni sems can 'khor ba cal gzhol ba 'di dag mya ngan las 'das pa la ji ltar gzhol bar 'gyur zhes te zang zing med pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe sems can rnams kyi don du zang zing med pa'i sems dpag tu med pa bskyed par gyur to/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus bskal 5pa dpag tu med pa/ bgrang du med pa/bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ mtshungs popa med pa/ gzhal du med pa/ brjod du med pa 'das pa 7de'i tshe de'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dbang po'i tog ces bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i tog des sems bskyed pa 9re re zhing tshagang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi 42—71

'jig rten gyi khams kyi /sems can rnams la phan par dgongs par gyur te don kyang mdzad do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i tog gimo sangs rgyas kyi zhing riyang 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed la sangs rgyas kyi zhing cagacig tu gyur te/ yongs su dag cing ngan song dang mi khom pa thams cad yongs su chad pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i btog de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na 5log par nges pa'i sems can gyi skye ba yong mumed par gyur to/ /rko lta ba'i rnam pa yong med dpar gyur to / /mngon pa'i nga rgyal can yong /1med par gyur to/ /lus dang ngag dang / yid kyi las kyi mtha' yongs su ma dag pa dang ldan pa'i sems can yong tshamed par gyur to/ /ngan song gi rgyur 'gyur ba'i nyon mongs pa dang las pa'abyung ba yong 7med par gyur tong/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa des yun ring po nas sems can rnams dge ba'i pachos rnams la btsud / cing btams 8te rjes su bstan cing bslabasamu pa'i phyir ro / /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dbang po'i tog gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na 'khod 1pa'i sems can rnams kyang bde 22ba lnga thob par gyur te snye/ 'di ltar la la ni 'dod pa'i bde ba dang ldan par gyur to/ /la la ni khyim nas 'byung ba'i bde ba dang ldan par gyur to/ /la la ni bsam gtan 24gyi bde ba dang ldan par gyur to/ /la la ni snyoms par 'jug pa'i bde ba dang ldan par gyur to/ /la la ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi bde ba dang ldan par gyur te su/ de dag bde ba de la yang spyod la/ bde ba de dag la yang mngon par zhen pa med par gyur to/ /'di lta ste/ dper na bung ba me tog gi khu bas nye bar 'tsho yang de la samangon 42—72

par zhen pa med dope/ /de bzhin du sems can de dag kyang bde ba de la yongs su mispyod kyang de la mngon par zhen pa med do/ /'di lta ste/ dper na bar snang la 3rgyu ba'i bya ni bar snang la yang rgyu la de la mngon par chags pa yang cimed do/ / de bzhin du sems can de dag kyang bde ba de la yongs su spyod kyang de la mngon par zhen pa med do/ /5de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i tog byude'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na 'khod pa'i sems can rnams la 7yid mi bde bar 'gyur ba'i mi dga' ba med rmongs par 'gyur ba med de / gzhan du na payid /nyabade bar 'gyur ba'i tshadaga' ba : sha stag la yongs su spyod de/ de ni 'di ltar sngon tshadage ba'i rtsa ba de lta bu bskyed pa'i phyir ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems can de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i tog des sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ mi dge ba las yongs su bzlog rkiste/ dge ba la btsud tshapas de dag la las gang gis sdug bsngal gyi 7tshor ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i rnam par smin pa dbang med par 'byung ba mi dge ba'i las de lta bu yong med de38/ de / ma bsags 2 pa'i phyir sdug bsngal tshor bar 'gyur ba'i rnam par smin pa0lhami 'byung ngo / /de dag gis 2rmongs pa'i sems tsam gyis kyang las gang gis rmongs pa rnams la sdug bsngal yang ma yin/ bde ba yang ma yin pa'i snyetshor ba 'byung bar 'gyur ba de lta bu mngon par 'du byum byas te/ de ma bsags 25pa'i phyir rmongs par 'gyur ba'i tshor ba sdug bsngal yang ma yin/bde ba yang ma yin pa de lami 'byung ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i tog de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na rgyu gang gis sems can de dag dus gyur pa las byungs ba'i sdug bsngal mi 'byung bas nyams su mi bde ba'i nyi ma mi 'char ro /42—73

rlung 3nyams su mi bde ba mi ldang ngo / /char nyams su mi bde ba mi 'bab po/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i tog de sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ sems can de dag la lus dang / ngag dang / yid kyi las thams cad shes pa sngon du 'gro zhing shes pa'i rjes su 'brang tsho ba bstan cing bshad pas sems can de dag gis kyang byang chub sems dpa' de las bstan pa de thos nas lus dang / ngag dang / yid kyi las thams cad shes pa sngon du 'gro zhing shes pa'i rjes su 'brang bar yongs su bsgrubs 3pas las de'i rnam par smin pas 5de dag la rmongs par 'gyur ba'am yid mi dga' bar 'gyur ba med do / /rmongs pa 8rnams la rgyu gang gis bde ba yang ma yin/ sdug bsngal 9yang ma yin pa'i tshor ba 'byung ba med do/ /de ltar sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na sems can de dag la 7sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba med cing bde ba yang ma yin/ sdug bsngal : yang ma yin pa yang pamed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skyes pa'i sems can de bzhin gshegs pa des btams pa /de dag ni chos la rim gro libya ba chen pos nye bar gnas par gyur to / /de dag 'chag na yang chos nyid la sems shing chos la mos pas zhen pa'i layid kyis 'chag ste'i/ chos la mos shing zhen pa'i yid kyis 'chag pa de dag la sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba mi 'byung ngo / /de bzhin du 'greng ba dang / 'dug pa dang / nyal ba dang / sad pa dang / spyod lam thams cad du yang sdug bsngal mi 'byung ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de'i sems can de dag la ya nga ba ma spangs pa med de na/ de'i phyir ya nga ba ma spangs pa'i sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba mi 'byung ngo / /yang dag pa'i spang 19ba yod pas de dag la skyo ba med de / de'i phyir de dag la 1yang dag par spang bar bya ba'i sdug 42—74

bsngal yang med do/ /sems can de dag la 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal yang med de/de ni 'di ltar sems can de dag chos thams cad la mngon par zhen pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag la mi 〉〉sdug pa dang riphrad pa'i sdug bsngal yang med de/ de ni 'di ltar sems can de dag sems can thams cad la mnyam pa nyid kyi sems nye bar gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag la sdug pa dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal yang med de/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag chos thams cad la rimangon par zhen pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /sdug pa dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal ni sdug pa las 'byung ste/ de'i phyir de dag cil sdug pa dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal yang med do/ /sems can de dag la desdug bsngal ba'i sdug bsngal yang mi 'byung ste / 'di ltar de na sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba rgyu ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan du na 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gcig pu yod de/ 'di lta ste/ mi rtag pa'i sdug bsngal nyid do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de ni don dam pa'i chos ston te / de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i na tog de bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du bzhugs pa'i tshe des gsungs pa la phyir 9smra ba'i sems can gang yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing der ma byung ste/ de ni 'di ltar sngon sems can de dag legs par yongs su min par byas pa'i phyir ro/ /dge slong dag de la ji snyam du sems/ dge ba'i rtsa ba zhan pa dang dzha/ dma' ba dang / zhum pa dang / chung ba dang / sdug bsngal gyis yongs su bsgrubs pa dang / sdug bsngal dang 'dres pa dang / sdug bsngal dang ldan pa dang / sdug bsngal gyis yongs su bzung ba dang / nyes par bsams 'ipa dang / nyes par 1 bsgrubs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas sems can de snyed cig 12don bya ba'am/ de dag tshal phan par bsams dpa'am/ bde ba bsgrub pa'am/42—75

sdug 3 bsngal bsal ci ba'am/ de ltar tha /gru che ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya ba'am/ sems can de snyed yongs su smin par bya bar ④nus sam / gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bka' stsal paspri /dge slong dag de la byuji snyam du sems/ sems zhan pa dang / sems dma' ba nas nyes par bsgrubs pa'i bar gyi sems kyis sems can de snyed cig gi don bya ba'am/ de dag la phan par bsam tshopa'am/ bde bar bsgrub ⑧pa'am/sdug bsngal bsal sgyuba'am/ de ltar tha pagru /stoche ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya ba'am/ sems can de snyed yongs su smin par bya bar nus sam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de la paji snyam du sems/ 'dad pa zhan pa nas nyes par r+shabasgrubs pa'i dad pa'i bar dang / tshul khrims zhan pa mnas nyes par 8bsgrubs pa'i tshul khrims kyi bar dang / thos pa zhan pa nas nyes par bsgrubs pa'i thos pa'i bar dang —/ brtson 'grus zhan pa nas nyes par bsgrubs pa'i brtson 'grus kyi bar dang ske/ dran pa zhan 7pa nas nyes par /5bsgrubs pa'i dran pa'i bar dang /ting nge 'dzin zhan pa nas nyes par bsgrubs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bar dang /shes rab zhan /3pa nas nyes par bsgrubs pa'i shes rab kyi bar gyis5)sems can de snyed cig gis don bya ba'am/ de dag la phan par bsam pa'abarte/ bde ba sgrubam pa'am/ sdug bsngal bsal 2 ba'am/ de ltar tha gru che ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya ba'am / sems can de snyed yongs su smin par bya bar nus sam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 455 pa/ dge slong dag legs so legs so/ /de ni 42—76

dge ba'i rtsa ba zhan pa dang / sems zhan pa dang / dad pa dang / tshul khrims dang / thos pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / dran pa dang / tingange 'dzin dang / shes rab zhan ci pa dang / dma' ba dang / zhum pa dang /chung ba dang / sdug bsngal gyis yongs su bsgrubs pa dang / sdug bsngal dang 'dres pa dang / sdug bsngal dang ldan pa dang / sdug bsngal gyis yongs su bzung ba dang / nyes par bsams pa dang / nyes par bsgrubs pa'i shes rab kyis sems can de snyed kyi don bya ba'am/ de dag la caphan par bsam pa'am / bde bar bsgrubs depa'am/ sdug bsngal bsal 0ba'am/ de ltar tha sgyugru che ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya ba'am/ sems can de snyed yongs su smin par bya bar mi nus so/ /dge slong dag de la ji snyam du sems/de'i tshe de'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i tog ces bya ba byung ba de gang zhig yin snyam/ de 9skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong de khodag cang mi zer bar 'khod do/ /de'i tshe shar phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed 1'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams zla ba'i 'od zer 32gyis rab tu brgyan pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid 'phags pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba da ’ ltar bzhugs te ba'atsho zhing gzhes 'al chos kyang ston te/ der 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa 'dus shing 'dug par gyur pa 8des bcom ldan 'das kyi dgongs pa sems kyis shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gzi 7brjid 'phags pa'i rgyal po de 18la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar mi mjed kyi 9'jig rten gyi khams na de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa chos ston gyis / bcom ldan 'das shākya 42—77

thub pa de la bsnyen bkur bgyi ba'i slad du bdag kyang mchi'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid 'phags pa'i rgyal pos 'jam 1dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'jam dpal de'i dus la bab par shes na song shig /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa stan las langs te bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid 'phags pa'i rgyal po'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te lan gsum bskor ba byas nas/ 'di lta ste dper na skyes 0bu stobs dang ldan pa'i lag pa bskum pa las brkyang 5ba'am/ brkyang ba las bskum pa tsam gyis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa 'jig rten gyi khams zla ba'i 'od zer 0gyis rab tu brgyan pa de nas mi snang bar gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i spyan snga ge'adir gnas par 8gyur to/ /des bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gang 'di skad du dge slong dag de la ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na de bzhin gshegs 1—pa dbang po'i tog ces bya ba byung ba de gang zhig yin snyam zhes bka' stsal pa ni bcom ldan 'das bcom ldan 'das 7nyid ni de'i tshe de'i dus na dbang po'i tog ces bgyi ba'i de bzhin gshegs par gyur to/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i thabs nyamakhas pa dang ldan pa ste/ sems can yongs su smin par bgyi ba la chog pa mi mnga' / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bgyi ba la rgyun chad 7par bgyi ba ma mchis/ sems can rnams byang chub sems dpa'i chos rnams la dgod 42—78

pas chog pa mi mnga' ste/ la la zhig yang dag par smra bas yang dag par smra na/rgyal ba gtso bo/ rgyal ba dam pa/ rgyal ba mchog /3rgyal ba rab ces brjod pa de ni bcom ldan 'das nyid lags par yang dag par brjod dpas yang dag par brjodamu do/ /de skad ces smras nas/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas de'i tshe tshigs su bcad 5pa 'di dag smras so/ /dpa' bo rnams ni thabs mkhas te4ne/ /sems can rnams la thugs brtse zhing / /sems 7can yongs su smin mdzad phyir/ /dpa' bo chen po rnam par 'phrul/ /bye ba brgyad cur rgyal ba nyid/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bstan gyur kyang / /da dung chog pa'i 'du shes bsalas / /byang chub mchog tu thugs kyang 'jug /stong gsum drug cu rtsa gcig gi/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams dag mdzad pas / /ji ltar thub pa thabs mkhas pa/ /rgyal ba khyod ni kun gyis 'tshal/ /da dung dang po thugs bskyed par / /de dang der ni yongs bstan te/ /da dung du yang 'dren pa khyod/ /sangs rgyas mang po ston pa mdzad/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs rnams kyis/ /gang zag mchog ni spyod pa ’ mdzad/ /chos kyi dbyings la chags mi mnga'/ /khyod kyi tshigang yang mkhyen mdzad de/ /brgya 12byin tshangs pa'i cha byad dang / /la lar bdud kyi r+shacha byad kyis/ /sems can rnams kyi tshadon mdzad de/ /'jig rten rnams kyis rtogs mi nus/ /bud med cha byad spyod pa mdzad/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas rnams na'ang tshagada'/ /'jig rten chos kyis 7mi gos te/ /pad ma chus : mi themachags pa bzhin/ /'dren pa sna tshogs khams can gyi/ /'jig rten 'di yi rjes 'jug mdzad/ /des na skye dgu 22'di dag rnams/ /gdugs mtshan khyod kyi 2yon tan brjod/ /la lar bltams pa yongs su bstan/ /42—79

la lar mya ngan 'das pa bstan/ /la la na ni gu'akhor lo skor / /la lar spyad pa spyod pa mdzad/ /sems can 'dul ba'i don slad du/ /dgyes ④shing mgur len rol pa mdzad/ /bshums mo cadag kyang 'byin par mdzad/ /sems can sus kyang yong ma 'tshal mo/ /'dod chags mi mnga' chags pa'i tshul/ /'jigs pa mi mnga' 'jigs pa ltar/ /sems can rnam 0par gdul 3don du/ /'dren pa rnam 8par 'phrul pa mdzad/ /rmongs med rmongs pa'i tshul bstan te/ /byis pa ma lags byis tshul gyis/ /sems can rnam par gdul slad spyo du/ /'dren pa rnam 7par 'phrul pa mdzad/ /smyos pa ma lags smyos pa'i tshul/ /zha ba ma lags zha ba 17ltar/ /rnam par 'phrul pa sna tshogs kyis/ /sems can rnams ni 'dul ba mdzad/ /de ltar bsam yas mgon po khyod/ /dam pa'i chos kyang bsam mi khyab/ /dpa' chen khyod la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /sems can thub chen 'drar gyur cig /sngon byung ba 'od srung mchen pos zhus tshapa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas bya'i rgyal po 'dab libazangs brgyad khri drug stong gis lha ma yin gyi dbang po de dag pagi mchod pa yang mthong / lung bstan pa yang thos nas/bcom ldan 'das la gzhal du med pa'i dad pa skyes pate/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i phyir brtson par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i don du rin po che sna bdun gyi khang pa brtsegs pa shin tu bkra ba blta na sdug pa brgyad khri drug stong mngon par sprul to / /lha'i rin po che sna bdun ni 'di lta ste/gser dang / dngul dang / be+e drur+ya dang / shel dang / spug dang / mu 42—80

tig dmar po dang / rdo'i ni snying po dang bdun no/ /khang pa brtsegs pa de dag kyang rin po che sna bzhi'i lan kun gyi dra ba ris bkra 5ba/ blta na sdug pa rim pa (ri bdun gyis kun nas bskor to/ /rin po che sna bzhi ni 'di lta ste/gser dang / dngul dang / be+e drur+ya dang / shel lo/ /gser gyi lan kun rnams kyi ka ba dang / gdang /bu rnams ni gser/ shar ba 5rnams ni dngul/dngul gyi lan kun rnams kyi ka ba dang gdang 'bu rnams ni dngul / shar ba trernams ni gser/ be+e drur+ya'i lan kun rnams kyi ka ba dang gdang bu 7ni be+e drur+ya/shar ba tsharnams ni shel/ shel gyi lan kun rnams kyi ka ba dang gdang ’ bu rnams ni shel/ shar ba 8rnams ni dngul las byas pa'o/ /khang pa brtsegs pa de dag dril bu g.yer kha'i tsho/2dra ba bkra ba blta sgon sdug pa rim 5pa bdun gyis kun nas bskor to/ /de dag kyang larin po che sna bdun las byas pa 7sha stag ste /snye/ 'di ltar gser dang / dngul dang :rte/ bai drur+ya dang / shel dang / spug dang /mu tig dmar po dang / rdo'i snying po dang bdun no/ /khang pa brtsegs pa de dag rin po che sna bdun gyi dra ba bkra ba/ blta na sdug 2pa 'di lta ste/gser rtegyi dra bangacudang / dngul gyi dra ba dang / be+e drur+ya'i dra ba dang / shel gyi dra ba0gdang / mu tig dmar po'i dra ba dang / spug gi dra ba dang / rdo'i snying po'i dra bas kun nas bkab par gyur to / /gdugs bkra ba/ blta nas sdug pa brgyad khri drug stong mngon par sprul te 9/ de dag kyang 'di ltar gser nas rdo'i snying po'i bar gyi rin po che snam bdun las bsgrubs pa sha stag go/ /rgyal mtshanas bkra ba/ bltas na sdug pa brgyad khri drug stong yang mngon par sprul te / rgyal mtshanas de dag kyang gser dang / dngul dang / be+e drur+ya dang /42—81

shel dang / rin po che sna bzhi'i rgyu las bsgrubs pa sha stag ste/ rgyal mtshan0sngon po rnams ni tog miser po can / rgyal mtshan ngaser po rnams ni tog sngon po can/ rgyal mtshan dadamar po rnamasal ni tog dkar po can sha stag mngon par mo sprul to/ /ba dan kha dog sna tshogs can bkra ba/ blta na sdug pa brgyad khri drug stong yang mngon par sprul par gyur to/ /bla re bkra ba/ blta nan sdug pa brgyad khri drug stong yang 9mngon par sprul par gyur te / bla re de dag kyang gser skud kyi : bla re dang / dngul skud kyi pabla re dang / 8bo drur+ya'i bla re dang dzha/ shel gyi bla re dang / mu tig dmar po'i bla re dang / spug gi bla re dang ske/ rdo'i snying po'i bla re stege/ rin po che sna bdun las bsgrubs pa sha stag go / /de nas bya'i rgyal po 'dab 5bzangs de dag gis khang pa brtsegs pa brgyad khri drug stong po de dag dang / gdugs brgyad khri drug stong po de dag dang /rgyal mtshan labargyad khri drug stong po de dag dang / ba dan brgyad khri drug stong po de dag dang / bla re brgyad khri drug stong po de dag bcom ldan 'das la phul ba dang ske/ de dag thams cad steng gi ’ bar snang la lding zhing bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas so/ /'di lta ste/ dper na glang po che'i rgyal po sa /shesrung gi bu ni sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams mgo la khyer zhing nam mkha' las song ste dzo / yongs 2 'du sa brtol 7du gzhog sa go/ /de bzhin du khang pa 2brtsegs pa de dag dang / gdugs de dag dang / rgyal mtshan de dag dang / ba dan de dag dang / bla re de dag bar snang gi nam mkha' la lding zhing bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum skor cib byed par gyur to/ /de nas 'dab bzangs brgyad tshokhri drug stong po de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas te/ bcom 42—82

ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod de 〉thal mo sbyar nas phyag 'tshal zhing tshigs su bcad pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod tsho pa/ rga dang 'chi las rnam bral 5khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rga dang 'chi las rnam 'grol cakhyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can gzhal yas kha lo sgyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod dang mtshungs pa ma mchis lhag pa'ang ma mchis so/ /bdag cag rnams kyang sred med bu yi 5lus ldan zhing / /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan gyis yan lag brgyan pa dang / /dpe phyibyad bzang po 7brgyad cus shin tu mdzes byas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnam par 'dren pa khyod 'drar gyur par na)shog /bdag cag 'dom gang 'od kyi gzi 9ldan zhing / /mngon 'phags gzugs kyi dam pas mdzes gyur te/ /spyod lam mchog dang bdag cag ldan gyur cing —/ /'gro ba rnams 7spyod mya ngan zlo bar shog /bdag cag tshul khrims ting 'dzin rab ldan zhing / /shes rab ldan pas ’ mchog tu gyur par 12shog /de 12ltar rnam par 'dren pa khyod lta bur/ /skye bo rab 'grel glusangs rgyas grub cipar shog /'dren pa 'jig rten mkhas pasakhyod lta bur / /bdag cag 'dren pa stobs bcu ldan pa dang / /ma 'dres bco 8brgyad chos kyi mthar phyin cing / /'jig rten mkhas pa thams cad mkhyen du shog /bdag cag kun kyang 'gro 19ba dngos med dang / /rmi 'dra sgyu 'dra gnas pa 1med pa 2dang / /brag ca snyenam mkha' 'dra bar ston byed cing / /ji ltar rnam 'dren khyod ston bzhin du 2 shog /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bya'i rgyal po 'dab labazangs de dag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa mkhyen nas 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rta thul gyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ rgyal ba rnam 'dren 42—83

gtso bo sangs rgyas rnams/ /rgyu ma mchis par bzhadam༅pa mi mdzad na/ /'dzum mdzad 'di la 2rgyu rkyen gang lags pa/ /'jig rten phan mdzad thugs rje mnga' bas gsungs/ /'dab ribazangs rnams kyis rgyal ba mchod bgyis te kyi/ /bla re nam mkha' tshargyas par 0cigang ba sgyubastan/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten 'di la ngo mtshar skyed/ /rkang gnyis dam ḍa pas de dag lung bstan gsol/ /'gro ba thams cad thal mo rab sbyar cing / /dga' ba'i sems dang mgu ba'i sems kyis 'khod/ /mkha' 7lding 'gro ba cir77'gyur nyan par 'tshal/ /rkang gnyis dam pas de dag lung bstan gsol/ /mi mchog khyod la khong mdag mchi ba ni/ /'gro ba thams cad the tshom med 'gyur zhing / /the tshom med pas 'khor du 'jigs med 'gyur/ /'dis pani sangs rgyas mnyes par bgyis shes mchige/ /'khor 'dir 7'jigs med rab tu dga' bar 'gyur/ /yongs su sbyangs shing shin tu skyon bsal nasatsha/ /rgyal bas 7lung bstan de dag mngon dga' ste/ /slob :snyem mchog la bla mas bstan pa bzhin/ /the tshom 'tshal ba'i the tshom gcad / du gsol/ /rab tu dga' mdzad rjes su smon pa mdzod sgyu/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis 'khor 'di 'dus gyur gyis 1/ /rang byung ci mkha' lding 'gro ba cir tsho 'gyur gsungs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rta thul la tshigs su bcad de slar bka' stsal pa/ thams cad zil gnon stobs bcu brtson 'grus bden/ /rgyal ba dbang po thub pa de bzhin gshegs/ /'dren pas yan lag brgyad ldan gsung cidabyangs kyis/ /'dabakhebazangs 'gro ba rta thul bka' stsal pa/ /rta thul khyod kyis dri ba legs par dris/ /'jig rten phan phyir 'dzum gang ngas bstan pa/ /de yi 'bras bu dga' ba'i yid kyis nyon//42—84

the tshom sol la 〉rab tu dga' ba skyed/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub zhi tshol zhing //stobs dang mi 'jigs bzhi po gang rnams kyis/ /'dren pa 'jigs med 'gyur ba btsal ba'i phyir/ / 'dab chags ridabang pos nga la mchod legs byas/ /ma 'dres bco /ribargyad chos ni smra ba yi/ / sred med bu lus shin tu mkhregs 5pa dang / /sum cu gnyis mtshan dpe byad bzang po rnams/ /yongs su btsal phyir nga la mchod pa byas/ /rgyal ba'i tshul khrims ting 'dzin btsal ba dang / /gzhan yang sangs rgyas spyod yul shes rab dang / /phun sum cazhing dang 'gro ba rnam dgrol 7ba/ /'di dag kun btsal don du mchod pa byas/ /de dag nga la dga' bas mchod byas pas / /dud 'gro'i gnas nas de dag shi 'phos nas/ /lha dang brtul 'o zhugs 'thun par de dag 'dong / /'di ni ngan song srid pa'i tha ma yin/ /bskal pa bye ba gang gā'i bye snyed du/ /de dag lha 7mi'i nang na lha gnas gyur cing / /rnam 'dren khrag khrig mtha' yas mchod byas nas/ /de dag dbang po thul ba'i rgyal bar 'gyur/ /de dag zhing du ngan song mi 'byung ste//mi khom 7mi 'byung mtshan dang : mi ldan med/ /rgyal ba de dag mtshan ni kun tu mdzesas / /ri rab rgyal mtshan dbaskal la rang byung tshe'agyur/ /lo ni bye ba brgyad cu bzhi bgrangs 7par/ /'jig rten phan phyir 'dren pa de dag bzhugs//'jig rten phan phyir rnam 'dren mnyam bzhag pas/ /lus can rnams la mnyam / pa'i don mdzad 'gyur/ /skyob pa rdul 2 med gyur pa de dag gi /'dus pa nga rgyal spangs pa brgyad cur 2'gyur/ /de tshe skyob pa rdul dang bral rnams kyi/ /shin tu sems dul 5bye ba brgyad cu 'byung / /'dren pa de dag 'gro ba'i nga bsal phyir/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu skor 2 bar 'gyur/ /mi 42—85

dag de ltar 'di rnams nga rgyal che/ /'dab 1bzangs lus su gyur nas stobs po che/ /'di dag sngon tshe 'das pa'i dus shig na/ /drang srong dka' 3thub drag po'i tshogs can gyur / /stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa drug tshang ba ste/ / dka' thub spyod cade rdzu 'phrul phun sum btsal/ /de dag rdzu 'phrul thob nas nga rgyal gyis / /dga' bas 5dka' thub drag dang ldan par gyur / /tshul khrims ma zhig de dag nags 'dab tu / /tshe zad shi 'phos gyur te lus kyang zhig /nga rgyal des ni mkha' lding mkha' 'gror gyur na/ /rdzu 'phrul sems kyis rdzu 'phrul ldan par skyes/ /tshul khrims dag pas rgyal ba'i 9bstan la sadad/ /nga rgyal gyis ni byang chub sems kyang bskyed/ /nam mkha' lding lung bstan pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //bam po bzhi pa/ de nas klu'i bu mo lha bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug gis lha ma yin gyi dbang po de padag dang / nam mkha' lding gi dbang po de dag gi bemachod pa yang mthong / lung bstan pa yang thos nas mchog tu dga' ba chen po choskyes te/ de dag dga' mgu yi tsharangs nas rab tu dga' ste/ dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i phyir brtson par gyur tol/ /de dag gis rin po che sna bdun gyi gdugs be+e drur+ya'i dra ba lda ldir bkye skob mu tig dmar po'i dra bas bskor ba/ gser gyi yu ba can/ be+e drur+ya'i thur ma brgya 1 stong bkye ba/ rin po che'i chun rtepo sbyangs 2 pa bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug mngon par sprul to/ /rta sngon po kha dog sngon po/ sngon po lta bur ston pa/'od sngon po 'byung ba/ rgyan sngon pos brgyan pa/ be+e drur+ya'i srab 2kyis 42wa 86

bsrabs pa〉/ bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug mngon par sprul to/ /nor bu skar mdog gi bla re kho ra khor 2yug tu dpag tshad drug cu yod la / des 'khor de dag thams cad yog pa cig kyang steng gi bar snang la mngon 5par sprul to / /de la rin po che sna bdun gyi lda ldi bkra ba mig tu mdzes pa blta na sdug pa bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug bres par sgyumangon par sprul to/ /bla re de'i kho ra nakhor yug tu rin po che sna bdun gyi dril bu g.yer ku'i 9dra ba mngon par sprul te bres so / /rin po che sna bdun gyi khrung khrung rkang 7dag mngon par sprul to/ /klu'i rol mo sil snyan bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug mngon par sprul to/ /de nas klu'i bu tsho/1mo de dag rta sngon po de dag la zhon nas rin po che sna bdun gyi gdugs steng gi bar snang la bres te/ nam mkha' las 'dong zhing rol mo'i sgra bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug po de dag dkrol 12cing / bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum skor 12ba byed la lha'i tsan dan gyi phye ma dag kyang bcom ldan 'das la mngon par 'thor /lha'i a ga78ru dang / ta ma la'i lo ma dang / ud pa la'i phye ma dang / me tog sna tshogs kyang bcom ldan 'das la mngon par 'thor/ me tog ud pa la dang ske/ tsam pa ma'i phreng ba dag kyang 'thor/ me tog rnam pa sna tshogs kyi phreng ba dag kyang 'thoras/ spos sna tshogs kyi phreng ba dang / na bza' 7dang /rgyan :snyedag kyang 'bul te/ lha ma yin gyis ji ltar byas pa de bzhin du mchod pa rgya cher byas so/ /de nas de dag gis rol mo sil snyan bye ba phrag dgu bcu rta rtsa drug po de dag byas pa'i sgras stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgyas par gang bar gyur te / sems can gang dag gis rol mo'i sgra de thos pa de dag 2thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las 42—87

phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /nor bu skar mdog gi ci tshobla re dgardzasadang / rin po che sna bdun gyi lda ldi de dag dang / dril bu g.yer ku'i dra ba de sridag dang /khrung khrung rkang de dag rlung gis bskyod pa las 'di lta ste/ dper na rol mo sil snyan yan lag brgyad cadang ldan pa mkhas pas dkrol 3)ba de lta bur snyan la 3)de lta bur 7yid du 'ong zhing mnyan na bde ba'i sgra byung bar gyur to/ /sgra des kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgyas nyu)par gang bar gyur te/1 / sems can gang gis rgyan gyi sgra de dag thos par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang sko/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur tosku/ /de nas klu'i bu mo de dag gis me tog rnam pa sna tshogs kyi char dang —/ spos chu rnam pa sna tshogs kyi char mngon par phab par 〉gyur tem/ me tog gi char de bab pa'i tshe spos kyi dri zhim po'i ngad byung ste/ 'gro zhing ldog gol / /spos chu'i 7char de bab pas kyang ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen po'i kho ra 8khor yug tu dpag tshad drug cu tshun chad spos chu'i ri /rdzab tu gyur te /spos kyi dri des kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgyas par gang bar gyur to/ /sems can gang gis spos kyi dri de 2 tshor bar gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /de nas klu'i bu mo de dag gis gdugs bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug dang / rta bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug dang / rol mo sil snyan bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug po de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa ri rtebyas nas rgyan thams cad dang ldan pa de dag bar snang 2gi nam mkha' la 'khod de ༄/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas bcom ldan 'das la lan 42wa 88

gsum ①bskor ba byas te/ thal mo 5sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal zhing phyogs gcig tu 'khod par gyur to / /de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag kyang smras so ri/ /klu yi bu mo mkhas pa de dag yi parangs dga' mgu yid kyis su/ /byang chub zhi ba tshol zhing shākya snyothub la der ni sgyumachod pa chen po byas/ /rgyan gyis legs brgyan bye ba dgu bcu drug gi gdugs rnams mngon 7sprul te/ /bde bar gshegs pa mchod cing rab tu dul ba'i yid kyis chags dang bral/ /rgyan gyis legs brgyan bye ba dgu bcu padrug gi borta rnams mngon sprul te/ /kha dog sngo zhing rgyan yang 5sngo ba'i rta la rgyal mtshan dasngon pos brgyan//de dag thams cad bar snang dong nas thub la rta 4yis mchod pa byed / /klu yi bu mo de dag dang ba'i 8yid kyis 9thub la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /mchog la mchod pa'i don du klu yi gnas nas klu yi sil snyan gyis/ /mchod pa'i 'os gyur 'dren pa shākya thub lam der ni mchod pa 1byas/ /sil snyan de dag bde bar gshegs la mchod pa'i sgra de khams gsum grag /sgra de thos pa'i sems can khrag khrig dag ni byang chub yang dag zhugs/ /de dag rnams kyis der sprul mkha' la bla re chen po gcig tu gyur/ /phyogs bcu'i 2dpag tshad drug cur rgyas 2shing 'gro ba thams cad khebs par gyur thu/ /nor bu rin chen skar ma'i mdog gi lhagazi brjid phyogs su 'bar zhing gsal/ /klu yi bu mo dga' nas 'gro ba'i don 0du rgyal las tshomachod pa byas/ /gzhal du med pa'i sems bskyed dga' nas byang chub zhi ba tshol byed cing / /'jig rten don byed bde gshegs sangs rgyas 'jig rten mkhas pa grub par shog /ji ltar stobs bcu mnga' ba khyod ni sems can sdug bsngal 'grol 0ba ltar/ /chos kyang bstan te sems can nyon mongs sdug 42—89

bsngal bsgribs pa khrag khrig dgrol/ /chos rnams sgyu ma smig rgyu 'dra zhing dbu snab lta bur nyam 5chung la/ /char rgyun chu la phog pa'i chu bur lta bur 'jig0cing bdag po med/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan 'dra bar 'gro ba thams cad brtags sgrunas ni/ /'gro ba dag la chos kyi rang bzhin yang dag de nyid bstan par bgyi/ /sgyu ma bkod pa lta bur ma mchis brdzun 5pa byis pa rmongs bgyid pa / /skye bo mi mkhas ji bzhin ma 'tshal ba dag ma rung rab bgyid 7pa/ /byis pa rmongs bgyid chos rnams sdig med khyod kyis de ltar legs par gzigs/ /de dag naji ltar gzigs pa de bzhin de dag sems can rnams la bstan/ /ji ltar sa chen 'di la sprin 'khrigs 9gyur na ri ltar gda' ba yang / /yang dag tu na ri 7ltar ngo bo nyid kyis de la gnas ma mchis/ /de ltar 'gro ba thams cad rang bzhin ma mchis dbang po mongs par bgyid/ /shes pas brtags nas skye bo mkhas pa dag ni mongs par 'gyur nyam mchis/ /yang dag tu na pa'agro ba thams cad rang bzhin ma mchis khyod ston 1 pas/ /des na 'dren pa rgyal sgob khyod la skye bo mkhas pa mi phyed pa'agyur/ /khyod kyi sras rnams chos kyis yongs su tshim nas rdzab la zam lapa 'dra/ /'di ni byis pa'i skye bo'i yul min 'gro ba 'di ni sgra phyir 'brang / /de lta lags pas sdig med yang dag ston pa byis pa'i skye bo'i mgon / /skyabs dang 7dpung gnyen naganas dang rten dang 19rtsa lag khyod la skyabs su mchi / /gzhal yas byang chub de btsal slad du rnam par 'dren pa khyod la mchod/ /sangs rgyas gyur nas rtogs bgyid sdig bral 'jig rten don rnams bgyid par shog /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis klu'i bu mo de dag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa thugs su chud nas 'dzum pa 2mdzad do/ /de nas tshe dang 42—90

ldan pa rta thul gyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de 1tshogasol pa/ /'jig rten na ni 'jig rten mkhas pa rnam par 'dren mchog khyod 'dzum mdzad/ /dpal sdugatsha 'dzum pa mdzad la rgyu ma mchis pa bdag gis yongs ma mthong / /mi yi dbang po snyedam pa 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i rgyu ni yang dag gsungs/ / de thos lha mi lha min tshogs dang klu yi bu mo gsang ba pa/ /dri za rnams kyang skyob pa'i 5dgongs pa thos nas yid ni dga' bar 'gyur/ /'jig rten dag na 'jig rten rnam phyi'adren khyod kyis rgyu rnams thams cad mkhyen/ /rgyal bas chos gang rgyu dang rnam pas mkhyen par ma gyur yong ma mchis/ / de ltas 8bde gshegs rgyal ba 9khyod kyis ji ltar thugs chud 'dzum rgyu gsungs/ /de thos nas ni 'gro ba thams cad yi khorangs dogs pa chad par 'gyur/ /thub pa bde bar gshegs kyi bstan pa mchog la don kyang thob par ’ mchi/ /'khor rnams 'di dag don myong gyur nas yid ni rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ /kun rtog lodabang du mi 'gyur byang chub yid kyis rgyal ba'i spyod nyan 'gyur/ /bde gshegs khyod kyi 1 'dzum mdzad don thos rang 'byung nyid du nges par 7'byung / /'khor 'di rgyal ba khyod kyi zhal nas 'dzum mthong the tshom 'tshal gyur te/ /sdug bsngal dogs bcas yid mi bde zhing chos la som nyi gang 'tshal ba/ /de dag la ni thub pa skaston pas dogs bsal lathe tshom dgum du gsol/ /drang srong khyod kyis gang slad 'dzum bstan myur du bka' stsal 〉the tshom khum/ /rgyal ba gang gis de ring yid ni rnam par sbyangs shing bdud bcom thul / /su zhig yid rab tshim nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa dam pa bgyis/ /'di ni su yi mthu lags ston pa 'gro ba'i mdun du 'di bka' stsol/ /thos nas bdag cag yi 9rangs mchog tu dga' ba skyes 42—91

nas bde bar 'gyur/ /khyod kyi zhabs kyi 3drung du 'dus pa'i 'gro ba 'di dag the tshom 'tshal/ /'dzum rgyu dga' ba skyed pa bka' stsol thub pa the tshom bsal du 3gsol / /de thos lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba 'di dag the tshom ma mchis 'gyur / /rgyal ba'i gsung sgra yang dag thos nas de dag yid dga' pa'agyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ tshe dang ldan pa rta thul la tshigs su bcad de slar bka' stsal pa/ rta thul legs so 6rgyal ba'i dgongs pa 'dzum pa 'di ni legs par dris/ /klu yi bu mos mchod tshe sgyu'ajig rten phan phyir ngas ni 'dzum pa bstan/ /de yi 'bras bu bstan gyis yid gnyis tha ba spangs pa'i sems kyis nyon / /gang gi don du ngas ni 'dzum pa 'dir mdzad nga yi tshig la nyon/ /klu yi bu mo 'di dag chags med yid kyis byang chub yang dag zhugs/ /'gro ba thams cad stong par rnam bshig /blo ldan dogs med legs par gnas/ /'di na 7byed med tshor med nyagang zag med cing skye ba po : yang med/ /chos rnams 'di dag brdzun pazhing smig rgyu mtshungs la me long gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /'di dag rnams kyis mchod byas byas gzo blo gros yang dag ngas lashes teni/ /rgyal ba'i chos nyid dang ni 'gro ba stong zhing bdag po med mthong legs/ /mchod pa rnam par phye zhing legs par bkod pa 'di dag sgyu ma 'dra/ /byang chub gzhal yas gang du smon lam btab pa de yang 'di 'drar stong / /nga sal gzhal yas mchod pa de byas pa dang sko'agro ba stong shes rta pas/ /klu las shi 'phos nas ni lha gnas brgya byin gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sum cu rtsa gsum song ste lha yi nang du dga' bar tshe rdzogs nas/ /ma smad grags dang ldan pa'i lha gnas 'thab bral gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /'thab bral lha nang gnas te lha yi gnas su lha 42—92

yi 1dga' ba spyod/ / lhar gyur bde gshegs sras rnams de ni 4tshe yi tshad du gnas par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i sras rnams 'thab bral dga' ba spyad nas tshe tshad 5zad pa dang / /dga' ldan gnas su lha yi grong 0khyer lha dang brtul 7zhugs 'dra bar 'gyur/ /de dag de na lha yi bu mos bskor nas lha yi dga' 9ba spyod//pad ma chus mi chags pa bzhin du bde gshegs mi gnas blo can gnas/ /'gro ba thams cad stong par rtogs rig blo las nyams par yong ’ mi 'gyur/ /skyob pa rnams kyi dran pa rdo la bskos 2pa bzhin du yong mi nyams/ /de dag dga' ldan gnas der gnas te lha yi skudaga' ba spyod r+sānas ni/ /tshe tshad yongs su zad nas de tshe rab 'phrul dag tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /bde gshegs ma smad grags ldan der yang lha mo'i tshogs kyis lamachod 'gyur tes/ /mi gnas blo gros ldan pa tshe tshad bar 7tu gnas na gnas par 'gyur/ /de dag gnas der rab 'phrul gyur te lha yi dga' ba spyad nas ni/ /mkhas pa tshe zad blo gros ldan pa lta chos kyi mthar ni phyin gyur nas/ /'dren pa bsam pa dag pa 9chags med yid ldan chos kyi bsam pa can/ /chos dang ldan rnams gzhan 'phrul gnas su lha 'du bar ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de dag lha gnas de na gnas shing lha yi dga' ba spyod par 'gyur/ /bde gshegs ma rmongs blo ldan de dag rang gi tshe tshad gnas par 'gyur/ /mya ngan 'das ltar lha yi 'dod pa'i yon tan mnyam nyid zhi bar rtogs/ /bsam gtan bsam pas tshangs gnas ma smad grags dang ldan par 'gro bar 'gyur/ /tshangs pa'i gnas su bsam gtan mkhas shing bsam gtan 'bras bu spyad gyur nas/ /der gnas dpe med gyur cing byang chub yid kyis bskal par gnas par 'gyur/ /de dag bskal par tshangs gnas 'thun 42—93

par ye shes don gnyer brtul zhugs bzang / /thub pa mkhas pa thabs mkhas de dag 'jig rten don ni mtha' yas byed/ /mkhas thub di dag de na bsam gtan spyod yul bsam gtan chags pa med/ /bsam gtan bde ba mnyam nyid 'drar rig byang chub phyir ni dbang po zhi/ /kun du grol yid 1drang srong byang chub phyir ni byang chub blo dang ldan/ /mya ngan 'das pa 4lta bur bsam gtan blo gcig zhi ba'i mtshan nyid 'gyur/ /bde bar gshegs dang bcom ldan sras po byang chub zhi ba yongs tshol ba/ /tshangs pa'i yid ldan 'jig rten 5don byed de dag tshangs gnas de na gnas / /kun kyang tshangs pa'i blo ldan mthar phyin sha stag byang chub don gyi phyir/ /rang 'byung 7dgongs pa khams gsum lam las 'das pa'i nges par 'byung ba ston/ /tshangs pa 8la ni gus pa bskyed nas 'gro ba byang chub tshol bar 'gyur/ /tshangs pa'i bsam pa rang byung 9bsam pa nges 7'byung mthar thug shes nas ni/ /bde bar gshegs kyi bstan pa mchog la brtson pa de dag 'gro ba la/ /ci tshanas chos tshul 'bras bu myur du shes 'gyur tshade ltar chos kyang ston/ /de dag tshangs gnas de na gnas shing 'jig rten dag la byang chub phyir/ /phan pa byas nas srog 'chags bye ba khrag khrig mang po byang chub bkod/ /rgyal ba kun la mchod phyir 'jig rten khams mang 'ikhrag khrig 'gro bar 'gyur/ /dbang po zhi ba de dag bskal pa skar ma 'dra tshal rgyal bar 'gyur//lha dang mi dang klu dang 'dab ’ bzangs dag dang lha min bcas pa dang / /dri za grul bum mi 'am ci tshogs gnod sbyin 'gror 9bcas dga' zhing mgu/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub tu ni yongs sbyangs chos kyis stobs rnyed pa/ /de dag thams cad yi rangs 2thal sbyar bde bar gshegs la mgos 2phyag 42—94

'tshal / /klu'i bu mo lung bstan pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas klu'i bu mo de dag gi mchod pa yang mthong / lung bstan pa yang thos/yongs su rdzogs par yang ཿrig nas klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / nye dga' la sogs napa klu bye ba phrag dgu bcu ngo mtshar thob par gyur te/ 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa de sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa mkhyen cing bcom ldan 'das de la pami mkhyen pa'am/ ma gzigs pa'am/ ma gsan pa'am/mngon du ma mdzad pa gang yang med cing bcom ldan 'das kyi chos ni legs par gsungs pa/ yang dag par mthong 5ba/ rims tshond med pa/ dus chad pa 7med pa/ nye bar gtod pa/ 'di mthong ba la don yod pa / mkhas pa rnams kyis spyorang gis rig par bya ba ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung —ba ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa de ni rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba mnga' ba'o/ /'di ltar bud med du gyur pa/ rgod pa/ mi brten 12pa/ mi gnas pa rnams kyis 2kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis chos bstan pa yongs su shes pa dang / de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyi slob ma dge 'dun yang legs par zhugs pa/ drang por zhugs pas rigs dzapar zhugs pa/ 'thun lapar zhugs pa / 'di ltar 18bud med du gyur pa 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug mi bzad 19pa dang ldan pa rnams kyang / bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab la 'jug pa ni ngo mtshar che'o snyam ste/ ngo mtshar thob pa de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i phyir 'dzam bu'i gling rgya mtsho'i ri'i mthas gtugs pa thams cad spos kyi sprin chen pos rikun nas yog par byas te/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 42—95

'jig rten 'di spos kyi ngad 1kyis khyab par byas so/ /spos kyi dri'i ngad des kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rgyas par gang bar gyur nas/ sems can gang dag gis spos kyi dri de tshor bar gyur pa de dag thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen po thams cad kyang dpag tshad drug cu tshun chad mu tig dmar pos pus mo nub tsam du rgyas 5par gang bar byas so/ /n+ya gro dha'i phyokun dga' ra ba de yang sgyu rin thang med pa'i nor bu rin po ches chal par bkang ngo / /klu'i me tog gi 'dun nakhang rgyar 9dpag tshad drug cu yod pa/ rin po 7che sna bdun gyi ka ba dang ldan pa dag 11mngon par sprul topa/ /klu'i rol mo sil snyan dpag tu med pa dag kyang mngon par sprul te 4sgra phyung ngo / /klu'i me tog gi 'dun khang de tshal yang me tog rnam pa sna tshogs kyi lda ldi bye ba phrag dgu bcu bres so/ /rin po che sna bdun gyi ka ba de dag kyang be+e drur+ya'i dra bas legs par brgyan to/ / 'dun khang de'i gzhi layang rin thang med pa'i nor bu rin po ches yog 7par byas par gyur to/ /'dun khang de'i gzhi 1 ni 'jam pa bsgyur /du rung ba ste/ 'di lta ste/ dper na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi rdo leb ar mo nig ltar 'jam 2 tshopa kha dog be+e drur+ya ltar 'dug pa/ ka tsa lin di ka 1ltar reg na bde ba/ nyams snyedaga' ba / sems can mthong ba rnams kyi mig 2 mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba byu/mi dang lha rnams kyis yid du 'ong ba lta bu'o/ /nor bu rin po che sna tshogs de dag gi nang nas 4nor bu la la las ni me 'byung / la la las ni chu 'byung ba sha stag ste/ de la'ang la la las ni chu kha dog sngon po 'byung / la la las ni chu 42—96

kha dog ser po 'byung / la la las ni chu kha dog dmar po 'byung / la la las ni chu kha dog dkar po 'byung ’/ la la las ni chu kha dog sna tshogs 'byung ngo / /nor bu la la las ni bde bar bsil ba'i rlung 'byung / nor bu la la las ni 5de ma yin pa'i yo byad gzhan dag bsam pa bzhin du 'byung / la la ni snum gyi ribya ba byed/ la la nga ni me long gi bya ba byed de 5'khor de dag 0thams cad kyang nor bu rin po che 7de'i nang du 8snang bar gyur to/ /ser skya'i gnas na sems can gang ji snyed cig rgyu ba de dag thams cad kyang nor bu rin po che de dag gi nang du snang bar gyur te/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyis bcom ldan 'das /rnam par sprul pa'i cho 'phrul de dag rnam par sprul pa mdzad pa/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa yang nor bu rin po che de chadag gi nang na bzhugs par mthong bar gyur to/ /'dun khang gi gzhi ’ de'i 'og nas kyang klu'i mthus gdugs rnam pa sna tshogs mngon par 'thon par 2gyur to/ /rgyal mtshan 1 rnam pa sna tshogs dang / ba dan rnam pa sna tshogs dang / me tog gi lda ldi 7rnam pa sna tshogs skadang / spos kyi lda ldi rnam pa sna tshogs dang / rin po che'i lda ldi rnam pa sna tshogs dang / mu tig gi phreng ba rnam pa sna tshogs skodang / me tog brtsegs 7ma'i lda ldi rnam pa sna tshogs ’ dang / 19rta rnam pa sna tshogs dang /dril bu g.yer ga'i dra ba rnam pa sna tshogs kyang 'thon 2 par gyur to/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / nye dga' la sogs pa klu bye ba phrag dgu bcus rta de rnams sngon du dkri ste rkang gis dong nas bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ nor bu rin po che ka tsa lin di ka ltar reg na bde ba dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gtor mngon par gtor/ mngon par rab tu gtor 42—97

to / /'dun khang gi gzhi 3de nas rin po che gang dag namangon par 'thon ripa de dag thams cad kyang / bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i steng du char bzhin du bab par gyur to/ /paklu'i rol mo sil snyan 5dpag tu med pa de nedag kyang steng gi bar snang las sgra 'byin par gyur to/ /de nas klu bye ba phrag dgu bcu po de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas thal mo sbyar te / cang mi zer bar bcom ldan 'das rnam pas 7rjes su dran par byed cing mig mi 'dzums par lta nal/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi 9yon tan 'dod pa'i phyir lhag pa'i bsam pas byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs par gyur to/ /de nas de dag gis cung zad cig tu mi smra bar bcom ldan 'das kyi yon tan 7rjes su dran par byas nas so so nas bla gos phrag pa chagacig tu gzar tepa/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs lonas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de sgologs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la yan lag lngas phyag 'tshal nas tshigs su bcad pa dag gis mngon par bstod pa'i/ mtshan brgya rdzogs pa brtul zhugs legs spyad pa/ /dka' thub dgyes tshapa dri med thugs rje can/ /rin chen 'byung gnas bcas pa'i sa spangs te/ /bde gshegs khyod ni grong 7khyer mngon par byung / /lo drug bar du dka' thub dka' :snyemadzad de/ /rgyal ba khyod kyis bdud rtsi ma brnyes 19kyang / /bde gshegs khyod kyi thugs ni zhum ma gyur / /thub pa khyod kyis byang chub thugs kyis spyad/ /ji ltar 'dren pa lha mi'i bla ma khyod/ /'gro la phan bzhed dka' thub spyad mdzad de/ /'jig rten mgon po sdug bsngal btar gyur pa/ /de thos pas kyang bdag cag yid mi 42wa 98

dga' / /thub pa dbu medang spyan ni btang 5ba dang / /byang chub sems ni ji ltar sgrub dmadzad pa/ /bde bar cagashegs kyi dka' spyad thos gyur na / /de thos pas kyang bdag cag bde mi 'gyur/ /gang tshe ka ling rgyal pos phyobazod smra ba'i la/ /zhabs dang phyag dang snyan rnams gtubs nagyur te/ /de bzhin shangs bcad tshorgyal ba mi 'khrugs 7pa/ /de thos pas kyang bdag cag yid mi dga'/ /phug ron skyabs su mchis pa ma btang ste/ /gang tshe 'dren khyod srang la gcal kogyur pa/ /rgyal ba'i de thos pas kyang mi bde ste/ /bde gshegs byang chub spyod pa sdug bsngal tshem/ /bdag cag mi 'tshal ma —lags ci zhe na/ /bde bar gshegs la 'gro ba gnod bgyid 4pa/ /ngan song mun par lhung bas bde gshegs kyi/ /sdug bsngal spyod pa dran nas mi dga' lags/ /ji ltar 'jig rten 'dren pa blo 'phags dang / /bde gshegs spyod pa mi 'tshe blor gyur dang / /sgrub tshapa'i tshe na de la mi gnod pa/ /'jig rten 'dren pa spyod bde bka' stsal gsol / /mtha' yas blo mnga' bde gshegs spyod pa la/ /thub pa klu tshogs 'di dag rab tu brtson/ /ji ltar khyod kyi bka' bzhin spyod 'gyur ba/ /de ltar bde gshegs byang chub lam bstan gsol/ /rga shi ma mchis go 'phang 'thob rte'atshal zhing / /klu tshogs 'di rnams thub pa skom 2 par gnas/ /'gro ba 'di dag bde bar 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /brtul zhugs spyod bde :bde gshegs bka' stsal gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis klu'i mchod pa de dag kyang gzigs / lhag pa'i bsam pas smon lam btab pa de dag kyang thugs su chud nas de'i tshe 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /'di ni 2chos nyid de sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams gang gi tshe 'dzum pa mdzad pa de'i tshe kha dog sna tshogs dang / kha 42—99
