dog 1du ma'i 'od zer dbacom ldan 'das kyi zhal gyi sgo nas byung ste tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du mngon par 'phags nas phyir log ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug tu nub bo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rta thul /gyis de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ brtul zhugs bzang po dge sbyong thub pa'i 5rnams/ /rgyu med rgyal ba 'dzum pa mi mdzad na/ /'dren pa bde gshegs thugs rje che mnga' ba/ /mtshungs med bcom ldan 'dzum rgyu bka' stsal gsol/ /tshogs kyi slob phyodapon skye bo 'di dag ni/ /'dzum rgyu nyan 'tshal khyod kyi zhal du lta / /yid ni zhum gyur the tshom 'tshal zhing mchis/ /mkhas pa the tshom rnam par bsal nadu gsol/ /'jig rten mkhas pa ston pa shākya thub/ /de ring su zhig yid ni yongs su dga'/ /gang gis bdud kyi dbang po mthong 9gyur te/ /rmongs par bgyis nas yid mi dga' bar bgyis/ /tshogs kyi slob dpon 'dren pa su zhig gis/ /bde gshegs chos nyid yab la bsnyen bkur bgyis / /bde bar gshegs la mchod pa dam pa bgyis/ /shākya seng ge bka' stsol pathe tshom khum/ /sor bcu thal mo sbyar ba mgor bzhag cing / /'gro ba 'di dag thub pa'i zhal du lta / /tshogs kyi slob tshadapon the tshom bsal skadu gsol / /'dren pa 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i rgyu yang gsungs / /de thos skye bo 'di dag dgar gyur 7te/ /rgyal bas dgongs pa'i tshul yang rtogs par 'gyur/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i /'khor rnams tshim bgyis na/ /gzhan du mi sems nan tan gnas par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rta thul la tshigs su bcad de slar bka' stsal pa/ thub mkhas 'dren pa tshogs kyi slob tsho dpon gyis/ /tshangs 'dra yan lag brgyadam ldan gsung brjod kyis / /rta thul 42—100

skyon med sems kyis dad byos la/ /'dzum pa mdzad pa'i rgyu de mnyan par gyis0 / /klu yi bdag po 'di dag dad gyur te/ /'gro ba zil gyis mnan nas mchod pa byas/ /skye bo bde bar yongs smin bya ba'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas byang chub 'di ni yongs su tshol/ /snying rje chen pos rnam 'dren med pa yi/ /'gro ba bltas nas sdug bsngal cis mi bsten / /'gro bas byang chub rgya chen thob bya la / /'dren pa dag ni skyo bar yong mi 'gyur/ /zhi gnas dga' cab ye shes stobs ldan stobs/ /mtshan med stong pa de bzhin smon med pa5/ /rnam thar sgo gsum yongs su bsgoms nas su/ /shin tu yongs dag yid can bde bar 'gro / /'gro ba mtha' dag mnyam pa nyid rtogs te/ /gang tshe rgyal bas shes rab mtshan thos nas/ /mnyam pa'i sems dang byams dang snying rje thobatsi/ /'gro la snying rje chen po rab bskyed nas/ /snying brtse ldan pa mchog tu snying rje can / /'jig rten mkhas pa bla na med par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba de dag 'gro 7'di mtshungs bsgral nas/ /de dag dgra bcom rnam par 'dren par 'gyur/ /rtag tu bdag med tshig ni nyan byed cing / /'jig rten gtam gyi rgyud la mi 'jug49ste/ /de dag bde bar gshegs kyi 'chi 7med thob/ /de na bdud med mu stegs tshogs kyang med/ /'dren pa bde gshegs snying rje ldan pa yi/ /rgyal ba de dag 'gro ba kun mos byed/ /bde gshegs bka' dang tshig rnams thams cad dang / /bde bar gshegs kyi dgongs la mos byed 'gyur/ /srid par bde gshegs rnams kyi spyad spyod cing / /rab bder 'gro ba yongs smin byed par 'gyur/ /mtshungs med thob 12pa bde bar myur du yang / /yongs su 'tshang rgya 'chi med thob par 'gyur/ /thob nas 'gro ba dag kyang mos par 'gyur/ /42—101

skye bo kun kyang gzugs kyi mchog dang ldan/ /'gro ba thams cad bde gshegs de dag gisna/ /dgongs pa'i tshig ni mngon du shes par 'gyur/ /phyugs dang bya dang gnod sbyin mi de dag /rang byung dgongs min cung zad byed mi 'gyur/ /de dag kun du chos rtogs dran dang ldan/ /bde bar gshegs rnams 'chi med 'thob ripar 'gyur/ /de dag tshig thos sems can gang yang ni/ /bstan pa de la mi dgar 'gyur ba med/ /bde gshegs de dag gsung la dga' ba yi/ /'gro ba 'chi med yang dag thob par 'gyur/ /de tshe 'gro bas rgyal ba'i dgongs legs rtogs/ /rga ba dang ni na dang 'chi ba dang / /mya ngan smre sngags 'don las yongs su 'grol / /tshig de thos nas ngar 'dzin med par 'gyur/ /klu yi bsam pa pashākya seng ge la/ /yongs su zhus nas ji ltar de dag rnams/ /gzhal yas byang chub thob nas thub rnams kyi / /ye shes 'jug 'gyur de skad sras la 7bstan/ /klu rnams lung bstan yid du 'ong ba yi/ /rgyal ba'i gsung thos 'khor rnams yid dga' ste/ /de la yid ni rab tu zhi nagyur nas/ /dga' /ba'i yid kyis rgyal ba'i skyabs su song / /klu lung bstan pa'i le'u ste rkabargyad pa'o// //de nas grul bum bye ba phrag bcwa brgyad kyi 11lha ma yin rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / klu'i bu tshamo rnams dang / klu rnams kyi skamachod pa yang mthong / lung bstan pa yang thos nas tshim zhing mgu la yi charangs te rab tu dga' zhing dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes bonas ngo mtshar lathob par gyur te —/ 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa la shes rab kyi mnga' ’ chen po mnga' zhing /42—102

'di ltar bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa rgya 1chen po 'di lta bu byas pas kyang ngo mtshar 5du mi dgongs te/ 'di lta ste/ dper na rgya mtsho chen po ni rgya che zhing yongs su rgyas capa yin pas mtho ba'am dma' bar mi pa'agyur ro/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das kyang chos thams cad la the 'tshom mi mnga' zhing yon tan 7thams cad yongs su rdzogs la/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yangs pa mnga' bas mchod pa 'di lta bu dag bzhes kyang mtho ba'am dma' bar mi 'gyur zhing ngo mtshar nadu mi dgongs pa ni ngo mtshar shin du che'o snyam mo/ /de nas grul 9bum bye ba phrag bcwa 7brgyad po de dag gis bdag cag nyid kyi mchod pas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i phyir rin po che sna bdun gyi bla re bye ba phrag bcwa :snyebargyad mngon par sprul te/ 'di lta ste/ gser gyi skud pa'i bla re dang /dngul gyi skud pa'i bla re dang / be+e dur+ya'i glubla re dang / shel gyi bla re dang /mu tig dmar po'i bla re dang / spug gi bla re dang / rdo'i snying po'i bla re skasha stag go/ /rin po che'i bla re de dag la yang me tog sna tshogs kyi phreng ba'i lda sdi mngon par sprul te/ gser gyi skud pa'i bla re rnams la ni dngul gyi me tog gi phreng ba'i lda ldi bkye/ dngul gyi skud pa'i bla re rnams la ni gser gyi me tog gi phreng ba'i lda ldi bkye/ be+e drur+ya'i bla re tshernams la ni shel gyi me tog gi phreng ba'i lda ldi bkye/ shel gyi bla re rnams la ni be+e drur+ya'i me tog gi phreng ba'i lda ldi bkye/mu tig dmar po'i bla re rnams la ni spug gi me tog gi phreng ba'i lda ldi bkye /spug gi bla re rnams la ni mu tig dmar po'i me tog gi phreng ba'i lda ldi bkye/rdo'i snying po'i bla re rnams la ni shel gyi me tog gi phreng ba'i lda ldi bkye ba sha stag mngon par sprul to/ /shing rta bkra ba/ blta na sdug 19pa bye ba phrag bcwa 42—103

brgyad kyang mngon par sprul te// de dag kyang gser nas rdo'i snying po'i bar du'odu la/ /shing rta de dag gi steng du rin po che sna bdun gyi gdugs thur ma brgya pa gser gyi yu ba can dang / be+e drur+ya'i yu ba gcan dang / shel gyi yu ba can bye ba phrag bcwa cibargyad mngon par sprul to/ /gdugs de dag la yang trerin po che rnam pa sna tshogs 0)kyi me tog gi 7lda ldi mngon par sprul te/ 'di lta ste/3gser gyi me tog gi lda ldi dang / dngul gyi me tog gi lda ldi dang / be+e drur+ya'i me tog gi lda ldi dang / shel gyi me tog gi lda ldi dang / mu tig dmar po'i me tog gi lda ldi dang / klu'i nor bu'i me tog gi lda ldi sha stag go/ /mu tig dmar po'i dra ba dag 9kyang mngon par sprul te / de dag gis gdugs de dag dang / me tog gi phreng ba de dag gi gzungs 7byas so/ /grul bum gyi rol mo'i masil snyan dag kyang mngon par sprul to/ /shing rta de dag re re zhing yang bla re de dag re re rjes su 'brang bar gyur to/ /de nas grul bum 7de dag rin po che sna bdun gyi shing rta de dag la pazhon te/ rin po che sna bdun gyi gdugs dang / bla re dang /me tog de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la 7mngon par gtor te mchod ’ pa byed cing ske/ bcom ldan 'das la steng gi snyebar snang las lan gsum bskor to // /bskor nas 2 shing rta de dag las babs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos 1phyag 'tshal nas/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod de 2/ bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa dag gis mngon par bstod pa rte/ thams cad du yang mi bsnyengs mnga' dbang can/ /thub pa chen po mi mtho mi dma' ste/ /ri yi rgyal po lhun po'i ri 'dra ba/ /mchod pa rgya chen 'di dag bzhes sasu gsol/ /'gro ba thams cad ming dang mtshan ma dang / /satha snyad tsam mkhyen thub pa chags mi 42wa 104

mnga' / /'dren 3pa khyod kyi ting 'dzin zhi bsgrubs pas/ /shes rab ldan la 4 dregs pa yong ri mi mnga'/ /rgyal ba khyod phyokyis 'gro ba sgyu 'drar mkhyen/ /rang bzhin stong ste rmi lam dga' 7'dra dang / /chu zla nam mkha'i smig rgyu lta bur ni ske/ /bde bar gshegs pas 'gro ba 9'di dag 7gzigs / /dri za'i grong khyer ji ltar snang gyur kyang / /grong khyer de ni phyogs bcu kun na med/ /gzhan du grong khyer de ni ming tsam ste/ /de bzhin bde bar gshegs pas 'gro 'di kogazigs/ /mchod pa 'di kun brag ca : ji bzhin te/ /shing rta gdugs dang bla re sil snyan dang / /me tog rgyal mtshan sgothal mo sbyar bgyis pa/ /brag ca mji bzhin de dag de ltar gda'/ /'dren pa mchod pa 'di bgyis bdag cag kyang dzi/ /sangs rgyas rkang gnyis mchog tu myur 'gyur shog /mi lam 'dra bar 'gro ba bdag cag gis/ /rtogs bgyis rgyal ba khyod bzhin bstan par bgyi / /na 1rtedang rga shis yongs su gtses gyur pa'i/ /skye bo mthong nas bdag cag rnams kyis kyang / /byang chub myur thob 19na shi med pa'i gnas/ /gang thos grol 'gyur 'gro la bstan par bgyi / /bdag cag byang chub lam nyamachog sangs rgyas nas/ /sems can blo stor rnams la bstan par bgyi/ /thub pa 'khrugs 2 med chos rnams rab ston pa snye/ /mya ngan 'das mchog sems can bstan par bgyi/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis grul bum de dag gi 2 lhag pa'i bsam pa thugs su chud nas 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rta thul gyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ ston pa rgyu med 'dzum pa mi mdzad de/ /rnam 'dren 'jig rten mkhas la mtsharang mi mnga' /ngo mtshar 'gyur med rgyal bas 'dzum mdzad na/ /'dzum rgyu legs par 42—105

bka' stsol 37nyan par 'tshal/ /rgyal ba'i zhal nas 'dzum pa mdzad mthong nas//'gro ba 'di dag the tshom som nyi 'tshal/ /the tshom 'tshal ba rnams kyi the tshom khum / /mi yi dbang po 'dzum pa'i rgyu yang gsungs/ /gang gis de ring chos la yid bzhag gyur / /de ring gang rigs chos kyi rgyal yang mthong / /deng sus sangs rgyas bsngags pa'i mchod pa bgyis3/ /mi yi dam pa bdag ni nyan par 'tshal / /de ring 'dus byas sdug bsngal shes gyur nas/ /gang gis 'du byed gyur pa'i yid gcig bcom/ /gang zhig yang dag mtha' la mi g.yo gnas/ /rnam dag thugs mnga' bdag ni nyan par 'tshal/ /de ring su yis 0'khor bcas bdud rnams bcom/ /thub pa ston pa deng sus mnyes par bgyis / /'dren pa su zhig de ring nagating rnyed gyur / /the tshom mchis te 7deng bdag de nyan 'tshal/ /'dzum mdzad de yi don ni mnyan slad du/ /'gro ba kun kyang /nyathal mo sbyar cing gnas/ /'dren pa the tshom 'tshal ba'i the tshom sol/ /rkang gnyis dam pas lung yang bstan du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang paldan pa rta thul la tshigs su bcad de slar bka' stsal pa/ rta thul khyod kyis dri ba legs par dris/ /'dzum pa'i rgyu 'di yongs su dris pas na/ /'gro ba'i don yang 'khyod kyis byas par gyurak+ṣa/ /de don bstan byas rta thul mnyan par gyisa'i/ /grul bum tshogs kyis nga la mchod byas te/ /zhi ba'i chos la de dag yid kyang bzhag /mtshar med nga lamathong nas ni ngom 7gyur te/ /zhi ba'i chos la de dag yid kyang bzhag /de dag rnams kyis de ring nga mchod de/ /zhi ba'i chos la blo gros rnam par btang / /lam stor skye bo rnams la snying brtse zhing ske/ /bsam pa thag pas snying rje chen po bskyed/ /snying rje bas na 19nga la 42—106

mchod pa byas/ /rab tu lam stor rnams la byams par bsams1)/ /mkhas pa de dag las de 2byas pas na/ /grul bum skye gnas shi 'phos brtul zhugs bzangal/ /brgya byin lha yi drung du 'dong sgrubar 'gyur/ /thugs rje 5byams don mdzad skyob drung du'ang 'dong / /de 0ni cung zad yang dang yang bstan te//phyir zhing chos la the tshom med par 'gyur/ /de dag bskal pa gang gā'i bye thosnyed du sku/ /zhing nas zhing du rnam par rgyu byed cing / /bdag nyid chen po'i lachos la mchod pa byed/ / go cha 7chen po rab tu bges yid kyis 1/ /de dag skyo ba 7med par 'jig rten khams/she/ /khrag khrig mtha' yas rnam par spyod 7par 'gyur / /skye bo mang po'i don byed 'dren 'gyur te/ /ngo mtshar med ces bya ba'i rgyal bar 'gyur/ /de dag zhing rnams gang du 'gro rgyu ba/ /der ni 'gro bas rgyal ba byung bar shes/ /de dag thabs kyis ma 'ongs dus dag na/ /ngo mtshar gemed par skye bo rnam grol byed/ /rgyal ba ngo mtshar med par 7zhing sbyong zhing ske/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub bla med zhi ba tshol/ /de dag tshol ba la yang mi gnas te/ /'di ltar bla med byang chub gnas phyir ro/ /de ltar 'dzum rgyu rgyal bas lung bstan cing / /bde bar gshegs pas 'jig rten dogs bsal 7te/ /grul bum mchod pa'i 'bras bu nges thos nas/ /'gro ba the tshom bsal /9te dga' bar gyur tsho/ /grul bum lung bstan pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //de nas de'i tshe dri za bye ba phrag sum cu rtsa drug gis lha ma yin rnams dang /nam mkha' lding rnams dang / klu'i bu mo rnams dang / klu rnams dang /grul bum rnams kyis 2mchod pa yang mthong lung bstan pa yang thos nas tshim 42—107

zhing mgu la yi rangs nas snarab tu dga' zhing ( chodaga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes nas /ngo mtshar 4thob par gyur te/ 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pas chos kyi dbyings 'gyur ba med par 5yang yang 5dag par bka' stsal / bya ba rnams kyang yang dag par bstan te/ dge ba'i rtsa tsho ba 'phel ba yang bstan la/ chos gang la yang lung bstan pa med par yang yang dag par bstan pa 'di ni ngo mtshar 9rmad do snyam nas de dag gis chos de lta bu khong du chud de/ de bzhin gshegs pa la rim gro 7bya ba'i sems rgya chen po skyes nyanas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mos par gyur te/ rab tu dga' ba'i yid dang ldan pa de dag bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa bya ba'i maphyir brtson par 7gyur te/ glang po k+ṣiche'i rgyal po sa srung gi bu bye ba phrag sum cu rtsa drug mngon par sprul to/ /glang po che sa srung gi bu bde dag re re zhing tshamago bo 7bye ba phrag sum cu rtsa drug drug ru /mgo bo :tshore re zhing so bye ba phrag sum cu rtsa drug drug /so re re la yang rdzing bu bdun bdun / rdzing bu re re zhing yang pad ma bdun bdun/ pad ma re re zhing 'dab nyam bye ba phrag stong stong / 'dab 22ma re re zhing yangang lha'i bu mo bdun bdun / lha'i bu mo re re zhing yang 'khor rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa lha'i bdug 4spos 2 thogs pa bdun bdun zhing khepad ma'i lo ma'i mtha' mtha' na 'khod pas bskor ba mngon par sprul to/ /glang po che sa srung tshogi bu de dag gis mgo bo 0re re la yang rin po che sna bdun gyi gdugs nas rin po che sna bdun gyi dra ba dag gis gzungasam byas pa dang / rin po che sna bdun gyisaḥlda ldi bres pa'i b.rang dang ldan pa bye bang phrag sum cu rtsa drug drug mngon par sprul to/ /glang po che'i mgo thams cad la yang lha'i spos kyi bla re sna tshogs rin po che sna tshogs kyi lda 42wa 108

ldi bres pa sha stag mngon par sprul te / de nas dri za de dag glang po che sa srung gi bu bye ba phrag sum cu rtsa drug po de dag la zhon te/ lha'i rol mo 3kyisil snyan len cing nam mkha' las rgyu ste/ bcom ldan 'das la lan sum cu rtsa drug tu bskor ba byas nas lha'i tsan dan gyi phye mas bcom ldan 'das la gtor/ mngon par gtor/ mngon par rab tu gtor to/ /lha'i a ga kyiru'i phye ma dang /lha'i ta ma la'i lo com dang / ud pa la'i phye ma dang / lha'i gser phye dang /lha'i me tog man dā par ba dang / man dā por ba chen po dang / man dzu ṣa 7ka dang / man dzu ṣa ri ka chen po dang / pa ru ṣa (ka dang / pa ru ṣa 4ka chen po dang / mdog dkar dang / mdog dkar lha chen po dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gtor/ mngon par gtor/ mngon par rab tu gtor to/ /gser dang / dngul dang / be+e drur+ya dang / shel dang / spug tshadang / mu tig dmar po dang / rdo'i snying po'i me tog rnams rta dang / sprul pa'i me tog rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gtor/ mngon par gtor/ mngon par rab tu gtor to/ /spos kyi bla re de dag las chosgos kyi ngad pa'abyung ste 'gro zhing ldog go/ /lha'i spos chu rnam pa sna tshogs kyi char yang steng gi bar snang las mngon par bab po/ /spos 7chu'i char de mngon par bab pas kyang ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen po kho ra khor : yug tu dpag tshad drug cu tshun chad spos chus rdzab tu gyur te/ spos chu'i rdzab de'i dris stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rgyas par gang bar gyur nas sems can gang dag gis spos kyi dri de sna tshor bar gyuram pa dang / rol mo silas snyan de dag gi 2sgra 2thos par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 42—109

las phyir mi ldog par gyur nyuto/ /de ltar 5dri za re res kyang bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i phyir glang po che sa srung gi bu mgo bye ba phrag sum cu rtsa drug la lha'i bu 5mo glu len pa dang / gar byed pa 'khod pa dag gis phyomachod de skye bo thams cad kyang 'dun 7par byas so/ /lha'i bu mo de dag las la la ni lus kyi tshul sgyur / la la ni tsan dan dang / a ga naru dang / ta ma la'i lo ma'i phye ma 'thor la la ni lha ma yin gyi lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / spos rnam pa sna tshogs kyi phye ma 'thor/ la la ni me tog man dā smyor ba dang / man dā khor ba chen po nas/ skya snar khra bo dang / skya snar bkra chen gyi nyabar gyi me tog dang / sprul pa'i me tog rnams 'thor/ la la ni gser gyi pame tog nas rdo'i snying po'i bar gyi me tog dang / dbyig dang / gser dang / rin po che snyim pas : blangs te/bcom ldan 'das la mngon par 'thor/ la la ni na bza' dag 'thor/ la la ni zhabs kyi rgyan cidang / sku rags dzadang / gser gyi phreng ba rin po ches spras pa'i bar dag 'bul 7lo/ /la la ni gser gyi dra ba dag 'dzin/ la la ni rin po che thams cad kyi rgyal mtshan 7dang / rin po che'i ba dan kha dog sna tshogs dang / tshon sna tshogs can 'dzin/ la la ni lha'i spos chu'i char 'bebs te / lha ma yin gyi bu mos tshigs su bcad pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod pa'i bar du 19snga ma bzhin no/ /de nas dri za de dag glang po che'i rgyal po sa srung gi bu de dag la zhon nas/ bcom ldan 'das la bskor 2ba byed byed pa las glang po che sa srung rigi bu de dag las babs te/ yang bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te thal mo sbyar nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod de / bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su 42—110

bcad pa dag gis mngon par bstod pa1/ bcom ldan bde gshegs srid pa namathar 'byin pa/ /srid pa'i bcings las 'gro ba rnam grol mdzad/ /khyod 'dra srid gsum gang na'ang ma mchis te/ /khyu mchog khyod ni gzugs dang mtshan snemachog mnga'/ /mi mchog khyod kyis sa chen 'di steng cadu/ /grags pa mtha' yas mnga' bas ngo mtshar bstan/ /'gyur bgyid chos ni gang yang ma mchis la/ /dge ba'i tshogs la 'gro sgrub rab tu bkod/ /bde gshegs 'gyur ba med pa'i de bzhin nyid/ /brjed rmepa tsam ste gzhan ni ci 7ma mchis/ /tha snyad gdags dang tha snyad 'dogs ma mchis/ /'on kyang bde gshegs khyod ni 'gro ba sbyang 7kyi/ /bde bar lagashegs pas ’ song med 'ong 1 med dang / /gnas med rang bzhin gyis ni stong pa dang / /chos rnams 'di dag rang bzhin med ces bstanam / /rgyal ba mchog gis bya ba rnams kyang bstan/ /chos rnams gang yang bya ba byed sgom mchis/ /'jig rten gtso bos 5bya ba'ang yongs su bstan/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi yon tan mi dgongs lasko/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bgyi ba kun kyang bstan/ /shing rta'i 7yan lag rnam 18pa sna tshogs dag /bdag dang gzhan gyi //yon tan mi sems kyang / /shing rta'i bgyi ba dag kyang bgyid par 'gyur / /de bzhin chos kun bde bar gshegs pas gsungs/ /chos ni chos la yongs su skul 1mi bgyid/ /chos ni chos la dran par bgyid ma mchis/ /chos rnams chos la nye bar mi rten te/ /chos rnams gang yang ma skyes 'chi snyem mchis / /'gro ba 'di dag kun 2 rdzob mngon par gsungs sku/ /kun rdzob de yang de na sam mchis te/ /'gro ba 'di 2 kun kun rdzob ji bzhin zhes/ /tshogs kyi slob spyadapon khyod kyis yongs dag gsungs/ /mig gi yorang bzhin gang 42—111

na'ang ma mchis la/ /bde bar gshegs pas bya ba rnam par gzhagazhu /chos tshul 'di 'dra yongs su bstan pas tshanan/ /'jig rten mkhas pas shin tu ngo mtshar rimadzad/ /de bzhin bdag cag bde gshegs nyid gyur dkyite/ / nor ba'i 5'gro ba blo 'gros stor ba 3rnams/ /chos kyis chos kyi tshul la gzung phya bgyis te/ /zhi ba'i go 'phang 'chi 9med thob par bgyi/ /rnam par 'dren pa khyed dzini ci 'dra bar/ /'dren pa bde gshegs grags pa mtha' yas pa/ /thugs rje ldan pa phan bzhed 'jig rten mkhas/ /bsod nams brgya yi mtshan dang ldan par shog /ji ltar bde gshegs khyod bzhin bdag cag gis/ /nga rgyal bsgribs : pa'i 'gro ba sdug bsngal ba/ /'dod pa'i yon tan rgyun gyi rjes 'gro ba/ /mngon dga' sdug bsngal brgyad ldan payongs su dgrol/ /ji ltar bde gshegs khyod bzhin bdag cag gis/ /'gro ba sdug bsngal gnod pa myong 'gyur la/ /g.yo payi zhags pas zin cing mu ma mthong / /yongs 'thom ruspre'u ltar rgod pa yongs su dgrol/ /ji ltar bde gshegs khyod bzhin bdag cag gis / /'gro ba mi mkhas mig dang bral ba 6yi/ /lha tshogs yongs skyo gnyid 8kyis log gyur cing / /bdag nyid las kyi 'bras bu chud gzon rdzidagrol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dri za bye ba phrag sum cu rtsa drug po de dag gi 12lhag pa'i bsam pa thugs su chud nas 'dzum pa mdzad do rte/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rta thul gyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcadamu tshode gsol pa/ bde gshegs mtha' yas gzigs pas 2 'dzum pa mdzad/ /'dren pa rgyu ma mchis par mi 'dzum na/ /bde gshegs 'dzum pa'i rgyu ni myur du gsungs/ /nem nur gnod gyur 2 rnams kyi the tshom sol/ /bde gshegs khyod kyi zhal gyi 'dzum mthong nas//42—112

skye bo 'di dag the tshom rnyed par 'gyur1/ /'dzum pa'i don ni de dag nyan par 'tshal/ /thub chen 'gro ba'i nathe tshom bsal du gsol/ /bde bar gshegs kyi bstan rtsol su zhig zhugs/ /the tshom bral zhing som nyi bsal 5bar gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gang gi bsam mkhyen nas/ /mi yi mchog gis 'dzum pa bstan pa mdzad/ /su zhig bde gshegs bka' stsal tshul bzhin du/ /blo gros rtogs pa chos rmebazhin gnas par gyur/ /gang gis blo gros dran rtogs blo mkhyen nas/ /bde gshegs 'gro ba'i nang du 'dzum pa mdzad/ /'gro ba 'di dag blo gzhan yongs btang ste/ /bde gshegs 'dzum don zhal nas thos 8par dga'atho / /sor bcu thal sbyar mgo 7la bzhag bgyis shing / /dga' ba'i yid kyis ston pa'i zhal du lta/1/ /nyon mongs bral zhing mya ngan rab spangs pa/ /dgyes 8pa'i thugs mnga' thub chen 'jig rten mig /'gro ba'i 12yid gnyis som nyi bsal 7du gsol/ /rgyal ba thugs rje ldan pas 'dzum rgyu gsungs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rta thul la tshigs su bcad de slar 15bka' stsal pa/ 'gro ba'i don du 'dzum pa ngas mdzad 7pa/ /khyod kyis don dris 'thun zhing legs pa ste/ /'dzum pa de yi don ni lung bstan pas / /skye bo'i tshogs chen don ni de ring 'phel/ /'dzum mdzad rgyu de rta thul mnyan par gyis rte / /rnam par 'dren pas 19'dzum pa 'di mdzad pa/ /de ni ma log par yang ngas bstan gyis/ /bstan pa de la dga' ba'i sems kyis nyon/ /dri za 'di rnams chos kyi rjes snyegs shing nya/ /bde bar gshegs la mchod pa 'di dag byas/ /chos nyid byung 2 bar gyur pa 2med pa ste thu/ /chos nyid zad par 'gyur ba'angakemed pa yin/ /rgyal ba rnam rtog sgyu ma lta bur gnas/ /rtog 42—113

par mi byed de dag rmongs par 'gyur/ /gang gis chos gang rjes su brjod bya ba//des ni de nyid stong zhes bde gshegs gsungs1tsho/ /de dag nga yi tshig de 5rtogs gyur nas/ /rta med glang po mchog gis mchod pa byas/ /byang chub rga med 'chi med tshol byed cing / /dri za'i rgyal po rnams kyis nga mchod do/ /nor ba'i 'gro la snying rje bskyed nas ni/ /thams cad mkhyerne pa nyid du 'di dag mos/ /'di dag nga la mchod pa 'di byas pas / /dri za'i ris bor dga' ba'i 5yid gyur te/ /blo gros bzang rnams lha gnas 3lha yul ba/ /brgya byin lha 'dus par ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de dag sangs rgyas bde 7gshegs rdul med pad / /bye ba khrag khrig mang la mchod byed 'gyur/ /zhing nas zhing du rjes su rgyu byed cing ske/ /de dag la ni mkhas pa chos kyang nyan / /de dag bde gshegs spyod pa 7yongs su sbyong 1/ /de dag zhing yang rtag dpar yongs dag 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin de dag sems can ni/ /khrag khrig mang po dag la byang chub ston snye/ /'gro ba 'di dag rang bzhin stong rig nas/ /bde gshegs 'gro ba dag la ston par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen cing likun gzigs pa/ /rdul med bskal pa khrag khrig bzhugs dpar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas mtshan ni mtha' yas rtogs pa stel/ /sangs rgyas re re khrag khrig phrag mang ba'i/ /bskal pa rnams su rdul med gnas par 'gyur/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam 'di 7rjes su ston / /rgyal ba thub pa nyon mongs bcom pa yis/ /de ltar de tshe dri zas mchod lung bstan/ /rta thul gyis ni 'dzum pa'i don zhus pa/ /dri za lung bstan pa ni bshad pa mdzad snye/ /dri za lung bstan yid du 'thad 3tshe'agyur ba / /de thos nas ni 'gro ba thams cad dga'/ /der ni bde bar gshegs kyi 2242—114

gsung thos nasame/ /shākya thub la thams cad 2skyabs su dong / /dri za lung bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// // 'phags pa yab dang sras mjal ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po lnga pa/ de nas gnod sbyin bye ba phrag brgyad cus lha ma yin rnams nas dri za'i bar de dag gi rimachod pa yang 5mthong / lung bstan pa yang thos nas tshim zhing mgu la yi rangs te/ rab tu dga' zhing dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes 7nas bcom ldan 'das kyi shes rab kyi rnam pa la 9rim gro ’ chen po bskyed de chos nyid la 'jug pa ’ yang thos pas maston pa'i 'du shes skyes 12par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyang blo zad mi shes pa'i 'du shes skyes 7par gyur tem / de dag gi sabacom ldan 'das blo zad mi shes pa zhes bya bar rig nas sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la 'dod ’ pa skyes 8par gyur to rte/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la 'dod pa skyes par gyur nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i phyir brtson par gyur te/ tshigs su bcad pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod pa/ mngon shes stobs ni kun du mtha' yas te 2/ /rgya mtsho chu 'dzin pas ma 'tshal dang 'dra rmi/ /de bas mtshungs med 'jig rten phan mdzad pa/ /mi yi seng ge 25khyod la 'di ltar bstod/ /ri rab srang snyol gzhal bar nus kyang gda'/ /gzi brjid chen po nam mkha' gzhal rung gda'/ /shes rab mchog mnga' bde gshegs ye shes stobs/ /tshad gzung dpag 2 par nus pa yong ma mchis/ /'gro ba kun gyi bsam pa thugs su chud/ /skye 2bo drang rung mi rung gdul 0min pa/ /de dag las kyi rnam pa mngon par mkhyen/ /de 42—115

bas mtshungs med kun tu mtha' yang yas/ /de dag ci 'dra'i khams la bsten pa dang / /de dag sems rgyud ci na'adrar 'byung ba dang / /de dag mos pa ci 'dra ma lus mkhyen/ /de bas mtshungs med kun tu mtha' yang yas/ /'dod chags spyod dang de bzhin zhe snang spyod/ /mi yi gti mug spyod pa de bzhin mkhyen//phrag 5)dog rnam pa'ang cade bzhin mkhyen pa ste/ /de bas mtshungs 5med kun tu mtha' yang yas / /'gro ba 'di dag lam rgyud gar 'khyams pa/ /de dag mtshungs rtsomed khyod kyis rab tu mkhyen/ /de la ye shes rgyun tu rab 'byung tho bas / /de bas mtshungs chamed kun tu mtha' /nyayang yas/ /bde bar gshegs pas 'gro 7kun rab tu gzigs/ /chud za'i lam rgyud bigang du 'khyams gyur cing dzha/ /byams pa'i stobs las rab tu nyams gyur pa/ /de dag ma lus khyod kyis rab tu gzigs/ /'gro ba rnams ni ji srid dus gnas shing / /ci 'dra'i sdug bsngal de dag reg 'gyur dang / /lus kyi rnam pa ci 'dra 'chang ba rnams/ /de dag 'dren pa khyod kyis rab tu gzigs/ /mi yi seng ges lta ba ci 'dra dang //gang gis sdug bsngal rnam pa sgo'athob 'gyur bar/ /gang la rten cicing las rnams bgyid 'gyur ba/ /de dag rnams kyang 'dren pas rab tu gzigs/ /de dag rgyal ba'i bstan la rab byung ste/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo ni gang zhig gis/ /ci 'dra'i lam la de dag bsten skyabagyis shing / /ci 'dra'ipha zhi ba 'thob 'gyur khyod kyis mkhyen/ /byis pa gang rnams bde gshegs bstan pa la/ /rab tu byung zhing 'jig rten mkhas pa yis snye/ /bstan pa rab phra 9ji ltar spong 'gyur ba / /de dag rnams kyang 'dren pas rab tu gzigs/ /'jig rten phan pa'i bstan la brnyas bgyis pas/ /dmyal ba chen por 1ji srid gnas pa dang / /42wa 116

ci 'dra'i sdug bsngal de dag myong 'gyur ba/ /de dag rnams kyang 'dren pas rab tu gzigs/ /gang dag rgyal ba rnams la dad bskyed de/ /rab tu byung nas rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin cing / /chos kun stong pa nyid du rab 5brtags nas/ /mtshan ma thams cad rnam par gzhig bgyis shing / /'gro rgyud kun tu smon pa rnam mispangs te/ /lus 'di sgyu ma 'dra bar rab brtags nas/ /phung po brag cane'adra bar rtogs gyur te/ /byang chub sems ldan de dag rab tu gzigs/ /mgon po khyod la bstod 5pa'i bsod nams gang / /mtshungs med khyod kyis ji ltar thugs chud pa/ /de 0yis bla med sangs rgyas 'grub 7par shog /'gro ba kun kyang rang byung thob gyur cig /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe gnod sbyin bye ba phrag brgyad cu po de dag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa thugs su chud 1)nas 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rta thul gyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ mi yi seng ges 'dzum pa 'di mdzad pa/ /mi yi zla ba rang byung 7gyur pa ni/ /rgyu ma mchis par 'dzum pa mi mdzad na/ /'dzum pa de yi rgyu ni bka' stsal dgasol/ /ston pa'i zhal nas 'dzum pa de mthong nas/ /bcom ldan 'jig /rten 'di dag the tshom 'tshal/ /mgon pos de dag the tshom bsal du gsol/ /'jig rten 'di dag dga' ba'i yid du 'gyur/ /de ring su zhig rgyal la dad pa skyed/ /gang gis chos rgya chen po rnam par rtogs/ /gang gi 5sems ni mi skul riganas par gyural/ /de dag rgyal bas 'gro ba bstan du gsol/ /de ring 7'khor rnams the tshom che 'tshal zhing / /kun kyang rgyal ba'i zhal du lta 19zhing sdod / /ci nas the tshom 2 ma mchis kun 'gyur ba/ /de ltar dpa' bos the tshom bsal du gsol/ /de ring 42—117

'di ni gang gi 1rnam 'phrul lags/ /gang gis brtson 'grus bzang po 'diralabastan lags/ /gang zhig khyod dang 'dir mjal ridon mchis gyurang / /de ni legs par 'gro la bka' su55 gsol/ /rgyal ba 'gro ba dag la phan bzhed pa/ /the tshom 'tshal ba'i 5yid gnyis legs bsalas gsol/ /de thos lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten rnams/ /dga' zhing mgu 7ba dag kyang 'thob par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rta thul la tshigs su bcad de slar bka' stsal pa/ rta thul khyod kyis dri ba legs par dris/ /de ring 'gro ba dag gi don chen nabyas/ /rang byungs 'dzum 7mdzad rgyu ni dris pas na/ /ston pa'i dgongs pa'ang khyod kyis legs par mthong / /de dag lung bstan ma lus bstan par byas / /gnod sbyin tshogs kyi payid ni gzigs gyur 12nas/ /'gro la phan pa'i don du 'dzum mdzad pa/ /dad pa'i yid kyis rta thul mnyan par gyis//rgyal ba'i byang chub zhi ba shes gyur nas/ /gnod sbyin tshogs kyis mos pa'i sems bskyed de/ /'byung po'i tshogs dbus sangs rgyas bstod labyas nas/ / rang byung dam pa mchog tu niyid kyang btang / /chos rnams stong pa nyid du shes bya dang / /mtshan ma thams cad rnam par gzhig 7pa'i phyir/ /'gro ba kun tu smon pa rnam 7spangs shing / /byang chub mchog tu de dag yid kyang btang / /rnal 'byor stobs kyis rta phung po rnam 9bshig cing / /kun rdzob tsam du rig nas mi chags te/ /srid pa kun tu chu la pad mo 3 bzhin/ /byang chub mchog tu de dag yid kyang btang / /de dag srid pa gang du chags 'gyur 1ba/ /stong par bshig ste thams cad legs rtogs pa/ /de nyid rgyal ba'i bla med byang chub ste/ /byang chub phyir ni dben pa'i brtul zhugs shes/ /skye dang rga shi yong gis stong pa 42—118

ste / /de ni rgyal ba'i bla med byang chub yin/ /dngos po'i rang bzhin stong par shes gyur nas/ /zhi ba bla med byang chub 'thob 1par 'gyur/ /phung po'i rang bzhin dben zhing stong pa nyid/ /byang chub rang bzhin dben nazhing stong pa nyid / /gang spyod de yang rang bzhin stong pa ste/ /ye shes ldan pas shes kyi byis pas min/ /ye shes rang bzhin stong par rig gyur te / /shes bya'i rang bzhin stong par rig gyur nas/ /shes pa po dang 'dra bar rtogs gyur na / /byang chub lam la de dag spyod ces bya/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin stong par shes par bya/ /mtshan ma med pa'ang rang bzhin nyid kyis stong / /smon pa med pa'ang rang bzhin stong pa ste/ /de ltar spyod na gzhan 5min spyod pa yin/ /de thos lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten rnams/phyo /dga' zhing de dag stobs dang ldan par gyuran / /rang byung chos la de dag yid ches te/ /zhi ba'i gnas shes byang chub yid ldan gyur/ /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams deng mos yid gyur te/ / 'di ltar nga gel mchod pa rab byas pas/ /gnod sbyin rgyud nas shi 'phos blo chen 7rnams / /mtho 11ris dong zhing yun ring bodaga' bar 'gyur/ /de dag ma 'ongs dus na rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /zhing du dong zhing skad cig gcig la yang / /blo chen lode dag rgyal ba bye ba mchod/ /de dag bzod mkhyen rgyal ba gdams changag ston / /de dag 'jig rten phyogs bcur rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /mtshan ma med par spyod cing 'dong 'gyur 5te/ /'jig rten 'di dag sprul pa 'drar shes nasas/ /'jig rten chags med mkhas pa spyad pa spyod/ /de ltar brten 7pas rgyal ba rab mchod :snyenas/ /byang chub bla med de yang lha thob 'gyur te/ /de dag rnams kyi zhing ni 5 mtha' yas 'gyur/ /sems can mtha' yas pa dag rnam par 42—119

'grel/tsho/ /sangs rgyas mkhyen pa dmatha' yas grags pa can/ /de dag ming ni 'jig rten mkhas rishes bya/ /zhi ba'i blo ldan rgyal ba de dag gi/ /tshe tshad bskal pa stong ni tshang bar 'gyur/ /de dag nyan thos dge 'dun 'byung ④ba ni/ /rgyal sras mang po skar ma'i tshogs snyed ri de/ /kun kyang bde bas rgyabasam pa thob par 'gyur/ /'jig rten mkhas pa rnams la sdug bsngal med/ /de skad thos nas lhar bcas 'jig rten dag /rab tu dga' ba'i sems kyis byang chub tshol//ngoms par gyur nas brtson 'grus ri brtan brtsams te/ /kun kyang brtson 'grus stobs kyis brtan par gyur / /gnod sbyin lung bstan pa'i le'u ste/bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas mi 'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa la sogs tshapa mi 'am ci bye ba phrag brgyad kyis lha ma yin gyi nyamachod pa de dag dang / gnod 7sbyin gyis tshamachod pa'i bar dag kyang skamathong / lung bstan 8pa yang thos nas shin tu ngo mtshar 'thob par gyur te / khyod 'di ltar sems can yang mi dmigs la 3)srog dang / skye ba po 19dang / shedab las skyes ri 7dang / shed bu dang / gang zag dang / bdag dang ske/ bdag gi yangam gang yang med la phung po dang / khams dang / skyem —mched gang la sems can zhes thugadags pa'i phung po dang / khams dang / skyesamached de dag kyang mi dmigs/ las gang yod pas rnam par smin pa sagadags par bya ba'i las de yang mi dmigs/ byang chub kyang mi dmigs/ byang chub sems dpa' yang mi dmigs snye/ sangs rgyas kyang mi dmigs la/ 'on kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' lung bstan pa mdzad pa 'di ni0rto42—120

ngo mtshar nyarmad do/ /ci zhig las dgongs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' rnams misangs rgyas su 'gyur ro rizhes lung bstanas pa mdzad/ci zhig las 3)dgongs te byang chub sems dpas yang dag par bsgrub 0pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi che ba nyid dang / sems can yongs su smin pa medang / zhing gi —3bkod pa dang / der skye 3zhing yongs su dag pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams zhing nas zhing du 'dong ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mchod 8pa dang / mchod pa de'i / mthu dang / sems can rnam par rkedagod pa dang /bskal pa 'di snyed nicig gis sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro zhes bya ba dang / bskal pa 'di snyed cig tu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi nyan thos 'dus pa ni 'di snyed cig tu 'gyur ro zhes bya ba dang / de dag yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas dam pa'i chos bskal tshapa 'di snyed cig tu gnas par 'gyur ro zhes de bzhin gshegs pas lung bstan pa mdzad / ci zhig las 18dgongs te sems can rnams nye bar len pa med pas mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa mdzad snyam ste/ de nas mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa /6de lta bu'i the tshom skyes 2 nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btudamu de/ bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis zhu ba zhus pa/ rgyal ba'i gsung ni thos gyur nas/ /shes rab che mnga' bdag dogs skyes / /stong pa nyid dang lung bstan pa/ /bde gshegs bdag gis de 22ma 'tshal / /gsung ba'i zla ba chos kyi dbyings/ /'gyur ma mchis la stong pa dang —/ /rang bzhin med gsungs ji lta bu/ /mchod pa 'di ci sagang zag 42—121

mchog /skye ba'ang ma mchis byang chub tu/ /sems bskyed pa ni ji lta bu/ /skyes bu mchog gis bka' stsal pa'i/ / ldem po ngag 17de bdag ma 'tshal/ /mi dbang bdag po ji ltar na / /'gag pa ma mchis 'chi 'pho gsung / /de ni yang dag lung bstan pas/ /thub pa bdag gi /the tshom khum/ /sgyu ma 'dra la lhar 4skye zhes/ /gsungs pa de ni ji salta bu/ /ldem por gsungs pa 'di dag kyang ske/ /shākya seng ge bdag ma 'tshal/ /gnas pa'ang yemachis pa ma lags la/ /dge bshes bsten gsung ji lta bu/ /ldem por gsungs pa 'di dag kyang / /skyes bu khyu namachog bdag ma 'tshal/ /g.yo 9ba'ang ma mchis bgyi ba rnams/ /rkang gnyis mchog gsung rkaji lta bu/ /ldem por gsungs pa 'di dag kyang / /dgra bsal bcom ldan bdag ma 'tshal lha/ /rang bzhin stong ste stong pa yang / /rtogs zhes mgon gsung ji lta bu/ /the tshom rnam pa 'di 'dra skyes/ /shes rab dpe pamed bdag ma 'tshal/ /zhi ba yod ces bka' stsal pa/ /chos kun zhi gsungs ji lta bu/ /mtshungs med 'di 'dra'i ldem po dag /bdag la rnam par bstan du gsol/ /sku mdzes gyur kyang chos kyi rnams/ /nam mkha' pa'adrar gsungs ji lta bu/ /chos ni rab tu spang babagyis na/ /mi mkhas mdamyal ltung 8 ji lta bu / /brtan pa mtho /ris 'jig rten dang / /'gro ba gzhan sna yang gsungs pa dang / /las de bgyid pa ma mchis la/ /rang las can gsungasang ji lta bu/ /bka' stsal tshul 'di rnam 22pa yang / /zil gyis mi non 22bdag ma 'tshal / /mgon po de la bdag dogs na/ /bde gshegs bdag gi 4the tshom sol / /dge ba'i tshogs gyur rim mchis la/ /byang chub yang dag bsgrub pa'angs gsungs / /dge sbyong rgyal po'i gsung gi tshul/ /de skadas bka' stsal bdag ma 42—122

'tshal/ /chos rnams zad 1pa med gsungs la/ /spong byed las ni zad bstan pa/ /tshad med blo mnga' 'di la yang / /bdag ni yid gnyis the tshom 'tshal/ /yang dag mtha' yang bka' stsal la/ /ma nor sbyin pa'ang ribastan mdzad pa/ /'di yang rab rib bral ba yi/ /spyan mnga' sdig spangs bstan du gsol / /thams cad gzigs pa ma gtogs par / /gzhan gyis bdag gi the tshom 'di/ /sel nus ma mchis de lta bas/ /bdag ni rgyal ba mchog la dad/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pas 5the tshom dris pa 'di dag gsan nas de la lan gdab pa'i phyir mi 'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa 5la tshigs su bcad de slar bka' stsal pa/ stong pa nyid dang lung bstan pa/ /bdag gis ma 'tshal ces smras pa/ /gal te 'ga' zhig mi stong na/ /rgyal bas de lung bstan mi gsung / /ci 9phyir zhe na 'di 7lta bur / /rang gi rang bzhin gnas gyur nas/ /'gyur ba med cing ther zug ste/ /de la 'phel med 'grib pa med / /tshame long shin tu 5yongs dag la/ / ji ltar rang bzhin med pa yi/ /d+kugazugs brnyan snang ba de bzhin du/ / sngon pa 7chos rnams shes par gyis / /chos kyi dbyings ni 'gyur med na/ /mchod pa'i yan lag 'gyur gang zhes/ /yan lag rnams la brtag byos la/ / ljon pa :dzomachod pa 'di la dpyod / /chos dbyings rnam pa 1thams cad du/ /'gyur med skye bo mkhas pas rtogs/ /byis pa rnams ni 'di 2la 'khrul snye/ /blo sbyangs pas ni med par shes/ /skye ba'ang rtenam mchis sems kyang bskyed/ /de ni ma 'tshal ces smras pa/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i ldem po ridag /gzhan du ma sems mnyan par gyis / /byis pas 'khor bar dga' ba'i 8rnams/ /'khor bar mngon dga' sems zhen pa/ /42—123

log pa'i sems dang 'du shes can/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal myong bar gyuratshi/ /de dag sngon cad ma thos pa'i/ /sems med chos ni ngas bshad na/ /byis pa'i blo dang ldan pas rnams/ /'di la kun tu rmongs par 'gyur/ /byang chub gzhol ba'i sems nyid dang / /byang chub phan yon thos gyur nas/ /zil gyis ma non rang byung gsems/ /rgya chen de ni thob par 'gyur/ /'gag pa ma mchis 'chi 5'pho ba/ /de yang ma 'tshal ces smras pa/ /'chi 'pho yang dag lung bstan gyisashi/ /gzhan du ma sems mnyan par gyisari / /gang dag rtag 'dzin de dag la/ /'di la mi 'gyur ther zug med/ /dngos po 'di dag mi rtag ces/ /bde gshegs 'chi 'pho rnam par ston/ /sgyu ma 'dra la lhar skye btso / /ji lta bu zhes dogs gyur pa/ /mthar phyin ma gyur slob 7pa dang / /skye bo rnams la mtho ris bshad/ /gnas pa'ang /tsho1yod pa ma yin la/ / dge bshes bsten 7ces gang smras pa rte/ /gnas dang bral bar bya ba'i phyir/ /gnas pa med pa'i dge bshes bstenache/ /g.yo 8ba ma tshamachis bgyi ba rnams/ /bstan pa ma 'tshal mazhes smras pa/ /shing rta'i yan lag 'dus pa dang / /shing rta'i /bya ba gzhan lha du rtogs/ /mi gang bdag yodamu)khas len cing / /bya ba'ang bdag gis byas zin 2pa/ /de dag la ni bya ba dang / /g.yong ba med par bde gshegs bshad/ /rang bzhin stong ste stong pa yang / /rtogs zhes nga yis gang smras pa/ /byis pa log pa'i blo can rnams/ /rang bzhin stong par༄nyemi shes pa/ /de dag rnams la bstan pa'i phyir/ /rang bzhin stong zhes bde gshegs ston rdo/ /kun tu rtog sapa'i rtog tsho 9pas bskyed/ /yang dag ma yin rtog pas bcings/ /zhi ba yod cing chos kun kyang / /zhi bar mthong zhesamanya42—124

smras pa ni/ /mi shes rmongs par gyur rnams kyis / /kun tu rtog las sred pa skyes/ /skom pas ji ltar smig 0rgyu la/ /kun tu rtog pas skom 4pa skye/ /mi mkhas des da ni rtog 0pa'i rgyu/ /yod pa min la log par brtags/ /chu yin par ni mthong gyur kyang / /smigate rgyu la ni chu med do/ /de bzhin yongs su rtog pas dkrugs ni/ /sdugam pa min la sdug par rtog /byis pa pa'adod chags ldan pa dag /sdug dang ldan pa /rterang bzhin gyis/ /sdug med smig rgyu chochu bzhin te/ /smig rgyu la ni 'chu med do/ /de bzhin gzugs la sdug sapa med/ /gzugs de sdugapha pa ma yin na/ /byis pa log pa'i 'du shes can/ /sdug par rtogamo/3pas bcings par gyur/rte/ /chos rnams nam mkha' 'dra ba dang / /spong ba dmyal ltung zhes smras pa/ /med pa mthong bar ma gyur pa/ /mi mkhas rnams ni skrag⑩par 'gyur/ /rang bzhin ngo bo nyid stong na/ /bdag zhen dus ni mi shes pa/ /de dag stong zhes thos gyur na/ /bdag med 'gyur zhes skrags /pa skye//de dag bdag tu mngon zhen te/ /nam mkha' la ni mdud 22bor nas/ /stong pa gya rnam spong byed de/ /mi mkhas sems dmyal chen por lhung snye/ /mtho ris 'jig rten (rungs bstan dang / /skye bo'i 2 'gro rgyud gzhan dag dang / /las kyang ngas ni bstan byas te/ /byed pa po ni rab tu bkags /yang dag tu ni0 sna'agro ba dag /rmi 'drar bshad par shes par gyis rte/ /rmi lam gang la'ang dngos po med/ /log pa'i blo ldan mngon par zhen/ /ngas ni las kyi rnam pa bstan/ /byed pom phyogs bcu rnams na med/ /shing rnams rlung gis bsgulam ba las/ /me 'byung 'gyur ba ji bzhin no/ /bdag cag me 'dir bskyed bya zhes / /rlung dang shing la sems pam med/ /'on kyang me ni 'byung ba ltar/ /42—125

las kyi byed po 3)de bzhin no/ /bsod nams tshogs ni yod min la/ /byang chub yang dag bsgrub 5pa dang / /legs spyad yod ces ri zer ba ni/ /de tshul yang dag mnyan par byos/ /mi yi tshe tshad lo brgya ste/ /de srid 'tsho 4zhes brjod mod kyi/ / lo la 5phung por spungs pa med/ /sgrub phyopa de yang de dang mtshungs ske/ /zad pa med ces gang smras dang / /las zad ces ni ngas smras pa//stong pa'i tshul du zad pa med/ /tha snyad tshul du zad par bstan/ /yang dag mtha' ni ngas bshad pa/ /phyin 8ci log de'ang /yang dag mtha'/ /log pa'i blo can byis pa rnams/ /yang 7dag mtha' ni mi shes so/ / mtshan nyid thams cad gcig nyid de/ / 1mtshan nyid med par shes pa yi/ /ye shes lam du zhugs rnams kyi/ /nges pa ljon pa 5khyod nyon cig /yi ge gcig gis 'jug pa yi/ /byang chub blo ldan rnams la bstan / /chos rnams thams cad ma gebyas pa / /a yi sgo yi gzungs su bstan/ /de ltar spyod pa byed rnams la/ /mtshan nyid mtha' yas ngas bstan te5/ /'di 'dra'i tshul la 'jug pa ni/ /a yi sgo yi gzungs su bstan/ /chos rnams thams cad 'gag med pa/ /a yis pachos 7la 'jug par bstan/ /a yi sgo 1 yi gzungs bstan pa/ /de yang ljon pas 9shes par gyis / /chos rnams rnam par rtog nyamed pa/ /de yang chos la 'jug par gsungs/ /chos kun 'gyur ba med pa 2 yang / /a ni chos kunang sgo mor bstan / /a yi sgo yi gzungs 'di dag / ljon pa 'di kyiltar shes par gyis 5/ /mi zad pa dang zad smras pa/ /chos kun mi zad brjod bya ste/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba thams cad kyis/ /mi zad sgo yi gzungs su bstan/ /chos rnams kun la sgo med de/ /de dag med pas sgo mi 'byung / /'di :yang gzungs kyi sgo 42—126

yin te/ /a la brten /tshonas 'jug par bya/ /chos kun bsam gyis mi khyab ces / /yang dag ji bzhin bde gshegs bstan/ /a yi sgo yi gzungs bstan pa / /'di ri yang sngon pas rko 7shes par gyis / /chos kun lus med byang chub ces / /blo ldan rnams la ngas bstan pa/ /'di yang gzungs kyi sgo yin te/ /a la brten nas 'jug par bya/ /chos rnams 'ong ba med pa ste/ /med pas de dag 'ong 5ba'ang med/ /'di yang gzungs kyi sgo 5yin te/ /a la brten nas 'jug par bya/ /chos rnams gdags pa med pa ste / /med pas de dag gdags pa med/ /'di yang gzungs kyi sgo yin te/ /a la brten nas 'jug par bya/ /chos rnams rang bzhin med pa ste/ /med pas de dag rang bzhin med/ /'di yang gzungs kyi sgo yin te/ /bde bar gshegs pas gzungs su bstan / /gzungs kyi sgo mo nga las 7nyon/ /chos ’ kun yid la bya ba med/ /'di yang gzungs kyi sgo yin sted/ /bde bar gshegs pas gzungs su bstan/ /med phyir chos kun sgrib med ces/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bstan mdzad pa/ /'di yang gzungs kyi sgo yin te/ /a la brten nas shes par bya/ /chos kun thogs pa med pa ste/ /thogs par bya ba de mi tshadamigs/ /'di yang gzungs kyi sgo yin te/ /a la brten nas 'jug par bya/ /chos rnams thams cad ma skyes par/ /mkhas pas mtshan nyid gcig shes bya/ /chos rnams gang dag ma skyes pa/ /de dag ming med shes par bya/ /chos rnams yang dag ma yin te / /de dag ma lus rang bzhin med/ /'di yang gzungs kyi sgo yin te/ /a la brten nas shes par bya/ /gang dag ma skyes ma byung ba/ /de dag mthong k+ṣimed skabastan par bya/ /lta ba po ni med pa dang / /de dag rnams kyang med phyir 42—127

ro / /chos kun mnyam kyi med de cibs na/ /mtshan nyid gcig cing mtshan gzhil med / /nam mkha' dang tri ni 'dra ba ste/ /chos kun yod pa ma yin no/ /de ltar lhag med chad pa med/ /mnyam gzhag chenomed cing gnyis su med/ /gdung med bsil 9med tsha ba'ang )med/ /blta ba'i lam na)min med phyir ro/ /drang po ma yin yon po min/ /mun pa ma yin snang 9ba min/ /mthong ba med cing thos med de/ /med pas gzungs su shes par gyisang/ /g.yo med drang po'ang dzo/nyamed pa ste/ /chos rnams gsal med g.yo ba'ang 'amed/ /'khrug pa med cing khro ba med/ /ci /rteyang mi byed nyer gezhi med/ /sgyel tshab med cing gnas kyang med / /'gro med ldog med 'gro sems med/ /nyal ba med cing mi nyal med/ /sad 7pa med par shes par gyis/ / /mig can ma yin long ba min/ /ltam//ba ma yin mun bsgribs min/ /sbas pa ma yin bzhag pa min/ /dul ba ma yin ma dul min/ /rgod pa ma yin zhi ba min/ /'khor min mya smyo rtsengan 'das pa min/ /bden min brdzunamu min de lta bur/ /rgyal ba'i spyod yul shes par gyis jirte/ /'jig rten gdul ba'i don phyir gyi snye/ /'di la the tshom gang yang med/ /gang gcad ri byubya ba'i the tshom des/ /dam pa'i don du byung ba med/ /de nas mi 'am ci'i rna rgyal po ljon pas rtebacom ldan 'das la zhu)zhus pa lung bstan pa dang /gzungs nges par bstan pas yongs su tshim par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i phyir brtson par gyur te/ khang pa brtsegs pa shing la rtenam tshopa dang —/ pad ma la rten07pa dang / ri la rtenam patha rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin can/ rin po che'i gdugs kyis mdzes par byas pa/ gdugs kyi lda ldis mdzesam0par byas pa/ rgyal mtshanamatshadang ba dan gyis brgyan pa/ bla rebarte42—128

dang lda ldis brgyan pa bye ba phrag brgyad 1mngon par sprul te/ mi 'am ci'i rol moshesil snyan bye ba phrag brgyad kyang mngon par sprul nas ri spos kyi ngad ldang las skyes pa dang / thang las skyes pa dang / chu las skyes pa'i me tog thams cad kyis kyang bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas nas/ de cimi'am ci'i tshogs dang lhan cig tu khang pa brtsegs pa bye ba 3phrag brgyad po de dag tu 'khod nas bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ thang las skyesakyi pa dang /chu las skyes pa'i me tog de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la gtor/ mngon par gtor / mngon par rab tu gtor to/ / de nas 7khang pa brtsegs pa de dag las babs te'i rkang pas dong nas bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te⑨ske/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas thal mo sbyar te /bcom ldan 'das la mig mi 'dzums par lta 1zhing rnam pas sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rjes su dran par byed cing phyogs gcig tu 'khod par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mi 'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa pa'akhor dang bcas pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa thugs su chud nas 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rta thul gyis/ bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ bde gshegs dri bral 7spyan mnga' ba/ /rgyu ma mchis par 'dzum mi mdzad/ /lha mis mchod pa yang dag tu/ /'dzum mdzad rgyu de bka' stsal gsol/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mi'adzum mdzad pa/ /'khor gyis mthong nas the tshom 'tshalaska/ /zla ba tshes la mi bzhin du/ /smra ba'i zla ba'i zhal du ltas/ /bde 9gshegs mdzes 38pa deng su zhig /gnyis med chos la shes mchog skyes/ /bdag ni the tshom 'tshal bar gyur / /mi mchog dam pa the tshom sol 9/ /bde gshegs gang gis chos nyid la/ /42—129

dad pa thob nas 1bcom ldan 'das/ /ji ltar 'dzum pa mdzad par gyur/ /smra mchog bdag gi the tshom khum/ /thams cad ldan pa'i 'khor 'di yis/ /bcom ldan bstan thos yid dga' zhing / /the tshom ma mchis som nyi chad/ /ji ltar bstan bzhin gnas par 'gyur/ /de ltar 5rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog /'gro la thugs brtsem mdzad pa dang / /the tshom bcad pa slad ljon parkadang / /mi ci rnams kyi lung bstan gsungs kyi/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rta thul la tshigs su bcad de slar bka' stsal pa/ skye bo tshogs chen rnams nang du / /sangs rgyas yon tan sten 7'gyur ba/ / ljon pa'ishelung bstan gang dris pa / /rta thul khyod kyis legs par dris/ /ye shes mthong ba sgrib med pa/ /bde gshegs ye shes ngo mtshar can/ /de khyod dang ba'i yid byos lam/ /skyo 11med yid kyis nga la nyon/ /'jig rten phan dang bde ba'i phyir/ / ljon pas 8the tshom gang dris pa/ /de yi 'bras bu brjod par byas7/ /the tshom gcad pa khung las bonyon/ / ljon pa la sogs 7mi 'am ci/ /bye ba phrag brgyad 'dir lhags pa/ /de dag nga la mchod byas nas/ /'di nas shi 'phos mtho 7ris 'dong —/ /bskal pa bye ba dgu bcu / der/ / lha mi'i nang du 19'khor bar 'gyur / /mngon par shes pa lnga bsgoms nas/ /sems la dbang sgyur dbang ldan 'gyur / /mi yi seng ge de dag gis/ /sangs rgyas zhing phragam khrag khrig tu / /sprul bkye rang ni lha gnas na/ /bsam gtan dga' ba'i bde ba myong / /bskal pa bye ba dgu bcur yang / /de dag lha mir 'khor 'khor nas/ /rang rang zhing rnams sna tshogs su/ /byang chub rnam par 'tshang rgyar 'gyur/ /rtag tu snang ba'i bskal pa la/ /mi yi seng ge 'jig rten mgon dze+e/ /chags med ye 42—130

shes mthong 3dpag yas/ /stobs bcu gzi ribarjid mtha' yas 'gyur/ /de dag zhing du sems can gang / /yongs su ma smin 'ga' mi skye —no/ /nyan thos theg pas gang byung 4)ba/ /kun kyang srid pa tha ma pa/ /mi yi seng ge'i zhing 5der ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang skye phyob/ /de dag tshe gcig thogs pa ste/ /mi mchog byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /gang dag gtso bor gyur pa rnams/ /bdag cag dpag med sangs rgyas zhing / /yongs su sbyang bar bya'o zhes/ /de 'dra'i bsam pas 3rab tu zhugs/ /sems can rlabs chen de dag ni/ /smon lam rgya chen yun ring btab/ /de dag 'di nas shi 'phos nas/ /bsam pas rang zhing 2)rnam par sbyong she/ /nyon mongs 'joms ’ pa de dag gi / /zhing gi bkod par 'gyur ba ni/ /dga' ldan gnas kyi longs spyod rnams/ /ngan song kun kyang yongs su dag /de dag zhing du rnam kun tuska/ /mi khom gang yang 'byung mi 'gyur/ /zhing rnams yongs sbyangs de dag ni/ /sems can rnams kyang bde bar 'drenapa/ /de ltar 'jig rten mgon po yis/ /mi ci rnams kyi lung bstan bshad/ /lung bstan de thos 'khor gyi rnamasal/ /kun kyang yi tshani rangs par gyur / /mi 'am ci lung bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas lha phreng 7ldan glang po can brgyad khris lha ma yin rnams nas mi 'am ci'i bar dag gis :snyemachod pa yang mthong / lung bstan pa yang thos nas tshim zhing mgu la yi : rangs te/ rab tu dga' zhing dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes nas sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la mos shing bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i phyir brtson par gyur te/ de dag gis 1ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyerang chen 42—131

po thams cad kyi khor yug tu dpag tshad drug cu tshitshun chad me tog man 'o⑧ra bas pus rinub tsam du gang bar byas so/ /de nas de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas tshigs su bcad pa dag gis mngon par bstod pa/ zhi ba'i dbang po 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /srog chags kun la thugs brtse ba / /bde bar gshegs pa thugs rje can/ /'jig rten bdag po ④mi yi stag /sangs rgyas chos la mos pa yi/ /'khor 'di ji srid 'dir gnas par/ /zhunizhabs mchog mdzes skyeshing dga' 7ldan pa / /thugs rje 7can la mgos 7phyag 'tshal / /ji ltar dgung〈 7zla nya ba'i tshetsha/ /mi rnams zla ba 8phyag 'tshal bci/ /de bzhin lha tshogs 'di rnams kyang / /bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal du lta8/ /dpag tu med pa'i dge spyad 2pa/ /dpag yas 3 ye shes phung po ldan/ /gzi brjid dpag yas phung po can/ /blo mchog khyod la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /stobs bcu mnga' zhing dpal stug sna pa/ / bden bzhi /)mi bsnyengs rtegri gsum sel/ /rgyal ba'i bcwa 1brgyad chos dang ldan/ /the tshom mi mnga' smra ba'i mchog /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan mnga' zhing / /dper byad bzang po brgyad cu ldan/ /dbang po'i rgyal mtshan du snyematshungs med thugs/ /bde gshegs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshul khrims stobs kyi mtharam)phyin pa/ /ting 'dzin stobs gnas mi bskyod pa//ye shes stobs kyi bumatshon cha can/ /bdud stobs bcom thub rgyal ba lags/ /ye shes stobs mchog rgyas 2 7gyur pa/ /ser sna mi mnga'5)nyan thos btu'akho/ /zhi ba'i thugs kyis spyod mdzad cing / /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'dul/ /skyes bu seng ge bde gshegs khyod/ /gti mug zhi bgyid chos brnyesab ripa/ /bdag cag rnams kyang stobs bcu yi/ /chos rnams 'dir ni thobatshwa par shog /42—132

ji ltar thub khyod sems can gyi/ /bsam mkhyen dang mdzad de bzhin du/ /'jig rten snang mdzad bdag cag0)kyang / /lha mir mibacas pa'i 'gro dang bgyil/ /de ltar 'gro ba'i don slad du/ /snying brtser nye bar bzung nas ni/ /'gro ba bya'akhor ba'i mtshor ri bying ba/ /srid pa'i rgyud las bsgral bar bgyi/ /bdag cag lhar bcas 'jig rten gyi/ /'dren sgyudang rab tu 'dren gyur tshon)cig /'gro ba sdug bsngal brgyasamanyunyen pa/ /srid pa'i rgyud las dgrol bar bgyitsha/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha phreng nyi ldan glang po can rnams kyi bsam pa thugs su chud nas de'i tshe 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rta thul gyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ bde gshegs rnam par tsha'adren pa po /rte/ /rgyu ma mchis par 'dzum mi mdzad/ /stobs bcu khyod ni 'dzum mdzad pa'i/ /rgyu gang lags pa sgobaka' stsal gsol/ /rgyal ba'i zhal nas 'dzum mdzad pa/ /'gro ba dad bgyis byung mthong tshanas/ /'khor kun the tshom 'tshal gyur 〉te/ /'dzum 33pa'i don ni nyan par 'tshal/ /don chen 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i don/ /bka' stsol bka' stsol 'dren pa'i //mchog /dge sbyong rnams kyi rgyal po khyod/ /the tshom chad 'gyur bka' stsal gsol/ /gang gis rgyal ba mnyes par bgyis / /gang gis deng mchog 22bla med bgyis rnye/ /su zhig de ring gting thob gyur byu/ /bde gshegs bdag gi the tshom khum/ /de ring gang gis bdud kyi gnas/ /dkrugs g.yengs 25kun tu 'khrugs snyopar bgyis/ /deng bus lha gnas thams cad kyang / /rab tu dga' yid tsholdan par bgyis snye / /rgyal ba thub pa de lung ston/ /'gro ba'i the tshom myur du khum/ /de thos bde gshegs 'khor gyi 9rnams/ /kun kyang rab tu yid dga' 'gyur/ /42—133

de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad de tshe dang ldan pa rta thul la slar bka' stsal pa/ phreng 17ldan glang po can lha yi/ /lung bstan rta thul khyod dris pas / /des na da'agro ba mang po a / /don chen shin tu deng 4byas 'gyur ci/ /stobs bcu dzirgyal ba ma dris par/ /sras mchog byang chub lung mi ston / /de ni 'gro ba mang don du/ /de ring khyod kyis du rgyal la zhus/ /phreng rje)ldan glang po lha tshogs kyis/ /nga la sems dang nga mchod pas/ /bskal pa grangs med 'das 'og tu/ /nyon mongs pham byas rgyal bar 'gyur/ /de dag 'di nas shi 'phos nas / /'thun par mi yi nang skyes te/ /rgyal ba bye ba dpag med la/ /me tog mchog gis mchod par 'gyur/ /kun tu bde bar gshegs kyi sems/ /skyed par 'gyur zhing 'phel byed 'gyur/ /rang byung mi 7yi seng ge la/ /tshigs su bcad pas bstod par 'gyur/ /ma 'ongs dus na 'di kun gyis/ /rgyal ba khrag khrig dpag yas mang / /me tog gis sna mchod tshigs bcad kyis/ /mi mchog rnams la bstod byas te/ /de dag bde gshegs rnams mchod cing / /mthu bo che yi sku bstod nas/ /rab tu dga' ba'i bskal bopa la/ /rnam par 'dren par 'jig rten 'byung / /grags pa ma smad nags rgyu ba/ /brgyad khri po rnams de dag kun/ /bskal pa gcig la bde gshegs 'gyur/ /me tog rgyal mtshan ldan 12zhes bya6/ /de na dmyal dang dud 'gro dang / /ngan song gshin lkerje'i 'jig rten medapa/ /zhing de na ni lha min med/ /mi khom 7thams cad rab tu bcom/ /phreng 18ldan glang po can lha yi/ /longs spyod sum cu rtsa gsum gyi/ /ci 'dra ba ni de 'drar 'gyur/ /'gro ba'i tshe tshad dpag tu med/ /de tshe mi dge sgra mi grag 9 /mi dge byed pa smos ci dgos/ /de na rnam 'drenas mchog 42—134

rnams kyi/ /skyelabo rnams kyang chos can 'gyur/ /srog chags bye ba khrag khrig phrag /gang gā'i bye ma rab mang snyed / /grol bar byed 'gyur stobs byubacu rnams / /gnas papo)med pa'i chos kyang ston/ /grags pa ma smad de dag gi / /ring bsrel gedag kyang rgyas nopar 'gyur/ /de dag rnams kyi ring bsrel la'ang //rgyal ba'i sku mang nya'abyung bar 'gyur/ /grags pa mtha' yas ldan 7rnams kyi/nya//ring bsrel cho 'phrul sku mthong nas/ /srog chags bye ba khrag khrig mang / /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed 'gyur/ /phreng paldan glang po can rnams kyi/ /lung bstan 'dren pas bka' stsal pa/ /thos shing shes nas 'khor kun kyang / /de tshe sems ni rab tu dga'/ /phreng maldan glang po can k+ṣilung bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas rgyal skuchen 7bzhi'i ris kyi 7lha dgu khris lha ma yin rnams nas phreng tshonaldan glang po can gyi lha'i bar de dag gi dzomachod pa yang mthong / lung bstan pa yang thos nas tshim zhing mgu la yi 2 rangs te/ rab tu dga' zhing dga' ba dang —/ yid bde ba skyes tsho nyanas sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams thob par bya ba'i phyir mos pa drag po bskyed de 'di lta ste/ dper na kham pa'i gru la zhon pa'i mi zhig chu'i dbus su phyin na gru chag tu 'ong zhes tshu rol nas pha rol du 'gro bar bya ba'i phyir mos pa drag po skyes pa byude bzhin du rgyal cichen bzhi'i ris kyi lha dgu khri po de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi che ba nyid la dad pa skyes snyenas sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams thob par bya ba'i phyir mos pa drag po skyes 0par gyur nas de dag sangs rgyas kyi chos tshol zhing bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i phyir brtson 42—135

par gyur te/ de dag rgyal po chen po zhisnabazhi dang lhan cig tu rin po che'i bla re bkra ba blta na sdug pa dgu khri mngon par sprul to/ /de dag kyang phal cher '-imu tig dmar po dang / skar mdog gudang / be+e drur+ya dang / gser dang / rdo rje'i gerang bzhin can sha 3)stag go/ /lha'i rol mo sil snyan budagu khri yang mngon par sprul te/ de dag nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyi bla re dgu khri po de dag thogs nas rol mo sil snyan dgu khri po /de dag byed cing steng gi bar snang las dong ste/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum skorapo ba byed cing she me tog man dā par ba dang / man dā /nyar ba chen po dang / man dzu ṣa 8ka dang / man dzu ṣa ḍa/2ka chen po dang / pa ru ṣa 8ka dang / pa ru ṣa 8ka chen po dang / sprul pa'i me tog rnams 7kyis bcom ldan 'das la gtor/ mngon par gtor/mngon par rab tu gtor te/ de dag gis mchod pa 7byas nas yang /snyebacom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ tshigs su bcad pa dag gis mngon par bstod pa/ rgyal ba'i yon tan mthong ba yi/ /lha ni dgu khri thamakhapa dag /'dren pa khyod kyi spyan snga na/ /thal mo rab tu sbyar nas mchis/ /rgod pa ma mchis zhum ma mchis(tsho/ /'dod pa ma mchis 'gyod ma mchis/ /mi blun ngo mtshar ma mchis pas / /rkang gnyis mchog la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /khyod ni srid pa'i rgyud rnams bkum/ /mi shes pa ni rnam par sbyangs/ /sred pa'i phur pa rab tu phyung / /nga rgyal rgyal mtshan khyod kyis bsnyal/ /khyod ni zug rngu phyung ba ste / /rma la gdug 1pa khyod kyis spangs/ /khyod ni mkhyen bzhin spyod pa ste/ /'dren pa khyod kyis du snyerma rnams sos/ /khyod kyisam nyon mongs thams cad spangs/ /'ching0srib dag ni thams cad bcadasku/ /sbyor ba kun dang bral ba ste/ /thub pa 42—136

chags pa kun las 'das/ /rgyal ba khyod kyi spyod yul ni/ /stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med/ /bcom ldan khyod la smon pa yang / /rnam pa kun tu mi mnga'o3//khyod kyis sred pa drungs nas phyung / /ma rig pas rlo ni thugs kyang phyungakhu/ /rnam pa bzhi po'i phyin ci logaci /rnam pa kun tu yongs su spangs/ /gang du 'jig rten midzagechud de/ /ri dgas porngon pas 7ji bzhin du/ /'jigs shing skrag bapar 'gyur ba yi1sku/ /yang dag mtha' ni khyod kyis gzigs/ /sems can 'jig tshatshogs ltar01lhung ste/ /stong pa nyid ni ma 'tshal tshabs/ /ma rigatsopa yi mun pas gegatibs/ /'khor ba'i btson borar dga' bar bgyid/ /khyod kyis yang dag ji bzhin du/ /'gro de chang ba lastong 'drar gzigs/ /gang gis rnam dag mig 'gyur ba'i/ /ye shes snang ba rab tu bstan/ /phung po stong par rnam 7par bshig/8 /ming //dang gzugs kyang gsog 'dra zhing / /khams rnams dang ni skye mched dag /bdag med stong par rnam par bshig lha /du nyachos gang dang ni ming gang gis/ /chos gang mngon par brjod bgyi ba snye/ /chos de chos des stong pa ste/ /thub pa khyod kyis stong par bstan/ /sgyu ma'i mkhan pos med pa la/ /skye bo'i tshogs chen mngon sprul na/ /de la sems can gdags ma mchis/ /srog dang gang zagano snyem mchis ltar/ /de bzhin phung po khams rnams dang / /dbang po dag dang skye mched kyang / /yang dag ma yin sgyu ma zhes/ /skyes bu dam pas bstan pa mdzad rin/ /ji ltar ri mo mkhan zhig gis/ /bud med gzugs ni rnam bris shing / /mnyam pa dang ni mi mnyam dang / /lci dang yang ba bstan bgyis kyang / /byis pa'i mig ni bslus shepa ste/ /de la mi mnyam ci ma mchis/ /de bzhin chos dbyings 2 mnyam lags na/ /du )byis pa 42—137

rnams ni de la rmongs/ /gang shes khyod kyi bslab pa la/ /legs bslabs rmongs par 1mi 'gyur ba/ /lag mthil 3skyu ru ra bzhin du / /de ni kun mkhyen khyod kyis bstan/ /shes rab chen po khyod kyis ni/ /ye shes sgron ma rab bus te/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor nas/ /sems can rnams la chos bstan pa/ /de ltar bdag cag myur du ni/ /bla med byang chub zhi thob ste/ /ji caltar 'dren pa khyod bzhin du/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bgyi/ /'khor ba'i lam log 'di dag tu/ /'khyams par 5gyur pa'i sems can la/ /ji ltar 'dren pas phyobastan pa bzhin/ /bdag cag gis kyang chos myur 7bstan/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal nachen 9bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyi 7lhag pa'i bsam pa thugs su chud nas 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rta thul gyis / bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ rgyu ma mchis par rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'dren pa 'dzum pa mi mdzad na/ /'dzum pa mdzad pa'i 'dzum gyi rgyu/ /dpa' bo chen pos 11lung bstan gsol/ /skyes bu dam pa 'khor 'di dag /bde gshegs deng bzhad tshamathong nas ni/ /yid gnyis chen po 'tshal gyur te/ /kun kyang the tshom 'tshal bar gyur snye/ /de ring su yis bdud pham bgyis / /nem nur gang gis bcad par gyurasku/ /su zhig de ring chos rtogs gyural/ /skyes bu mchog gis lung bstan gsol/ /de ring khyod la su yis mchod / /ston pa gang gis bsnyen bkur bgyis/ /'gro kun nem nur 'tshal gyur na/ /rnam par 'dren pas lung bstan gsol/ /ji ltar rkang gnyis mchog khyod kyis/ /lung bstan 'di dag thos gyur na/ /'gro ba the tshom 'chad 'gyur bas / /'dren pas de ltar lung bstan gsol/ /ci nas rnam pa thams cad du/ /42—138

kun mkhyen lam la gnas pa kye rnams/ /myur du byang chub thob ci'agyur ba/ /de ltar 'dren pas bstan du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rta thul la tshigs su bcad de slar bka' stsal pa/ 'gro ba rnams la phan pa'i phyir / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mgon po la/ /'dzum pa'i rgyu rnams dri bya zhes/ /rta thul khyod kyis dris pa legs/ /'jig rten kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /bstan pa yid du 'ong 'gyur zhing / /nyams dga' byed pa de bshad kyis / /dran pa mngon byos mnyan par gyis no/ /dgu khri tham 5pa'i lha rnams kyis/ /mchod pa'i rnam pa 'di lta bu/ /de ring de bzhin gshegs pa la/ /shin tu dang ba'i yid kyis byas/ /sangs rgyas mngon par bstod pa byas / /stong pa nyid kyang shes par gyur / /chos rnams la ni nges pa rnyed/ /nga yi bstan la rab tu gnas / /sngon nayang sangs rgyas bye ba /phrag / brgyad cu 7dag la 1'di dag mchod / /ma 'ongs dus na'ang masangs rgyas ni/ /bye ba mtha' yas mchod par 'gyur / /'dren pa de dag ji srid du/ /sangs rgyas bye ba snyem mchod cing / /bsnyen bkur byas par ma gyur pa/ /de srid byang chub 'tshang mi rgya'i/ /de bas lkeshin tu 'phyi ba na/ /kun kyang gang zag mchog 7tu 'gyur/ /mtshan ni 'od zer 'chang ba ’ ste/ /'jig rten kun mkhyen thub par 'gyur/ /'jig rten sgron ma de dag gi snye/ /nyan thos 'dus par 'gyur ba ni/ /blo yi mchog dang ldan pa dag /'dus pa brgyad cu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sgrib med gzigs pa de dag gi k+ṣ-i/ /mi rnams de yi dus kyi tshe/ /lo grangs bye ba brgyad cu tham/ /srog gi 2 dbang po gnas par 'gyur/ /shes rab mtha' yas de dag gi/ /nyan thos 'dod chags bral ba rnams/ /lus kyi tha ma 'dzin pa dag /bye ba tshad 42—139

med 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sems can rnams la thugs brtse ba'i/ /'jig rten mgon po dpal ldan rnams/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i ring bsrel yang / /shin tu rgya cher0'byung bar 'gyur/ /mi dbang mya ngan 'das gyur nas/ /rnam par 'dren pa dpal ldan pa/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten rnams kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams legs brgyan dka'agyur/ /'jig rten mgon po skyobasarnams kyirtso)/ /mchod rten de dag thams cad la/ /srog chags brgya dang stong rnams dang / /khrag khrig rnams kyis mchod byas nas/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob par 'gyur/ /rang byung mya ngan 'das nas kyang / /de dag dam chos gnas 'gyur ba kyi/ /lo grangs bye ba khrag khrig phrag /brgyad cu tshang bar gnas par 'gyur/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i sras rnams kyis/ /bzung zhing yongs su bsrungs par gnas/ /'jig rten thugs brtse mdzad pa dang / /shākyar yongs su smin mdzad phyir / /rgyal chen bzhi yi ris ri /rnams la/ /'jig rten sgron mas lung bstan mdzad/ /de thos nas ni skyelabo kun/ /kun tu dga' zhing rab dga' ste/ /sems mgu yid kyang rangs gyur nas/ /ston pa la ni mngon par bstod/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris lung bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //bam po drug pa/ de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin la sogs 7pa sum cu rtsa gsum ris kyi /nyalha bye ba phrag brgyad cus lha ma yin dag dang / nam mkha' lding dag tshadang / klu'i bu mo dag dang / klu dag dang / grul bum dag dang / dri za dag dang / gnod sbyin dag dang / mi'am ci dag dang / phreng ldan glang 42—140

po can dag dang / rgyal7chenashebazhi'i ris kyi lha dag gi mchod pa yang mthong /lung bstan pa yang thos nas sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la tshim zhing mgu la yi curangs te/ rab tu dga' zhing dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas yid byung ba chen po skyes te/ 'dod 3)pa'i tshul gyis lha'i dbang po brgya byin la sogs gepa bcom ldan 'das la mchodango pa'i phyir brtson par gyur te/ de dag gis rin po che'i khang pa bkra ba/ blta na sdug pa/ rin po che 9sna bdun gyi rang bzhin canatri/ mu tig dmar po'i phreng 37ba dang / be+e drur+ya'i phreng bas brgyan pa/gser gyi phreng tshab sna tshogs dang / nor bu rin po che skar mdog gi 7phreng bas brgyan pa/ sa gnas 8rim pa brgyad skodang / ba gam dang / khang pa brtsegs pa dang / skar khung gis brgyan pas/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan 7dang /ba dan dag gis brgyan pa/ lha 3 rdzas kyi seng ge'i khris brgyan pa/ bla re 37chen po dang / dril bu rtogayer ga'i dra bas brgyan pa/ lha'i bu 1mo'i tshogs kyis mdzes par byas pa/ lha'i rol mo sil snyan sgra rab tu 'byung ba bye ba phrag brgyad cu mngon par sprul to/ /rta cang shes kyis drangs pa'i 2shing rta lha rdzas kyi rnam pas rtelegs par brgyan pa/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan cadang / ba dan dag gis mdzes par byas pa bye ba phrag brgyad cu yang mngon par sprul to/ /ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer chen po dusathams cad dang ldan pa'i kho ra khor gi yug tu dpag tshad drug cu tshun chad me tog man dā du ra ba dang / lha'i mchod pa dem dag gis rgyas par gang bar byas so/ /glang po che sa sung gi /bu bye ba phrag brgyad cu yang rtemangon par sprul te/ glang po che sa srung gi bu de dag re re zhing yang mgo07bye ba phrag brgyad cu brgyad cu/ glang po che sa srung gi bu'i mgo de dag 42—141

re re zhing yang so drug drug /so 37de dag re re zhing yang dardzing bu bdun bdun/rdzing bu de dag re re zhing yang pad ma stong phrag bdun bdun/ pad ma de dgashogare re zhing yang 'dab rim brgyad khri brgyad khri/ 'dab rim re re zhing yang lha'i bu mo bdun bdun/ lha'i bu mo de dag re re zhing yang 'khor bdun bdun yod pa / rgyanam thams cad kyis brgyan pa sha stag mngon par sprul nas rin po che'i khang pa de dag mdun sgyu du byas te/ dbus su glang po che sa srung gi 8bu dag btsud nas phyi bzhin shing rta de ltar bshams pa de dag bkye 9rinas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa 7byas so/ /rin po che'i khang pa de dag las kyang lha'i tsan 11dan dang / a ga tsharu dang / ud pa la dang / ta ma la'i lo ma'i phye ma dang /gser phye'i char mngon par bab par gyur to/ /lha'i me tog man dā par ba dang /man dā char ba chen po dang / mañju ṣa ka tshadang / mdzi ṣa saka chen po dang /pa ru ṣa 7ka dang / pa ru ṣa naka chen po dang / mdog dkar dang / mdog dkar 9chen po dang / sprul pa'i me tog dag gi char yang mngon par bab par gyur to/ /gser dang / dngul dang / be+e drur+ya dang / shel dang / 1mu tig dmar po dang / spug dang / rdo'i snying po dang / rin po che sna bdun gyi me tog gi char yang mngon par bab par gyur to/ /lha'i bu mo de dag las la la ni glu len/ la la ni gar byed/ la la ni rol mo byed/ la la ni lus kyi tshul sgyur zhing lha ma yin gyi mchod pa lta bu dang / glang po che ri snyes srung gi bu de dag dang —/ rin po che'i khang pa rnams kyis mchod pa byas nas de'i 'og tu rta cang snyeshes kyis drangs pa'i 4shing rta bye ba phrag brgyad cu ril zhon te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas lha'i yo byad rnam pa sna tshogs mang po yang 42—142

phul bar gyur to/ /lha'i rol mo sil snyan bye ba phrag brgyad cu yang bar snang las sgra 'byin par gyur to/ /shing rta bye ba phrag brgyad cu po de dag la yang lha'i bu mo ’gzhan bye ba phrag brgyad cu brgyad cu mngon par sprul te/ lha'i bu mo de dag kyang la la ni glu len/ la la ni gar byed/ la la ni rol mo byed/ la la ni lus kyi tshul sgyur zhing lha ma yin gyi mchod pa ji lta ba bzhin du byas so/ /de nas sum cu rtsa gsum ris kyi lha bye ba phrag brgyad cu po de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ji ltar sprul pa'i lha'i bu mo 'di dag bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byed pa rilas na gechos thams cad kyang shesprul pa dang 'dra ba yin du nges so snyam nas de dag 'di snyam du chos 'di dag thams cad ni ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pas bstan pa de bzhin te/ sprul pa dang 'dra ba yin no snyam du sems par gyur cing nede dag gis chos thams cad sprul pa dang 'dra bar shes nas chos la the tshom med pa thob 8par gyur to/ /de dag de ltar 'the tshom med cing nem nur med par gyur nas bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi tshi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de dag chos thams cad sprul pa dang 'dra bar rtog 11cing bdag cag kyang sprul pa padang 'dra bar mthong / mchod pa de dag kyang sprul pa dang 'dra bar mthong bcom ldan 'das kyang sprul pa dang 'dra bar mthong nas bcom ldan 'das kyis chos gang /rtebastan pa de dag kyang rusprul pa dang 'dra bar 7yang dag par shes tel/de dag gis 7chos thams cad lha sprul pa lta bu'o zhes bya bar shes nas the tshom med cing :tshonem nur med par gyur te/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa dag gis mngon par bstod do / /'gro ba kun gyis mchod pa gang bgyis 42—143

dang —/ /sprul pa'i mchod pa 'di dag gang bgyis 3)dang / /lha rnams kyis ni sangs rgyas mchod byas pa/ /de ②ltar chos 'di thams cad sprul pa nyid/ /'dren pas chos kun gsungs pa gang lags dang / /de bzhin gshegs pas lung ri bstan mtha' dag kyang ge/ /'di dag thams cad sprul pa 'dra'o zhes/ /de ltar lha tshogs de dag blo gros skyes/ /bcom ldan sprul pa 'di dag ji cho5)bzhin du/ /ston pa'ang de bzhin sprul dang 'dra ba ste/ /rgyal bas lung bstan bdag cag 'tshal gyur pas/ /'di la bdag cag the tshom mtshanamachis so/ /rgyal bas so so'i skye bo rnams mkhyen nas/ /byis pa'i sa thob tha snyad gang btags pa/ /de dag kun kyang sprul pa ji bzhin ten / /bde gshegs 'gro ba lung bstan de bzhin no/ /slob pa rnams dang gang dag mi slob dang / /bcom ldan nyan thos dul spyoba'i sa thob pa/ /de dag kun kyang bcom ldan sprul dang 'dra/ /bcom ldan bstan la the tshom ma tshamachis so/ /bcom ldan gang rnams mi smra lhur len cing —/ /bse : ru lta bur ngaganyis med nyon mongs spangs/ /de dag rnams kyang sprul 'dra skubacom ldan 'das/ /bde gshegs bstan la the tshom ma mchis so ldagang rnams 'gro ba kun la bde phan phyir/ /rgyal ba'i byang chub spyad spyod 8bag yod pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' bde gshegs sras dag kyang / /khyad par ma mchis sprul pa 'di dang 'dra/ /bde gshegs rang byung parnam par 'dren pa mchog /stobs bcu shes rab mtha' yas thugs rje can/ /ye shes stobs 'phags 'jig rten gtso bo dag /sprul pa 'di 'dra de dag rang bzhin mtshungs//'dren pas 'di la chos rnams gang gsungs pa/ /gnas med zhi bsil nyon mongs med gyur cing / /sdug bsngal zhi byed mthar thug grangs med pa/ /de 42—144

yang sprul pa 'di dag ji bzhin no/ /bcom ldan 'di la chos rnams71tshogang dag kyang / /sprul pa'i rang bzhin ma lags de ma mchis/ /gang tshe go eta ma'i bstan pa 'di/ /bdag cag rtogs nas the tshom thams cad spangs/ /sprul pa 'di 'drar chos rnams kun mthong nas/ /bdag cag rnams kyang 'jig rten mgon por 'gyur/ /bde gshegs spyod yul 'di la spyod pa'i snyernams/ /the tshom ma mchis rang byung ④'dren par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe sum cu rtsa gsum ris kyi lha'i bu bye ba phrag sgrubargyad cu po de dag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa thugs su chud nas 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rta thul gyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ gzhal yasachugrags mnga' )mtha' yas gzi rin brjid can/ /bde gshegs rnams ni rgyu med 'dzum mi mdzad/ /rnam par 'dren pas 'dir ni 'dzum mdzad na/ /rgyal bas 'dzum pa'i tshig 1gsungs the tshom khum/ /rang byung 7bde gshegs zhal nas 'dzum pa 'di/ /byung bar rig nas 'jig rten the tshom 'tshal/ /'gro ba'i the tshom thub pas bsal du gsol/ /'gro ba 'di dag the tshom ma mchis mdzod / /lha tshogs 'di dag 8rab tu yid dga' bas/ /rgyal ba bstod sna de lha rdzas k+ṣarnams kyis mchod/ /bde gshegs de dag don dadu 'dzum pa mdzad/ /rgyal ba 'khor 'di dga' mdzad bka' stsal gsol/ /zla ltar sadri med 'od mnga'atshamamatha' yas gzi/ /ci 38nas bde gshegs bka' ni 'di thos pas/ /mgon po 'gro ba thams cad dga' 19'gyur bar/ /rgyal ba lha tshogs mchod mkhyen bka' su55 gsol/ /bde gshegs lha tshogs 'di yis chos rnams kun/ /sprul pa lta bur rnam par rtogs gyur nas / /stobs bcu mnga' bas don 'di tsho 7bka' 42—145

stsol te// /rab rib bral ba lha yi bslab pa gsungs / /skye bo 'di dag the tshom bral gyur nas/ /thub pa de ltar byang chub spyod rtsom pa'agyur/ /rab tu dpa' 5ba 'khor 'dis po thos gyur te/ /dgongs pa rig nas rgya richen rtsom par 'gyur / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tsho tshe dang ldan pa rta thul la tshigs su bcad de slar bka' stsal pa/ lha tshogs 'di dag rab tu dga' shes nas/ /rta thul khyod kyis dus dang ldan pa'i tshig /smras pa de ni dus la bab pa ste / /'dzum pa dris pa de ni lung bstan to/ /lha rnams bsam shes 'dzum pa de dris pa / /des sna ni khyod kyis 'gro ba'i don chen byas/2/ /'dzum 8mdzad pa yi rgyu de ngas bstan gyisatsha/ /dga' zhing dang ba'i sems kyis nga la nyon/ /lha tshogs rnams kyis chos rnams 'di dag ni/ /ma lus sprul pa lta bur shes gyur nas/ /chags med ye shes mthong ba dpag med cing / / rab rib 'bral ba'i 'jig rten mgon por 'gyur/ /srid pa'i rgyud na sngon yang 'khor ba'i tshe mi yi gtso sabo gang gā'i bye snyed mchod/ /srid rgyun 7de na 'di dag thub pa las/ / chos rnams : sprul pa lta bur ma mthong ngo / /'di dag nga la mchod mchog 'dir byas pas/ /chos rnams sprul pa 'dra bar tsho 7mngon du mthong / /bde gshegs bstan pa 'di la byas pa ni/ /chud zos mi 'gyur bar chad yod mi 'gyur/ /lha tshogs 'di yis nga la mchod byas te/ /chos rnams thams cad sprul pa 'drar shes pas/ /bskal pa pad ma zhes bya byung ba'i tshe/ /smra ba'i zla ba mi yi mchog tu 'gyur/ /khyu mchog ldan pa'i ming mchog 'gyur ba ni/ /bde gshegs rab mkhas dbang po'i tog rgyal po/ /chos rnams thams cad sprul pa 'drar ston cing —/ /'gro ba khrag khrig dpag med 'grel par 2 'gyur/ /bde gshegs de 42—146

dag bstan la bag yod pa/ /chos rnams 'di dag sprul pa 'dra bar sems/ /zhim/riganas de la su sten 5bag yod pa/ /myur du bla med byang chub mchog zhi sne'athob / /sum cu rtsa 4)gsum pa lung bstan pa'i le'u ste bcwa 5lnga pa'o// //de nas de'i tshe 'thab bral gyi lha bye ba 6 phrag bzhi bcus lha ma yin rnams nas sum cu rtsa gsum ris kyi lha'i bar de dag gi 7mchod pa yang mthong / lung bstan pa yang thos nas tshim zhing mgu la yi rangs te / rab tu dga' zhing dga' ba dang yid shebade ba skyes dzinas bcom ldan 'das kyang lung bstan pa la thogs pa mi mnga' bar shes shing sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni nyams dga' ba ste/de dag thob na lha ma shes pa'am/ ma mthong ba'am/ ma rtogs pa'am/ mngon tshidu ma byas pa'am/ skye ba'am/ 'gag pa'am snye/ las sam/ las kyi rnam par smin pa gang yang med do zhes sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la 'dod 4pa bskyed do/ /'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pas kun rdzob dang don dam pa gnyis thugs su chud de/ shes par bya ba yang kun rdzob skadang don dam pa la'adir zad do/ /de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis stong pa nyid parab tu gzigs/ rab tu mkhyen/legs par mngon du mdzad pas de'i phyir thams cad mkhyen pa zhes bya'o/ /de la kun rdzob ni 'jig rten gyi spyod par de bzhin gshegs pas me gzigs so/ /don dam pa 39gang yin pa de ni brjod du med pa ste/ shes par bya ba ma yin pa/rnam par shes par bya ba ma yin pa/ yongs su shes par bya ba ma yin pa/ ma bstan pa/ rab tu ma bstan pa/ ma thos pa/ thos par ma byas pa/ ma shes pa / rnam par ma shes pa/ ma bstan pa/ ma mthong ba/ ma brtags pa/42—147

'dzin du ma bcug pa/ rtogs par ma byas pa/ thob par ma byas pa/ ma thob pa / nye bar ma bsnyen7pa/ ma bor ba/ ma bzhag pa/ ma spangs pa/ bya ba med pa/ byed pa med pa/ rab tu zhi ba med pa/ ma smad pa/ ma bstod pa / thob pa ma yin pa/ ma thob pa ma yin pa/ bde ba ma yin pa(ge/ sdug bsngal ba shum yin pa/ snyan pa ma yin pabya/ mi snyan0pa ma yin pa/gzugs ma yin pa/ gzugs med pa ma yin pa/ grangs med pa/ bgrang ba med pa/ 'jig rten med pa/ 'jig rten dang bral ba med pa/ kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa/ rnam par byang ba med pa/ 'gro ba med pa/ ldog pa med pa/ ma brtags56)pa/ rnam par ma brtags ༅pa/ ma g.yos pa/ ma bsams gepa/ ma bskyod pa/ mngon par 'dus khyam byas pa/ ma spros pa/spros pa dang bral ba ste/ 'di ltar gzugs kyi mtshan ma mi dmigs 7pa/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa'i mtshan ma mi dmigs pa/nya/ mig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang /yid kyi mtshan ma mi dmigs pa/ gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg mabya dang / chos kyi mtshan ma mi dmigs pa/ mig gi rnam par shes pa dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i mtshan ma mi dmigs pa/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i mtshan ma mi dmigs pa/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba'i mtshan ma mi dmigs pa/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba'i bar gyi mtshan ma mi dmigs pa/ gzugs kyi 'du shes kyi mtshan ma mi dmigs pa/42—148

chos kyi bar gyi 'du shes kyi mtshan ma mi dmigs pa/ gzugs su sems pa'i mtshan ma mi dmigs pa/ chos kyi bar du 1sems pa'i mtshan ma mi dmigs pa/yid la bya ba'i mtshan ma mi dmigs pa/ sa dang / chu dang / me dang /rlung dang / nam mkha' dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi mtshan ma mi dmigs pa/ 'dod pa dang / gzugs dang / gzugs med pa'i khams kyi mtshan ma mi dmigs pa/ 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas kyi mtshan ma mi dmigs pa ste/ 'di ltar chos gang dang gang brjod pa'i rang bzhin gang dang gang gis brjod pa'i gechos de dang / de brjod pa'i rang bzhin de dang des mi brjod pa stes/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni de 5ltar nyams dga' ba yin na yide byis pa so so'i skye bo thos pa dang mi ldan pa mi shes pa rnams kyis thos na sbyo ri'ajigs shing dngang ba byadang / skrag par 'gyur te/ des 'jigs par gyur pas thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes las nyams par 'gyur te/ de dag ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis mya ngan du bya ba ste/ 'khor ba na yod pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgyun to zhes te/ de dag gis 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la 'dod 7pa bskyed nas sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi don du bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i phyir brtson par gyur tokho/ /de dag gis sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i mchod pa las khyad par sna 'phags pas bcom ldan 'das la mchod de/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas 'thab bral gyi lha de dag gis tshabacom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa dag gis mngon pararwa bstod pa/ rgyal ba 7khyod kyis phung po dben par gzigs/ /42—149
