khams dang skye rimached rnams kyang de bzhin te/ /dbang po'i grong nirdzo nomatshan mas dben pa dag /kun kyang thub pa khyod kyis ji bzhin gzigs/ /'jig rten mkhas pa'i bden pa gnyis yin 5te/ /khyod kyis gzhan las ma gsan4rirang gis gzigs/ /de ni kun rdzob sgrubaden dang don dam ste/ /bden pa gsum pa tshigang yang ma mchis so/ /gang gis bde bar gshegs lamana'agro ba rnams / /bde ba'i don du dad pa skyed na'agyur ba/ /rgyal bas 'gro 3ba rnams kyi don slad du/ /'jig rten phan phyir kun rdzob de bstan to/ /sems can tshogs kyi 'gro drug gang bstan pa/ /sems can dmyal dang dud 'gro yi dgas dzidang ske/ /lha min ris dang mi dang lha yi rnams/ /mi sa yi seng ges kun rdzob btags dpa mdzad/ /rigs dma' de bzhin mtho ba'i rigs rnams dang / /phyug po'i khyim dang dbul po'i khyim dag snyedang / /bran gyi tshogs dang de bzhin g.yog gi tshogs/ /bud med tshogs dang skyes pa khum ning dang / /'gro ba'i khyad par ji snyed gang yang rung / /mtshungs med khyod dkyis 'jig rten bstan mdzad pa/ /kun rdzob bden par lamakhas pas thugs chud nas/ /'jig rten phan pas mi la de bstan to/ /de la dga' ba'i 'gro ba 'khor ba nalnga/ /'gro ba'i chos brgyad /de la mi 'byung ste/ /thob dang ma thob snyan dzodang mi snyan 2 dang —/ /bstod dang smad dang bde dang sdug bsngal lo/ /thob pa rnyed na 1de la chags pa skyed/ /ma thob gyur na des kyang 'khrug par 'gyur/ /gang gzhanang ma bstan tshul 'dis shes par bya/ /nad rnams brgyad 2 kyis de 24rgyud gnodang par 'gyur / /kun rdzob de la don dam su smra ba/ /de dag nor ba'i blo ldan shes par bya/ /mi sdug sdug dang sdug bsngal bde ba dang / /bdag med rang bzhin 42—150

bdag tu smra ba dang / /mi rtag chos la rtag ces smra bgyid cing / /de la 1dga' ste mtshan mar gang gnas pa/ /de dag bde gshegs gsung tsho ni thos gyur nang)/ / 'jigs shing 5ji bzhin mi rtogs phyospong bar 'gyur / /de dag bde gshegs gsung ni spangs 8gyur pas/ /sems can dmyal bar sdug bsngal mi bzad 9myong / /de dag tshul min bde ba 7tshol bgyid kyang / /sdug bsngal brgyad lha dag byis pas myong bar 'gyur/ /'jig rten phan pa'i bstan pa su zhig gis / /ma log blos ni rnam par rtogs gyur na/ /sbrul gyi pags pa rnying paltar rab spangs te/ /srid pa kun las 'das nas zhi bar 'gyur/ /chos 'di thams cad rang bzhin dben pa ste/ /stong pa mtshan ma med pa don dam zhes/ /gang gis thos nas dga' ba bskyed pa'agyur ba/ /de dag bla med byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /ji ltar bde bar gshegs pas gsungs pa'i chos/ /de la lha rnams the tshom ma mchis te/ /'gro ba thams cad yongs su dgrol ba'i phyir/ /de dag bla na med pa'i byang chub tshol/ /byang chub blo can rnam dag blo can rnams / /skyes bu mchog gis dga' ba bskyed du gsol/ /de thos 'gro ba kun la sman bislad du/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis ge'athab bral ris kyi lha bye ba phrag bzhi bcu po tshadag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa thugs su chud nas de'i tshe ’ 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rta thul gyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/'jig rten phan pas ’ 'dzum pa gang mdzad des/ /khyod kyi 'khor ni the tshom 'tshal bar gyur rte/ /mi mchog 2 'dzum pa'i rgyu de bka' stsal gsol/ /des ni 'khor 'di 2rab tu dga' bar 'gyur/ /lha rnams lung bstan ride ni thos 42—151

gyur 1na/ /'khor 'di shin tu dga' zhing mgu bar 'gyur/ /rigs pa 5ldan pa bstan pa 'di nyid la/ /bde bar nan tan ri bgyid cing rtsom 5par 'gyur//rgyal ba khyod 'khor 'di tsi ni mchog geldan te/ /drang srong chen po sangs rgyas yon tan snod/ /'gro ba 'di rnams bsdu bar namadzad slad du/ /snyan pa'i gsung ni legs par brjod du gsol/ /sangs rgyas yon tan mthu dag thos gyur na ske/ /skye dgu 7kun la rab tu sman par 'gyur/ /bde bar gshegs pas lung bstan de thos na/ /mkhas pa rnams ni tshul bzhin rtsoms/ par 'gyur/ /mi yi dam pa smra ba'i ha mchog gis 'dir/ /the tshom 'tshal ba'i nem nur legs par sol snye / /'khor rnams thams cad thos par dga' zhing sdod / /lha rnams lung bstan pa ni bka' stsal gsol/ /kun kyang rim gror dgus par rna blags 7te/ /khyod kyis ’ lung bstan rab tu dga' ba la/ /sgrib pa rab tu spangs shing de dag nyan / /'jig rten phan phyir skyes bu mchog gis gsungs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rta thul la 1 tshigs su bcad de slar bka' stsal pa/'jig rten phan phyir mkhas pas 'dzum mdzad pa 9/ /rta thul khyod kyis dris pas dus dang ldan/ /sangs rgyas yon tan mthu ni thos gyur na/ /skye ci bo tshogs chen rnams kyi don du 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas yon tan tshogs la blo zhan cing / /'dod chags blo dang zhe snang blo ldan dang / /tshe rabs brgyar 2ni rtsod pa'i blo can dang / /gti mug blo can dga' ba skyer mi 'gyur/ /gang rnams rgyal bas snyebastan la dga' ba dang / /gang gis rgyal ba kyirnams las cisngon dris dang / /gang rnams snying rje che dang ldan pa dag /de kun sangs rgyas yon tan ldan par 'gyur / /gang gis 'gro ba gdon sazin mthong gyur te/ /mi yi seng ge snying rje 42—152

skyed byed pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas yon tan 'di thos nasami/ / ud pal 5phreng bzhin mgo la khyer bar 'gyur/ /nga yi 'khor 'di rab tu dga' 'gyur ba / /sngon gyi rgyal la bobasnyen bkur sngon byas 5te/ /de dag sangs rgyas yon tan yid 'ong 'di/ /me tog phreng bzhin de dag yang dag lta/ /'thab bral lha rnams sngon gyi rgyal kun la/ /bsnyen bkur byas shing chags pa spangs pa ste/ /nyon mongs dmad cing mesangs rgyas blo ldan 'gyur / /snying rje ldan zhing nyon mongs med blo ldan/ /rgyal ba mi yi seng ge gang gā yi/ /bye snyed kun la sngon chad 9)bsnyen bkur byas/ /byang chub bla na med par smon byed cing / /dge ba mtha' 7yas 'di dag kun gyis byas/ /sems can nyon mongs 'dam /nyabying rig gyur nas/ /sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams la snying rje skyed/ /de dag mi mchog sems can phan mdzad latsha/ /chos tshul mtha' yas yongs su dris par gyuratsha/ /gang thos nas ni rnam par 'dren 'gyur ba'i/ /rnam 'dren chos la 'jug pa 'chad par 'gyurang/ /mi yi nyon mongs spyod pa rab mkhyen nas/ /de dag rnams la rgya chen chos kyang 'chad/ /rnam 'dren skyes bu dam pa'i mchog de dag /rang bzhin med pa stong pa nyid kyang 'chad/ /de dag rgyal ba'i gsung de thos gyur nas/ /'gro ba thams cad stong par rab tu rtogs/ /cis stong zhe na mtshan ma'i rnam pas stong / /rang bzhin med cing mtshan ma med pa smra/ /rgyal ba'i chos rnams de ltar shes gyur nas/ /kun kyang sangs rgyas yon tan 7rnams la gnas/ /de dag nga la mchod pa rgya 7chen byas/ /bdag gis 1 chos bzhin du ni lung bstan nas/ /skar tshogs mnyam pa'i bskal pa dam pa la/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /bde gshegs mnyam pa med pa bye ba 19phrag /42—153

nyi shu nyi shus yongs su gang bar 'gyur/ /blo gros dag ces 3bya ba'i grangs su 'gro / /sems can bsam yas yongs su sbyong 3bar 'gyur/ /'thab bral 'khod pa'i lha yi bsam pa rnams/ /rta thul gyis ni yongs su zhus byas pa/ /rgyal ba dgra rgyal drang srong chen po yiri / /lung bstan lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten dga'/ /'thab bral ba lung bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //de nas dga' ldan ris kyi lha bye ba phrag brgyad cus lha ma yin rnams nas 'thab bral gyi 5ris kyi lha'i bar de dag gi mchod pa yang mthong / lung bstan pa yang thos nas ne'adi snyam du sems te/ gang bcom ldan 'das kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan pa'i chos de gang zhig ci gzugs sam/ 'on te tshor ba'am/ 'on te 'du shes sam/ 'on te 'du byed dam/ 'on te rnam par shes pa zhig bcom ldan 'das kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan snyam nas de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ gzugs ni 7bcom ldan 'das kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ma bstan to/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa ni bcom ldan 'das kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ma bstan to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/gzugs kyang ma skyes 8pa/ /byang chub kyang ma skyes pa na ji ltar ma skyes pas ma skyes pa mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya rkabar bya/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang —/ 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa yang ma skyes 11pa/ byang chub kyang ma skyes 2pa na de la ji ltar ma skyes dpas ma skyes pa mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya 42—154

bar bya/ gzugs kyang 'gag pa med pa/ byang chub kyang 'gag pa med pa/rnam par shes pa'i bar yang 'gag pa med pa/ byang chub kyang 'gag pa med pa/gzugs kyang 3spros pa med pa/ byang chub kyang spros pa med pa/ rnam par shes pa'i bar yang spros pa med pa/ byang chub kyang spros pa med pa/ gzugs kyang gnyis su med pa/ byang chub kyang gnyis su med pa/ rnam par shes pa'i bar yang geganyis su med pa/ byang chub kyang gnyis su med pa/ gzugs kyang g.yo ba med pa/ byang chub kyang g.yo sneb med pa rnam par shes pa'i bar yang g.yo ba med pa/ byang chub kyang g.yo ba med pa/ gzugs kyang dmigs su med pa/byang chub kyang dmigs su med pa rnam par shes pa'i bar yang dmigs su med pa/byang chub kyang dmigs su med pa na ji ltar 'gag pa med pa dang / spros pa med pa dang / gnyis su med pa dang / g.yo 5ba med pa dang dmigs su med pas 'gag pa med pa dang / dmigs su med pa'i bar du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya phyobar bya/ de ltar chos thams cad mi dmigs na 'di la sangs rgyas ni gang / byang chub sems dpa' ni gang / byang chub ni gang / lung bstan pa ni gang / gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang —/ 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa ni rnam par shes pas stong /sangs rgyas ni sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong / byang chub sems dpa' ni byang chub sems dpa'i ngo bo nyid kyis stong / byang chub ni byang chub kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong / lung bstan 7pa ni lung bstan pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis stong ste/ de ltar chos thams cad narang bzhin gyis stong pa la gzugs zhes bya ba dang /rnam par shes pa'i bar zhes bya ba dang / sangs rgyas zhes bya ba dang / /lung 42—155

bstan pa'i bar zhes bya ba de dag ni tha snyad tsam/ ming tsam/ brda tsam/kun rdzob tsam/ brjod pa 37tsam/ gdags pa tsam ste/ de la mkhas pa rnams kyis mngon par zhen par bya ba'i mi cha'o / /'di lta ste/ dper na mi zhig nyal ba'i mi lam na 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan zhing rtse rtse 0ba las de ce nyal ba las sad na tsho/ 'dod pa'i yon tan de dag mi 7mthong ste / de 9)rjes su dran na yang mi rnyed 7cing de ltar ma rnyed 1pa'i phyir sdug bsngal du 'gyur ba de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa rnams kyang byang chub tshol na de dag byang chub dang phrad par mi 'gyur te/ byang chub ma rnyed bocing ro ma myong 7bas sdug bsngal du 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar chos thams cad ni mi lam lta bu nor ba ste/ chos de dag gi don ni rnam pa ligazhan la so so'i skye bo de dag kyang 5rnam pa gzhan ladu zhan /rteto/ /chos de dag ni de ltar shes par bya ba yin na 1 de la chos gang zhig sangs rgyas yin/ gang zhig byang chub sems dpa' yin/ / gang zhig byang chub yin/ gang zhig lung bstan pa yin/ de ltar chos thams cad dmigs su med de du tsho/ so so'inganaskye bo yang dmigs su med snye/ so so'i sa skye bo'i chos kyang dmigs su med/ nyan thos kyang dmigs su med/ nyan thos kyi chos kyang dmigs su med/ rang sangs rgyas kyang dmigs su med ru/ rang sangs rgyas kyi chos kyang dmigs su med/byang chub sems dpa' yang dmigs su med/ byang chub sems dpa'i chos kyang dmigs su med/ zosangs rgyas kyang dmigs su med/ sangs rgyas kyi mchos kyang dmigs su med/ byang chub kyang dmigs su med/ mya ngan las 'das pa yang dmigs su med do/ /bcom ldan 'das de la ni bdag cag the tshom ma 42—156

mchis/ yid gnyis ma mchis so zhes gsol nas dga' ldan ris kyi lha'i bu de dag chos nyude dag la the 45tshom med cing nem nur med par gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir brtson par gyur nas de dag gis 'thab bral gyi mchod pa las khyad par du 'phags pas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas te/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum cabaskor ba byas te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa dag gis mngon par bstod pa / gang dag sangs rgyas yon tan rab gnas pa/ /de dag 'jug pa de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /rnam 5thar sgo gsum po 5ni rnyed gyur pas/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i spyod yul spyod par 'gyur/ /gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes ma mchis te/ /sems dang bsam pa de bzhin ma mchis pa/ /chags med blo mnga' rnams kyi spyod yul lags/ /mi yi seng ge phung po dben la dgyes/ /skyes bu dam pa mkhas pa de dag gi/ /byang chub za bosems kyang nam yang 'byung ma mchis/ /phung po dben pa'i yon tan myong gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas dgongs la nem nur spangs blo ldan/ /de dag byang chub smon pa ma mchis shing / /byang chub sems la'ang de dag mi smod /de/ /dga' dang zhum par 'gyur ba ma mchis par/ /bde gshegs sras rnams spyad pa spyod pa bgyid / /bde gshegs rnams kyis chos rnams mnyam par gzigs/ /de la rgyal sras 'jigs dang bral ba rnams/ /yang dag nyid du sangs rgyas legs spyod cing / /mkhas pa de dag 'jig rten 'di na spyod/ /gzugs kyi mtshan ma rnam par gzhig bgyis shing / /mtshan ma'i rnam pa thams cad rab spangs te/ /srid pa gsum 42—157

la de dag yong mi smon/ /dngos po stong par smon lam de dag bgyid/ /phung po 'di dag ma skyes rtogs gyur cing / /lung bstan bde gshegs nyid kyang ma skyes la / /byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyang ma skyes/ /de ltar gang 'tshal de la rmongs ma mchis/ /skye bo'i chos dang sangs rgyas yon tan rnams/ /de dag kun dang bde gshegs ma skyes te/ /mi yi seng ge de ltar gang 'tshal ba de ni khyod sras khyod ni de yi yab/ /gang zhig phung po 'gag pa ma mchis shing / /khams dang skye mched de bzhin rgyal ba'i chos/ /71 bobyang chub rgyal ba de bzhin lung bstan pa/ /bcom ldan 'di kun 'gag med 'tshal ba dang / /gang rnams byang chub 'tshal zhing spyod bgyid pa/ /'jig rten mkhas pa de dag 'gag ma mchis/ /'gro ba thams cad 'gag med blor gyur na/ /de 'dra'i blo ldan ribyang chub rnyed mi dka' / /phung po skye mched dag dang khams rnams dang ske/ /byang chub rgyal ba rgyal sras mi g.yo 5bar/ /gang gis phyi'atshal ba de dag rgyal sras te/ /de dag rgyal ba'i chos 'di 'dzin pa lags/ /phung po sems med de bzhin skye mched dang / /khams dang byang chub rgyal ba rgyal sras dang —/ /lung bstan de bzhin sems pa ma mchis par/ /gang gis 'tshal ba de dag rgyal ba'i sras/ /rang byung naphung po dngos nyid stong pa ste/ /khams dang skye mched dag dang rgyal ba dang / /byang chub dang ni lung bstan rgyal sras rnams / /ngo bo nyid kyis stong par gang spyod dang / /phung po spros 'dra de bzhin khams rnams dang / /skye mched rkang gnyis mchog dang byang chub dang / /lung bstan spros pa med par gang spyod cing / /de ltar gang 'tshal de dag rgyal ba'i sras / /gnas pa ma mchis mi gnas ma lags te/ /mchis pa ma lags ma 42—158

mchis yong ma lags/ /'dus byas ma lags 'dus ma byas ma lags/ /de ltar gang 'tshal de dag rgyal ba'i sras/ /rgyal dang 'gro 'di de ltar yongs mthong zhing / /ston pa'i dgongs pa de ltar 'tshal gyur la/ /de ltar bgyis na gang zag mchog mchod cing / /'dren pa 'khor dang ribacas la 5bsnyen bkur lags/ /rnam par 'dren la byubastod pa'i bsod nams gang / /ji —snyed 'jig rten phan mdzad mkhyen pa yi/ /dge ba de 5yis 'gro ba rang byung phyob/ /rgyal ba 7mtshan mchog ldan pa grub par shog /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dga' ldan ris kyi lha de dag gi 9lhag pa'i bsam pa thugs su chud nas 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rta thul gyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ 'dren pa rgyu yi stobs ni tshe gang zhig gis/ /stobs bcu brnyes pa 'di ltar 'dzum mdzad pa / /'dzum pa'i rgyu de 'dren pas pabaka' stsal gsol/ /des ni 'jig rten 'di dag :snyedaga' bar 'gyur/ /shākya thub pa'i zhal nas 'dzum mdzad pa/ /'gro ba 'dis mthong the tshom 'tshal 'gyur 7te/ /nyan par 'tshal zhing gzhan du mi sems 'apar/ /kun kyang 'jig rten phan pa'i zhal du lta/ /'di ltar dper na nad pa nad skyo ba/ /sman pas bsgo lab bzhin du 'dzin bgyid pa/ /de bzhin 'khor 'di lung bstan sna thos 'tshal zhing / /rkang gnyis dbang po bde gshegs zhal du lta/ / 'khor 'di thams cad rgya chen ldan pa ste/ /sna sangs rgyas dgongs la ཿ(zhen pa'i yid dang ldan/ /rgyal bas lung bstan de dag thos 'tshal te/ /kun kyang bde gshegs zhal du lta zhing sdod/ /de la rgyal bas thugs rje che bskyed cing / /ci nas 'khor 'di rab tu dgar 'gyur dang / /sangs rgyas dgongs la bsam pa gzhog 'gyur 42—159

bar1—/ /ye shes stobs kyis the tshom rigacad du gsol/ /mi yi khyu mchog lung bstan dus la gebab the tshom 0'tshal ba'i the tshom bsal da du gsol/ /sangs rgyas slar sdo'i khudagra ni mi'i mnga' na/ /rtog ge'i tshogs kyi sde ni gzhig kyitu gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rta thul la tshigs su bcad de slar bka' stsal pa/ rta thul khyod kyis 'jig rten sgron mdzad la/ /'dzum pa'i don dris de ni dus dang ldan/ /de ltar 'jig rten mkhas la dris 9 pas na/ /de ring 'gro ba 'di yi don chen byas/ /'jig rten phan phyir 'dzum pa 'di mdzad pa/ /gang gis chos rab 'di dag shes gyur te/ /nga 7la mchod pa rgya chen 'di byas pa'i/ /dga' ldan lha yi /1bsam pa mkhyen nas mdzad/ /'gro ba yang dag rtogs pa bzhin du mthong / /rgyal ba'i dgongs pas chos nyid brnyes par gyurang/ /gang la 'gro ba thams cad rmongs gyur pa'isku/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum rab tu rtogs/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams la lhag bya byas/ /bsam pa gcig gis zhu ba legs par zhus/ /de nyid du ni stong nyid legs par bsgoms/ /sngon chad byas pa de ni 'dir yang bstanas/ /de dag de bzhin gshegs dang deng phrad cing / /skyes bu mchog dang 'grogs pa thob gyur nas/ /stong pa nyid kyis 'dren pa bstod byas pas/ /de ring 'gro ba'i don mchen shin 8tu byas/ /'gro ba thams cad skye med ji bzhin du/ /byang chub rgyal ba de bzhin lung bstan dang / /gang dag zhi ba thob nas spyod pa dang / /byang chub de bzhin de dag skye ba med/ /'gro ba kun gyi chos nyid 'di za'adra ba/ /de shes byang chub thob par 'gyur ro zhes/ /lha rnams gang yang de la the tshom med/ /byang chub sems kyis rtag par de ltar spyod/ /de bzhin 'gro ba 'gag med ji 42—160

bzhin du/ /lha tshogs 'di dag rtogs 1pa'i blo ldan te/ /mkhas pa 'di dag nem nur med pas na/ /de phyir 'di dag rgyal ba rang byung 5'gyur/ /gnas pa med pa la ni nges gyur nas/ /g.yo ba med pa de la nem nur med/ /'gro ba kun la sems pa yong min pa/ /de la'ang lha rnams the tshom yong med do/ /chos rnams ngo bo nyid kyis rang bzhin med/ /byang chub sems dang de bzhin byang chub kyang / /thams cad — nongo bo nyid kyis rang bzhin med/ /de la'ang lha rnams the tshom rnam par dag /blo mchog ldan pa'i dga' ldan lha 'di rnams/ /kun kyang gnas med de la rab gnas te/ /de ciphyir 5lha rnams byang chub 5rnyed mi dka'/ /rang byungamo nyid ni myur du thob par 'gyur/ /'dren pas nyamar ma 'dra ba'i bskal pa la/ /'gro ba mtha' yas rnam par 'grel par 9'gyur/ /rgyal ba de dag mtshan du 'gyur ba tshani/ /rang byung ’ chos la rnam nges rgyal po'o / /de ltar rgyal bas dga' ldan lha rnams kyi/ /bsam pa mkhyen te 'gro la bstan mdzad pa/ /de thos nas ni lhar bcas 'jig rten yang / / yi rangs ① gyur cing stobs kyang thob par 'gyurab/ /dga' ldan pa lung bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o// //de nas de'i tshe rab 'phrul la sogs dpa 'phrul dga' ba bye ba phrag bdun cus lha ma yin rnams nas dga' ldan ris kyi bar gyi lha de dag gi tshamachod pa yang mthong ske/ lung bstan pa yang thos nas tshim zhing mgu la yi rangs te/ rab tu dga' zhing dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes nas yang dag pa'i mtha' la gnas shing de bzhin nyid la the tshom med par gyur nas stan :snyelas langs te/42—161

bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 1logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud 5de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i don bdag gegis 'tshal ba ltar na/ chos thams cad ni yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / sgrib pa ma mchis pa'i mtha' dang / mtha' yas pa'i mtha' dang / mi gnas pa'i mtha' dang /mi zad pa'i mtha' dang / mi gnyis pa'i mtha' ste/ mtha' ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de la ma nor ba'i slad du yang dag pa'i mtha' zhes bgyi'o/ /tshad ma mchis pa'i slad du mtha' yas pa'i mtha' zhes bgyi'o/ /chags pa ma mchis pa'i slad du sgrib pa ma mchis pa'i mtha' zhes bgyi'o/ /ngo bo nyid ma mchis pa'i slad du mi gnas pa'i mtha' zhes bgyi'o/ /'byung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du mi zad pa'i mtha' zhes bgyi'o/ /ro gcig pa'i slad du mi gnyis pa'i mtha' zhes bgyi'o/ /mtha' 5ma mchis pa'i slad du mtha' ma mchis pa zhes bgyi'o / /bcom ldan 'das yang dag pa'i mtha' 'di ni thams cad kyi 0rjes su song ba lags te/ chos gang yang dag pa'i mtha' ma lags pa'i chos de gang yang ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub ces bgyi ba 'di ni yang dag pa'i mtha' ste/ byang chub gang zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad rang bzhin ma mchis pa ni byang chub lags par rig par bgyi'o/ /tha na mtshams med pa rnams kyang byang chub bo/ /de ci'i slad du 7zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub ni rang bzhin ma mchis pa ste/ mtshams med pa 8rnams kyang rang bzhin ma mchis pa lags pas de'i slad du mtshams med pa rnams kyang byang chub ces bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das phung po ma lus pa'i 9mya ngan las 'das pa'i 42—162

dbyings ni rang bzhin ma mchis pa ste/ mtshams med pa rnams kyang de'i rang bzhin no/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni phung po ma lus pa'i 1mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings te / mtshams med pa rnams kyang de'i rang bzhin no/ /bcom ldan 'das gang su dag yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar ca'atshal ba de dag ni gnod par 'gyur ba'i chos can te/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ gal te 'khor bar zhugs pa zhig mchis na ni mya ngan las 'da' ba 5yang btsal pobar 'gyur na/ yang dag pa'i mtha' la ni 'khor bar zhugs pa gang yang ma mchis na de mya ngan las 'das pa ci zhig tshol bar 'gyur/bcom ldan 'das yang dag pa'i mtha' ni gnyis su ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das de la bdag cag som nyi ma mchis the tshom ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig chos 'di la nem nur dang the tshom ma mchis na de ni sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis 7bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan par 'tshal bar bgyi'o / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe lha'i rgyal po rab 'phrul la sogs 9pa/ 'phrul dga' 7ris kyi lha 1bye ba phrag bdun cu po mde dag rang 12gis rang lung skabastan pa gsan thunas 'gro ba thams cad rab tu dga' bar 7bya ba'i phyir de'i tshe 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rta thul gyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ 'jig rten phan par bzhed pas 'dzum pa mdzad/ /'dzum pa'i rgyu ni khyod kyis ma bstan te/ /rang byung 7skyes bu dam pa gang dag kyang / /rgyu ma mchis par 'dzum pa mi mdzad pas/ /khyod kyi snyezhal nas 'dzum pa de mdzad pa/ /mthong nas lhar bcas 'jig rten the 42—163

tshom 'tshal/ /'dzum pa'i rgyu de gang lags rang byung 3tshogasungs/ /the tshom 'tshal ba'i the tshom bsalapo ༄du gsol/ /khyod kyis mi'adzum50mdzad rgyu de' thos gyur na / /'khor 'di thams cad ngo mtshar ⑦thob par 'gyur/ /byang chub mchog ni yongs su bsgrub 2slad du/ /de dag lam mchog shin tu rnam dag 'gyur / /the tshom 'tshal ba dag ni nam du yang / /spyodabyang chub yid bzhin bde bar mi 'grub 7ste/ /the tshom som nyi bsal nya nas mkhas pa rnams/ /byang chub mchog gi rgyu dang skal 7ldan 'gyur/ /rkang gnyis dbang po mkhyod kyi r+sā'akhor 'di dag /sdig pa yongs spangs byang chub sems dang ldan/ /lha rnams lung bstan de dag thos gyur na/ /rgyal ba'i go 'phang rgya chen thob par 'gyur/ /de bas rgyal bas 'ithugs rje che bskyed cing / /the tshom 'tshal ba rnams la thugs brtse 7bas/ /lha tshogs 'di dag thams cad lung bstan cing / /'gro ba 'di dag thams cad dga' bar mdzod / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rta thul la tshigs su bcad de slar bka' stsal pa/ ngas ni 'jig rten phan phyir 'dzum pa mdzad/ /rta thul khyod kyis zhu bsna/)de zhus pa/ /lung bstan de ni khyod la ma lus par/ /bstan par ngas byas dang bsam/1kun kyang nyon/ /'phrul dga'i ris kyi ri lha tshogs 'di rnams kyis/ /thams cad mkhyen par bdag cag lung bstan 2 te/ /mu stegs tshogs kyis tsho rtebasam pa zil mnan nas//'khor 'dir seng ge'i nga ro chen po bsgrags/ /gnam du rdo 'phangs sa la lhungam ba ltar/ / de la the tshom za bar mi 'gyur te/ (stede ltar the tshom med pa'i tshul thob pa/ /bdag cag nyid ni stobs bcur 'gyur bar shes/ /nyi ma nub gyur nam sros gyur pa'i tshe/ /mi rnams zla ba myur du 'char bar shes/ /de bzhin 42wa 164

rgyal ba'i sras po 3 tshul thob dag /bdag cag nyid ni stobs bcur 'gyur bar shes/ /skar tshogs dbus na zla ba gnas pa ni/ /sems can mtshungs tsho ripar 'di la the tshom med/ /de bzhin rgyal ba'i sras ripo tshul thob dag /bdag cag thams cad mkhyen du 'gyur bar shes/ /ji ltar nyi ma nub par gyur pa'i tshe/ /nyi ma mi mthong sems can de dag shes/ /de bzhin bde gshegs ci sras po tshul shes pa/ /ye shes dam pa thob par 'gyur du shes/ /chu klung 5ji ltar gzhol bar 'bab dkyi'agyur zhing / /rgya mtshor 'bab par mkhas pa rnams kyis shes/ /de bzhin bde gshegasar sras po tshul shes pa/ /byang chub rgya chen thob 9par 'gyur bar shes/ /ji ltar gnam du bong ba 'phangs pa ni/ /sa la lhung tshabar 'gyur du the tshom med/ /de bzhin rgyal sras mkhas pa de dag kyang / /'jig rten mkhas par myur 'gyur ye shes 'jug /gang thos nas ni the tshom med 'gyur zhing —/ /sangs rgyas yon tan gleganas par bdag shes la/ /rang gi sar nyamatshalag stong 'am yin par/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi chos lonyid rab tu mthong / /gal te bdud kyi tshogs ni bye ba dag /sangs rgyas gzugs bsgyur bar chad smras tshabyas kyang / /chos la mkhas pa chos nyid rab mthong ba/ /de dag byang chub las ni bzlog mi nus/ /de ltar sangs rgyas yon tan rab gnas shing / /bdag gis bdag nyid lung bstan rjod labyed pa/ /de la 'dren pa cho ga tshul mkhyen pa//mi dbang lung bstan de la yi rang mdzod / /de ltar lha tshogs 'di dag tshul 'di la/ /gzhan gyi dring la mi 'jog mngon shes shing / /de dag 19bde gshegs 'gyur zhes rang smra la/ /'jig rten mkhas pa rjes su yi rang mdzad / /rta thul de bas mkhas pa gang gi rnams/ /bla med byang chub thob par byar 42—165

sems pa/ /de dag tshul 'di shes par gang gyur pa'i/ /'phags pa'i skye bo mkhas la bsten 1par bya/ /gang dag tshul la 'jug pa narab mthong zhing / /mkhas pa gang dag bde gshegs ribasnyen bkur ba/ /de dag byang chub lag mthil 'dra bar gsal / /tshul shes de dag rang gis rang 'byung 'gyur/ /gang gis bskal pa stong du dka' thub spyad/ /sha khrag pags 'al mi lta byas pa bas / /gang gis tshul 'di skad cig rtogs gyur na/ /de ni khyad 'phags dka' thub da ltar 5min/ /'das pa'i rang byung cagang rnams byung 3ba dang / /ma 'ongs sems can phan bzhed gang 'byung tshodang / /da 7ltar dus na 'dren /nyapa gang bzhugs par/ /kun kyang tshul gyis bde bar gshegs pa thob rab 'phrul lha tshogs thub pa'i tshul shes pa/ /'di dag nga la mchod pa mchog byas shing ske/ /'dren 12pa thams cad bsnyen bkur rab byas nas/ /tshul gyis su ni rang 'byung skathob par 'gyur/ /'jig rten mkhas pa'i ting 'dzin gang yin pa//de yis 7rgyal ba rang byung 7gnas pa'i rnams/ /de dag thams cad rgyal ba'i spyod yul lo18/ /tshul thob rnams kyis mngon 9bsten myur du 'thobad / /de la rta thul sangs rgyas sras rnams ni/ /sangs rgyas gnas pa de la nemamanyanur med//sangs rgyas tshul la sems can rnam rtse 2ba/ /tshul shes pa dag ston pa'i lam la spyod / /de ltas 2tshul la dad pa'i 24yid byas te/ /brtsam par bya yis sdug bsngal spyod la min/ /rtag tu dge bshes mkhas pa bsten byas nas/ /bla med byang chub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung mchog thos nas ni/ /'khor kun rgyal ba'i byang chub yi rangs te / /rjes su yi rang the tshom med gyur nas/ /mthar phyin blo gros la ni zhugs 8par gyur0/ /'phrul 42wa 166

dga' ba lung bstan 1pa'i le'u ste bcwa brgyad pa'o// //bam po bdun pa/ de nas de'i tshe lha'i rgyal po dbang sgyur la sogs ripa gzhan 'phrul dbang byed ciris kyi lha khrag khrig phrag brgyad cus lha ma yin rnams nas 'phrul dga'i lha'i bar dag gis rimachod pa yang mthong / lung bstan pa yang thos nas tshim zhing mgu la yi phyorangs te/ rab tu dga' zhing dga' ba dang ske/ yid bde ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phrul dga'i lha 7rnams kyis yang dag pa'i mtha' zhes gang smras pa de la bdag cag gis ni yang dag pa yang mi 9dmigs na de'i mtha' lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig gis yang dag pa 7dmigs na ni mtha' yang des ha dmigs par 'gyur te de ni gnyis kyis spyod pa'o/ /de lta bu de boni theg pa la yang dag par zhugs 1 pa'i rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo rnams kyi spyod yul glum lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig gnyis su ma mchis pa'i chos rnams la chos rnams ni gnyis su med do zhes mi spyod ma mos na de 'di snyam du bdag gis byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya'o snyam du sems su lags kyang / de ni lam log par zhugs par 'tshal bar bgyi ba'ong/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/bcom ldan 'das gang 'di byang chub tu smon pa de ni lam log par zhugs pa lags te/ bcom ldan 'das gang mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya labar bgyi ba'i chos de gang yang ma mchis so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das chos 'ga' 7zhig dmigs par gyur na byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya 42—167

bar mi nus so/ /bcom ldan 'das chos ni 'das pa ma lags/ ma 'ongs pa ma 1lags/ da ltar byung ba ma lags/ 'dus byas ma lags/ 'dus ma du byas ma lags/ dngos po ma lags / dngos po ma mchis pa ma lags/mngon par shes par bgyi ba 4ma lags/ yongs su shes par bgyi ba (zherim lags / spang bar bgyi ba ma lags/ bsgom par bgyi ba ma lags/ mngon du 7bgyi ba ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub ces bgyi ba de yang chos gang gi gnyen po yang ma lags la chos gang yang chos /de'i gnyen po ma lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ chos de ni kun nas nyon mongs pa ma lags / rnam par byang ba ma lags te/ gang gis chos gzhan gyi gnyen por gyur pa'i chos de yang rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs la gang chos de'i gnyen por gyur pa'i chos gzhan de gang yang rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni mtshan ma dang bral ba ste/ de dag ni mngon par shes par bgyi ba ma lags/ yongs su shes par bgyi ba ma lags / spang bar bgyi ba ma lags/ bsgom par bgyi ba ma lags/ mngon du bgyi ba ma lags te/ bcom ldan 'das gzugs ni gzugs kyi mtshan ma dang bral ba'o/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa 7ni rnam par shes pa'i mtshan ma dang bral ba'o/ /gzugs kyi skye ba'i mtshan ma nas rnam par shes pa'i bar gyi skye ba gang lags pa de yang skye ba'i mtshan ma dang bral ba'o/ /gzugs kyi 'gag pa nas rnam par shes pa'i bar gyi 'gag pa gang lags pa de yang 'gag pa'i mtshan ma dang bral ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba yang 'das pa dang / ma 42—168

'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba dang bral ba'o/ /'dus byas kyang 3)'dus naribyas kyi mtshan ma dang bral ba'o/ /'dus ma byas kyang 'dus ma byas kyi mtshan ma dang bral ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar ji tsam du phung pos bzung ba'am/skye ba dang / 'gag pas bzung ba'am/ 'das pas bzung ba'am/ ma 'ongs pas bzung ba'am/ da ltar byung bas bzung ba'am/ 'dus byas kyis cibazung ba'am / 'dus ma byas kyis bzung ba de dag ni rnam pa thams cad du mi dmigs te / de ltar mi dmigs pa de ni mngon par shes par bgyi ba ma lags/ yongs su shes par bgyi ba ma lags/ spang phyobar bgyi ba ma lags/bsgom par bgyi ba ma lags/ mngon du bgyi ba ma lags te/ bcom ldan 'das gang dag de ltar zhugs pa'i rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa zhes bgyi'o / /de nas rngu gzhan 'phrul dbang byed ris kyi lha de dag gis ji ltar shes pa'i chos de ltar lung bstan nas de'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa dag gis mngon par bstod pa/ bcom ldan srid pa mthar 'byin legs 9par gsungs/ /'dren pas srid pa'i snying po ma brnyes nas/ /skye bo mi mkhas de dag 'jigs pa yis / /'khor ba'i pha rol bgrod phyir rab tu zhugs/ /phung po rnams ni kun tu mi dmigs telha / /phung po'i mtshan mas phung po stong pa nyid/ /chos gang gang gi paganyen por 'gyur ba ni/ /mtshan mas stong ste dgang yang ma mchis so /ngo bo nyid kyis stong phyir dngos po gang / /yongs shes bya dang spang bsgoms mngon bya ba/ /gang yang ma mchis gang du'ang mi dmigs te/ /dngos po rnams ni dngos med rang byung tshagasung / /byang chub gang yang mtshan mar mi 42—169

dmigs te/ /byang chub phyogs kyi chos rnams de bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas gang yang mtshan mar mi dmigs te/ /byang chub sems dpa' mtshan mas rtogs mi 'gyur / /mi mkhas gang dag mtshan mar mngon zhen pa/ /de dag byang chub 'tshang rgyar 1sems bskyed kyang / /mtshan mar spyod cing spyod yul log pa ste/ /blo gros ngan pas 5byang chub lam mi spyod/ /mtshan ma sus spangs sangs rgyas spyod yul la/ /spyod pa de dag sangs rgyas bstan la mkhas/ /mtshan ma de bzhin mtshan ma med spangs te/ /stong dang mi stong de bzhin dmigs ci med pa/ /mkhas pa de dag byang chub lam la spyod/ /de dag byang chub dam pa zhi ba 'thob ske/ /phas kyi phyorgol ba kun gyi spyod yul min/ /gnas de nyan thos rnams kyis bgrod bya min/ /rang rgyal rnams kyang de la mi 'gro ste/ /rnam grol sems ldan zag med tha ba med/ /dgra bcom bstan pa 'di la zugang brtson dang / /de bzhin rang rgyal skyob napar gyur pa dag /mkhas pa'i spyod yul de la spyod yul med/ /go 'phang 9de ni mtshan ma spyod pa dang / /nyi che'i 7stong pa nyid la sgom ’ pa dang / /gang rnams stong pas stong zhes stong smra dang / /chos kun rang bzhin yong smras 'thob mi nus/ /sangs rgyas ma smad rnams kyi bslab pa la/ /slob dang rnam bral slob pa slob pa'i rnams/ /mkhas de rtogs pa med pas byang chub rtogs/ /ston pas bstan pa bzhin du dgyes byed tshalags/ /sangs rgyas rkang gnyis gtso bo bstod pas na snye/ /bdag cag bsod nams mi chung gang thob des / /'gro ba byang chub dam pa 'tshang rgya 7zhing / /mi shes ston mdzad sangs rgyas 'grub dpar shog /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe lha'i rgyal po dbang sgyur la sogs lapa gzhan 'phrul dbang byed 7ris kyi lha lha 9khyag khrig phrag 42—170

brgyad cu po de dag gi rtsilhag pa'i bsam pa thugs su chud nas skye bo phal po che de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa'i phyir de'i tshe 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rta thul gyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad /de gsol pa/gzhan 'phrul dbang byed lha yi bsam mkhyen nas/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo khyod kyis 'dzum mdzad las/ /thub pas 'dzum pa'i rgyu de rim gsungs na/ /rgyal ba phyi 'dzum pa'i rgyu ni bstan du gsol/ /'dren pa rgyu med 'dzum pa mi mdzad ces/ /rgyal ba khyu mchog dam pas de skad gsungs/ /'jig rten don slad na'adzum pa mdzad pa'i rgyu/ /'dren pas 9bka' stsol the tshom bsal du gsol/ /drang srong chen po'i zhal nas 'dzum rig nas/ /thub chen khyod kyi nga'akhor rnams the tshom 'tshal / /go /1tam rgyal ba 'dren pas de dag la/ /'jig rten sman slad 'dzum rgyu lung bstan tshagasol/ /'di dag 'khor ba'i rgyud las rirgyab phyogs te/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i sems kyis thal sbyar sdod/ /'khor 'di yangs pa'i sems ldan the tshom 'tshal/ /don yod grags mnga' som nyi bsal mdu gsol/ /bde gshegs bstan la the tshom ma mchis te/ /phyir zhing dad bskyed rim gro mcher bgyid de/ /the tshom mi 'tshal sems ni grol 'gyur bar/ /rgyal bas skye bo'i the tshom legs par khum/ /bde gshegs bstan la 'di dag bder gnas shing la/ /gang lam rang byung 7rgyal ba gshegs gyur pa/ /lam de nas ni the tshom ma mchis 1 mchi / /de bas skye bo'i the tshom gcod rtedu gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rta thul la tshigs su bcad de slar bka' stsal pa/ skye bo tshogs chen don dbang brten byas nas/ /tshigs su bcad de dus su gang smras shing —/ /'dzum pa'i don gyi rgyu ni yongs zhus pa/ /khyod kyi tshig 1ni dus dang 42—171

ldan pa yin/ /rta thul dri ba de yi don dris pas/ /skye bo tshogs chen 'di yi don byas gyur / /khyod kyis de dris skye bo tshogs chen dag /byang chub mchog tu yang dag zhugs par 'gyur/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed bsam pa ngas mkhyen te/ /rta thul 'dzum pa 'di gni ngas bstan to/ /'jig rten mkhyen pa'i ④bstan pa'i lam de nas/ /don du gnyer ba de 5dag de bzhin 'dod/ /gang gis 'gro ba 'di dag mtshan med par/ /smig 5rgyu la ni ji ltar chu bzhin mthong —/ /byis pa rmongs pa mkhas pa'i tshul bzhin te/ /de dag rjes su byang chub 'dod pas bslab/ /mtshan ma'i 'du shes spang phyir mi rnams gang / /rtag tu mtshan ma mngon dga' 'jig na'agyur zhing / /mtshan ma'i 'du shes log pa'i lam du 'dong / /mtshan ma med pas 9byang chub mchog thob 'gyur/ /med pa'i rtog ldan mtshan mar rnam brtags nas/ /ji ltar brtags pas tshade ltar 'ching ba yin/ /mtshan ma stong par ① rnam mthong skumakhas pa yi/ /zhi ba dag ni grags pa dam pa thobasku/ /'du shes mtshan can mi mnyam sems rgyud kyis/ /sdig pa brgya gedag mi mkhas de dag byed/ /'gro ba kun tu masdug bsngal mi chung myong tri/ /de ltar mi mkhas mtshan ma ཿ brtag pa byas/ /mtshan mar 'du shes pa ni phung po dang / /sangs rgyas byang chub byang chub sems dpa' mthong /rte/ de ltar mtshan ma med cing stong mthong na/ /byang chub gzhal med bla na med pa 'thob 9/ /'du shes mtshan ma can la nyon mongs 'phel/ /mtshan ma med pa kun tu sbyor ba spong / /mtshan ma las ni kun 2 7sbyor gzhan07med de 2/ /kun tu sbyor ba de nyid mtshan med 2yin/ /gang rnams byang chub thobang par bya rtog pa / /rtog pa de nyid mi mkhas bar chad yin/ /mkhas pa'i)longs spyod rnam 42—172

pa 〉〉thob byed na/ /longs spyod de nyid mtshan ma med par 'gyur/ /chos rnams gang yang rang bzhin nyid kyis med/ /rnam par rtog pas chos byung cakun kyang stong / /rtog pa med pas mtshan ma med par 'gyur/ /de nyid byang chub gzhan du mkhas mi smra/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa de dag thos gyur nas/ /mi 'jigs ldan pa'i 'khor ni the tshom bsal/ /dper na tsam pa'i phreng 5ba 'dzin pipa ltar/ /mkhas narnams thub pas gsungs la legs zhes 'dzin / /'jigs pa med pa'i lha tshogs 'di dag gis/ /mchod pa 'phags pa bla na med byas shing / /rgyal ba'i spyod yul chos rnams yongs chashes nas/ /'gro ba rnam par 'dren pa kun mkhyen 'gyur / /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa 2lung bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o// //de nas tshangs ris kyi lha bye skab phrag drug cus lha ma yin rnams nas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed ris kyi lha'i bar dag gi mchod —pa yang mthong r+ṣa/ lung bstan pa yang thos nas tshim zhing mgu la yi tsharangs te/ rab tu dga' zhing dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes ① nas sngon dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags 1 pa dang /sngon gyi rgyal ba la bsnyen bkur byas pa dang / bsam pa yongs su dag pa'i phyir 'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan la mi 'dod pa skyes shing de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa 'di la ni 19snang ba thob ste/ chos zab mo la bzod pa thob par gyur nas de dag gis chos thams cad byas pa yang 2 ma yin / ma byas pa yang ma yin 2 zhes bya bar shes par gyur to/ /de bzhin du 2 skyes pa yang ma yin/ ma skyes pa yang ma yin/ byung ba yang ma yin/ ma byung ba yang ma yin/ grub pa 42—173

yang ma yin/ ma grub pa yang ma yin/ 'gags pa yang ma yin/ ma 'gags pa yang ma yin/ gnas pa yang ma yin/ mi gnas pa yang ma yin/ kun nas nyon mongs pa yang ma yin/ rnam par byang ba yang ma yin/ rjes su chags pa yang ma yin/ khong khro ba yang ma yin/ rmongs pa yang ma yin/ ma rmongs pa yang ma yin/ shes pa po yang ma yin/ shes pa po med pa yang ma yin/mthong ba po yang ma yin/ mthong ba po med pa yang ma yin/ tshor ba po yang ma yin / tshor ba po med pa yang ma yin/ ston pa po yang ma yin/ ston pa po med pa yang ma yin/ yod pa yang ma yin/ med pa yang ma yin/ dngos po ’yang ma yin/ dngos po med pa yang ma yin/ dmigs pa yang ma yin/ mi dmigs pa yang ma yin/ 'gro ba yang ma yin/ 'ong ba yang ma yin/ song ba yang ma yin/ 'ong ba yang ma yin/ stong pa yang ma yin/ mi stong pa yang ma yin/ mtshan ma yod pa yang ma yin / mtshan ma med pa yang ma yin/smon pa yod pa yang ma yin/ smon pa med pa yang ma yin no zhes bya bar shes par gyur to/ /de dag de ltar chos thams cad la yong 5mi gnas pa'i yid kyis de dag ming la yang phyomi gnas/ tha snyad la yang mi gnas/ brjod pa la yang mi gnas / de dag ni brjod pa'i 'du shes can yang ma yin brjod du med pa'i 'du shes can yang ma yin/ bya ba'i 'du shes can yang ma yin/ bya ba med pa'i 'du shes can yang ma yin/ so so'i skye bo'i 'du shes can yang ma yin/so so'i skye bo ma yin pa'i 'du shes can yang ma yin/ so so'i skye bo'i /chos kyi 'du shes can yang ma yin/ so so'i skye bo ma yin pa'i chos kyi 'du shes can yang ma yin/ nyan thos kyi 'du shes can yang ma yin/ nyan thos ma yin pa'i 'du 42—174

shes can yang ma yin/ nyan thos kyi chos kyi 'du shes can yang ma yin/ nyan thos ma yin pa'i chos kyi 'du shes can yang ma yin/ rang sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes can yang ma yin/ rang sangs rgyas ma yin nga 'i 'du shes can yang ma yin/rang sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi 'du shes can yang ma yin/ rang sangs rgyas ma yin pa'i chos kyi 'du shes can yang ma yin/ byang chub sem sa dpa'i 'du shes can yang ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' ma yin pa'i 'du shes can yang ma yin/byang chub sems dpa'i chos kyi 'du shes can yang ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' ma yin pa'i chos kyi 'du shes can yang ma yin/ sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes can yang ma yin/ sangs rgyas ma yin pa'i 'du shes can yang ma yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi 'du shes can yang ma yin/ sangs rgyas ma yin pa'i chos kyi 'du shes can yang ma yin/1 mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'du shes can yang ma yin / mya ngan las 'das pa tsho ma yin pa'i 'du shes can yang ma yin/ 'khor ba'i 'du shes can yang ma yin/ 'khor ba med pa'i 'du shes can yang ma yin te/ de ltar — thams cad kyi thams cad du rtog pa med pa'i blo can nam mkha' cibazhin du dag cing gos pa med par gyur nas de rnams 5dag pa dang gos pa med pa'i phyir de'i tshe de dag zhi bas/ bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad 5pa dag gis mngon par bstod 7pa/ zhi la zhi ba'i thugs mnga' zhi ba spyad cing zhi ba'i pha rol byon / /zhi ba bsten 9par mdzad cing 'gro la zhi ba bsten 7pa rjes su ston/ /zhi ba'i spyod yul dgyes shing byang chub zhi la dri bral 'khrugs tsham mchis/ /khyod kyis 'chi med zhi ba 'gro rgyud thams cad zad rta pa myur du brnyesami / /zhi ba thob par mibagyid pa'i zhi ba'i lam mchog zhi ba yang dag 42—175

bsten / /yan lag brgyad pas nyon mongs klong0 rnams zhi mdzad 'gro ba thams cad bton/ /sngon gyi rgyal bas bston pa'i byang chub gzhal yas zhi ba de la 'god —/ /de bsten risangs rgyas 'phags pas bsten pa'i grong khyer zhi bar deng zhes gsung / /'dren pa de ltar 'gro ba 'di la rgyal bas bsten pa'i bslab pa bstan / /gal te bslab pa de slob pa'agro ba 'di dag byang chub gzhal yas 'thob / /bslabs phyinas zhi zhing yid zhi zhi ba'i lam dong dbang po zhi ba dag /'jig rten mkhas pa 'gro ba zhi byed mthu 7chen zhi ba shes napar 'gyur/ /'dren pa khyod kyi sras mchog zhi ba 'gro ba zhi bgyid gang dag gis/ /'chi med zhi ba mtshan ma thams cad zad pa rnam par rtog 9gyur pa/ /de dag 'dren pa tshul la mkhas pa ’ mchod pa mchog gis mchod par 'gyur / /nyon mongs zhi zhing mtshan ma kun spangs zhi ba rtag tu ston par 'gyur/ /'gro ba thams cad zhi zhing mtshan ma bral ba de nyid mya ngan 'das/ /thub pa gang dag zhi las tshazhi 'dod sems pa de dag nyon mongs 'gyurapa/ /rgyal ba khyod kyi byang chub dang ni 'gro kun chos kun bsam mi khyab/ /thub pa blo ldan 'dam las rgal ba de la bdag cag dogs ma mchis/ /gang dag phung po bor te byang chub zhi getshol de la zhi bar rtogs / /phung po 'jig dpa de dag shākya thub pa'i bstan la dga' ma lags/ / dben pa'i lablo gos ldan pa zhi 7tshol de dag blo 'khrugs gyur pa ste/ /chos kyi mtshan ma spyod yul 'di dag byis pa zhes ni ston pas gsungs/ /thams cad mkhyen pas zhi dang mtshan ma'i 'ching ba 'di dag : gsungs/ /thub pa gang dag phung po rnams la rnam pa kun tu mtshan mi rnyed rte/ /de dag shākya thub pa'i bstan pa mdzes byed gang dag mtshan med dga'/ /de dag byang chub skyon bral zhi ba 42—176

mkhas pa'i spyod yul thob par 'gyur/ /bdud kyi rtsod mirilas rgyal nas nyon mongs zhi ba'i pathams cad ririmakhyen pa 'thobaca/ /rnam 'dren zhi ba mdzad la bstod pas bdag cag bsod nams gang rnyed 5pa/ /chags med thugs mnga' bde bar gshegs pas 'di tsam zhes ni mkhyen gyur pa/ /des ni 'gro ba thams cad lam mchog thams cad mkhyen pas bsten gyur pa/ /zhi byed zhi ba bsten dzinas mkhas pas tshomachod pa'i rang 'byung sdig med shog /de nas mi mjed 9)kyi bdag po tshangs pas tshangs pa rnams dang / lha rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la bstod par rig nas bdag nyid kyis tshul dang 'dra ba'i tshigs su bcad pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod nyi pa/ mi dbang khyod kyis chos rnams thams cad ni/ /log pa 1nyarmongs byed chang ba stong 'dra zhing / /ston gyi sprin 'dra mig 'phrul 'dra bar mkhyen/ /rgyal bas 'dod pa'i yon tan med par mkhyen / /ji ltar mi zhig mi lam bkres gyur pas/ /kha zas ro brgya zos kyang ma 'drangs tshapa/ /de la bkres pamed zas 7med sems can med/ /rmi lam de 'drar chos rnams thams cad gzigs/ /sgom pa'i mi zhig nyal ba'i mi lam na/ /chu bsil dang zhing rnyog 8med 'thungs gyur kyang la/ /ngoms med tsha ba zhi bar mi 'gyur te/ /de bzhin khyod kyis 7chos rnams thams cad gzigs/ /'di la byed med tshor med sems can med/ /byas pa de bzhin med cing rnam smin med//'bras /bu myong bar 'gyur ba de med ces/ /'di 'dra'i chos ma/khyen 9be tshom yong mi mnga'/ /mi zhig yid du 'ong ba'i tshig smra na/ /dga' bar 'gyur 22yang tshig la 'pho ba med/ /tshig nyid med cing dgar 'gyur dngos kyang med / /de mkhyen de la the tshom yong mi mnga'/ / pi bang sgra snyan mnyan na rnar snyan te//42—177

sgra de rang bzhin gang yang yod pa min / /de ltar mkhas pas phung po 'di gzigs na/ /phung po'i rang bzhin gang yang dmigs mi mnga'/ /nor bu rin chen rang bzhin gsal dag pa/ /gos kyi drung bzhagate sna tshogs tshon ridu 'gyur//de ltar rang bzhin yongs 5dag chos rnams kyang / /log pa'i rnam par rtog pas de ltar gyur / /tsan dan dri med skyon dang bral ba yang / /rkyen dang sbyar na dri zhim gzhan du 'gyur/ /de ltar rang bzhin yongs dag chos rnams kyang / /so so rang gis brtags pa'i rnam napa bzhin/ /ji ltar mi yis /dung gi sgra thos te/ /sgra 'di ga las byung zhes brtag 7byas kyang / /rang bzhin gyis stong dngos po de ’ mi dmigs / /mi dbang khyod kyis de bzhin chos kun gzigs/ /ji ltar mi zhig bsod pa'i kha zas la/ /yan lag srog phan ji ltar 'gyur brtags na / /dngos med yan lag srog kyang de bzhin te/ /drang srong chen pos de bzhin chos kun gzigs/ / ji ltar sgomi zhig nam mkha'i 'ja' mthong na'i / /yan lag gzhigs tshabartags rang bzhin med cing 7stong / / nam mkha'i 'ja' bzhin khyod kyis yan lag stong / /: drang srong chen pos sna de bzhin chos kun gzigs/ / grong khyer mchog kyang yan lag rnam gzhigs na/ /grong khyer rang bzhin de bzhin ming mi dmigs/ /grong khyer ji bzhin de ltar yan lag stong / /mi dbang khyod kyis de bzhin chos kun gzigs/ /2 skyes 21bu dga' bar rnga zhig brdungs 22bgyis na/ /dga' ba skyed kyang sgra yi 2 rang bzhin stong —/ /ji ltar sgra bzhin de ltar yan lag stong / /mi dbang khyod kyis de bzhin chos kun gzigs/ / 5skyes bus ji ltar rnga de brdungs pa'i tshe/ /sgra ni phyogs su mi 'gro 'byung ba medas/ /phyogs su de bzhin 'gag par mi 'gyur 42wa 178

te / /mi dbang 4khyod kyis de bzhin chos kun gzigs/ /skyes bus 5ji ltar rnga de brdungs pa'i tshe/ /thogs pa med cing snyan pa'i rang bzhin te/ /cakhyod kyi yan lag rnga sgra de dang 'dra/ /mi dbang khyod kyis de bzhin chos kun gzigs/ /skyes bus ji ltar rnga de brdungs pa'i tshe/ /sgra de 5'jig rten dga' byar rtog pa med / /poji ltar sgra bzhin khyod kyi 7yan lag stong / /mi dbang khyod kyis chos kun de ltar gzigs/ /skyes bus ji ltar rnga de brdungs pa'i tshe/ /g.yo ba med cing zhi ba'i dngos kyang med/ /ji ltar rnga bzhin khyod kyi yan lag stong / /mi dbang khyod kyis de bzhin chos kun gzigs/ /skyes bus ji ltar rnga de brdungs pa'i 9tshe/ / sgra de yan lag ma byung rang dbang min / /ji ltar sgra bzhin khyod kyi yan lag stong / /mi dbang khyod kyis de bzhin chos kun gzigs/ /11de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshangs ris kyi 12lha de dag dang / mi mjed 1 kyi bdag po tshangs pa de'i lhag pa'i bsam pa thugs su chud cing zhi gnas dang ye shes mthong ba'i bstod 7pa des de ltar bstod pas 'khor de yang dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags tshapar gyur par gzigs nas de'i tshe 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rta thul mi gyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/shākya thub pa'i zhal nas 'dzum mdzad dri med dag mthong skonas/ /lhar bcas mir bcas 1 klu dang gnod sbyin bcas pa'i 'jig rten kun/ /skyob pa'i 'dzum mthong thams cad ldan pa'i 'gro ba the tshom 'tshal/ /bde gshegs zhal bzangs de la lta 19zhing thos par dga' ste sdod/ /rgyal ba 'dzum mdzad legs par bka' stsol 2the tshom dgum du gsol/ /rnam par 'dren pa thub mchog kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'dren pa rnams/ /rgyu ma mchis par 'jig rten don byed 42—179

'dzum mdzad ma mthong na/ /bde gshegs khyod kyis gang slad 'dzum mdzad the tshom rgyu de gsungs/ /rgyal ba 'dzum mdzad rgyu thos 'gro ba rnams ni dga' bar 'gyur / /'khor 'di the tshom 'tshal nas thal mo sbyar te khyod la sems /bde gshegs thub pa'i gsung mchog the tshom gcod 1pa nyan 'tshal na/ /rnam 'dren thub pa 'dzum mdzad rgyu de de ridag rnams la gsungs/ /thos nas 'gro ba dga' zhing the tshom ma mchis 'phel cabar 'gyur/ /'khor 'di snying po 5ldan zhing rtog med sangs rgyas yon tan phyi'atshal/ /ston pa khyod kyi zhal mdzes zla ba mdzes pa 'dra la lta / /'dren pa chags med rdzogs pa tshangs pa 'dra ba'i gsung bsgrags gsol/ /de thos 'khor rnams the tshom chad cing chos la gnas par 'gyur/ /khyod kyi 9tshangs pa'i gsung dzimachog don ldan 'jig rten 'das rig nas/ /skye bo dga' zhing mgu ba'i yid ldan thams cad mkhyen pas tshim /de dag dogs bsal sbyangs pa'i yid kyis thams cad mkhyen du sgrub / /brtson 'grus stobs chen skabaskyed nas 'dun —pa stobs ldan rtsom par bgyid/ /de lta lags pas 'jig rten 'dren pa phan mdzad gsung cibasgrags tshagasol/ /rkang gnyis dam pa'i gsung mchog mi g.yo thos nas de yis ni/ /dge ba thob pa'i 'khor 'di thams cad mkhyen du sems 'gyur bar/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba 'gro ba kun la phan pa legs 7par dgongs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rta thul la tshigs su bcad de slar bka' stsal pa/ rta thul nga yis phan byed 'dzum pa 'gro ba kun la gang bstan pa/ /rtse gcig yid kyis snyen 19cing bsngags pa mdzes pa de ni mnyan par byos/ /de thos 'gro ba yon tan bsags pa myur du 'jig rten don byed pa/ /phan dang ldan pa'i bya ba sangs 42—180

rgyas bka' stsal :de la brtson 'grus rtsom/ /tshangs pa kun 'khor 'di dag dga' zhing chos rnams la ni the tshom med/ /bskal pa khrag khrig gang gā'i bye ma snesnyed du cadage ba legs par spyadapa/ /kun tu rnam pa dzidag la ma chags yid gyur 'du shes mkha' 'dra ste/ /de ltar gyur kyang bde gshegs byang chub rdzogs par 'tshang rgya sgyusems ma bskyed/ /'di dag ma 'ongs dus na bskal pa bye ba brgya phrag nagazhal yas pa/ /gang gā'i bye ma snyed na rdul bsal 9thams cad mkhyen pa'i stobs la gnas/ /de dag phyi nas bde bar gshegs pa che 4ldan sangs rgyas 'dren che ba/ /srid pa sel cing 'gro ba stong par ston pa'i bcom ldan 'das su 'gyur/ /skyob papa de dag ji ltar spyod pa sku tshe'i 2tshad kyang de ltar 'gyur / /bde gshegs mtha' yas grags ldan 'jig rten sdug bsngal 'grel 7cing gnas par 'gyur/ /de dag rnams kyi sangs rgyas zhing ni zhing gi da'abyor pa gzhal yas tel/ /'dren pa chen po rnams kyis bskal pa khrag khrig rnam pa du mar ni/ /sangs rgyas mtha' yas rnams kyis gsungs kyang de dag bkod pa zad 7mi nus/ /de tshe de dag ye shes stobs ldan zhes bya'i rgyal bar 'thun par 'gyur / /g.yo 8ba med cing sems med mi gnas chos ni 'gro la ston par 'gyur / /de dag zhing mchog rnams su skyob pa'i thams cad mkhyen lam 9ma sbyangs pa'i/ /sems can gcig kyang mi 'byung srid pa de la phal cher mya ngan 'da' / /de dag na ni de tshe 'gro ba de dag sdug bsngal gcig shes te/ /mi rtag 'du byed sdug bsngal rab tu 'jigs pas sems can yid 'byung ba'o/ /de na 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang rnani sdug bsngal sdug bsngal snyeyong mi 'gyur/ /de dag thams cad blo 'thun 'gyur zhing sla ba'i lam la myur bar 'gyur/ /de 42—181

na /mi rnams dag gi sgra skad rang bzhin nagazhan ni 'byung mi 'gyur/ /mi sdug mi rtag de bzhin nyid dang sdug bsngal de bzhin bdag med dang / /zhi ba stong nyid mtshan med 'chi med mya ngan 'das dang byang chub zhi/ /sgra skad de dag yang cadang yang 'byung de dag rna la gnas par 'gyur/ /sgra gang thos nas de dag 'khor ba grol gnas 5thob par mi 'gyur ba/ /de 'dra'i sgra de shing ngam rtsig tshipa dag dang gang na'ang yong mi 'gyur/ /bla gab med dang mkha' dang gtsug 7lag khang dang gnas nakhang rnams tshon med/ /de tshe sangs rgyas mthu dziyis yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i sgra dbyangs 'byung / /de tshe 'dres pa'i nyes pa med cing 'dod chags dang ni zhe sdang dang / /gti mug dag gis gzir ba rnams kyi rnar ni dge ba'i sgra grag ko'agyur/ /'gro ba thams cad 'khor ba 1 las ni 'byung zhing mya ngan 'das 'gror 'gyur/ /de tshe zhing mchog stong pa thams cad dga' ba'i skye bos gang bar 'gyur/ /skyes bu dam pa de dag bskal pa khrag khrig byang chub brtson —byas nas/ /drang srong chen po de dag smon lam gyis ni 'byor pa 'di brtsams gte/ /zhing mchog de na lasems can tshogs gang yod pa de kun bde gshegs 'gyur/ /tshangs pa'i smon lam yangs pa rgya chen 7zhi ba 'gro bas mthong gyur na/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas bka' stsal bzhin du tshangs pa'i tshogs kyis bsten 8gyur pa/ /de la bslabs 9nas 'gro ba thams cad thogs pa med pa'i 'dren par 'gyur/ /de dag rgyal ba thob nas 'gro ba 'di kun dngos po med ces ston / /de lta bas na tshul kun 'jug la mkhas pa'i spyod pa bstan par gyis na / /tshangs pa lung bstan pa'i le'u ste nyi shu pa'o// //42—182

de nas 'od gsal gyi lha bye ba phrag lnga bcu rtsa 1brgyad kyis lha ma yin rnams nas tshangs pa'i bar gyi lha de ridag gi rimachod pa yang mthong / /lung bstan pa yang thos nas tshim zhing mgu la yi cirangs te/ rab tu dga' zhing dga' ba dang yid bde ba 5skyes nas stan nelas langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu bgos 7nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpas tshul la 'jug pa'i slad du gang la bslabs nas 7chos thams cad snang bar 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin chos thams cad snang ba zhes bgyi ba mchis te/ des /chos thams cad kyi tshul la : 'jug pa rtogs snyepar bgyid do/ /de rtogs pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i spobs pa dang / thogs pa ma mchis pa'i spobs pa dang / byin gyis brlabs pa'i spobs pa dang / sna tshogs kyi spobs pa dang / 'jam pa'i spobs pa dang /dge ba'i spobs pa dang / rigs sapa'i spobs pa dang / grol ba'i spobs pa dang ske/ nye bar gyur pa'i spobs pa dang / zab pa'i spobs pa dang / phra ba'i spobs pa dang / thun mong tsham yin pa'i spobs pa can du 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi spobs pa tshayang thob par 'gyur ro/ /chos thams cad snang ba zhes bgyi ba'i ting nge 'dzin de 7gang zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos thams cad kyi tshul la 'jug pa'i slad du rnam par rtog pa dang / rnam par dpyod pa thams cad yid la mi bgyid de/ de 'di snyam du chos thams cad ni rnam par rtog pa med de rnam par rtog pa yongs su chad pa'o/ /gang rnam par mi rtog pa /de ni thams cad du song ba ste/42—183

chos gang yang rnam par rtog par nus pa ma mchis tenya/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/rang bzhin ma mchis pa'i slad du ste/ chos gang la mirang bzhin ma mchis pa bde la byuji ltar rnam par rtog par 'gyur zhes chos thams cad la rnam par mi 5 rtog par a la 'jug pa'i spobs pa rab tu thob necing / de dag a'i sgo la zhugs pas spobs pa mtha' yas par 'gyur 3te/ a zhes bgyi ba ni mtha'ams yas pa/kun tu mtha' yas pa/ ma bgyis pa/ mngon par 'dus 1ma bgyis pa/yongs su ma grub 7pa/ dngos po ma mchis pa/ mi gnas pa/ mi g.yo tsho/nyab/ 'du ba rnam mchis pa/ 'phro ba ma mchis pa/ rtog pa ma mchis pa/ rnam par rtog pa ma mchis pa/ ma bsgrubs pa/ yongs su thug 7pa ma mchis pa'i/ma brtags dpa/ gzugs ma mchis pa/ bstan du ma mchis pa/ bltar ma mchis pa/ ma mthong ba/ bsam du ma mchis pa/ rnam par mi gnas pa/ma shes pa/ rnam par ma shes pa/ ma smos pa/ ma bstan pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ bsam du ma mchis pa song ba ma mchis pa 'ongs pa tsham mchis pa / nye ba ma lags pa / ring ba ma lags pa snye/ ma brtags lha pa/gdags pa ma mchis pa'i chos can/ ming ma mchis pa/ tha snyad ma mchis pa/gnyen po ma mchis pa/ sgrib pa ma mchis pa/ 'pho ba ma mchis pa/ 'khrug pa ma mchis pa/ brtag 2 tu ma mchis pa/ mi zad pa/ gnyis su ma mchis pa/ma byung ba/ brdzun pa ma lags pa/ bden pa ma lags pa/ sho be ma lags pa/ ma skyes pa/ ma 'gags 2pa/ sbyangs pa ma lags pa/ sbyang bar 'os pa ma lags pa/ gdags su ma mchis pa/ mtshan mas ma 2bskyod pa/ma bzung ba/ ma bor ba/ 'dzin pa ma mchis pa ri/ yongs su 'dzin pa ma 42—184

mchis pa/ gtad 3du ma mchis pa/ yongs su gtad du ma mchis pa ma btang ba/ yongs su ma btang ba ste/ a zhes bgyi ba ni sus kyang ma bgyis pasku / chos gang gi byed pa 4po yang ma lags so/ /a ni ma skyes pa ste/ chos gang yang skye bar bgyid pa ma lags so/ /a ni ma skyes pa ste/ chos gang gi 5skye ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'ang nem lags so/ /a ni ma 'gags pa ste/ chos gang gi 'gag pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba'ang ma lags so/ /a ni ma 'gags 9pa yang ma lags pa ste / chos gang gi 1mi 'gag pa'i rkyen du 'gyur ba'ang tsham lags sol/ /a ni gnas pa yang ma lags/ mi gnas pa yang ma lags/ a ni btags 5pa yang ma lags/ ma btags 5pa yang ma lags/ a ni spangs pa yang ma lags/ ma spangs pa yang ma lags/ a ni shes pa yang ma lags/ ma shes pa yang ma lags/ a ni dmigs pa yang ma lags/ ma skadamigs pa yang ma lags/ a ni stong pa yang ma lags/ mi stong pa yang ma lags/ a ni dmigs su mchis pa yang ma lags/ dmigs su ma mchis pa yang ma lags/a ni mtshan ma yang ma lags/ mtshan ma ma mchis pa yang ma lags/ a ni smon pa yang ma lags/ smon pa ma mchis pa yang ma lags te/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar na chos thams cad kyi mtshan nyid ni a'i tshul lo/ /chos thams cad ni tshul gcig pa ste ma'i tshul lo/ /chos thams cad ni 'gro ba gcig pa ste/a'i la'agro ba'o/ /chos thams cad ni 'jug pa gcig pa ste a la 'jug pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni gdags pa gcig pa ste 7as gdags pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni tha snyad gcig pa ste a'i tha snyad do/ /chos thams cad ni brjod pa gcig pa sna ste mas brjod pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das chos gang :dzom skyes pa de dag ni 142—185

rtogs par bgyi ba ma lags 1pa'i tshul gyis rtogs par bgyi'o/ /chos gang rim byung ba de dag ni dngos po ma mchis pa'i tshul gyis rtogs par bgyi'o/ /chos gang ma grub pa de dag ni ma grub pa'i tshul gyis rtogs par bgyi'o/ /chos gang ma 'gags pa de dag ni 'gag pa ma mchis pa'i tshul gyis rtogs par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das chos gang mngon par 'du rim bgyis pa de dag ni/ 'dus ma bgyis pa'i tshul gyis rtogs par bgyi ste / de ni chos thams cad kyi tshul lo/ /bcom ldan 'das chos gang ma skyes pa de dag ni 5tha snyad ji ltar rtogs par bgyi zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dper na rmi lam na bya ba sna tshogs 'byung ba de bzhin du chos thams cad blta bar bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das rmi lam gyi bya ba ni ma skyes pa/ ma byung ba/ dngos po ma mchis pa ste/'on kyang de dag la gdags par gsungs so/ /de bzhin du chos thams cad kyi byed pa yang 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ dper na brag ca la tha snyad 9mchis pa de ’ bzhin du chos thams cad kyi tha snyad kyang blta 1bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ dper na sgyu ma'i skyes bu la gdags pa dmachis pa de bzhin du chos thams cad kyi 1snyegadags par blta'os/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ dper na smig rgyu la chab tu gdags pa'i tha snyad 'imachis pa de bzhin du chos thams cad kyi tha snyad blta bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ dper na me long gi dkyil 'khor la bud med kyi gzugs sams / skyes pa'i gzugs kyi tha snyad mchis pa de 7bzhin du chos thams cad kyi tha snyad blta bar bgyi ste/ bcom ldan 'das byis pa rnams dga' bar bgyi ba'i slad du rmi lam gyi bya ba tshotha snyad du bgyi'i rmi lam gyi bya ba de dag ni ma mchis 12—186

so / /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du byis pa dga' bar bgyi ba'i slad du mig yor dang / mig rgyu dang / brag ca'i 1bya ba dag kyang tha snyad du bgyi ste/brag ca la bya ba ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar bdag cag gis bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i don 'tshal te / bcom ldan 'das 'di ni chos thams cad snang ba zhes bgyi ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de skad ces gsol nas 'od gsal gyi lha rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa dag gis mngon par bstod pa/ bde gshegs khyod kyis tshul gcig mkhyen te 'on kyang gzhan dang gzhan du gsungs/ /thub pa 'jig rten mkhas pa'i sras rnams rnam 5par rol pa'ang de bzhin no/ /de la 'jig rten blo med bdag tu lta ba rnams kyis khong mi chud/ /bdag gi don de phyogs bcur ma mchis bdag nyid kyis ni 'gro ba stong / /sgyu ma gsog dang smig rgyu chu ma mchis la chab kyi 'du shes can / /byis pa de dag blo log de bzhin 'khrul te bdag tu sbyor bar bgyid/ /de dag yang dag ma 'tshal mi mkhas gnas min dngos la rten kyang 'cha' / /de bzhin byis pa'i skye bo smig rgyu 'dra ba'i phung po yong ma 9'tshal/ /'khor bar dga' ba 〉zug rngus zug cing sdug bsngal de yis dbang po bdas lha/ /gang la mi mkhas nges par sdug bsngal myong ba de la dngos ma mchis/ /blo stor yid nor sdug bsngal rnams la bde bar 'du shes nor ba la/ /nyon mongs 'jigs pa che dang dug gsum rnams kyang rjes su 'gro zhing 'brang / /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dug chen nyon mongs mtshungs med rjes su 'brang / /blo stor de dag sdug bsngal gang gis sdug bsngal gyur lopa'i sdug bsngal ba/ /de rnams de dag rjes :lha'abrang byis pa mi mkhas gnod pa'i 5khur yang khyer/ /de dag rgyal ba'i 42—187

tshul sgo thar pa 3bgyid pa stong pa 'di thos nas / /skyes bu ngan pa blo zhan de dag bstan ngag bden pa 5nyid kyis 'jigs/ /bde gshegs khyod kyis a yi ciyi ge 5tshul chen gasgo gcig de ltar bstan/ /de la yang dag blo can sa las shing skye 7bzhin du yid bskyed cing / /bdud rnams bye ba dpung dang bcas btul byang chub zhi ba mngon /'tshang rgya/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i gru 9bcas skye bo nyon mongs rgya mtsho che las sgrol/ /bde bar gshegs pa cang mkhyen des pa rnams ni 7tshul gyi :stodam pa des/ /myur du nyon mongs dug bsal byang chub dpag yas zhi ba 'thob 'gyur zhing ska/ /grol nas dug med gyur pa skye bo gzhan mthong nges pa'i mkhyen brnyes nas/ /pha rol myur phyin dug med bde zhing gdug pa thams cad 'joms par mdzad/ /bde gshegs thams cad stong yang bdag tu rtog / rnams tshul dang tshul min rtogal /'gro ba kun gyi nang nas mkhas pa mtshul dang tshul min bslabs lapa dag /grol nas 'gro ba kun la chags med yid kyis ngo bo nyid kyi chos/ /de yi tshul mthong tshul la mkhas pa de dag mthu chen mgon por 'gyur/ /'ching dang bcings pa med cing sna bde bar gshegs pa chos rnams chos nyid med/ /de bzhin nyid dang :snyem nor de bzhin nyid zhi mi 'dag sna nyon mi mongs/ /nyon mongs mtshan ma med cing zhi 2 byed med la nyon mongs rnams kyang med/ /gang gis tshul chen dam pa 'di mthong de dag thams cad mkhyen du 'gyur / /grol 2 zhing 'grol mdzad zhi ba'i chos can zhi mdzad ngo mtshar 22'gyur mi mnga'/ /bcom ldan lhar bcas 'jig rten dpyid kyi smig rgyu bzhin du 'khrul pa ste / /kun rtog bdag nyid zil gnon bdag dang gzhan med skyes pa bud med rtog /'gro ba sdug bsngal de na sna tshogs kyis bskyed sems kyis 42wa 188

sems kyang ni/ /las dang 'bras bu med cing de myong gang gyur mede yang med/ /bde gshegs de ltar sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyod yul tshul ni bdag cag 'tshal/ /des na da ltarapo bde gshegs zhi thugs dbang po zhi zhing des pa ste/ /dge ba'i blo mnga' dag rigatsang dri med chos kyis carab tu mchod par 'gyur5/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'phags pa'i gtso bo bstod phyopas bsod nams gang byung ba/ /ji /snyed dpal stug rkang gnyis gtso bos 9rnam smin yongs su mkhyen 7gyur pa'i / /bdag cag dge rtsa de yis 'gro ba 'di kun kun mkhyen nyid thob shog /bsod nams ’ 'di kun 'gro ba kun gyi don bsngo kun kyang rgyal bar shog /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'od gsal gyi lha pade dag gi rilhag pa'i bsam pa yongs su dag pa dang / tshul gyi rjes su 'gro ba'i spobs pa phun sum tshogs pa yang thugs su chud la 7'khor de dag gis kyang 'khyad par thob par 'gyur bar mkhyen nas de'i tshe 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rta thul gyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ 'jig rten don mdzad rnam par 'dren mchog kun mkhyen thams cad lazil gnon pa/ /bde gshegs thugs rje ldan rnams rgyu ma mchis par bzhad ’ pa mi mdzad na/ /rgyal ba dpal stug /8rkang gnyis mchog gis 'jig rten thugs brtses bka' stsal gsol/ /'jig rten 'das khyod ci slad 'dzum mdzad de rgyu bdag cag rnams la gsungs/ /gtso bo de thos 'gro ba mtha' 19dag yid ni rab tu dang 'gyur zhing / / rnam par 'dren pa nges 'byung las dang 'bras bu gzhal yas bgyid par 'gyur/ /desas ni lha mir bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'khor bar sdug bsngal nyam thag 'di/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad bstan srid pa'i rgya mtsho 'di nas pasgrol bar 'gyur//42—189

drang srong chen po'i gsung mchog 1yan lag brgyad ldan bzang po 'di thos nas //'gro ba thams cad sangs rirgyas nyid 'tshal dge la cabartson zhing dga' bar 'gyur / /the tshom bral gyur rnam dag yid kyis brtson 'grus drag po'i stobs bskyed cing / /bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa bzhin bgyid khyod dang 'thun byung rasras su 'gyur/ /'khor rnams 'di dag brten pa gzhanam ma mchis par 'dren pa khyod kyi zhal du lta / /'gro ba'i rtsa lag rtog pa yid gnyis bsal zhing bka' lung 9stsal du lagasol/ /bcom ldan 'jig rten 'di dag khyod kyi zhabs 'bring 1 gnas shing nyan par 'tshal/ /gsung rab legs brjod bdud rtsi'i char phob gang dag skom pa 'tshal bar 'gyur/ /'dren pa chen po khyod kyi tsha'akhor 'di dag cing sangs rgyas yon tan 'tshal/ /ring du song ba'i ma la bu lta 12bzhin du khyod kyi zhal du ltas/ /bde gshegs lha rnams lung bstan bka' stsol bzhad pa'i don kyang bstan du gsol/ /skyob pa'i gsung mchog thos na 'jig 7rten don chen shin tu thob par 'gyur/ /thub pa de ring su zhig dge ba 'phel zhing 7grags pa don du gnyer/ /su zhig 'dren pa'i yon tan gter rnyed 7'gyur ba bdag cag ’ de nyan 9'tshal/ /rgyal ba'i 'khor rnams khyod kyis gsungs pa de dag thos shing dgar gyur rtsonas/ /tshul 'di ston cing ting 'dzin stobs ldan shes rab la yang sgom nyapar 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rta thul la tshigs su bcad de slar bka' stsal pa/ rta thul khyod kyi spobs pa legs par dus ldan skyes pa shin tu legs snye/ /bde gshegs rnam par sprul bzhin de ltar khyod kyi dablo gros 'byung 'gyur zhing / /spobs pa che 'byung de phyir gang dang gang dag khyod kyis dris gyur pa/ /de dag lung bstan ngas bshad 42wa 190

kun kyang dbang po zhi bas mnyan par gyis/ /'od gsal ba yi lha rnams blo dag ’sngon gyi rgyal ba namathong ba ste/ /'jig rten mgon med yid can 'di ri dag mthong nas 4 byang chub yang dag zhugs/ /byang chub nges 'byung lam mchog yang dag rgyal bas spyad spyod pa5/ /byang chub 'gro 'dod gang tshe ston med lam stor rnams la ston par 'gyur/ /tshul gyi dam pa shin tu gsal sgra thun mong nem yin 'di thos na / /sangs rgyas yon tan don gnyer blo sbyangs de dag byang chub zhi 'thob ('gyur/ /de dag stobs skyes ’ tshul dang tshul min mkhas shing byang chub yid nges gyur nya/ /bu skyes ma bzhin dga' bas byang chub lamachog tu ’ de dag smon lam btab/ /'od gsal lha rnams 'di dag byang chub 'dod la tshul gyi sgo bstan te/ /bskal pa khrag khrig brjod du med par phra ba'i tshul 'di bstan byas nas/ /sems can skar ma'i grangs pas ches mang ba dag byang chub dga' byas te / de yi 'og tu 'jig rten mkhas pa rang byung 〉skyon bral kun mkhyen 'gyur / /de dag zhing mchog brjod du med pa zhing rnams bye ba brgya 'grangs 7par / /yangs shing shin tu dga' la mtha' dag bkod pa rnams kyis brgyan pa ste/ /kun gyi zhing du ngan song rnams dang de bzhin mi khom yong mi 'byung / /bde bar gshegs rnams thugs brtses : sems can thams cad rang 'byung mdzad par 'gyur/ /zhing rnams de dag gang na'ang nyan thos theg pa ston par mi 'gyur te/ /sems can thams cad rang byung 2nyid du mngon phyogs 'phrogs ri pa med par 'gyur/ /de na rang byung sangs rgyas nyid ston mdzad pa ga'ajig rten mkhas rnams kyis/ /sku che'i tshad ni bskal pa bye ba brgya 'grangs gang gā'i bye snyed 'gyur/ /rta thul 'jig rten khrag khrig khams kyi nyan thos mya ngan 42—191

bzlas pa bas/ /gang yang skyes pa'am bud med gcig cig byang chub yang dag dga' byas na/ /bsod nams de la snga mas grangs sam dper yang /bya bar mi nus so/ /de bas byang chub zhugs pa'i skyes bu dam pa byang chub dga' bar gyis / /rta thul 'di la 'dren lke snapa thams cad mkhyen pa 'byung ba rnyed sla ji min / /de ni u dum ba ra'i 5me tog 'dra zhes sangs rgyas mtha' yas blo mnga'as phyogasungs/ /de phyir bla na med pa'i zhi bde byang chub mi gang 'dod pa yis / /shin tu blo phra sten 7bzang mkhyen pa tshul mkhas 'dren la bsten napar bya / /de bzhin gshegs kyi zhal nas don byed gsung tshodag de 'dra thos gyur nas / /'khor rnams thams cad yi rangs lamachog tu dga' zhing yang dag dga' bar 'gyur 1/ /khrag khrig lha rnams nam tshamakhar 'khod nas gos kyi g.yab mo 'dor bar byed/ /dga' nas sangs rgyas dbang phyug khyod la phyag 'tshal lo zhes sgra yang phyung / /zhi ba thugs zhi skye bo nyon mongs rgod pas rgod gyur zhi bar mdzadabe/ /bdud rtsi ston cing dug gsum zhi mdzad sems can dug ni bskyug khutu gsol/ /khyod kyi ye shes thos nas skye dgu'i 'dug med 'gyur zhing dgra med 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal rnams kyis 'dren tshalas tshul thos mi bzad lnga srid pa'i rgyud las grol 8/ /'od gsal ba lung bstan pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa /rtegacig pa'o// //bam po brgyad pa/ de nas dge rgyas ris 1kyi lha khrag khrig phrag bcu gnyis kyis lha ma yin rnams nas 'od gsal ba'i lha'i 2bar dag gi snyemachod pa yang mthong ske/ lung bstan pa yang thos nas tshim zhing mgu la yi 24rangs te/ rab 42—192

tu dga' zhing dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas bdag cag tshul phun sum tshogs par gyur pa yang brjod 1cing bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to / /bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad la bde bar 'gro ba zhes bgyi ba'i ting nge 'dzin mchis te/ ting nge 'dzin de thob pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dmigs pa'i dngos po thams cad la ribade ba'i tshor ba sha stag myong bar 'gyur zhing sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba mi myong la/ sdug bsngal yang ma lags bde ba yang ma lags pa yang mi myong ste/ sems can dmyal ba'i gnod pas gnod par bgyis kyang bde ba'i 'du shes nye bar ciganas pa dang / mi'i gnod pas gnod par bgyis 5kyang bde ba'i 'du shes nye bar gnas pa dang /lag pa bcad phyi dam/ rkang pa bcad dam/ rkang lag bcad dam/ rna ba 'am / sna'am/ rna ba dang sna gtubs 9kyang bde ba'i 'du shes nye bar gnas par 'gyur ba dang / sba lcag gis gzhus lasam/ sba lcag ’ phyed tshal 12lam/ lcag gis gzhus pakyang bde ba'i 'du shes nye bar gnas par 'gyur ba dang /btson rar bcug gam/ lcags 7sgrog dang / shing sgrog tu bcug tshagam/ btson cha tshadam po la rgyas btab bamasto/ byis pa'i gtsug phud ’ ltar bcings sam / dugs kyi nya snod ltar bdugs sam/ bu ram shing brdungs pa ltar brdungs 2 sam/ 'dam bu gzhom 2pa ltar bcom 'am lha/ 'bru mar gyi mar me ltar 'bar bar byas sam/ mar gyi mar me dang zho bskol ba ltar 'bar bar byas kyang bde ba'i 'du shes nye bar gnas par 'gyur ba dang / me'i nang du bor ramakha5/ seng ge'i khar bstabs lasam/ stag gi khar bstabs nasam/skam ril bya ba ltar grilam tam/ byi bo'im chad pa lta bus bcadam dam/ nyesam 12—193

byung ba bsgrags 1pa ltar bsgrags nasam/ kur ṣa ripa ṇa tsam du gtubs 5sam / 'bras phye btso pob ltar btsos sam/ glang po che rnams kyis bcom tshoyang bde ba'i 'du shes nye bar gnas par 'gyur ba dang / mig phyung ngam/gsal shing gi rtse dzimo la bzhag : gam/ gsad tshapa'i gnas su khrid de rnam pa thams cad du mgo gcod : kyang bde ba'i 'du shes nye bar gnas par 'gyur te/bde ba khuyang ma lags/ mi bde 5ba yang ma lags pa'i 'du shes rnam pa thams cad du mi 'byung ngo / /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des yun ring po lanas spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe smon lam 'di ltar btab ste/ gang gis bdag la kha zas byin pa de dag nye bar zhi ba'i bde ba thob par gyur cig /gang gis bdag la skom blud 7pa snyedang / gang gis bdag la rim gro (byas pa dang / bkur sti byas pa dang / bsti 21stang byas pa dang ske/ mchod pa byas pa de dag thams cad kyang nye bar zhi ba'i bde ba thob param gyur cig /gang yang bdag la gshe ba dang / mi bde bar byed 2pa dang /brdeg pa dang/ mtshon 5gyis 'debs pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du srog gcod tshopa'i bar du byed pa de dag thams cad kyang byang chub kyi bde ba thob cing bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig ces smon lam btab ste/ de yid la bya ba de dag dang ldan zhing de de lta bu'i las dang / de lta bu'i smon lam dang ldan pas sems can thams cad kyi rjes su song ba'i bde ba'i 'du shes la sten cing snyen la sgom 2 zhing mang du byed de/ de las (de'i rnam par smin pas chos thams cad la bde bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin rab tu 'thobs bo/ /gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpasam chos 42wa 194

thams cad la bde bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob par gyur pa de'i tshe/bdud kyi las thams cad kyis mi 'phrogs shing mi 'khrugs 1par 'gyur te /de'i tshe 'di ltar tshe la dbang ba dang / skye ba la dbang ba dang / las la dbang ba dang / rnam par rtog pa la dbang ba dang / yo byad la dbang ba ste/dbang lnga thob par rig par bgyi'o / /de 'tshal na tshe rjes cam thag tu byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /de 'tshal na bskal pa grangs ma mchis par gnas so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs shing byang chub sems dpa' sgrub 5pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' yongs su 'dzin pa dang /ngan 'gro thams cad rab tu bsal snyob dang / 'gro ba drug po kun tu skyes pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab 8pa thams cad la bslabs pa 9dang /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas yongs su bzung ba dang / thabs mkhas pa 7dang ldan pa dang / bdud kyi las las rnam par rgyal ba dang / chos thams cad khong du chud par rig par bgyi ba'i slad du ste/ bcom ldan 'das gang gis byang chub sems dpa' chos thams cad la nges pa'i rtogs pa thob par 'gyur ba thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthu'o/ /de nas dge rgyas ’ kyi lha rnams kyis ’ ting nge 'dzin 'di brjod nas de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod 5pa/ dge rgyas lha tshogs 'di dag thams cad chos la mthar 5thug gyur pa ste/ /ston pa dbang po zhi zhing zhi ba mkhyen la mgo bos skyabs su mchisal/ /de dag mkhas pas mchod pa'i sangs rgyas don mkhyen 'khor ba rgal 7gyur pa/ /thub pa mi yi 'dren pa'i ha tshul 42wa 195

mkhas rgyal ba 'dren pa 'dren la bstod me/ /'di na rang bzhin nges pa'i thub chos gnas pa gang rina'ang ma mchis te/ /sgyu ma'i mkhan pos sgyu ma ji bzhin khyod kyis thub pa legs par mkhyen/ /yan lag sna tshogs sgra brnyanam ri khrod 'byung ba mkhas pas partogs pa ltar/ /de bzhin bde gshegs0)drang srong khyod kyis lha mir bcas pa'i 'jig rten gzigs/ /'di na posems can srog dang shed bu gso ba gang zag ma mchis te/ /mi mchog khyod kyis 'du shes rnam par 7bshig cing stong par narnam gzhags la/ /rkang gnyis dam pa sems can gtso bo byams pa gzhal yas sgom sapa'ang mdzad/ /rgyal ba sangs rgyas dgongs pa 'di ni 'gro ba kun gyis rtogs par dka'/ /byams pa dge sgom tsho/1sems can dmigs pa yin zhes 'dren pas bka' stsal lam/ /sems can rnam 7par bshig cing 'gro ba thams cad sems can med par mkhyen/ /de ltar rkang gnyis dam pa rnyog pa mi mnga' the tshom bral thugs ldan/ /des na bde gshegs rnam brtags —blo mnga' mchod 'os khyod la mchod pa da'atshal/ /bde bar gshegs pa sdug bsngal phyogs labacur gnas pa kun tu 7mi dmigs kyang / /lha yi lhar gyur khyod kyis sems can rnams la snying rje bgyi ba //gsungs/ /de ltar rgyal mchog bdag cag rgyal ba'i dgongs pa 19ji bzhin kun tu 'tshal/ /des nang rkang gnyis gtso bo mi mchog mchod 'os khyod la mchod pal 'tshal/ /thub pa khyod kyis sems can dang ni bsal bgyi 2sdug bsngal ming gzigs la/ /dgyes thupa skyes sanas rab tu dgyes lapa'i thugs kyis mi dgyes rnam par bsal / /de ltar sangs rgyas tshul ni bsam gyis mi khyab tshul 'di ji bzhin 'tshal/ /des na mi mchog khyod la mchod nas brnyes pa'i 'bras bu thob par bgyi/ /skyon bral 42—196

khyod kyis 'gro ba kun tu sdug bsngal mya ngan 'das ma lhadamigs/ /'on kyang 'khor bar sems can gzigs shing don mdzad stobs dang ldan pa 5bskyed/ /sems can sdug bsngal 'gro dang thub dang mya ngan 'das dang gnas ma mchis/ /sangs rgyas tshul 'di rtogs nas thub pa mchod 'os khyod la mchod pa ri'atshal/ /'dren pa tshad med bzhi po gzigs shing de yang gnyis su med par bstan/ /gang zhig der dul com gzigs gang 5yang tshad med gnas pa de ma gzigs/ /thub pas bag med gang yang ma gzigs bag yod mi yang ma gzigs te/ /sangs rgyas tshul 'di 'tshal nas thub pa 0ston pa khyod la mchod pa bgyis/ /thub pa nasku ni rnam par spangs pas 9sku btsal mdzad na ma brnyes —kyang / /de ltar 'dren pa dran pa ma gsungs ma lags bsnyel ba yang rtemi mnga'/ /bde bar gshegs pas lus tshal song ba'i bsgom pa bsgom 2par gyis 7shes gsungs//sangs rgyas tshul 'di rig nas bde bar gshegs pa skyob la rimachod pa bgyis/ /'dren pas tshor ba'i rang bzhin btsal ba mdzad na brnyes 4par ma gyur la/ /tshor ba tshor bar bgyid pa'ang 7thub pas yongs su btsal na ma brnyes 8te/ /de ltar gang zhig dran sgom /6de ni sangs rgyas kyis kyang yong ma 2 gzigs/ /sangs rgyas tshul 'di 'tshal nas ston pa la ni bdag cag mchod pa bgyis/ /thub pas sems dang sems las byung ba dgongs te btsal na ma brnyes la / /gang gim nye bar gzhags pa de yang dran pa med par rab mkhyen kyang / /thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyisabasems 'dus dran pa bsgom sapar gyis shes gsungs/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i dgongs pa 'di 'tshal nas ni ston la mchod pa bgyis / /'jig rten phan par bzhed pas chos dang chos la gang spyod de ma gzigs/ /bsgoms 42—197

par gang gsungs dran pa de yang 'di na rang bzhin ma mchis la thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyis chos 'dus dran pa bsgom 1par gyis shes gsungs/ /sangs rgyas tshul bzhi po 'di rab tu 'tshal nas skyob la mchod pa 5bgyis/ /gnas gcig mchis pa ma lags gnyis sam gsum 'am sgrubazhi lta ga la mchis/ /gang gis phyoganas su brjod pa'i dran pa de yang gang na'ang ma mchis te/ / de bas gang gi 9bde ba'am sdug bsngal 7yang dag gang na'ang de ma mchis/ /ston pa'i tshul 'di 'tshal nas des na bdag cag khyod la mchod pa 'tshal/ /ston pa'i tshul mchog bzhi po 'di rnams dge slong gang dag 'dzin bgyid tshan/ /'di dag thar pa nyid kyi lam ste 2'khor ba las ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de ltar de ni tshul 'dir ma bcing —ma grol byang chub 'dren pa min/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis brtags dpa ma bshig 7des na khyod la mchod pa sko'atshal/ /thar mdzad slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis lam zhi rdzu 'phrul rkang pa gsungs/ /'di dag bsgoms na mi rnams dbang po dul zhing mya ngan 'da' bar 'gyur/ /yang dag du na 7rdzu 'phrul dang ni rkang pa sgomang pa mi dmigs te/ /chad par mi 'gyur bya ba'ang ston cing byed pa po yang yong mi dmigs 2/ /thams cad mkhyen gyi bstan 'dir lha tshogs 2the tshom gang na'ang ma mchis te/ /de dag de las nem nur ma mchis de bzhin som nyi ma mchis 'gyuras/ / 'di ni snyomachod pa bzang po mchog ces mchod 'os sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ / des na bde gshegs dpe med spyod mnga' mchod 'os khyod la mchod par 0'tshal/ /thar par mdzad slad 'jig rten mkhas pas nges 'byung dbang po lnga yang gsungs / /rtag tu bag yod byos la mya ngan 'das 'gro'i lam 'di sgomasang zhes 42—198

bstan〉ske/ /thub pa dbang po dang ni sgom 2pa po dang thar pa'ang mi dmigs te/ /'di la lha 'khor the tshom ma mchis de slad khyod la mchod pa ri'atshal sangs rgyas rnams kyi mya ngan 'das par 'gro caba'i drang lam stobs lnga po/ /de dag nyon mongs zad bgyid thar par bgyid ces ston pa 5thub pas gsungs/ /de dag rang bzhin ma mchis nyon mongs ma mchis rgyal ba ma mchis te/ /thub pa phyobadag cag gang la'ang the tshom ma sgyumachis de slad khyod la mchod/ /byang chub yan lag bdun po 'di dag dge ba lam gyi dam pa ste/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi 9mya ngan 'das 'gro'i 7drang lam mchog ces thub pas gsungs / /'ching ba mchis pa ma lags grol ba ma mchis bcings pa'ang ma mchis te/ /sems can dkon mchog 'di la bdag cag the tshom ma mchis khyod la mchod/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo khyod kyis bzhi phrag gnyis lam sems can rnams la bstan/ /brtson 'grus ldan par pa'aphags lam sdug bsngal mtha' rimar 'byin pa sgoms 7zhes gsungs / /mi mchog lam dang de bzhin nyon mongs 'di gnyis g.yo ba ma mchis te / /'di la lha tshogs the tshom ma mchis gyur pas mimachod 'os khyod la mchod/ /'dod chags gnyen por sazhi gnas bka' stsal zhe sdang gnyen por byams pa gsungs / /gti mug gnyen por lhag mthong thub pa mchog gis sems can rnams la bstan/ /'di dag thams cad g.yo ba ma mchis skad ’ cig dag min nyon mongs min/ /'di la lha tshogs the tshom ma mchis thub pa mchod slad rtag tu brtson / /sdug bsngal zhi bya phyir ni zhi gnas lhag mthong lam yang sgoms 19zhes gsungs / /bcom ldan gang gis 'gro ba nyon mongs bag chags bcas dri de dag zhi/ /thub pa zhi gnas lhag mthong de bzhin dri ma thams cad stong pa ste/ /42—199
