'di la lha tshogs gang du'ang the tshom ma mchis skyon bral khyod la mchod/ /stobs bcu 1sems can rnams la dge ba bcu yi las rilam gabastan mdzad de/ / gsod dang 'khrig jidang ma byin phra ma brdzun75ridang zhe gcod kyal tshig dang / /gnod sems dang ni mi rigs tha'adod dang de bzhin log par rtog pa rnams/ /mi dge'i las lam 'di yang bcom ldan 'das kyis sems can rnams la bstan/ /sems can mi dmigs gsod pa nag la mchis te lhag ma de dang 'dra/ /gnyen po dge ba ma mchis de ni ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa ste/ /bde gshegs thub pa zag pa mi mnga' rnams kyang ngo bo nyid kyis stong / /rnam 'dren the tshom som nyi ma mchis de slad khyod la mchod par 9'tshal/ /sangs rgyas sras po dge ba'i blo can gang zhig spyod pa 7'di sten 1pa/ /mkhas pa kun tu dge ba nyid myong sdug bsngal myong bar yong mi 'gyur/ /bcom ldan bde gshegs ye shes des ni tshul 'di bde bar thob par bgyis/ /'di la lha tshogs the tshom ma mchis mchod 'os bokhyod la mchod par tsha'atshal/ /de ltar dge rgyas kyi r+shalha rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod tshanas cang mi zer bar 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge rgyas kyi lha rnams cang mi zer bar 'khod pa yang mkhyen/de dag gi mi lhag pa'i bsam pas sgrub ’ pa yang thugs su chud nas de'i tshe /snye'adzum pa mdzad do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rta thul gyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ skye bo 'di kun bcom ldan khyod kyi //mkhyen pa'i zil gyis zil mnan nas/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba mchog khyod kyis ni 'dzum mdzad pa 'ding 'jig rten bstan/ /rgyu ma mchis parang chos kun mkhas pa rnams ni 'dzum pa mi mdzad na/ /'dzum rgyu don gnyer mig medang rnams la 42—200

'jig rten mkhas pas 3bka' stsal gsol/ /ma lus 'di dag thams cad gzhan du mi sems khyod 'dzum re zhing 'khod/ / dpal stug khyod la bstod pa bgyid cing nyan par rlo 'tshal ba'i yid kyis gnas/ /sangs rgyas gsung gi dbang phyug thos nas yid ni rab tu rangs gyur te/ /chos rnams kun la nges pa'i blo dge ldan pa'i ston par skye bar 'gyur/ /bde gshegs mi mchog dge ba'i thugs can de ring su zhig blo gros bskyed/ /de ring gang gis 'chi med zhi ba rtogs shing phyogs rnams snang bar bgyis/ /su zhig 'jig rten thugs brtse rgyal ba ci 'dren pa dpag tu 5med 'gyur ba / /de dag bka' stsol 7drang srong 'khor 'di legs par gsungs pas tshim par mdzod / /rgyal ba khyu mchog dge sbyong dam pa deng su btsun 9la dad pa skyes / /bdud kyi mi phrogs sna blo ldan gang zhig chos la yang dag yongs su gnas/ /sangs rgyas sras po tshul mkhas gang zhig de ring nges pa bothob par 'gyur/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo de dag bka' stsol 'gro 'di the tshom tsham mchis mdzod/ /bde gshegs deng su 'gro la dang bskyed skye dgu lornams la byams gyur cing d+ku/ /byang chub mthar phyin blo gros brtan tshizhing thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la gnas/ /gang la 'dzum pa deng bstan bde gshegs bstan pa 'dzin pa de gang lags/ /bsod nams brgya yi 7mtshan mnga' de dag bka' stsol bdag gi 18the tshom khum/ /'dren pa khyod gsung yan lag brgyad ldan legs par 19bka' stsal thos gyur na/ /bde gshegs gsung gis thog mar bdag cag 'dong zhing nya'agro ba gzhan 2yang 'dren/ /de ltar gyur na bde gshegs bstan rab 'di ni sras la gnas par 'gyur/ /'jig rten 'di dag yid ni myur du bde gshegs rnams la gnas par 'gyur/ /de nas 42—201

bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rta thul la tshigs su bcad de slar bka' stsal pa/ nga yis 1 'jig rten don byed 'dzum mdzad rta thul khyod kyis mthong gyur cing / /skyes bu dam pa khyod kyis dus su dris te 'gro ba'i don byas pa/ /khyod kyis ribasod nams 'phel ba brjod du med de de ni zad mi 'gyur/ /de ni khyod la bstan gyis cakhyod dang 'gro ba 'di dag dga' bas nyon/ /dge rgyas lha tshogs 'di dag nga yi 5chos nyid la ni the tshom med/ /kun kyang yi rangs phyorab zhi yid kyis tshigs bcad dag gis nga la bsngags/ /sngon gyi sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig stong bgrangs namachod 'os mchod byas te/ /the tshom med pa'i yid kyis tshul dris kun tu som nyi med par gyur / /de ltar sngon gyi rgyu des 'dir yang tshigs su bcad pas nga 7la bstod/ /bskal pa bzang po'i rgyal ba bstod 'os kun la'ang 'di dag bstod 1 par 'gyur/ /'di dag bskal pa tsha.ud pa la la rgyal ba dgra rgyal mthu chen 'gyur/ /'di dag sems can khrag khrig bsam yas yongs su mya ngan 'da' bar byed/ /sangs rgyas drang srong chen po de dag yid 'ong mtshan du gang 'gyur ba/ /de yang bstan gyis tshadang ba'i yid kyis sems kyi 7tha ba spangs pate nyon/ /rgyal ba de kun chos kyi tog ces bya ba tsha'adren pa gzhal yas 'gyur/ /'di dag re res kyang ni khrag khrig bsam yas mya ngan bzla 7bar 'gyur/ /de yi tshe na bde gshegs kun gyi ring bsrel 18shin tu rgyas 'gyur dzote/ /de tshe zhing rnams kun tu rgyal ba'i mchod rten me tog rgyas par 'gyur/ /thub pa grags chen de dag yongs su mya ngan 'das par gyur pa na / /thub pa skyob pa de dag kun gyi ring bsrel rgyas pas don chen 'gyur/ /sems can khrag khrig bsam yas rnams kyis de 2tshe ring bsrel 22mchod byas te/ /42—202

ring bsrel77de dag mchod nas mya ngan 'das pa zhi ba 'chi 5med 'thob/ /thub pa rkang gnyis gtso bo de dag grags pa rgyun 'chad mi 'gyur te/ /slob pa khrag khrig bsam yas rnams kyang de tshe rgyal ba'i drung du 'du/ /ji ltar bye ba brgya bgrangs ngaphagal legs par spyad pa byas phyinas su/ /byams pa blta phyir rgya chen yid kyis byams pa'i 'khor du 'dong 7'gyur ba/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i nyan thos slob tshogs de dag rgyal nas nargyal 'khor du/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo de dag kun gyi ring bsrel mchod pa bya 9phyir 'dong / /bde gshegs gsung snyan 7'gro ba thams cad ngo mtsharasto 7gyur pa desnamathos shing / /dge rgyas ris kyi lha yi bdag nyid chen po de tshe pathos gyur nas/ /'khor rnams thams cad rab tu dga' ste phal cher byang chub sems kyang bskyed/ /bdag nyid chen po shes lanas thub pa'i zhabs la mgo bos rab tu gtugs / /dge rgyas ris lung bstan sapa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa boganyis pa'o// //de nas de'i tshe 'bras bu che ba'i ris kyi lha bye ba phrag brgyad ’ cus lha ma yin rnams nas dge rgyas kyi tsho//lha'i bar dag gi mchod pa yang mthong lung bstan pa yang thos nas tshim zhing mgu la yi 2 snarangs te/ rab tu dga' ba dang / mgungastob dang / yid bde ba skyes nas/ tshul gcig la zhugs pa dang / chos re re las kyang chos kyi sgo 24mtha' yas pa 'byung bar g.yang dag par mthong zhing /tshul la 'jug pa thams cad las kyang snyomatha' yas pa'i spobs pa dang / mi chodam tshopa'i spobs pa dang / rigs pa'i spobs pa dang / grol ba'i spobs pa dang ske/ thogs pa med pa'i spobs pa dang / nye ba'i spobs pa dang / phra ba'i 42—203

spobs pa dang / zab pa'i spobs pa dang / sna tshogs kyi spobs hu)pa dang /'jam pa'i spobs pa dang / 'brel ba'i spobs pa dag kyang nya'abyung bar shes nas bcom ldan 'das la dga' ba skyes te/ chos nyid brjod cing bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sgo'i tshul mtha' yas pa zhes bgyi ba'i ting nge 'dzin mchis te/ de la brtson par bgyis na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spobs pa 'thob cing 4mi chod pa'i spobs pa thob par 'gyur ba dang / dmigs pa dang snyoms par 'jug pa thams cad la rmongs pa ma mchis par 'gyur ro/ /de la dmigs pa gang yang gzugs lags 5par ma po'atshal ba'i tshul gyis sgrib par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ni phung po la 'jug pas kyang sgo'i tshul mtha' yas pa'i gzungs thob par 'gyur/ khams 3kyil 'jug pa dang / skye mched la 'jug pa dang / dbang po la 'jug pa dang /bden pa la 'jug pa dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la 'jug pa dang /sems can la 'jug pa dang / sems can ma mchis pa la 'jug pa dang /dngos po la 'jug pa dang / dngos po ma mchis pa la 'jug pa dang /dmigs pa la 'jug pa dang / dmigs pa ma mchis pa la 'jug pa dang /bdag la 'jug pa dang / stong pa la 'jug pa dang / mtshan ma la 'jug pa dang —/ mtshan ma ma mchis pa la 'jug pa dang / smon pa la 'jug pa dang /smon pa ma mchis pa la 'jug pa dang / gnas pa la 'jug pa dang / gnas pa k+ṣ-im mchis pa la 'jug pa dang / 'dus byas la 'jug pa dang / 'dus ma byas la 'jug pas kyang sgo'i tshul mtha' yas pa'i gzungs thob par 'gyur te/thams cad la thogs 7pa ma mchis pa'i spobs pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /de 42—204

ni phung po la 'jug pas kyang 'di lta ste/ phung po zhes bya ba'i0chos 'di ni yongs su ma grub pa'o zhes gzungs rab tu 'thob bo / /de ci'i slad du zhe na/gzugs ni gang yang yongs su grub pa ma mchis te/ sa ni sar yongs su ma grub/de bzhin du chu dang / me dang / rlung ni rlung du yongs su ma grub pa'o / /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ sa ni rang bzhin ma mchis pa ste / chos gang la yang 5rang bzhin ma mchis pa 5de ni yongs su ma grub pa'o/ /chu dang / me dang /rlung ni rang bzhin gem mchis pa ste / chos gang la yang rang bzhin ma mchis pa de ni yongs su ma grub pa'o/ /de ltar yongs su ma grub pa'i gzugs ni 'das pa zhes gdags par mi bgyi/ ma 'ongs pa zhes gdags par mi bgyi/ da ltar byung ba zhes gdags par mi bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar gzugs rteni dngos po ma mchis pa ste/ dngos po ma mchis pa'i slad du skye ba ma mchis pa'otsha/ /gang la skye ba ma mchis pa de la 'gag pa ma mchis te gang ma skyes ma 'gags /nyapa de ni gdags su ma mchis sod/ /de bzhin gshegs pas kyang 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i gzugs snyegang ci yang rung ste/ de dag thams cad gcig tu bsdus nas gzugs kyi phung po'o gezhes bka' stsal te / gzugs kyi rang bzhin ni dmigs su ma mchis na 'das tshapar lta ga la 'gyur/ ma 'ongs par yang 7ga la 'gyur/ da ltar byung bar yang /snyeg la 'gyur te/ de 9bas na gzugs kyi phung po ni gdags su ma mchis pa'od / /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang 22/ 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa'i phung po rnams kyang 2de bzhin te/ de'i 2 slad du phung po rnams ni dmigs su ma mchis so/ /phung po dmigs su ma mchis pas gzungs 25dmigs su ma 42—205

mchis te/ de ltar phung po la 1'jug pas gzungs la 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /gzungs 5de yang ming tsam dang / tha snyad tsam dang / brda tsam dang / kun rdzob tsam dang / brjod pa tsam dang / gdags pa tsam ma gtogs par gzungs la 'jug pa rimi dmigs te/ 'di la phung capo yang mi dmigs/ gzungs kyang 5mi dmigs/ 'jug pa yang mi dmigs/ gzungs 0kyang rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ gang 'di phung po zhes bgyi ba de ni ma bgyis pa'i chos te/ chos gang 7ma bgyis pa de la spungs pa yang ga la mchis te/ phung po ni spungs pa'i slad du phung po zhes bgyi'o/ /dper na khyim dang / khang bzangs dang bsil 9khang dang / khang pa brtsegs pa dang ske/ skar khung khol ma ladang / ba gam dang / dra ba dang / stegs bu dang ske/ kha khyer dang / skar 11khung dang / rta babs dang /pa ra ba dang /shing thags dang / 'obs dang chos mang po bsags 7pa la'i/ grong khyer zhes bgyi ba bzhin du phung po zhes bgyi ba yang de bzhin te/ gzugs de yangatre ngo bo nyid kyis mi 7dmigs na de la spungs pa lta ga la mchis/ spungs pa ma mchis pas na gzugs kyang ma mchis/ gzugs kyi /phung po yang ma mchis so /de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa yang rang bzhin gyis dmigs su ma mchis na de la spungs pa lta ga la mchis te/spungs pa ma mchis pa'i slad du rnam par shes pa yang ma mchis/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po yang ma mchis so/ /de ltar phung po la 'jug pas gzungs thob par 'gyur / gzungs thob pas spobs pa thob 19par 'gyur ro/ /de la skye mched la 'jug pas gzungs thob par 'gyur ba ni mig gi skye mched ces bgyi ba ni ci'i skye 42—206

mched ces bgyi na/ sdug bsngal gyi skye mched do/ /de la mig gang zhe na/'byung ba chen po bzhi dang ba ste/ sa'i khams dang / chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams dang ba'o / /de la risa'i khams dang ba ni rang bzhin ma mchis pa ste/ chos gang gi rang bzhin mi dmigs pa de ni yongs su ma grub pa'o/ /de bzhin du chu'i khams dang ba dang / me'i khams dang ba dang /rlung gi khams dang ba ni rang bzhin ma mchis pa ste/ chos gang gi rang bzhin mi dmigs 4pa de ni yongs su 5ma grub pa'o / /de ltar yongs su ma grub pa'i mig giri skye mched 7de ni 'das pa zhes gdags par bgyi ba ma lags/ ma 'ongs pa rinadang / da ltar byung ba zhes /gdags par bgyi ba ma lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar 7mig gi skye mched ni dngos po ma mchis pa ste/dngos po ma mchis pa'i slad du skye skab ma mchis pa'o/ /gang la skye ba ma mchis pa de la 'gag pa ma mchis te/ / gang ma/ skyes ma 'gags pa de ni gdags su ma mchis pa'o/ /6de ltar mig kyang ma skyes ma 'gags/ skye mched dang sdug bsngal yang ma skyes dam 'gags pa'o/ /gang ma skyes ma 'gags pa de ni ming tsam dang / tha snyad tsam dang / brda tsam dang / kun rdzob 7tsam dang /brjod pa tsam ma gtogs par gdags su ma mchis pa ste/ ming de yang ming gis ma mchis pa'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ chos gang la mig ce'am snye/ skye mched ce'am/9/ sdug bsngal zhes gdags par bgyi ba'i chos de gang yang dmigs su ma mchis te / ming yang rtoming du brjod du ma mchis so22/ /rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid dang / gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya dang / chos rnams kyang de bzhin te/42—207

de'i slad du skye mched la 'jug pas gzungs 'thob37/ gzungs la 'jug pas spobs pa 'thob bo/ /de la khams la 'jug pas gzungs 'thob 7pa ni mig ni mig gis ma mchis pa/ khams ni khams kyis ma mchis pa ste/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ mig ni mig gi rang bzhin dang bral ba/ khams ni khams kyi rang bzhin dang bral ba'i slad du ste/ chos gang la rang bzhin ma mchis pa de ni dngos po ma mchis pa'o/ /gang la dngos po ma mchis pa de ni yongs su ma grub pa'o / /gang yongs su ma grub pa de lam ni skye phyob ma mchis so/ /gang la skye ba ma mchis pa de la 'gag 7pa ma mchis so/ /gang ma skyes nam 'gags pa de ni ming tsam dang / tha snyad tsam dang / brda 7tsam dang / kun rdzobs 1tsam dang /brjod pa tsam ma gtogs par 'das pa zhes gdags par bgyi ba tsham lags sos / /ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba zhes gdags par bgyi ba ma lags so/ /ming de yang ming gis ma mchis/ brjod pa'i bar de yang gebarjod pas ma mchis pa ste/ chos gang la rang bzhin ma mchis pa de ni dngos po ma mchis pa'o/gang la dngos po ma mchis pa de ni yongs su ma grub pa ste/ yongs su ma grub pa'i slad du skye tshab ma mchis pa'o/ /gang la skye skyab ma mchis pa de la 'gag pa ma mchis so/ /gang ma skyes ma 'gags pa de ni 'das pa 7zhes gdags par bgyi ba ma lags/ ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba zhes gdags par bgyi ba ma lags so/ /gang dus gsum du gdags par bgyi ba ma lags pa sna de ni ming ma mchis pa/ mtshan nyid ma mchis pa/ mtshan ma ma :/mchis pa tha snyad ma mchis pa/ brda ma mchis pa/ dngos po ma mchis pa/ 'dris pa ma mchis pa/ brjod du ma mchis pa/ 'ong ba ma mchis pa/ 'gro ba ma mchis 42—208

pa / ma bstan pa/ rab tu ma bstan pa/ mngon par shes par7)bgyi ba ma lags pa )/ yongs su shes par bgyi ba ma lags pa/ dkar po ma lags pa /nag po ma lags pa / gnas ma lags pa/ rten rim lags pa/ thob pa ma lags pa/ thob par bgyi ba ma lags pa/ rtogs pa ma lags pa/ rtogs par bgyi ba ma lags partso/ mngon du bgyis pa ma lags pa/ mngon du bgyi ba ma lags pa/ so so'i skye bo'i rdzis ma lags pa/ nyan thos kyi sa ma lags pa/rang sangs rgyas kyi sa ma lags pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa ma lags pa/sangs rgyas kyi sa ma lags pa ste/ sa yang ma lags/ sa ma lags pa yang ma lags so/ /de ni de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang /gzhan ma lags pa de bzhin nyid dang / zhi ba dang 9/ mtshan nyid ma mchisakhopa ste/ tha snyad tsam du btags : pa'o/ /des tha snyad 12du de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bgyi ste don dam par ni ma lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ gang la de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bgyi ba'i chos de mi dmigs so/ /de bzhin du gzugs kyi khams dang / mig gi rnam par shes dpa'i khams dang / yid kyi khams dang ske/ chos kyi khams dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi bar du rgya tshacher khams thams cad kyisam chos kyi dbyings la 'jug par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi dbyings ni phung por btags kyang chos kyi dbyings nyid mi 'dor / khams dang / skye mched dang / dbang po dang / bden pa dang /rten cing 'brel par 'byung bar btags kyang chos kyi dbyings nyid mi 'dor te/chos kyi sadabyings te ’ ming gang dang gang gis btags kyang de dang des /chos kyi dbyings nyid mi 'dor 9ro/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ dper na sa'i 42—209

khams ni ming gang dang gang gis tha snyad du bgyis kyang de dang des sa'i khams nyid mi 'dor 1ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du chos kyi dbyings kyang ming gang dang gang gis tha snyad du bgyi ba de dang des chos kyi dbyings nyid mi 'dor 5ro/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ dper na chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang ske/ rlung gi khams dang / nam mkha'i khams ni ming gang dang gang gis tha snyad du bgyi ba de dang des 5chu dang / me dang / rlung dang / nam mkha'i khams nyid mi 'dor ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du chos kyi dbyings kyang ming gang dang gang 4 gis tha snyad du bgyi ba de dang des chos kyi dbyings nyid mi 'dor te/ de ltar na khams 5la 'jug pas gzungs 'thob ri/ gzungs la 'jug pas spobs pa 'thob bo/ /bcom ldan 'das de la dbang po la 'jug pas chos kyi dbyings la 'jug pa ni dbang po nyi shu naganyis te/ 'di lta ste/mig gi dbang po dang / rna ba'i dbang po dang / sna'i dbang po dang / lce'i dbang po dang / lus kyi dbang po dang / yid kyi dbang po dang / mo'i dbang po dang / po'i dbang po dang 9/ srog gi dbang po dang / bde ba'i dbang po dang / sdug bsngal gyi dbang po dang / yid bde ba'i dbang po dang /yin mi bde ba'i dbang po dang / btang snyoms kyi dbang po dang /ngo nad pa'i dbang po dang / brtson 'grus kyi dbang po dang / dran pa'i dbang po dang /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po dang / shes rab kyi dbang po dang / mi shes pa kun shes par byed pa'i sa dbang po dang / kun shes pa'i dbang po dang / kun shes pa dang ldan pa'i dbang po ste/ de la mig ni mig gis ma mchis/ dbang po ni dbang pos ma mchis pa'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ mig ni mig gi rang 42—210

bzhin dang bral ba ste/ chos gang la rang bzhin ma mchis pa de ni dngos po ma 3mchis pa'o/ /gang la dngos po ma mchis pa de ni yongs su ma grub pa'o/ /gang yongs su ma grub pa de ni mi skye ba/ gang mi skye rib ni mi 'gags pa/ gang ma skyes ma 'gags 5pa de ni 'das pa zhes gdags par bgyi ba ma lags/ ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba zhes gdags par bgyi ba ma lags so/ /gang dus gsum du mi dmigs patre de ni mig sgyum lags / dbang po ma lags so/ /9gang mig ma lags shing dbang po ma lags pa de'i tha snyad ji ltar 'tshal bar bgyi/ 'di lta ste/ dper na chad pa stong pa ni brdzun pa/ yang dag pa ma lags pa/ ma mchis pa ste/ 'di ltar ming du gdags par bas kyi/ don dam par teni stong pa yang mi dmigs chad pa snyeyang mi dmigs so/ /de bzhin du mig /thudang dbang po yang chad pa stong pa ltar brdzun zhing ma sumachis la/yang dag pa lam lags pa ste/ gsobadzi/ gsog /log pa/ slu ba'i chos can/ byis pa na'adrid pa/ glen pa rmongs par bgyid pa ste/ 'di ltar ming 19du gdags par bas kyi/ don dam par ni mig kyang mi dmigs/ dbang po yang mi dmigs na 2 de ni bcom ldan 'das kyis thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes brnyes rnes ji tsam du phyin ci log nyal gnas pa'i sems can rnams gzud pa'im slad du dbang po zhes btags 2kyi/ don dam par ni ma lags so/ /dbang po ningabyurang bzhin dang bral zhing dbang po'i ngo bo gnyid kyis stong pa ste/ chos gang chos gang gis stong pa de la des tha snyad du bgyi ba ni/ brdzun sapa/ ma mchis pa/ gsob/ gsog /log pa/ slu ba'i chos can byis pa 'drid pa/glen pa mongs par bgyid pa/ rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ de ni mi skye mi 42—211

'gag go/ /gang ma skyes ma 'gags pa 3de ni 'das pa zhes gdags par bgyi ba ma lags/ ma 'ongs pa dang ri/ da ltar byung ba zhes gdags par bgyi ba ma lags so / /gang dus gsum du ma mchis pa de ni ming ma mchis pa/mtshan ma ma camachis pa/ brdzun 5pa/ mtshan nyid ma mchis pa/ gdags su ma mchis pa/phyo gdags pa ma lags pa/ ma shes pa/ shes par bgyi ba ma lags pa/ rnam par ma shes pa / rnam par shes par bgyi ba ma lags pa/ma thos pa/ thos par bgyi ba ma lags pa/ rnam par ma rig pa/ rnam parasherig par bgyi ba ma lags pa/ ma rtogs pa/ rtogs par bgyi ba ma lags pa/ma thob pa/ thob par bgyi ba ma lags pa/ ma mthong ba/ mthong bar bgyi ba ma lags pa/ ma rnyed 7pa/ rnyed rtepar bgyi ba ma lags pa'otsha/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ ma mchis shing mchis pa ma lags pa'i slad du'o/ /'di lta ste/dper na mi zhig rmi lam na rgod thupa dang / dga' ba dang / rtses pa dang / dga' mgur 5spyad pa dag nyal nyal ba las sad de rjes su dran la 'de dran yang rnyed tshapar mi 'gyur/ 'thob ’ par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ rmi lam na yang mi /des rgod 9pa dang / dga' ba dang / rtses ri pa dang / dga' mgur spyad pa de dgang ma thob ma rnyed na sri/ nyal ba las sad pa'i tshe lta smos kyang ci 'tshal te/ thob pa dang / rnyed par bgyi ba de'i gnas ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du dbang po rnams ni mi lam lta bu ste/ji ltar mi lam na rgod 4pa dang / dga' ba dang / rtsesam pa dang / dga' mgur /spyad pa de dag dmigs su ma mchis pa snyode bzhin du chos thams cad kyang ngo bo nyid kyisam dmigs su ma mchis pa ste/ de dag ni 'das pa zhes 42—212

gdags par bgyi ba ma lags/ ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba zhes gdags par bgyi ba ma lags so/ /gang dus gsum du dmigs su ma mchis pa de dag ni brjod du ma mchis pa zhes bgyi ste/ dbang po thams cad kyang de bzhin du rig par bgyi'o/sna/ /de ltar na chos kyi dbyings la 'jug pas chos thams cad la 'jug par bgyi / chos thams cad la 'jug pas kyang chos kyi dbyings la 'jug par bgyi'o/ /de la ji ltar na bden pa la 'jug pas chos kyi dbyings la 'jug par bgyi zhe na/ bzhi po 'di dag ni bden pa ste/ sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung ridang / 'gog pa dang / lam mo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang chos thams cad ni stong pa ste/ sems can med pa/ srog med pa/ gang zag med pa/ mtshan ma med pa/ mtshan nyid med pa'o zhes bka' stsal te/ de la jibadag cag the tshom ma mchis/ som nyi ma mchis so /bcom ldan 'das de la sems can ma mchis pa'i slad du sdug bsngal ma mchis par rig par bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ gang la sems can ma mchis pa de la sdug bsngal yang tshom mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das sdug bsngal ma mchis pa'i slad du kun 'byung ba 6yang ma mchis par rig par bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ gang la tsho'abras bu ma mchis pa de ni rgyu ma lags 8pa'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kun 'byung ba ma mchis pa'i slad du/ 'grog pa ma mchis par rig par bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ kun 'byung ba ma mchis pa la spang ba 9ma mchis pa'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'gog pa ma mchis pa'i slad du lam ma mchis par rig par bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ gang spong bar mi bgyid pa de ni lam ma lags te / lam gyi 'bras bu ni 'gog pa ma ’ lags lam/42—213

gang spang 1ba'i 'gog pa'i nyon mongs pa de ni mi dmigs te/ 'gog pa dmigs su ma mchis na lam du 'thad pa rim lags te / 'bras bu ma mchis pa'i lam yang ma mchis pas de ltar na ca'aphags pa'i bden pa bzhi po de dag ni brtags pa rnam par bsgrubs pa ste/ gang brtags shing rnam par bsgrubs 5pa de ni ma mchis pa'o/ /gang ma mchis pa de la ni phyi'adas pa zhes tha snyad 3)du bgyi ba ma mchis so/ /ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba zhes tha snyad du bgyi ba ma mchis so/ /gang dus gsum du mi dmigs pa de ni ma skyes tshopa ma 'gags pa/mtshan nyid ma mchis pa mtshan ma ma lamachis pa/ ma btags 1pa gdags par mi bgyi ba 2/ ma bstan pa/ rab tu ma bstan pa/ bstan par bgyi ba ma lags pa/ rab tu bstan par bgyi ba ma lags pa/ ma brjod pa/ brjod par bgyi ba ma lags pa/ mngon par ma brjod pa/ mngon par brjod par bgyi ba ma lags pa snye/ ma mthong ba/ mthong bar bgyi ba ma lags pa/ ma shes pa/ shes par bgyi ba ma lags pa/'a khong du ma chud pa/ khong du chud par bgyi ba ma lags pa/ ma rtogs pa/ rtogs par bgyi ba ma lags pa/ ma rnyed pa/ rnyed par bgyi ba ma lags pa/ ma thob pa/ thob par bgyi ba ma lags pa/ ma thos pa/ thos par bgyi ba ma lags pa/ ma mthong ba/mthong bar bgyi ba ma lags pa/ ma bsgrubs pa/ bsgrub tshapar bgyi ba ma lags pa/ mngon du ma bgyis pa/ mngon du bgyi ba ma lags pa/ dkar po ma lags pas/ nag po ma lags pa/ snang ba ma lags pa / mun pa ma lags pa/ 'gro ba ma lags pa/ 'ong ba ma lags pa/ gsal ba ma lags pa/zab pa ma lags pa/ 'khrugs pa ma lags pa/ dang ba ma lags pa/ 'jig snye42—214

pa ma lags pa/ bde ba ma lags pa/ 'ching ba ma lags pa/ grol ba ma lags pa/ rjes su chags pa ma lags pa/ khong 1khro ba ma lags pa/ kun nas nyon 5mongs pa ma lags pa/ rnam par byang ba ma lags pa/ ye shes ma lags pa/ rnam par shes pa ma lags pa/ lam ma lags pa/ lam gol ba ma lags pa/ 'jig pa ma lags pa/ rnam par 'jig pa ma lags pa/gzung rib ma lags pa/ mi gzung rib ma lags pa/ dor ba ma lags pa/rab tu dor ba ma lags pa/ dmigs pa ma lags pa/ dmigs su ma mchis pa ma lags pa/ sems can ma lags pa/ sems can ma mchis pa ma lags pa / srog ma lags pa/ srog ma mchis pa ma lags pa/ gang zag ma lags pa/gang zag ma mchis pa ma lags pa/ bdag ma lags pa/ bdag ma mchis pa ma lags pa/ dngos po ma lags pa/ dngos po ma mchis pa ma lags pa/stong pa ma lags pa/ mi stong pa ma lags pa/ mtshan ma ma lags 5pa/mtshan ma ma tsumachis pa ma lags pa/ smon pa ma lags pa/ smon pa ma mchis pa ma lags pa/ gnas nam lags pa/ gnas tshom mchis pa ma lags pa/'dus byas ma lags pa/ 'dus ma byas ma lags pa/ chad pa ma lags pa/rtag pa ma lags pa/ log pa ma lags pa/ yang dag pa ma lags pa/ bden pa rtam lags pa/ brdzun /1pa ma lags pa/ mngon par zhen pa ma lags pa/mngon par zhen pa ma mchis pa ma lags pa/ rten ma lags pa/ rten ma mchis pa tsham lags pa/ gzhi sgom lags pa/ gzhi tsham mchis pa ma lags pa/mngon par shes par bgyi ba ma lags pa/ yongs su shes par bgyi ba ma lags pa / spang ba ma lags pa/ bsgom pa ma lags pa/ mngon du bgyi ba ma lags 42—215

pa / rnyed pa 1ma lags pa/ rnyed par bgyi ba rim lags pa/ 'khor ba ma lags pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa ma lags pa/ sangs rgyas ma lags pa/ ri'atshang rgya cabar bgyi ba ma lags pa/ so so'i 5skye bo'i spyodar yul ma lags pa/'phags pa'i spyod yul ma lags pa/ nyan thos kyi spyod yul ma lags pa/ rang sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul ma lags pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul ma lags pa / sangs rgyas kyi spyod 7yul ma lags pa/ spyod yul yang sam lags pa/spyod yul ma lags pa yang ma lags pa/ bgyis pa ma lags pa/ ma bgyis pa ma lags pa/ dag pa ma lags pa/9 dag par bgyi ba tsham lags pa ste/ de ltar bden pa la 'jug pas chos kyi dbyings la 'jug par 'gyur/ chos kyi dbyings la 'jug pas gzungs thob par 'gyur/ gzungs thob pas spobs pa 'thob ’ par 'gyur ro/pa /de la ji ltar na /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la 'jug pas chos kyi dbyings la 'jug ce lan/ ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed rnams / 'du byed kyi darkyen gyis rnam par shes pa tenas de ltar 7sdug bsngal gyi phung / po chen po 'di 9'ba' zhig 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes bgyi ba'i bar du ste/'di ni rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de la ma rigangartag ni ma rig pas ma mchis so / /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar ma rig pa ni rang bzhin dang bral ba ste/ chos gang la rang bzhin ma mchis pa de ni dngos po ma mchis pa'o/ /gang la dngos po ma mchis pa de ni yongs su ma grub pa'o/ /gang yongs su ma grub pa de ni mi skye ba'o/ /gang mi skye ba de ni mi 'gag pa'o/ /gang ma skyes ma 'gags pa de ni 'das pa zhes gdags par bgyi ba ma lags/ma 'ongs pa dang snye/ da ltar byung ba zhes gdagasang par bgyi ba ma lags so/ /42—216

gang dus gsum 3)mi dmigs pa de ni ming ma mchis pa/ mtshan nyid ma mchis pa/ mtshan ma ma gemachis pa/ gdags su ma mchis pa ste/ gzhan du nam ming tsam dang / brda 5tsam dang / tha snyad netsam dang / kun rdzob 7tsam dang /brjod pa tsam dang / gdags pa tsam du sems can rnams gzung ba'i don du bgyi ba ma gtogs par ma rig pa de ni don dam par dmigs su ma mchis so /chos gang don dam par dmigs su ma mchis pa de ni gdags su ma mchis pa/tha snyad du bgyir ma mchis pa / brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das gang ming tsam zhes bgyi ba nas/ gdags pa tsam gyi bar de dag kyang yang dag pa ma lags pa/ brdzun 7pa/ log pa / brtags pa/ rnam par bsgrubs pa/ yongs su brtags pa/ rnam par brtags pa/ rnam par dpyad papa/ma zhi ba dang sna / rab tu spros pa'o / /ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed rnams zhes bgyi ba payang chos gang tshango bo nyid kyis ma mchis pa de 'du byed skyed par yang ji ltar 'gyur te/ de bas na ma rig pa ni ma rig pa ma mchis pa'o/ /de ltar :snyem rig pa ma mchis pas 'du byed rnams kyang ma skyes 9pa'o/ /gang ma skyes pal de dgal ni rga bar mi 'gyur/ na bar mi 'gyur/ 'chi bar mi 'gyur/shi 'pho bar mi 'gyur/ skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das chos gangal ma skyes pa de la rga ba ga la mchis te snye/ gang la rga ba ma mchis pa de ni na bar mi 'gyur/ 'chi bar mi 'gyur/ shi 'pho bar mi 'gyur/skyemathubar mi 'gyur ro/ /'di ni 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi byang chub ste ming tsam du bas kyis / don dam par ni ma lags so/ /ma rig pa gang lags pa de nyid byang 42—217

chub bo/ /de bzhin du srid pa'i yan lag thams cad kyang shes par bgyi ste/de ltar na rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la 'jug pas chos kyi dbyings la 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ni gaskyes pa ste/chos thams cad kyang ma skyes pa'o/ /de bas na chos thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ni ma 'gags 1pa ste chos thams cad kyang ma 'gags 5pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa ni mtshan nyid ma mchis pa / mtshan ma ma mchis pa/dmigs su ma mchis pa/ kun nas nyon mongs pa ma mchis pa/ rnam par byang ba ma mchis pa/ rjes su chags pa ma mchis pa/ khong khro ba ma mchis pa ste/chos kyi dbyings dang / de bzhin nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' ste/ chos thams cad kyang yang dag pa'i mtha'o/ /de'i slad du chos thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar na chos gang dang ga'i dag 5gis de bzhin gshegs pa dzimachis pa'i chos de dang de 7dag gis chos thams cad mchis pa ste / de'i slad du chos thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig 'di skad du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis 9byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so zhes mchi na de dag thams cad ni lta ba'i rnam pa la mngon par zhen pa'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni gnyis su ma mchis pa ste/ byang chub kyang gnyis su ma mchis pa lags pas gnyis su ma mchis pas ni gnyis su ma mchis pa —mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang mi rgya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du gang la la zhig 'di skad du de bzhin gshegs pas bla na med 42—218

pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor to zhes mchi na de dag thams cad ni lta ba'i rnam pa la lha mngon par zhen pa'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni zlog 2pa'am skor 5ribar mdzad pa ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig 'di skad du de bzhin gshegs pas sems can tshad med pa yongs su mya ngan las bzlas so zhes mchi na de dag thams cad ni lta ba'i rnam pa la mngon par zhen pa'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni sems can ma mchis pa ste/ de la yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa gang ciyang ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig 'di skad du de bzhin gshegs pas sems can tshad med pa'i don mdzad do zhes mchi rin de dag thams cad ni lta ba'i rnam pa la mngon par zhen pa'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ni 0chos gang la yang phan pa'am/ gnod pa'i rnam par nye bar gnas pa ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig 'di skad du de bzhin gshegs pas tshe'i na'adu byed bor ro 9zhes mchi na de dag thams cad ni lta ba'i rnam pa la tshamangon par zhen pa'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/bcom ldan 'das chos kyi dbyings ni ci'ang 'dor ba'am/ len pa ma mchis so//bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig 'di skad du de bzhin gshegs pa ni phung po'i lhag ma med ① 7pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i lodabyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das so zhes mchi na/ de dag thams cad ni lta ba'i rnam pa la mngon par zhen pa'o / /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das chos kyi dbyings ni 'khor ba'am / yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig 'di lta lta bu'i chos la nges par gyur chon de dag thams cad subla na med 42—219

pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das chos kyi dbyings la ni 'gyur ba ma mchis kyang gda'i// rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar mi 'gyur ba 5mi gda'o// //bam po dgu pa/ de nas 'bras bu che ba'i lha bye ba phrag brgyad cus bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar chos nyid la nges par 'gro ba brjod nas bcom ldan 'das kyi cazhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas thal mo sbyar te/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /pa phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas kyang de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa cadag gis mngon par bstod 7pa/ bde gshegs mthu nachen 'dren pa tshul dang tshul min mkhyen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba kun la thugs brtse thub pa yang dag ji (bzhin ston mdzad pa/ /'dren pa tshul mkhas khyod kyis tshul ni yang dag nyid du yang dag bstan/ /mtha' yas yon tan mnga' zhing ye shes mngon par 'phags la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /khyod kyis byang chub nges par 'byung ba'i drang lam gcig pu bgrod pa bstan / /khyod kyis byang chub dam pa gzhal yas zhi ba shis /nyapa mi g.yo tshabarnyes/ /srog chags bye ba khrag khrig 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal nyam thag 'grol /snyemadzad pa/ /mtha' yas yon tan mnga' zhing ye shes mngon par 'phags la mgos 4phyag 'tshal/ /phung po rnams ni ngo bo nyid stong shin tu phung po rnams dang bral/ /byis pa darmongs byed rnams ni rab tu bral bar khyod kyis yongs su brtags/ /shes pa mi ldan skye labo phal chen 'dir bcings rnyong tshal spre'u thogs pa 18bzhin/ /grol ba mkhas pa rnams ni mkha' la rlung bzhin chags 42—220

pa med par 'dod/ / khams rnams khams kyis :rnam pa kun tu stong par thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs/ /dper na brag ca rnam pa kun tu shin tu cisgra dang bral ba 'dra/ /des ni mi mkhas skye bo yang dag ji bzhin mi shes mang po bcings/ /grol ba mkhas pa yang dag rtogs pa rnams ni khams gsum chags ma mchis / /skye mched 5ngo bo nyid kyis rtag 0tu stong zhes thams cad mkhyen pas bstan/ /yang dag ma lags brdzun 7zhing byis pa slu ba chad pa stong pa 'dra/ /mi mkhas skye bo lam tshal gcig tu ma nges mang po de la chags/ /dper na 'gron po rkyargya mtsho chen por 'khyams pa bzhin du 'khor bar lhung / /'dren pa dbang po 'di dag dbang po nyid kyis shin tu stong pa ste/ /thub pa me long nang gi bzhin gyi : dkyil 'khor lta bur shin tu stong / /mi mkhas skye bo yang dag ma 'tshal mang po dag ni de la chags/ /bya dang mtsho yi mnya dang srog 5chags dag ni rgya la thogs pa bzhin/ /sems can sems can nyid stong sems can bral zhing ngo bo nyid kyis stong / /thub pa sems can ri mo mkhan gyis gzugs bris bzhin du ma mchis na/ /mi mkhas skye bo yang dag ji bzhin ma 'tshal mang po de la chags/ /mkhas pa yang dag rtogs rnams sgo nga'i sbubs nas byung ba'i bya bzhin grol/ /rten cing lachos rnams de dag skad cig pa ste stong zhing dmigs ma mchis/ /mi lam dga' ba 7bzhin du gzung ’ du ma mchis byis pa rmongs bgyid pa/ /mi shes rtog 9pa'i slad du des kyang mi mkhas skye bo mang po bcings//mkhas pa yang dag rab tu rtogs rnams gzeb nas thar ba'i bya bzhin grol/ /thub pas chos nyid bsam yas ji bzhin chos rnams thams cad bsam mi khyab/ /thub pa zhi ba mya ngan 'das pa ji bzhin chos kun mtshan nyid bral/ /thub pa 42—221

khams gsum mi chags bzhin du chos kun gnas pa ma mchis te/ /de slad nyatshul gcig 'di 'tshal 2gyur na 'gro kun bde bar gshegs par 'gyur/ /thub pa bdag dang gzhan du mi mkhyen lta bur chos kun g.yo ba med/ /thub pa'i ye shes rgyal ba'i bstan pa ji bzhin chos kun bsam mi khyab/ /thub pa byis pa'i spyod yul ma lags ji bzhin chos kun brtags ma lags/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyod yul 'di byuni rab gsal 5de bzhin shes par bgyi / /mi mkhas gang dag rgyal bas byang chub gzhal yas brnyes shes smra ba dang / /gang dag rgyal bas 'khor lo dam pa gzhal 9yas mchog bskor smra ba dang / /gang dag bde gshegs skyob pas srog chags khrag khrig mya ngan bzlas 7smra ba/ /de dag thams cad yang dag ma 'tshal lta ba thibs por yongs su dkris/ /gang dag bde bar gshegs pas tshe yi 'du byed btang bzung smra ba dang / /gang dag stobs bcu 'gro ba'i don mdzad yongs su mya ngan 'das smra ba/ /de dag thams cad lta bar song la yid chags bdud kyi lag tu mchis ri/ /chos kyis de bzhin nyid ma 'tshal te 'dren pas mkhyen bzhin 'tshal bar bgyi/ /gang dag tshul dang tshul min 'di la mkhas pa de dag 'dren pa 5'tshal/ /de dag 5rkang gnyis gtso bo dpal stug la'ajig rten thugs brtse rgyal bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin nyid 'di —'gyur ba'i dbang dang ldan te de nyid chos nyid lags/ /de ltar 'di 'tshal 18gyur nas tshul la dzomakhas pa mi yi 2 mchog tu 'gyur/ /de ltar 'bras bu che ba'i lha tshogs chos rnams nges par rtogs gyur pa/ /ston pa'i spyan sngar brjod de lhag pa'i bsam pa de yangs bstan byas nas/ /kha cig yi rangs 2dogs med yid kyis sangs rgyas nyid du bdag mthong cinas/ /'dren sras de dag tshul 42—222

'di nyid kyis bdag gis bdag lung bstan par gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'bras bu che ba'i lha de dag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ske/ chos rnams nges par rtogs par 1thugs su chud nas sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa'i phyir de'i tshe 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rta thul gyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ dpal stug 'dren pa rnams ni rgyu zhig gzigs nas 'dzum pa mdzad lags te/ /rgyu med mi mdzad bka' stsal bdag gis bde gshegs mngon sum de skad thos/ /'di ltar 'dren pa khyod kyis zhi ba bde ba bsil ciba'i 'dzum mdzad na/ /rgyal ba lha mi lha min bla ma 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i rgyu de 5gsungs/ /de tshoring 'di ltar 'dren pa khyod kyi zhal nas 'dzum mdzad bsil mthong nas/ /'gro ba 'di kun the tshom 'tshal te 9bde gshegs khyod kyi zhal du lta / /mi mchog thugs rje ldan pa khyod kyis 'dzum rgyu de ni myur du gsungs/ /de thos gyur nas rgyal mchog 'gro ba 'di dag the tshom ma mchis 'gyur/ /'dren pa dam pa lha tshogs gang dag rang gis rang la lung bstan pa/ /de dag su zhig gang gis ci 'thob skamatha' bcas rnam par 'phrul pa gsungs/ /mi mchog tshangs pa'i gsung ’ dbyangs sgrog ste —the tshom kun tu bsal gdu gsol/ /de thos rgyal ba'i 'khor 'di rab tu dga' zhing mchog tu mgu lab 'thob/ /bde gshegs rgyal mtshan mthon po skode dag thams cad gzhan du mi sems par / /'dren pa'i sras rnams byang chub gzhal yas zhi ba dam pa sems shing mchis/ /thub pa 'dren mchog the tshom 'tshal ba de dag rnams kyi the tshom khum dzo/ /des ni ye shes stobs ldan tshul dang tshul min mkhas kun rgyal bar 'gyur/ /rkang gnyis gtso 42—223

bo'i yan lag brgyad ldan gsung thos gyur nas rab dga' ste/ /bde gshegs bstan 1pa bzhin du bgyid cing ci gsungs pa'i rjes 'jug mkhas par 'gyur//de dag don gyi dbang la brten denas bde gshegs 'dren pa bka' stsal gsol/ /des ni yi porangs gyur te — 'gro brtso chos kyi mtha' nyamar phyin par 'gyur/ /'dren pa chen po lha de dag gi 7sngon gyi spyod pa thos gyur cing / /rgyal ba'i gsung thos gyur nas brnag pa yongs 5rdzogs zhi bzhing rab dga' ste/ /tshul la zhugs shing tshul la mkhas 5rnams myur du thams cad mkhyen par 'gyur/ /'gro ba rab tu 'grol thamadzad ji bzhin yang dag ston par lamadzad par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rta thul la tshigs su bcad de slar bka' stsal pa/ lha tshogs rnams kyi 7ched du nga yis 'dzum pa sna 'jig rten bstan dzomadzad pa/ /rta thul khyod kyis dus dang tshod shes nga la dris pa shin tu legs / /gang phyir nga yis 'dzum pa mdzad pa 'di yi tshul dang rgyu / /de khyod bstan gyis 1khyod dang 'gro ba rtse gcig yid kyis nyon/ /thams cad mkhyen pa rnams ni rgyu yi 'bras bu rnam pa gsum gzigs shing / /rgyu lasang gzigs nas rkang gnyis dam pa dpal stug snyernams ning 'dzum pa mdzad/ /kha cig blo zhan cibadag cag lanyan thos 'gyur zhes mya ngan 'das zhugs dang / /kha cig kha rog 'dug la dga' zhing rang rgyal byang chub 'dod zhugs dang / /kha cig bdag cag 'jig rten 'dren pa mthu 2 bo cher ni sngo'agyur bya sto / /skye bo sdug bsngal lhung ba dgrol zhesang zhugs pa'i bsam pa mkhyen gyur nas/ /'dzum pa chung mdzad gang byungam nyan thos don du mdzad par shes par bya/ /'dzum pa 'bring mdzad gang byung ri rang rgyal don du mdzad par rig par bya/ /'dzum mchog ngas 42—224

gang mdzad pa 'di ni 'dren pa'i don du shes par bya/ /rab 'bring tha ma rnam ’pa 'di gsum 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i rgyur gsungs te/ /kha cig thar pa'i don gnyer lam gsum zhugs pa'i 'jig rten 'di mkhyen nas/ /des na 'jig rten mkhas pa rnam ripar 'dren pa dam pa 'dzum pa mdzad/ /rta thul de la nyan thos don du 'dzum mdzad zhabs 'og 5nub par 'gyur/ /rang rgyal don du 'dzum pa gang mdzad sku yi dbus su nub par 'gyur/ /'dren pa stobs bcu'i don du 'dzum pa mdzad pa gtsug tu 5nub par 'gyur/ /de ltar rta thul khyod kyis 'dzum pa'i rgyu ni rnam gsum shes par gyis / /rgyal ba mchog rnams don du gang 'dzum de kun nga yi gtsug tu nub/ /sdig pa gzhom pa'i tshul du de ltar 'dzum pa ngas bstan shes par gyis/ /'dren pa rnams kyi 'dzum pa gang yin de rgyu rnam gsum yang bshad kyis / /kun kyang rtse gcig yid byos de ni nga las legs par mnyan par gyis / /dang po'i don du 'dren pa 'dzum pa ngas mdzad myur du thog mar nub/ /'bring gi don ni 7dus tshod cung zad bsdud cing phyi nas nub par 'gyur/ /blo mchog ldan phyir 'dzum pa rgyal ba ngas mdzad pashin tu ring du gnas/ /rta thul nyan thos don du gang gnas 'dzum de theg pa'i dbang gis mdzad/ /gzhan yang 'dzum rgyu rnam snyegasum bshad kyis k+ṣirta thul khyod kyis mnyan tshapar gyisal/ /gang dag rgyal ba drang po stobs bcu po la skor 7ba byed pa ni/ /de dag nga la skyen par bskor lha nas myur du shin tu mkhas 9par 'gyur/ / 'bring don phyir ni srab cing che la dal gyis skor ba byed par 'gyur / /dal gyis g.yas phyogs bskor ba byas nas rgya cher 'gyur zhing mnan par 'gyur snye/ /gang dag gser rgyan la dkar steng bzhag 'dra ba'i bde 42—225

gshegs mthong gyur nyan/ /de ni rkang gnyis dam pa thub pa'i sku kun khyab par gnas par 'gyur/ /thams cad mkhyen pas 'dzum bstan 'di ni zhing gi dbang du shes par bya/ /gang tshe gdugs 'dra rimatha' yas mig ldan pas ni 'dren de 'gebs pa dang / /gang tshe me tog 'dra la 'dren pa'i steng gi mkha' la lding ba dang / /gang tshe sgo mo 'dra zhing bde bar gshegs la lan gsum skor byed pa/ /de ni 'jig rten 'das pa tshe yi dbang du 'dzum mdzad shes par bya/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams kyis 'dzum mdzad rgyu 5ni rnam gsum de tsam bstan/ /rta thul khyod kyis 'dzum mdzad rgyu rnams phyogasum po de dag shes par gyis/ /des na 'jig rten don bstan bzhed nas 'jig rten rnam 'dren 'dzum pa mdzad/ /de thos gyur nas thams cad mkhyen gyi bstan la the tshom med par gyis/ /'bras bu che ris lha tshogs bye ba brgyad cu tham pa 'di dag ni/ /zhing rnams dag tu chos tshul shin tu rgya chen smra ba'i rgyal bar 'gyur/ /mkhas pa de dag dpag med tshe ldan bskal pa mang por gnas par 'gyur/ /de /phyir bde bar gshegs pas 'dzum pa rgya chen mchog gi cha 'di bstan/ /de dag sngon gyi bskal pa sum cu drug gi rgyal ba rnams kyang mthong / /dzibaskal pa sum cu drug tu thams cad mkhyen pa bsnyen bkur spyad pa spyod/ /da dung mtshul mkhas 'di dag bskal pa grangs med sum cu rtsa drug tu/ /gang zag chen po 'di dag rgyal ba khyu mchog mchod pa byed cing gnas/ /thams cad du yang phun sum tshul rtogs pargyal ba'i mchog la mchod pa byed/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo mchod de byang chub zhi ba yongs su btsal byas nas/ /de dag de'i 'og tu dpal stug rkang gnyis dam pa skyes bu mchog /'dren pa mthu chen yon tan ldan par gser gyi rgyal mtshan bskal la 42—226

'byung ske/ /rgyal ba de dag sna tshogs zhing na gnas shing rang rang zhing sbyangs te/ /sems can dam pa de kun nyi ma'i 'od kyi dkyil mi'akhor dpal zhes bya/ /de tshe yon tan ldan pa de dag rnams kyi 'dus pa grangs med de/ /de tshe thub pa re re'i nyan thos 'dus par 'gyur ba de dag ni/ /gal te bskal pa khrag khrig dag tu stobs bcus nyan thos de bgrangs kyang / /legs mdzad rnams kyi nyan thos 'dus pa dag ni mthar phyir ribagrangs mi 'gyur/ /'dus pa de dag thams cad grangs med 'dus pa de rini ci 'dra ba/ /de las nyis gyur cade tshe byang chub tu ni yang dag zhugs par 'gyur/ /de tshe rgyal bar zhugs kyi rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma yin/ /de dag thams cad yongs dag zhing du spyad nas kun 5kyang rgyal bar 'gyur/ /bde gshegs de dag spyod pa gang yin de dag rnams kyi'ang de nyid 'gyur/ /'jig rten mkhas pa de dag mya ngan 'das par gyur nas dam pa'i chos/ /de tshe sras kyis gzung dzizhing bskal pa bye ba brgyad cur gnas par 'gyur/ /de dag 'das nas ston pa'i gsung rab de la byang chub sems bskyed pa/ /gang gā'i klung gi bye ma bas kyang shin tu mang ba 'byung bar 'gyur / /de dag 'das nas ston pa skyob pa rnams kyi gsung rab de la ni/ /nyan thos rgya mtsho kun gyi bye snyed dpag yas mya ngan 'da' bar 'gyur/ /de ltar 'jig rten don rnams mdzad pa rang byung tshode dag thams cad kyi/ /bstan pa gang yin de ni chos dang yongs su legs par ldan gyur cing / /yang dag shar bar sna 'gyur te pade ni bstan pa rnams kyi chos nyid yin/ /mi dmachog de yi gsung rab de thos 'gro ba ma lus dad gyur nas/ /rkang gnyis dam pa gzhal yas 'jig rten don byed bdag cag 'gyur zhes te/ /thams cad dga' nas 42—227

rgyal ba'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal skye bo rab tu dga'/ /bde bar gshegs la dga' ba gzhal yas bskyed nas chos kyis bsnyen bkur byas/ /de lta bas na dga' bar byos la mgo la 'bar bzhin spyad spyod de/ /rtag tu shes rab pha rol phyin dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten byos la/ /yang dag mthong ba'i spyad 〉pa dge ba 'di ril kun tu bsten byos te/ /dge slong khyed cag rkang gnyis gtso bo 'jig rten thugs brtser 'gyur bar gyis/ /'bras bu che ba pa lung bstan pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o// //de nas gnas 5gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha rnams kyis de'i tshe sems can dpag tu med pa byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs par rig cing sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la the tshom med par gyur par rig nas tshim zhing mgu la yi gyurangs te rab tu dga' zhing dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das la tshul dang 'dra ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis so so nas mngon par bstod do/ /de la nalha'i bu sbyin pa la mos pas gsol pa/ khyod kyis sdug pa'i sras rnams dang —/ /btsun mo dang ni srog phangs btang / /rgyal srid btang bar 9ci smos te / /sbyin mthar phyin la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu tshul khrims la mos pas gsol pa/ khyod kyis —tshul khrims rnam ’ sbyangs pa/ /rnam pa kun tu bsnyengs mi mnga'/ /shin tu bslabs dpas mthar phyin pa/ /khrims mthar phyin la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu bzod pa la mos pas gsol pa/ khyod kyis bzod pa bsten mdzad pas/ /yan rilag gtubs 4pa'ang bzod par mdzad/ /zab mor sgyid lug ma lags te/ /bzod mthar phyin la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu 42—228

brtson 'grus la mos pas gsol pa/ brtson pa ma btang brtson 'grus te/ /stobs / chen brtson 'grus ldan gyur pas/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub mchog brnyes pa / /brtson mthar phyin la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu bsam gtan la mos pas gsol pa/ khyod kyis bsam gtan bsten mdzad pa/ /de la 'jig rten gting mi rnyedami/ /dus gsum mnyam pa nyid brnyes pa/ /bsam gtan mthar phyin phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu gzi brjid dang ldan pas gsol pa/ dpa' bos shes rab pha rol phyin/ /yang dang yang ni sgrubasgoms pas na/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid brnyes pa/ /shes rab mthar phyin phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu khams kyi blo gros kyis gsol pa/ sbyin rmi dag dang ngag snyan dang / /don spyad 'thun pa'i don dag gis/ /'jig rten 'di dag khyod kyis btul/ /'dren pa khyod la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu dge ba'i blo gros kyis gsol pa/byams chen thugs rje chen po dag /yun ring dus nas bsgoms mdzad de/ /sems can dpag yas yongs su bsgral/ /gdos 'dzin khyod la phyag kyang 'tshal / /lha'i bu dag pa'i sems kyis gsol pa/ nyon mongs med pa'i mthar phyin cing / /thub chen rtedul ba'i sems mnga' bas/ /ma dul thams cad dul mdzad pa/ /kha lo sgyur la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu blo nyagros dri ma med kyisamatshagasol pa/ sems dag mnyen pa'i sems mnga' ba/ /sems dul dbang po zhi mnga' ba/ /sems can kun gyi sems mkhyen pa/ /sems mkhyen khyod la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu blo gros rnam —par dag pas gsol pa/shes rab ldan pa'i blo gros can/ /blo gros mchog la rab tu zhugs/ /thugs gsal phun sum tshogs pa'i blo/ /mi mkhas rtogs mdzad phyag kyang 'tshal/ /42—229

lha'i bu sems brgyan 〉gyis gsol pa/ khyod kyi risems ni rnam par sbyangs/ /sangs rgyas zhing yang rnam dag mdzad/ /sems can blo yang rnam sbyangs pa/ /kun dag khyod la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu pham pa med pas gsol pa/dgongs pa pham pa mi mnga' ba/ /khyod kyis bdud kyi dpung yang bcom/ /khyod kyis lha tshogs thams cad kyang / /rab tu dga' ba'i yid du bsgyur/ /lha'i bu myur du byed pas gsol pa/ khyod kyis chos rnams myur bar mkhyen/ /sems can myur bar rnam par sbyangs/ /zab 5cing blta dka'i chos dag la/ /myur du mdzad la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu brtson 'grus brtan nepas gsol pa/bral gyur yongs su bral gyur pa/ /chu bo rgal te zag pa spangs/ /pha rol phyin cing thang la bzhugs/ /brtson 'grus brtan la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu spyod lam dang ldan pas gsol pa/ 'dod chags spangs shing zhe sdang spangs/ /gti mug spangs pa zag med pa/ /sbyin gnas bsod nams zhing gyur pa/ /'jig rten mchod 'os phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu shin tu brtan pas gsol pa/ khyod kyi dam chos shin tu brtan / /'jig rten gsum du rab tu mchod/ /gcig pu bgrod pas bde ba brnyes/ /de phyir khyod la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu mi 'khrugs pas gsol pa/ lhun stug gcig tu gyur pa'i ri/ /rlung gis bskyod tshopar mi nus te/ /de bzhin bstod dang smad pa yis/ /bde gshegs bskyod par mi nus so/ /lha'i bu mnyam pa nyid thob pas gsol pa/ dpa' bo chen po zab cing mnyam/ /mtshan rab sum cu rtsa gnyis can/ /shes rab zab mo blo ldan pa/ /rgyal ba mdzes la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu zab pa'i blo gros kyis gsol pa/ sku chen khyod la sku mi mnga'/ /de bzhin nyid la rab tu bzhugs / /42—230

yang dag mtha' yang ri1rab tu ston/ /khyod mtshungs gang zag yong ma mchis/ /lha'i bu blo gros dang bas gsol pa/ gnyis su med pas yang dag ston/ /dpa' bo dpa' bas rnam par gnon/ /gang dag pazab la zhum ma mchis/ /de dag khyod chos pha rol phyin/ /lha'i bu rab tu dga' bas gsol pa/ mchog tu dga' yid brtan pa dag /khyod kyi slob la bslabs 5pa'i rnams/ /sbrul rnams pags 0pa rnying 'dor bzhin/ /srid pa gsum po 'di dag 'dor/ /lha'i bu zhi ba'i yid kyis gsol pa/ ji ltar mar me mar zad cing / /snying po zad pas zhir 'gyur sgyubazhin/ /khyod kyis bstan pa myur thos nas / /shes rab chen po mya ngan 'da'/ /lha'i bu zhi gnas la gnas —pas gsol pa/gang gis kun mkhyen khyod mthong ba'i/ /mi rnams 'dod chags bcings pa yang / /shes rab mtshon gyis mkhas pa dag /'dod chags zhags pa gcod par 'gyur/ /lha'i bu zhi ’ gnas mang gis gsol pa/ zhi ba'i sems mnga' zhi la spyod/ /cho ga spyod yul rab tu zhi/ /nyon mongs thams cad zhi gyur pa/ /dgra rnams zhi la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu zhi gnas 'jigs 7med kyis gsol pa / khyod kyi mazhi gnas bslabs —pa yid/ /byang chub sems dpa' grags lachen dag /zhi gnas nyid kyis 'byung 'gyur zhing / /sems zhi de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur/ /lha'i bu zhi gnas zas kyis gsol pa/ chos rnams kun gyi zhi ba ni/ /dpa' bo khyod kyis rab tu bstan/ /shes rab chen pos 7de 'tshal na/ /de dag de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur/ /lha'i bu rtag tu rnam par lta sna bas gsol pa/ khyod kyis sems can rtag tu gzigs/ /mkhas pa khyod ltar slob pa rnams/ /ye shes mchog gis mnyam gzhag 9cing / /byang chub 42—231

mchog kyang thob rtsopar 'gyur/ /lha'i bu snang 'dzin gyis gsol pa/ shes rab pha rol phyin gyur pa/ /thub chen khyod las gang slob pa/ /de dag 'jig rten snang mdzad nacing / /sgrib pa med par gzigs par 'gyur/ /lha'i bu 'od byed kyis gsol pa/ 'jig rten sgron ma khyod kyi gsungs / /ye shes rgya mtsho de thos nas ske/ /de dag dri med bde ba 'thob/ /bsam gyis mi khyab 'od kyang 'byung //lha'i bu dri ma med pa'i 'od kyis gsol pa/ chos rnams thams cad rnam mi rtog /thabs la mkhas pas de dag gsungs/ /de 'dra'i ye shes ston bgyid pa/ /de dag gang zag mchog tu 'gyur/ /lha'i bu rab tu mi gnas kyis gsol pa/ gnas ma mchis shing blang ma mchis/ /chos rnams thams cad sems ma mchis / /bdag dang gzhan gyi rnam 'gyur ba/ /de dag khyod kyis de bzhin mkhyen / /lha'i bu gnas med blo gros kyis gsol pa/ chos rnams thams cad gzhi med par/ /rnam par 'dren pa khyod kyis gzigs/ /de dag khyod kyis lugs bzlog ste/ /sems can rnams la bstan pa mdzad/ /lha'i bu mi rten blo gros kyis gsol pa/ chos rnams thams cad rten ma mchis/ /sems can ma mchis phan tshun min/ /lag mthil skyu ru ra bzhag bzhin/ /yang dag ji bzhin khyod kyis bstan/ /lha'i bu bar snang rgyu bas gsol pa/ bde gshegs khyod kyis chos kyi rnams/ /bar snang lta bur (snang ba ste/ /skye dang 'gog pa med par gzigs/ /de slad 'jig rten chags mi mnga'/ /lha'i bu ngar 'dzin pa 7med pas gsol pa/ khyod kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /lus kyi ngo bo / nyid kyis ni/ /g.yo ba med cing ngar 'dzin med/ /spyod med rtsol ba med par gzigs/ /lha'i bu blo gros rnam par bsgoms kyis gsol pa/ sgyu ma sna tshogs 42—232

legs0skabagyis pa/ /sgyu ma'i mkhan pos bstan gyur na/ /de bzhin ma lags de bzhin gda'/ /thub pa de ltar mnyam ma mchis/ /lha'i bu rab tu sad pa'i ngang tshul gyis gsol pa/ gzugs brnyan ji ltar me long la/ /gda' yang de ltar ma mchis pa/ /de bzhin chos rnams khyod kyis gzigs/ /de bas 'jig rten mongs mi mnga'/ /lha'i bu yid gnyis rnam par 'jig gis gsol pa/sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas chos kyi rnams/ /de bzhin khyod kyis bstan pa mdzad/ /de ltar 'gro ba kun kyang mkhyen/ /lha'i bu spobs pa thogs med kyis gsol pa/ chos nyid la ni khor zug ritu/ /spobs pa rab tu 'byung 'gyur zhing / /chos nyid de ni brnyes cipas na/ /de slad khyod ni spobs pa ldan/ /lha'i bu chags med blo gros kyis gsol pa/ khyod kyi45chos 'di thams cad ni/ /rang bzhin mtshan nyid ma mchis par/ /yang dag ji bzhin rab tu mkhyen/ /de bas thub pas nerab rib bsal / /lha'i bu mya ngan bral gyis gsol pa/ mya ngan med cing nyer len med/ /spros pa med cing rnyog pa med/ /chos rnams kun tu nyon ma mongs/ /de dag rang bzhin khyod kyis mkhyen/ /lha'i bu rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pas gsol pa/ chos rnams yang dag ma lags de / /'gro dang 'ong ba ma mchis pa/ /de dag khyod kyis yang dag mkhyen/ /de bzhin rab tu bstan par tshomadzad/ /lha'i bu blo gros mchog gis gsol pa/ lhun gyis grub cing blang med pa/ /rmongs pa med cing shes pa med / /chos rnams ci rmeng mi bgyid pa/ /khyod kyis rang bzhin thugs su chud/ /lha'i bu sgrib med thob kyis gsol pa/ snang ba ma mchis mun ma mchis/ /gzugs med ma lags gzugs can min/ /gzung 7ba ma mchis grol ma mchis//42—233

khyod kyis rang bzhin thugs su chud/ /lha'i bu mig dpas kyis 3gsol pa/yul dang phyogs na mi gnas pa/ /yod dang med pa ma lags par/ /rmi lam 'dod pa ji bzhin du/ /de dag rang bzhin khyod kyis gzigs/ /lha'i bu mig mi 'dzums kyis gsol pa/ byis pa rnams kyi 4blo rmongs pa/ /ma skyes pa dang ma 'gags pa/ /bar na'ang gnas pa ma mchis pa/ /de dag rang bzhin khyod kyis gzigs/ /lha'i bu stong pa nyid la gnas pas gsol pa/ gang zag sems can ma mchis pa/ /ma mchis tha snyad ma mchis pa/ /bstan pa'i slad du brjod bgyi ba/ /de dag rang bzhin khyod kyis gzigs/ /lha'i bu mtshan ma med pa la gnas pas gsol pa/ gang gis tha snyad gdags pa yi/ /mtshan ma de dag ma mchis te/ /chos kun mtshan ma ma 5mchis par/ /rnam par 'dren pa khyod kyis gzigs / /lha'i bu smon pa med pa la gnas snyopas gsol pa/ ji ltar mtshan ma stong gyur cing / /smon pa dmigs su ma mchis dang / /su la smon lam mchis gyur pa/ /de yang de lta'i 4tshul du mkhyen/ /lha'i bu ting nge 'dzin la gzhol bas gsol pa/ rnam thar sgo la brten 9bgyis shing / /gang zhig grol tsha'agyur de ma mchis/ /de bzhin kun nas nyon mongs pa/ /de dag rang bzhin khyod kyis gzigs/ /lha'i bu ma smad pas gsol pa/ khyod ni sdig pa kun spangs shing / /bsod nams thams cad bsags ’ gyur te/ /bde gshegs khyod la smad mi mnga'/ /su smod de dag mkhas ma lags/ /lha'i bu glog gi sprin gyis gsol pa/ ji ltar glog bcas sprin gyi tshogs/ /char gyis sa chen ngoms par skabagyid/ /de bzhin 'dren pas chos char gyis/ /'jig rten rnams ni ngoms par mdzad/ /lha'i bu bsam pa don yod kyis gsol pa/ thub khyod 42—234

gsung /ni don mchis te/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor / /shin tu brtags te mdzad pas na/ /de ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i mtshan/ /lha'i bu blo gros caphun sum tshogs pas gsol pa/ chos rnams thams cad dngos nyid kyis/ /ma skyes 'gags 5pa ma lags te/ /de dag bde gshegs khyod kyis mkhyen/ /gzhan yang de bzhin rtogs par mdzad/ /lha'i bu seng ge'i phyong ros gsol pa/khyod kyis stong pa nyid bstan te/ / seng ge'i nga ro bsgrags mdzad pas/ /mu stegs can kun rab 'jigs pa/ /seng ges ri dgas phra /mo bzhin/ /lha'i bu bag yod las kyis gsol pa/ bag yod sngon du btang mdzad de/ /khyod kyis spyod pa spyad bgyis pas/ /sangs rgyas chos la 'dren pa khyod/ /bag yod pas 7ni nges par 'byung / /lha'i bu bag yod rab gnas kyis gsol pa/bag yod pa la rab gnas te/ /khyod kyis nyid kyi chos kyang spel/ /stobs bcu gzhan yang masangs rgyas chos/ /bsam gyis mi khyab rab tu spel/ /lha'i bu bag yod skyes kyis gsol pa/ bag yod pa nya la brtson pas nas/ /byang chub phyogs rnams yang tshadag skyes/ /thub chen rang yang grol gyur nas/ /de dag rnams ni 'jig rten 'grelas/ /lha'i bu bag yod nges par byung gis gsol pa/ byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos dag /ji snyed thar la rten pa'i rnams/ /kun kyang khyod la bslabs 19pa ste/ /bag yod pas ni nges par 'byung / /lha'i bu bag yod gnas pas gsol pa/ bag yod yongs su ma btang bas/ /rnam par 'dren pa khyod kyi sras/ /'gro ba 'di la ma chags par / /thams cad mkhyen du nges par byung 2/ /lha'i bu bag yod bsrungs kyis gsol pa/ byang chub lam la bsten 4mdzad cing / /khyod ni bag gis bsrungs pas na/ /thugs rje 42—235

chen po mkhas pa yis1/ /byang chub dam pa brnyes 3par gyur / /lha'i bu bag yod brtson gyis gsol pa/ bag yod pa la rab brtson zhing / /mtshan nyid gcig po rtogs bgyis pasnye/ /dpa' bo chen po khyod 6kyi sras/ /yab kyi dkor yang thob par 'gyur / /lha'i bu bag yod mngon par dga' bas tsho gsol pa/ bag yod dga' ba'i brtan pa rnams/ /de dag sangs rgyas ye shes kyis/ /dpa' bo nyon mongs ri 'jig 7pas/ /nga rgyal ri yang de bzhin bsnyil —/ /lha'i bu bag yod 'dzin gyis gsol pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes tshol mdzad tshe/ /khyod ni bag gis bzung bas tshan/ /bskal pa bye ba grangs med du//khyod kyi tshothugs ni skyor tsham gyur/ /lha'i bu zhi gnas brtson gyis gsol pa/chos rnams de dag rang bzhin zhi/ /de ni sangs rgyas spyod yul lags/ /byang chub yang dag gang zhugs dang / /thams cad mkhyen pa der mi 'jigs/ /lha'i bu zhi gnas la yang dag par gnas pas gsol pa/ sangs rgyas zhi gnas bzhugs dpa ste/ /'on kyang de la chags mi mnga'/ /sems can nyon mongs zhi bar mdzad/ /rdul 'thul ba la char pa bzhin/ /lha'i bu zhi gnas la rab tu gnas kyis gsol pa/ sangs rgyas zhi sal rab tu bzhugs / /sus kyang mi bskyod : ri bo bzhin/ /khyed 19la gnod bgyir mi nus te / /semasamanyazhi khyod las phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu zhi gnas dul gyis gsol pa/ khyod kyi sras rnams ma smad pa/ /zhi gnas kyis ni yongs su dul snye/ /bdud rnams bye bas mi tshugs te/ /'dod chags kyis ni gnod mi 'gyur/ /lha'i bu zhi gnas nges par byungam gis gsol pa/ zhi ba'i yid mnga' zhi ciganas la/ /dpa' bo chen po bsgom samadzad pas/ /ci la gnas te bsam gtan mdzad/ /sus kyang khyod 42—236

kyi tshul ma 'tshal/ /lha'i bu zhi gnas sngon du 'gros lhagasol pa/ ston pas nasangs rgyas chos rnams kyi/ /sngon du zhi gnas 'gro zhes gsungs / /gang cagis byang chub 'grub 'gyur ba'i/ /chos gzhan de yi rjes su 'brang 5/ /lha'i bu zhi gnas rjes su 'brang gis gsol pa/ 'jig rten sgron ma'i dzizhi gnas ni/ /sems kyi rnyog pa 'dang bar bgyid / /zhi ba'i sems ldan rnamari she kyis 'ching —/ /de khyod mtha' yas dbang du mdzad/ /lha'i bu zhi gnas spyod yul gyis gsol pa/ chos rnams kun gyi spyod yul ni/ /zhi gnas yin zhes 'dren pas gsungs/ /de la chags med spyod pa lani/ /rnam par 'dren pa sangs rgyas 'gyur / /lha'i bu zhi gnas brlan gyis gsol pa/ bsam gtan gyis ni sngon pabarlan te/ /shes rab kyis ni sems bsgoms pas/ /de phyir rdzogs pa'i byang chub brnyes/ /de bzhin skye bo rnams kyang 'dren/ /lha'i bu zhi gnas lhur len gyis gsol pa/ sangs rgyas chos rnams gang la yang / /lam gzhan bdag glugis ma mthong ste/ /zhi gnas ye shes che thob na/ /rang byung 7nyid du nges par 'byung ske/ /lha'i bu lhag mthong mngon dgas gsol pa/ dpa' bo chen po lhag mthong ni/ /chos rnams thams cad ston pa ste/ /de la khyod kyi 7sras spyod cing //rang byung sanyid ni thob par 'gyur/ /lha'i bu lhag mthong byung 7gis 8gsol pa/shes rab pha rol phyin gnas shing / /rnam par 'dren pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sman pa'i rgyal po ston pa ste/ /de bas 19lhag mthong dge ba lags/ /lha'i bu lhag mthong rab gnas kyis gsol pa/ chos rnams thams cad btsal bgyis te rtso / /yang dag ji bzhin mthong gyur na/ /brtan pa rdzogs pa'i 2byang chub 'thob rte / /byang chub nyid la gnas par 'dod/ /lha'i bu lhag mthong nges 42—237

'byung gis gsol pa/ gang zag mchog rnams ye shes kyis/ /byang chub mchog tu nges par byung ’/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub ye shes kyis/ /brnyes pa'i dran ②pa skye mi 'gyur/ /lha'i bu lhag mthong mngon dgas gsol pa/ yang dag ji bzhin yang dag tu/ /chos rnams rnam par gzigs pas na/ /byang chub gzhal yas brnyes 5gyur te/ /de bas rnam ca'adren sangs rgyas lags/ /lha'i bu lhag mthong la mngon par brtson pas gsol pa/ mkhas pa ye shes gang brtson zhing 5/ /dka' ba mang po spyod bgyid pa/ /de dag rgol tshogs thams cad kyis/ /pham par bgyi bar dziyong mi nus/ /lha'i bu lhag mthong byungadza gis gsol pa/ chos rnams rnam mthong bgyi slad du/ /rgyal sras gang dag zhugasasnyipa'i rnams/ /chos rnams ngo bo nyid 'tshal cing 9/ /rang byung nyid ni thob par 'gyur/ /lha'i bu lhag mthong la bsten ’ pas gsol pa/ rnam 7'dren khyod kyis yun ring du/ /ye shes la ni bsten tshamadzad pas/ /thams cad mkhyen pa brnyes nas ni/ /srog chags bye ba grol bar mdzad/ /lha'i bu khyad par ldan gyis gsol pa/ sangs rgyas mkhyen pas skethams cad mkhyen/ /'dren pa dam pa mngon par 'phags/ /srid pa'i rgya mtshos khyer ba yi/ /'jig rten de yis sgrol bar rimadzad/ /lha'i bu lhag mthong gnas kyis gsol pa/ lhag mthong la ni gnas mdzad cing / /chos kun rnam par gzigs pas na/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams 'phel 'gyur te/ /sa bzang n+ya gro dha laskyes 'dra/ /lha'i bu lhag mthong dang ma bral bas gsol pa/ rnam par 'dren pa khyod kyi sras/ /ye shes kyis ni yongs bzung ste/ /byang chub mchog ni thob bgyis shing / /skye bo mang po 'grel bar ’ bgyid/ /lha'i bu lhag mthong la rnam par rtse bas gsol pa/42—238

sangs rgyas mkhyen la 1rnam par rol/ /chos rnams kun la 'jigs mi mnga'/ /zhum pa ma mchis dngang dmi mnga'/ /thub pa 'jig rten thams cad mkhyen/ /lha'i bu lhag mthong la yang dag par 'jug gis gsol pa/ dpa' bo chen po chos kun ni/ /lhag mthong nyid du yang dag 'du/ /rang bzhin med par rnam mthong na/ /de ni rang byung byang chub lags/ /lha'i bu lhag mthong snying pos gsol pa/ sangs rgyas lhag mthong snying po ste/ /chos rnams kun la 'jigs mi mnga' / /'jig rten sdug bsngal 'di gzigs shing / /thugs rje chen po shin tu skyed/ /lha'i bu lhag mthong 'gros kyis sgrugasol pa/ byang chub phyir ni shes 'gro phyoba'i/ /'jig rten mkhas pa nges par byung 7/ /de dag byang chub mchog kyang 'thob // /grol nas skye dgu 'di dag 'grel/ /lha'i bu stong pa nyid la bsten 7gyis gsol pa/ stong pa nyid kyi chos sten ’ pa'i/ /mkhas pa byang chub 'tshang rgya ste/ /sems can bcings las 'grol 7bgyid cing / / bcings pa 7thams cad rnam par gcod / /lha'i bu stong pa nyid la mos kyis gsol pa/stong pa nyid la mos gyur pa'i/ /'gro ba 'di dag srog med gzigs/ /dmigs med ngo bo nyid med pa/ /de ltar srog chags rnams la stonas/ /lha'i bu stong pa nyid kyi saspyod yul gyis gsol pa/ sangs rgyas kun gyi spyod yul ni/ /chos rnams rang bzhin stong pa ste/ /srog chags rnams la thugs brtse bas/ /dpa' bos de la spyad par /snyemadzad/ /lha'i bu stong pa nyid kyi 19bsam pas gsol pa/skyon dang bral zhing bcings med la/ /'jigs skrag thams cad rab tu spangs/ /chos rnams kun la mi gnas shing / /nam mkha'i rlung bzhin spyod pa mdzad/ /lha'i bu stong pa nyid la mngon par dga' bas gsol pa/ stong 2 nyid chos la 42—239

sten ribagyid cing / /sangs rgyas spyod yul gang mos pa/ /de dag ston pa mchod pa ste/ /mchod pa de ni bla na med/ /lha'i bu stong pa nyid kyis yang dag par 5'phags kyis rigasol pa/ gang gis 'dren pa 'phags gyur pa / /de ni yang dag 'phags zhes gsungs/ /stong nyid chos la sten sgrubagyid pa/ /ma smad pide dag sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /lha'i bu stong pa nyid kyis 'dren gyis gsol pa/dpa' bo chen po chos rnams gang / /mya ngan 'das min ston ma namachis/ /kun kyang mya ngan 'das par 'dren/ /drang srong chen po'i byang chub lags/ /lha'i bu stong pa nyid kyis yang dag 9shar gyis gsol pa/ stong nyid zhi la brten 7nas ni/ /khyod kyi slob ma yang dag shar/ /stong pa nyid la gang sten tshapa/ /de dag rim gro dbagyid pa lags/ /lha'i bu stong pa nyid la sten khugyis gsol pa/gang rnams dastong pa nyid sten sapa/ /mkhas pa de dag mongs mi 'gyur/ /nyon mongs med cing lta med rnams/ /byang chub rdul med thob 7par 'gyur/ /lha'i bu stong pa nyid phun sum tshogs pas gsol pa/ gang rnams stong nyid sten / bgyid pa/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams 1 phun sum tshogs/ /rang byung pham pa med par 'gyur/ /'jig rten don kyang bgyid par 'gyur/ /lha'i bu stong pa nyid la yang dag par zhugs pas gsol pa/ sangs rgyas chos la zhugs gyur te/ /stong pa nyid la gang sten pa/ /de la bdud rnams bye bang phrag /stong gis dkrug 2par mi nus so/ /lha'i bu mtshan ma med 2 la dga' bsal gsol pa/mtshan ma med la mngon dgyes te/ /dngos po thams cad rnam bshig nas/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten rnams nas byung / /mtshan ma rnams la chags mi mnga'/ /lha'i bu mtshan ma med la gnas pas gsol pa/ mtshan ma med la spyod gyur 42—240

cing / /zhi ba zhi la spyod pa rnams/ /mtshan ma rnam par bshig rnams kyis / /tshul ni bdud kyis shes mi nus/ /lha'i bu mtshan ma med pa'i spyod yul gyis gsol pa/ sangs rgyas kun gyi spyod yul la/ /'dren pa khyod ni spyod mdzad de/ /mtshan ma mi mnga' rtogs dka' zhing / /zhi spyod khyod la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu mtshan ma med pas skom gyis gsol pa/ thub pa'i 'khor 'di thams cad ni / /mtshan ma med pas skom 5gyur te/ /yab kyi dkor ni 'tshal gyur nas/ /de bzhin gshegs la bkur ste ribagyid/ /lha'i bu mtshan ma med pa la spyod pas gsol pa/ mtshan ma med la nyin mtshan du/ /gang zag mchog ni laspyod mdzad pas3/ /lha dang dri za 0mi dag kyang / /khyod kyi tshul ni ma 'tshal to/ /lha'i bu mtshan ma med pas rnam par grol gyis gsol pa/ chos rnams thams cad rnam bshig cing / /dpa' chen 'jig rten sgron ma khyod/ /mtshan ma med la gnas par mdzad/ /de bas khyod la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu mtshan ma med pa la rnam par rtse bas gsol pa/ thub chen dpa' bo chen po khyod/ /mtshan ma med la rnam par rol/ /mis rnams yongs su smin mdzad cing / /sangs rgyas ye shes mchog la zhugs/ /lha'i bu mtshan ma med pas yongs su 9grub kyis gsol pa / gang gis mtshan ma spangs gyur pa/ /de dag byang chub grub 7pa ste/ /yab kyi chos kyi 3 brtul zhugs can/ /de dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mchod/ /lha'i bu mtshan ma med pa la dga' bas pagasol pa/ gang gis mtshan ma rnam bshig pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas chos la dga'/ /bla ma'i gnas la gnas pa ste/ /sems can kun gyi mchod rten lags/ /lha'i bu mtshan ma med pa la rten tshapas gsol pa/ zhi la spyod cing rnam grol ba/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten bla na med/ /42—241

'byung po kun gyi skyabs 1dang rten/ /dpung gnyen de bzhin gnas kyang lags//lha'i bu mtshan ma med pa la mos pas gsol pa/ mtshan ma med la mos gyur cing —/ /zhi ba rgyudagra las rgyal gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas rgal ba 'gro sgrol ba/ /de dag tshad ni ga la mchis/ /lha'i bu smon pa med pa rtogs kyis gsol pa/mgon po gang dag smon lam ni/ /rnam pa kun tu mi dmigs pa/ /de dag 'jig rten bral ba ste/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten nang nas byung / /lha'i bu smon pa med pa la sten 4pas gsol pa/ zhi ba'i thugs dang ldan pa khyod/ /srid pa rnams su smon mi mdzad/ /sred 5pa yongs su chad pas na/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten yong phyomi gos/ /lha'i bu smon pa med pas skyes kyis gsol pa/ gang gis srid 7pa yongs bcom pa/ /de dag gzi mchog skyes 9pa ste/ /de dag 'jig rten mgon po'i sras/ /rang gi 7yab la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu smon pa med pas bskyed kyis : gsol pa/ khyod kyi sras rnams ma smad pa/ /sred tshapa yongs su bcad pas na/ /srid pa 'jig skabagyid srid pa la/ /de dag smon pa mi bgyid do/ /lha'i bu smon pa med pas yongs su grol bas gsol pa/ gang dag smon pa mi bgyid pa/ /gzi ldan khyod kyi sras kyi rnams/ /re ba btang zhing bcings grol ba/ /de dag yongs su grol bar 'gyur/ /lha'i bu smon pa med pas byung gis gsol pa/ gang gis sred pa rab bcom pa/ /de dag mya ngan dgon pa rgal / /de dag mi skom zang zing med/ /dpa' chen khyod la deng tshaphyag 'tshal/ /lha'i bu smon pa med skol nges pas gsol pa/ gang gis srid dang sdug bsngal dang / /bde ba dngos po med bsgoms pa / mgon khyod de dag rnams kyi yab/ /de dag khyod kyi sras kyang lags/ /lha'i bu smon pa med pa'i 42—242

'khor gyis gsol pa/ srid pa'i 1sdug bsngal sus mthong ba/ /de dag khyod kyi bstan la dulas/ /kha lo sgyur zhing srid sel cib/ /sems dul khyod la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu smon pa med pas byung gis gsol pa/ srid pa'i dgon las byung ba narnams/ /bde ba thob cing zhi gnas te/ /nyon mongs dgra rnams pham mdzad pa/ /'jig rten mgon la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu smon pa med pas ya mtshan du gyur pas gsol pa/ g.yul las rgyal bar gyur pa ste/ /khyod ni rnam rgyal pham mi mnga'/ /bdud kyi dpung rnams pham mdzad cing / /srid pa kun tu smon mi mdzad/ /lha'i bu smon pa med pa stobs ldan gyis gsol pa/thar pa'i chos la stobs 5ldan pas/ /bdud kyi zhags pa yongs bcad cing / /khyod kyi sras rnams bdud dag la/ /bskyab pa'i 'du shes mi bgyid do/ /lha'i bu lus rnam par brtags kyis gsol pa/ lus med 'chi ba med tshul du/ /lus 'di gang gis mthong gyur pa/ /de dag sangs rgyas spyod yul dga'/ /'dren pa khyod kyi rjes su zhugs/ /lha'i bu lus nges par sems pas 9gsol pa / mi gtsang rul ba parnag zag pa/ /lus 'di mi bzad nges bsams te //yang dag ji bzhin 'tshal gyur nas/ /rnam 'dren khyod la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu lus rtogs kyis gsol pa/ lus la mi gtsang brtags skabagyis te/ /lus la dran pa rnam dpyad cing / /lus kyi sdug bsngal rnams 'grol nas/ /des pa khyod la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu lus yongs su gtong gis gsol pa/sbrul gyi pags tshapa rnying bzhin du/ /rnag can lus 'di spangs lanas ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pas sku bo che/ /sku mi mnga' la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu lus la smod pas gsol pa/ mi gtsang dri nga rnag zag cing / /rul 19ba'i lus la 42—243

rtag 〉smad de/ /mi gtsang gang ba rnam spangs nas/ /'dren pa khyod la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu lus kyis yongs su skyo bas gsol pa/ gang dag rul ba'i lus skyo zhing / /rgyal sras gtsang ba 'tshal ba rnams/ /chos kyis rab tu bskyed 5pa'i sras/ /de dag sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal 'gyur/ /lha'i bu lus kyis skrag pas gsol pa/ 'byung ba chen po sbrul gdug 'drar / /gang gis shin tu rtogs gyur pa/ /de dag lus las 'das pa ste/ /rkang gnyis gtso la phyag kyang 'tshal / /lha'i bu lus kyi skyon mthong bas gsol pa/ lus kyi skyon la mngon sum ste/ /ye shes gzigs pa'i spyan mnga' bas / /sangs rgyas mkhyen pas sgrumakhas pa dag /srid gsum thams cad yongs su gzigs/ /lha'i bu lus la 'dod chags dang bral bas gsol pa/ lus kyi 'du shes 'dod chags bral/ /chos kyi 'du shes mi gnas pas/ /kun sbyor kun las 'das pa ste/ /rnam 'grel phyisangs rgyas phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu srid pa'i dgra'i blo gros kyis gsol pa/ srid par srid pa 'joms mdzad pa/ /khyod kyis dgra yi 'du shes mkhyen / /khyod kyi nasras rnams sgom 9bgyid cing / /mkhas pa byang chub mngon 'tshang rgya/ /lha'i bu srid pa sel bas gsol pa/ srid pa rnams kyi lanyes dmigs mthong / /mya ngan 'das pa : 'jigs med mthong / /khyod kyi sras rnams 'gro phan phyir/ /byang chub spyad pa spyod pa bgyid/ /lha'i bu srid pa rnam par spangs kyis gsol pa/ gang gis srid pa rnam spangs shing / /'jig la tshamangon par mi dga' ba/ /bral bar gyur cing sems dag pa/ /mkhas khyod zhabs la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu srid pa bsal gyis gsol pa/ mi yi dam pa khyod 4kyi sras/ /srid par khrid pa rab bsal cite/ /khyod kyi bslab la 42—244

bslabs 1pa dag /stong gsum 'di na rnam par mdzes/ /lha'i bu srid pa las rgal 5bas gsol pa/ srid pa'i mtsho las rgal ba yi/ /'jig rten mgon mchog skyob 4rnams la/ / grangs kyis rgyun 5tu bgrang ba yi/ /grangs ni 'jig rten 'di na med/ /lha'i bu srid pa 'joms kyis tshigasol pa/ srid pa thams cad yongs bcom ste/ /gang dag rtag tu dran spyod pa/ /de dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mchod/ /srog chags rnams la chos kyang ston/ /lha'i bu srid pa las rab tu grol bas gsol pa/ srid pa'i rgyun las rab tu grol/ /rnam par 'dren pa srid pa rgal/ /srid pa mthar 'byin sgyusangs rgyas te / /srid pa sel 9la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu srid pa rab tu zhi byed kyis gsol pa/ srid par khrid pa rab zhi zhing / /srid pa pham par mdzad nas gshegs/ /brten 7pa srid pa mthar 'byin pa/ / /khyod la do zla dam mchis so/ /lha'i bu srid pa'i mthar 'gro bas gsol pa/ srid pa'i mthar phyin rab zhi ba/ /mgon po khyod kyi srid pa'i mtha'/ /srid pa phyir 'byin skathams cad mkhyen/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten rtogs par mdzad/ /lha'i bu srid pa'i 5tha ma'i lus 'dzin gyis gsol pa/ srid pa'i rgyu ni rnam spangs nasad/ /srid pa tha ma 'dzin mdzad pa/ /gang gis srid pa len 'gyur ba'il/ /khyod kyis sa kun tu sbyor ba mthong / /lha'i bu srid pa rab tu zhi ba thob kyis gsol pa/ khyod kyis srid pa stong mkhyen te/ /srid pa'i rgyu yang de bzhin no/ /zhum dang rab tu zhum mi mnga'/ /mnyam nyid gyur la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu srid pa'i pha rol du 'gro bas gsol pa/srid pa'i pha rol rgal 18ba ste/ /srid par khrid 19pa yang dag bsal / /rnam par 'dren pa thugs brtse bas/ /skye bo gzhan ni sgrol ba mdzad// //42wa 245

bam po bcu pa/ lha'i bu tshor bas mnar 〉gyis gsol pa/ tshor ba bdag tu bgyi ma mchis/ /sems ma mchis shing rtsol ma mchis/ /bsam gtan mdzad pa che khyod kyis/ /tshor ba chu bur lta bur 5rimakhyen/ /lha'i bu tshor ba ston pas gsol pa/ ngo bo nyid kyis dngos med par/ /tshor ba khyod kyis rab tu mkhyen/ /mi lam sdug gu'i cadaga' 'dra ba/ /de la so so'i skye bo chags/ /lha'i bu tshor ba la yongs su rtogs pas gsol pa/ shes rab bcas pas yongs brtags na / /tshor ba 'gro bar ma song zhing / /'ong ba med la spyodangos med par/ /de ni thub chen khyod kyis gzigs/ /lha'i bu tshor ba dang bral bas gsol pa/ tshor ba dang ni tshor ba po/ /rang bzhin med par khyod kyis gzigs / /zab mo blta dka'i tshig 7de yang / /khyod kyis sems can rnams la bstan/ /lha'i bu tshor ba'i rgyud la nges pas gsol pa/ tshor ba de ni kun rdzob tsam/ /don dam nyid du mi dmigs te/ /khyod kyis sems can der btul bas/ /'gro ba the tshom ma mchis gyur 7/ /lha'i bu tshor ba la mkhas pas gsol pa/ tshor ba'i phung po mkhas pa po 2/ /mkha' la rlung gi dkyil 'khor bzhin / /byis pa'i blo can rmongs bgyid pas/ /de ni khyod kyis yang dag gzigs / /lha'i bu tshor ba tshamangon par shes pas gsol pa/ tshor ba'i phung po mngon mkhyen pa/ /rig cing rig pa'i mthar byon pa'itsha/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi mchog khyod kyis/ /tshor ba bdag med rab tu gzigs/ /lha'i bu tshor ba las rgal tshabs gsol pa/ rkang gnyis gtso bo dam pa khyod/ /rgal tshadaka' tshor ba'i mtsho las rgal 8/ /'dam la rgal lha cing sdig med pa/ /byang chub mchog 'di sangs rgyas gyur / /lha'i bu tshor ba las byungam gis gsol pa/ rnam par 42—246

'dren pas 'jig rten du/ /tshor ba rnams ni 'byung mkhyen nas/ /tshor ba'i phung po rab rgal 17te/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten chags mi mnga'/ /lha'i bu tshor ba rig pas gsol pa/ mi rnams dag la gang 'ching ba'i tshor ba thams cad khyod 5kyis mkhyen/ /nyon mongs zhags pas 'ching 5'gyur ba/ /de yi rang bzhin khyod kyis gzigs/ /lha'i bu sems la mkhas pas gsol pa/ khyod kyi 4sems kyis 5nyon mongs pham/ /bdud rnams kyang ni spa bkong 0ste/ /sems de rang bzhin ma mchis par/ /thub pa chen po khyod kyis gzigs / /lha'i bu sems yongs su shes pas gsol pa/ ji ltar sgyu ma'i mkhan po yis/ /sgyu ma sna tshogs sprul pa bzhin/ /sems ni bde gshegs khyod kyis mkhyen/ /de phyir khyod la 'jig rten mchod/ /lha'i bu nasems la yang dag par rtogs (pas gsol pa/ sgyu ma'i khomakhan nam slob ma bzhin/ /gang gis 'gro ba 'di bcings pa'i/ /sems de khyod kyis yang dag brtags/ /de ni khyod kyis ji bzhin mkhyen/ /lha'i bu sems kyi spyod yul la spyod pas gsol pa/ sems kyi spyod yul khyod kyis mkhyen/ /rnam par 'dren pa rmi lam na/ /ji ltar tshogs kyi grangs bzhin du/ /byis pa'i sems rmongs bgyid par gzigs/ /lha'i bu sems kyi dbang phyug gis gsol pa/ /dul gyur las su rung ba yi/ /sems kyi rang bzhin rtog med tshapa/ /gang la 'jig rten gting mi rnyed/ /mtshan nyid brtan pa khyod kyis gzigs/ /lha'i bu sems la dpa' bas gsol pa/ gang gis sems la sems med shes/ /mkhas pa skyid lug mi 'gyur zhing / /bdud sde rab tu 'dul tshabagyid pa/ /de dag 'dir ni dpa' lazhes bgyi/ /lha'i bu sems kyis yang dag 'phags kyis gsol pa/ gang dag sems la sems med 42—247

shes / /de dag sangs rgyas sras 1lags te/ /dpa' chen sangs rgyas chos rnams la/ /skyes bu de dag yang dag 'phags/ /lha'i bu zhi ba'i sems kyis gsol pa/ gang gis sems la dbang bgyis pa/ /sems can de dag zhi rab zhi / /bdud kyi zhags las rab grol bas/ /de dag bdud kyi dbang mi mchi/ /lha'i bu sems mnyen pas gsol pa/ mi rnams gang dag sems mnyen zhing / /bsnyen 5par dka' dang dpa' ba dang / /khyod kyi bstan la gang mos pa de dag 'dod par zhum mi 'gyur/ /lha'i bu sems dag pas gsol pa/ sems dag las rnams gtsang cagyur cing / /yang dag rtogs pas spyod bgyid pa/ /de dag rgyal ba'i bstan thos nas / /zab mo rnams la zhum mi 'gyur/ /lha'i bu chos nyid la gnas pas gsol pa/ gang gi poyid ni chos nyid la/ /rab tu dga' zhing thogs med pa/ /de dag mi dbang sras po ste/ /zhi ba'i sar ni phyin pa lags/ /lha'i bu chos la sems pas gsol pa/ chos rnams thams cad chos dbyings su/ /'dren pa de la bslabs 7pa rnams/ /chos nyid la ni gang sems pa / /de dag spyod yul ma yin med/ /lha'i bu chos kyi dbyings la 1nges par byung gis gsol pa/ mi mchog khyod kyi sras kyi rnams/ /chos kyi dbyings la nges byung —ste/ /'dren pa khyod kyi sras de dag /mtshan nyid gcig gis nges byung lags/ /lha'i bu chos kyi dbyings kyi spyod yul gyis gsol pa/ chos rnams kun gyi spyod yul ni/ /chos kyi dbyings zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ /dpa' bo khyod ni gang spyod pa'i/ /ye shes de ni bsam mi khyab/ /lha'i bu chos kyi dbyings la zhugs pas gsol pa/ chos kyi dbyings la gang zhugs pa/ /de dag ye shes bsam yas te/ /sangs rgyas chos la the tshom med/ /sems can bsam la de 12wa 248

dag mkhas/ /lha'i bu chos kyi dbyings la bab kyis gsol pa/ gang dag chos kyi mtshan nyid gcig /chos kyi dbyings la bab pa rnams/ /de dag spobs pa'i stobs bskyed pa/ /bsam gyis mi khyab thob par 'gyur/ /lha'i bu chos kyi dbyings la 'jigs 1pa med pas gsol pa/ gang la de dag gnas pa yi/ /'jigs pa med pa thob med pas / /de dag rnams kyi spobs dang stobs/ /de la mtshungs pa med pa 'byung / /lha'i bu chos kyi dbyings la mkhas pas gsol pa / khyod ni chos dbyings mkhas pa ste/ / chos rnams kun la shin tu mkhas/ /cilag mthil skyu ru ra bzhag bzhin/ /chos kyi dbyings kyang rnam par ston/ /lha'i bu chos kyi dbyings la gnas pas gsol pa/ chos rnams rang bzhin med gzigs pas/ /khyod ni chos kyi dbyings la bzhugs / /mi gnas zhum pa ma mchis te/ /bzung phyob ma mchis btang 7ma mchis/ /lha'i bu chos kyi dbyings la spyod pas gsol pa/ sangs rgyas spyod yul gang lags pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings la khyod spyod de/ /bar snang mkha' dang 'dra ba yi/ /'jig rten mgon la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu chos kyi dbyings la rton pas gsol pa/gang dang gang gi sgo dag nas/ /skyes bu dam pa ston mdzad pa/ /de yi sgo nas chos dbyings ston/ /de phyir rtags dang gzugs ma mchis/ /lha'i bu chos kyi rtedabyings la brtson pas gsol pa/ mngon par brtson pas chos kyi dbyings/ /skyes bu dam pa khyod kyis mkhyen/ /brtson pas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /ye shes pha rol phyin par gyur / /lha'i bu chos kyis tshim gyis gsol pa/ dpa' bo khyod kyis skye bo 'di/ /chos kyis rab tu tshim par mdzad/ /chos kyi dbyings ni rnam mkhyen pas/ /'dren pa byang chub mchog la bzhugasalo/ /lha'i 42—249

bu chos nyid kyi gting rnyed pas gsol pa/ gting rnyed gyur pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /'dren pa khyod kyi zhal du lta// /chos dbyings rnam par mkhyen pa yi/ /'dren pa khyod la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu gnas shes pa la rab tu gnas pas gsol pa/ mi mchog 'dren pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /ye shes gnas 'di chos dbyings te/ /rnam par 'dren pa stobs bcu po/ /gang la spyod pa de lags so/ /lha'i bu gnas la gnas pas gsol pa/ chos kyi dbyings ni gnas chen te/ /thams cad mkhyen pa bzhud pa'i lam/ /de ni chos rnams thams cad kyang / /mtshan nyid gcig par shes pa lags/ /lha'i bu gnas mngon par shes pas gsol pa/khyod ni chos dbyings mngon par mkhyen/ /mtshan nyid gcig la mkhas pa ste/ /sems can kun gyi bsam pa yang / /rkang gnyis gtso bo khyod kyis mkhyen/ /lha'i bu gnas nas nges par byung gis gsol pa/ rnam par 'dren pa khyod kyi sras/ /gnas su bya ba chos dbyings shes/ /gsal bar 'tshal ba'i mkhas pa rnams/ /rang byung nyid du nges par byung / /lha'i bu gnas la bslabs dpas gsol pa/ chos kyi dbyings la rigang bslabs capa'i/ /skyes bu de dag byang chub zhugs/ /rang rabyung nyid du gnas rnyed pas/ /de dag rkang gnyis mchog tu 'gyur/ /lha'i bu gnas med pa la mkhas pas gsol pa/ gnas med pa ni gang 'tshal neb/ /de dag bde gshegs dgongs la mos/ /bdud rnams bye ba stong gis kyang / /de dag rmongs par yong mi nus/ /lha'i bu gnas med pa snyumangon par shes pas gsol pa/ gnas med gang gis rig gyur pa/ /de dag bdag cag bdud kyi tshogs/ /bye bas byang chub mi skyod naces/ /mkhas pa de dag shin tu dga'/ /lha'i bu gnas med pa'i dgongs pa la mkhas pas gsol 42—250
