pa/ gnas med 'du shes mkhas pa ni/ /chos nyid la ni rab gnas te1)/ /sdig can bdud rnams bshal ba ni/ /ji ltar rta yis shing rta bzhin/ /lha'i bu gnas med pa la mkhas pas gsol pa/ mtshan nyid gcig la mkhas pa po/ /chos kyi dbyings la bgegs bgyid pa'i/ /bdud kyi las ni gnas med de/ /gnas med do zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ /lha'i bu gnas dang gnas ma yin pa rtogs pas gsol pa/ gnas dang de bzhin gnas min pa/ /byis pa'i blo can rnams la bstan/ /rang gis de ni thugs chud nas/ / sems can rnams la khyod kyis bstan/ /lha'i bu sbyin pa la mkhas pas gsol pa/ sngon chad rgyu ni gang dag dang / /las 'dra 'byung ba ma 'tshal ba'i/ /rgyu de khyod kyis thugs su chud/ /las kyi gnas kyang rab tu mkhyen/ /lha'i bu las la mkhas pas gsol pa/ chags dang zhe snang gti mug ni/ /las kyi rgyu zhes khyod kyis mkhyen/ /gang gis rgyu yis bgyis cide yang / /gang zag mchog gis thugs su chud/ /lha'i bu ma 'ongs pa la mkhas pas gsol pa/ ma 'ongs pa yi dus dag nas/ /mi rnams las gang bgyid 'gyur ba/ /de yi rgyu dang len pa dang / /gnas dang las kyang khyod kyis mkhyen/ /lha'i bu da ltar byung ba la lta bas gsol pa/phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten 'di dag gi/ /sems can rnams dang rgyu dang las/ /gnas dang las kyi len cipa rnams/ /kun kyang 'dren pa khyod kyis mkhyen/ /lha'i bu stobs kyi spyod yul gyis gsol pa/ mi dbang khyod kyis ma gzigs pa'i/ /las dang rgyu dag ma mchis te/ /gnas dang skye ba'ang ma mchis so/ /de bas khyod ni gang zag mchog /lha'i bu stobs la mngon par dga' bas gsol pa/las mo/dang rgyu dang de bzhin gnas/ /dus la rnam smin rnam gsum dang / /ji 42—251

ltar de yi len pa yang / /khyod kyis mkhyen pas de slad mchod/ /lha'i bu stobs kyi blo gros kyis gsol pa/ rgyu dang las dang len pa dang / /rnam par smin dang rkyen dang gnas/ /rang bzhin bral bar khyod kyis mkhyen/ /de phyir rgyal ba mnyam pa med/ /lha'i bu stobs kyis byung gis gsol pa/ rgyu dang las dang len pa dang / /gnas dang rkyen dang rgyu 1rnams dang / /rnam smin so so yang dag rig /thams cad stong par 5rab tu mkhyen/ /lha'i bu stobs la dga' bas gsol pa/ rgyu dang las dang len pa dang / /gnas dang rkyen dang rgyud kyi rnams / /khyod nyid rang gis mngon mkhyen te/ /rang bzhin med par bstan par 4mdzad/ /lha'i bu stobs kyis rnam par rtse 5bas gsol pa/ rgyu dang las dang len pa dang / /gnas dang rkyen dang rgyud kyi rnams/ /'pho med dbang phyug med pa ste/ /rten cing 'byung bar khyod kyis mkhyen/ /lha'i bu stobs kyis 'phags kyis gsol pa/ rgyu dang rkyen dang las rnams dang / /rnam par smin pa sten nepa rnams/ /de kun rang bzhin stong ngo zhes/ /seng ge'i nga ror khyod kyis gsungs/ /lha'i bu stobs kyi 9rjes su 'brang bas gsol pa/ 'jig rten las ni gang zhig gis/ /khams ni gang zhig spel gyur pa / /de dag rkang gnyis gtso bos mkhyen/ /de bas khyod ni do zla med/ /lha'i bu stobs dang ldan gyis gsol pa/ khams gang la ni bsten pabagyis shing / /gang gis mngon par las bgyis dang / /de yi rirnam smin ci —'dra ba/ /de kun spyan dang ldan pas mkhyen/ /lha'i bu stobs yang dag 'phags kyis gsol pa/ khams gang la ni bsten dbagyis shing / /ci 'dra'i rang labazhin gyur pa yi/ /sems can thams cad khyod 7kyis mkhyen/ /phyag gi sor mo lnga dang 'dra/ /lha'i bu stobs 42—252

la spyod pas gsol pa/ khams gang la ni bsten bgyis 1shing / /bshes gnyen ci 'dra rnyed gyur nas/ /'du 'dzi ci 'dra bgyid gyur pa/ /de dag 5)bla na med pas mkhyen/ /lha'i bu stobs kyi byin gyis brlabs pas gsol pa/stobs kyi byin gyis brlabs snamakhyen cing / /'dren pa de ni 0khams dang ni/ /'du 'dzi bshes sgyuganyen tshogs kyi rnams/ /de dag mi mchog khyod kyis mkhyen/ /lha'i bu khams nges pas gsol pa/ khams de dang ni len pa 9dang / /bshes gnyen de dang de la'agrogs pa/ /de la khyod kyi mkhyen pa des/ /de phyir the tshom yong mi mnga'/ /lha'i bu khams la rten ’ pas gsol pa/ sems can gang na gnas gnas pa'i/ /'khor ba de dang khams de dang / /spyod dang skad dang 'gro ba rnams/ /mi mchog khyod kyis rab tu mkhyen/ /lha'i bu khams la mkhas pas gsol pa/ ye shes gang gis khams de ni/ /'dren pas mngon par mkhyen pa yi/ /mkhyen de tshamakhyen pas stong ngo zhes/ /blo mchog mnga' bas yang dag bstan/ /lha'i bu khams nas tshanges par 'byung ngagis gsol pa/ khams gang la ni bsten bgyis tshan/ /'dus byas dag la ji srid gnas/ /de ni khyod kyis ji bzhin mkhyen/ /khyod la do zla ma mchis so/ /lha'i bu khams kyi tsharjes su song bas gsol pa/ khams gang la ni bsten bgyis pas/ /yon tan ji snyed bskyed pa dang / /rnam par smin dang 'bras bu dag /de dag ma lus khyod kyis mkhyen / /lha'i bu khams la yang dag zhugs pas gsol pa/ khams gang la ni bsten bgyid nacing / /'gro ba ci 'dra 'dod bgyid 19pa/ /de yang khyod kyis thogs med mkhyen/ /de phyir khyod ni mkhas pas mchod/ /lha'i bu lam mngon par shes pas gsol pa/ khams gang la ni bsten bgyis pas/ /'gro ba ci 42—253

'dra mchi ba 3yi/ /sems can rnams kyi lam dag kyang / /ye shes mkhas pa khyod kyis mkhyen/ /lha'i bu lam la mi 'jigs rnyipas gsol pa/ sems can log pa nyid nges shing ri/ /mya ngan 'das 'gro skal med pa/ /phung po gsum po de cadag la/ /khyod kyi 5ye shes nges par 'jug /lha'i bu lam gyis nges par byung gis gsol pa/ sems can yang dag nyid nges te/ /ngan 'gror 'gro ba'i skal med pa / /de la 'jig rten sgron ma 7khyod/ /rtogs pa thogs pa med par 'jug /lha'i bu lam la mos pas gsol pa/ ma nges phung por gyur pa la/ /gang zag gang rnams gnas pa rnams/ /de la ngan song ngan 'gro dang / /mya ngan 'das pa'ang khyod kyis bstan/ /lha'i bu stobs kyi na/brdas gsol pa/sangs rgyas brda 9tsam nyid lags te/ /de bzhin stobs dang ye shes dang / /mi 'jigs bzhi yang de bzhin du/ /kun rdzob ces ni thub pas gsungs/ /lha'i bu yang dag pa mthong bas gsol pa/ sangs rgyas sangs rgyas chos rnams medango/ /ye shes gnas pa gzhan yang med/ /don dam nyid du bstan to zhes/ /de bzhin gshegs pa khyod kyis nyamakhyen/ /lha'i bu stobs la gnas kyis gsol pa/sangs rgyas chos la stobs gnas pas/ /des na de la 'jigs med de/ /rgyal ba de bzhin gshegs kyi sras/ /ji ltar 'dod dgur parnam par 'phrul/ /lha'i bu chos la 'jigs med kyis gsol pa/ kun rdzob dang ni don dam dang / /de dag rab tu bstan mchis kyang / /kun rdzob dang ni don dam dang / /brda rmuyang dmigs su ma mchis so/ /lha'i bu ye shes lhur len gyis gsol pa/brjod pa thams cad rnam pa gzhan/ /chos kyi mtshan nyid rnam pa gzhan/ /mtshan nyid ma mchis brjod ma mchis/ /khyod kyis chos kyi mtshan nyid gzigs/ /42—254

lha'i bu lam la brtson pas gsol pa/ nges par gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /gzhan gyi rgyud mchi'i gnas ma mchis/ /log par nges rnams kun tu 'gror/ /drang srong chen po khyod kyis gzigs/ /lha'i bu mos pa'i stobs kyis gsol pa/khams gang la ni bstenam17bgyis te/ /gang rnams ci 'drar mos 'gyur zhing / /'dod chags khams la sdug bsngal 5ba/ /de dag thub chen khyod kyis gzigs/ /lha'i bu mi sdug pa las nges par byung cagis gsol pa/ ma mchis yongs su brtags pas na/ /'dod chags khams ni rab tu byung / /de la mos pa nges 'byung ba/ /de dag khyod kyis ji bzhin zigazigs/ /lha'i bu byams pas nges par byung gis gsol pa/ ma mchis yongs su brtags pas na/ /zhe sdang khams ni rab tu byung / /de la mos pa nges 'byung ba/ /de dag khyod kyis ji bzhin gzigs/ /lha'i bu rkyen 'dis 0nges par byung gis gsol pa/ ma mchis yongs su brtags pas na/ /gti mug khams ni rab tu byung / /de la mos pa nges 'byung ba/ /de dag khyod kyis ji bzhin gzigs/ /lha'i bu gtong bas nges par byung gis gsol pa/ 'tsho med 'jigs pa rnyed pa dag /ser sna mngon par 9'phel 'gyur te/ /de la mos pa nges 'byung ba/ /de dag thub chen khyod kyis gzigs/ /lha'i bu dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis nges par byung gis gsol pa/ sdig pa'i grogs dang 'grogs pas chan/ /'thun pa'i khams ni rab tu 'byung / /de la mos pa 'thob sko'agyur ba/ /de dag 'dren pas rnam par mkhyen/ /lha'i bu lirnam par shes pa 5snying por 'dzin pas gsol pa/'khor ba na ni 'khor rnams kyisal/ /ci 'dra'i khams la bsten 7pa dang / /mos pa de mthar phyin pa dag /khyod kyis ma lus rab tu mkhyen/ /lha'i bu nan 42—255

tan snying por byed pas gsol pa/ 'khor ba na ni 'khor rnams kyis/tsho/ /gang gi rgyus byung rinan tan dang / /mos pa de las gyur pa yang ri/ /smad pa med pa khyod kyis gzigs/ /lha'i bu dbang po la mos pas gsol pa/ sems can gang gis khams rigang la/ /bsten phyin ji ltar 'gyur ba yi/ /rgyu de khyod kyis rab tu mkhyen/ /des na khyod ni dga' bar mdzad/ /lha'i bu dbang po la spyod pas gsol pa/ sbyor ba gang gis skye ba dang / /gang gis rgya chen skye ba dang —/ /dmigs pa dang ni zhing rnams dang / /dbang po khyod kyis rab tu mkhyen / /lha'i bu dbang pos nges par byung gis gsol pa/ 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal gnod gyur dang / / sred pa mngon par na'ajug pa dang / /srid 9pa zhi bar bgyi ba'i dzidon/ /de dag smra ba'i mchog gis mkhyen/ /lha'i bu dbang po'i spyod yul gyis gsol pa/ dbang po nyam chung rnam /nyadag ni/ /gzugs kyi 'dod chags dben par 'tshal/ /srid dpa rnam par gzhig pa yang / /rkang gnyis dam pas bsten 5pa mdzad/ /lha'i bu dbang po rnam par rgyal bas gsol pa/ dbang po rtul po dur khrod bsten / /rang gi 'dod chags zhi bar bgyid//rkang gnyis gtso bo'i zhal mthong nas/ /sred dang bcas pa 7khyod la ltal/ /lha'i bu dbang po rtogs kyis gsol pa/ 'dod chags can dang 'dod chags dang / / zhi dang shes dang mi shes dang / /srid 8pa zhi dang dbang po rnams/ /rnam par gzigs na sngon ma dzodamigs/ /lha'i bu dbang po la gnas pas gsol pa / zhe snang gnyen por gyur pa yi/ /gnod sems med dang dben pa dag /dbang po rtul po stenam pa'i tshe/ /khyod kyis 2 'gro ba'i bsam pa gzigs/ /lha'i bu dbang po la brtson pas gsol pa/ zhe sdang gnyen por byams pa 42wa 256

gsung ri / /sems can shes pa rjes su skye/ /zhe snang khams ni zhi bar bgyid/ /de dag mi mchog khyod kyis mkhyen/ /lha'i bu dbang po tshol bas gsol pa/gnod sems med dang byams pa dang / /zhi ba'i ngo bo nyid ma gzigs/ /dag /dang nyon mongs ma dmigs te/ /des na ca'ajig rten khyad par 'phags/ /lha'i bu dbang po rjes su 'brang gis gsol pa/ log par rnam par rtog pa dang //log par 5nye bar ston pa yang / /nyon mongs dam phyir kun sbyor te / / bzlog pas thar par 'gyur ba gzigs / /lha'i bu ye shes yang dag shar gyis gsol pa/ 'dod chags zhe snang gti mug dang / /dngos la 'dzin pa mun pa 9ste/ /bzlog 7pas snang ba chen por 'gyur/ /de ni grags chen khyod kyis mkhyen/ /lha'i bu ye shes 'dod chags chad pas gsol pa/ 'dod chags zhe snang gti mug dang / /mun pa snang ’ ba dngos po rnams/ /rang bzhin nyid kyis ma mchis te/ /de ni rkang gnyis gtso bos gzigs/ /lha'i bu snang ba 'dzin gyis gsol pa/ sems can gang gi pashes pa gang / /ji tsam yongs su bsgrub tshabagyis dang / /snod du gang rung ji snyed pa/ /de dag mi mchog khyod kyis mkhyen/ /lha'i bu dbang po dang zhe 'gras pas gsol pa/ nyon mongs spang phyir shes gang gis/ /shes pa de la rtog chibagyid pa/ /de yang ston pa khyod kyis mkhyen / /de bas khyod la mngon par dga'/ /lha'i bu dbang po la dga' bas gsol pa/ yul dang dus dang gnas dag dang / /spyod pa rnam par bsgom dpa dang dzha/ /nyon mongs ston mongs tshirnam dag pa/ /thub pa khyod kyis stong par gzigs / /lha'i bu ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis gsol pa/ dbang po rno rtul 'bring dag dang / /gang zag dag gi bsam pa dang / /bcings dang thar dang zad 42—257

dang mishes/ /g.yo ba med par khyod kyis mkhyen/ /lha'i bu dbang po'i 2rgyal mtshan gyis gsol pa/ dbang po rab 'bring rtul bo ridang / /nyon mongs ye shes tshor ba dang / /gdul dang gdul bar bgyid pa dag /khyod kyis mtshanas nyid med par gsungs/ /lha'i bu dbang po rnam par brtags kyis gsol pa/sems can rnams kyi bsam gtan dang / /rnam thar kun nas nyon mongs dang //snyoms 'jug ting 'dzin ldang ba 5dang / /rnam byang thub pa khyod gyis mkhyen/ /lha'i bu stobs kyi gshugs kyis gsol pa/ zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin bsten te de/ /chos kun ngo bo nyid kyis 9ni/ /rang bzhin med par khyod kyis mkhyen/ /des na thams cad mkhyen ces bgyi / /lha'i bu stobs kyi go cas gsol patsha/chos rnams gang dang skarang bzhin gang / /chos gang gis ni brjod bgyis pa/ /yang dag ji bzhin thugs su chud/ /des na dus gsum chags mi mnga'/ /lha'i bu stobs 'dod kyis gsol pa/ log par brtags pas kun nyon mongs/ /rnam pa bzhi ni skye bar 'gyur/ /las las skyes par de dag mkhyen/ /des na khyod la tshado zla med/ /lha'i bu stobs shes kyis gsol pa/ nyon mongs rnams dang las rnams kyi/ /gnyen po rnam par byang ba dadang / /bstan pa'ang khyod kyis rab tu mkhyen/ /des na khyod la do zla med/ /lha'i bu stobs kyi 'od kyis gsol pa/ bsam gtan rnam thar paldang ba dang / /snyoms par 'jug dang ting 'dzin dang / /kun nas nyon mongs rnam byang dag /ming tsam mo zhes khyod kyis bstan/ /lha'i bu stobs las 7byung gis gsol pa/ bsam gtan rnam thar rnam byang dang / /snyoms par 'jug dang ting nge 'dzin/ /bag yod pa las byung ba ste/ /de la khyod kyis ’ ye shes 'jug /lha'i bu stobs rnam par 42—258

spel gyis 33gsol pa/ dpa' bo khyod kyi mkhyen pa ni/ /bsam gtan la sogs 5de dag dang / /ldang dang rnam par byang la 'jug /de ni rlung riltar chags pa med / /lha'i bu sngon gyi mtha' la mkhas pas gsol pa/ bskal pa bye ba grangs med du/ /srid pa 'di na sngon bzhugs tshe/ /srid pa'i skyon dang yong 5ma 'dres / /des na khyod la do zla med/ /lha'i bu sngon gyi mtha' la gnas pas gsol pa/ bskal pa bye ba grangs med du/ /byang chub gzhal yas tshol mdzad cing / /'dren pas yongs su spyad pas na/ /des na khyod ni dpa' bo lags/ /lha'i bu sngon gyi mtha' la rtogs pas phyogasol pa/ sngon mthar 8sbyin pa sna tshogs dag /blo mchog gsungs 9tshe gsol pas na/ /spobs pa sna tshogs rab mnga' bar/ /rnam par 'dren pa des 7nges byung / /lha'i bu sngon gyi mtha' la byang bas gsol pa/ sngon chad 'khor bar spyod pa'i tshe/ /tshul rnams la ni tshul mkhas pa/ /'jig rten sgron rnams khyod kyis gzigs/ /des na khyod ni tshul la mkhas/ /lha'i bu sngon gyi mtha' tshar phyin pas gsol pa/ma sngon mthar chos rgyal mang po la/ /dpa' pos sngan ’ chad spyod mdzad pas/ /thams cad mkhyen du nges par yang mu/ /sems can mkhas skal phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu sngon gyi tshul phun sum tshogs pas gsol pa/ byang chub mchog ni btsal ba'i phyir / /bskal pa bye ba grangs med du/ /sangs rgyas bye ba mtha' yas pa /de la khyod kyi pas bon btab/ /lha'i bu sngon gyi tshul la stonges pas gsol pa/bskal pa bye bar brtag mdzad pas / /chos kun sems can med pa zhes/ /chos rnams thams cad nges par mkhyen/ /'du 'phrod tsam du rgyal bas gsung 19/ /lha'i bu sngon gyi mtha' la sems pas gsol pa/ bskal pa bye ba 42—259

grangs med du/ /gnas dang gnas min rab mkhyen par/ /rnam par 'dren pa spyod mdzad pas/ /des na 'jig rten rmongs mi mnga'/ /lha'i bu sngon gyi mtha' la dpyod 1pas gsol pa/ gnas dang gnas min brtenam bgyis nas/ /las dang rgyu rnams dpyad pas na/ /khams dang dbang po mos pa dang / /bsam gtan sngon gyi mtha' yang mkhyen/ /lha'i bu sngon gyi mtha' la yongs su rtog pas gsol pa/ khyod kyi sngon mtha' yongs brtags pas/ /5stobs kyi ye shes rnam phyobacu po/ /dpa' bo chen pos rnam par spel/ /des ni 'jig rten 'di la gzigs/ /lha'i bu sngon gyi mtha'i spyod yul gyis gsol pa/dpa' bo /sems can thams cad kyi/ /sngon gyi mtha' yi spyod pa dang / /dge dang mi dge'i rgyu ba rnams/ /mkhyen pas 'jig rten gso ba mdzad/ /lha'i bu sngon gyi mtha'i spyod pa la so sor rtog 7pas gsol pa/ thub pas ’ sngon gyi sems can gyi/ /sngon mtha'i spyod pa rab mkhyen cing / /khams dang mos pa mkhyen pas na/ /de phyir sems can gso ba mdzad/ /lha'i bu mos pa'i stobs can gyis gsol pa/ bskal pa bye ba mtha' tshalas su/ /sngon gyi mtha' la brtag tshabagyis kyang / /khyod kyi dgongs pa chags mi mnga'/ /des na mgon mul bdag mos lags/ /lha'i bu ye shes la mos pas gsol pa/ bskal pa bye ba grangs med du/ /sngon mtha'i srid pa bsam bgyis pakyang / /rkang gnyis gtso bo'i skayon tan gyi/ /pha rol phyin nus 'ga' ma mchis/ /lha'i bu phyi ma'i mtha' la mkhas pas gsol pa/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten 'di dag gi/ /skye dgu 7sna tshogs las ldan pa/ /shi 'pho skye bar 'gyur ba dag /khyod kyis rtanasangs rgyas spyan gyis gzigs/ /lha'i bu phyi ma'i mtha' las nges par byung gis gsol pa/42—260

rgyu gang gis ni las gang zhig /bgyis shing rgyud drug mchir mi'agyur ba/ /de dag thams cad rgyal bas mkhyen/ /des na thams cad mkhyen ces bgyi/ /lha'i bu shi 'pho dang skye ba mngon par shes pas gsol pa/ khams gang gis 5ni sems can gang / /bsgos par gyur cing las bgyid pa'i/ /bag chags las dang sems can dag /khyod kyis g.yo ba med par mkhyen/ /lha'i bu 'chi 'pho dang skye ba rig pas gsol pa/ bshes gnyen ci 5'dra bsten bgyi 5shing / /las gang mngon par 'dus bgyis pas / /'gro ba gang du mchi na'agyur ba/ /thub pa 9khyod kyis de yang lamakhyen/ /lha'i bu dgos pa la mkhas pas gsol pa/las de yi ni bgyi ba pagang / /dgos pa khyod kyis rab tu mkhyen/ /gang gi slad du las bgyis pas/ /de yang ma lus rab tu mkhyen/ /lha'i bu dngos 5po la mkhas pas gsol pa/ dngos po gang 5dag dmigs pa dang / /las gang mngon par 'dus labagyis pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pas de mkhyen te/ /de ni sangs rgyas spyod yul lags/ /lha'i bu dngos po rig pas gsol pa/ sems can rnams kyis lha bsam mkhas pa 9/ /dngos de ji ltar gnas pa dang / /de ni ji ltar grub pa yi/ /las de khyod kyis mngon par mkhyen/ /lha'i bu shes pa la mkhas pas gsol pa/ shes pa gang gis dngos po de/ /brtags par gyur pa rab tu mkhyen/ /de la ji ltar chags gyur pa'ang / /thub pa khyod 2kyis shin tu mkhyen/ /lha'i bu mngon par 'du byed pa la mkhas kyis gsol pa/chags pa gang gis las de rnams/ /nyon mongs gang gis 'du bgyis pa'i/ /nyon mongs de dag yang dag mkhyen/ /de bas khyod ni bdag gi mgon/ /lha'i bu 'gro ba la mkhas pas gsol pa/ 'gro ba gang du las gang gis/ / mchis 42wa 261

shing 1sgrib pa gang rnyed nas / /'bras bu thob par mi 'gyur ba/ /de kun spyanapha ldan khyod kyis mkhyen/ /lha'i bu dmigs pa la mkhas pas gsol pa/ 'gro ba dag tu skyes rnams kyi/ /gang gis 4las rnams smin 'gyur ba'i / /dmigs pa khyod kyis rab mkhyen te/ /de la khyod kyi 7blo gros 'jug /lha'i bu bag chags la mkhas kyis gegasol pa/ 'gro dang 'gro bar mi rnams kyis/ /sngan na chad bgyis pa'i sdig las dang / /de bzhin dge ba'i las rnams kyi/ /bag chags khyod kyis rtorab tu mkhyen/ /lha'i bu las la mkhas kyis gsol pa/ 'gro bar 'byung po thams cad kyi/ /rnying dang gsar tshadang slad ma dang / /las rnams gsum po khyod kyis mkhyen/ /de la so so'i skye bo 'khrul/ /lha'i bu rnam par smin pa la mkhas kyis gsol pa/ chung zhing rnam smin che ba dang / /che zhing rnam smin chung ba dang / /chung ngam che 'am mnyam pa 'ang rung / /de la mu stegs can rnams rmongs/ /lha'i bu las la mkhas kyis gsol pa/ tshe 'di'i palas rnams gang lags dang / / skye ba'i las rnams gang lags dang / / lan grangs gzhan gyi cigang lags pa/ /de dag spyan ldan khyod kyis mkhyen/ /lha'i bu tshe 'di la myong bar 'gyur ba la mkhas kyis gsol pa/ tshe 'di la ni dbagyis pa yi / /las kyi rnam smin mi gang dag /myong bar 'gyur ba gang dag la/ /so so'i skye bo mongs pa mkhyen/ /lha'i bu skyes nas myong bar 'gyur ba la mkhas kyis gsol pa/ gang gis las gang bsags lagyur te/ /skyes nas rnam par smin gyur pa/ /gang la 'jig rten gting mi rnyed/ /shes rab chen pos de nyidamo mkhyen / /lha'i bu lan grangs gzhan na myong bar 'gyur ba la mkhas kyis gsol pa / las gang bskal pa bye ba yi/ /phyi dus rnam par smin 'gyur zhing / /dus 42—262

gzhan dag na yang 'byung ba/ /de dag yang dag nyid du mkhyen/ /lha'i bu yongs su mtsha smin pa myong bar 'gyur ba la mkhas kyis gsol pa/ las rnams gang zhig bgyis gyur pa/ /yongs su smin par ma gyur na/ /de srid 'bras bu mi 'byin pa/ /rkang gnyis mchog gis de yang mkhyen/ /lha'i bu yongs su ma smin pa myong bar 'gyur ba la rtog ripas gsol pa/ las gang dang ni ldan pas can/ /sems can 'di ni skyer 'gyur ba/ /pham pa med pas de mkhyen te/ /yongs su brtags nas rab tu mkhyen/ /lha'i bu yongs su smin pa myong bar 'gyur ba la mkhas pas gsol pa/ las ni ji ltar yongs smin na/ /'bras bu dkar bar 'gyur ba mkhyen/ /de la khyod kyi ye shes 'jug /de dag stong par rnam par mkhyen ske/ /lha'i bu yongs su smin pa myong bar 'gyur ba la nges pas gsol pa/thams cad mkhyen pas las kyi rnams/ /lci dang yang ba rab tu mkhyen/ /sems can bsam pa thugs su chud/ /de slad bcom ldan bdag gi bla/ /lha'i bu lci yang la mkhas kyis gsol pa/ las gang gis ni sems can rnams/ /ngan song mchi bar 'gyur ba dang / /lci ba dang ni yang ba gzigs/ /de shes mkhyen pas rab tu mkhyen/ /lha'i bu sems can gyi spyod pa la mkhas kyis gsol pa / sems can spyod pa nyer bzung zhing / /las kyi lci dang yang ba dag /dpa' bo khyod kyis rab tu mkhyen/ /mu stegs can rnams de la rmongs/ /lha'i bu sems can gyi spyod pa la dpyod pas gsol pa/ sems can spyod pa dpyad mdzad cing / /las kyi rnam par smin pa bstan/ /phor bu'i chu dang gang gā'i chu / /lan tshwas rnam par bstan pa bzhin/ /lha'i bu las la mkhas kyis gsol pa / slob dang mi slob rnam par smin/ /rkang gnyis dam pa ston mdzad cing / /42—263

kun nas nyon mongs las myong nas/ /las ni zad par 'gyur ba bstan/ /lha'i bu sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la reg par byed pas gsol pa/ sangs rgyas spyan gyis khams gsum na/ /las kyi 1'bras bu rten pa yi / /byis pa dag dang mkhas pa gzigs/ /phra gzigs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha'i bu las zad par byed pas gsol pa/ 'jig rten dag na rnam 'dren khyod/ /sems can rnams kyi shi 'pho dang / /skye ba kun la ye shes 'jug /mkhyen pas 'jigs med phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu dmigs pa med pa la spyod pas cigasol pa/'chi 'pho ba dang skye dang las/ /'gro dang de bzhin sems can dang / /rnam smin rmi lam 'drar bstan pa/ /'dren pa rkang gnyis mchog gis mkhyen/ /lha'i bu nyon mongs pa la rtog pas gsol pa/ ji ltar rmi lam skom pa zhig /shin tu bsil ba'i chu 'thungs bzhin/ /rkang gnyis mchog khyod 'dod chags dang / /zhe sdang gti mug rnams kyang zad/ /lha'i bu yongs su rtog pa dang bral phyobs gsol pa/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams/ /yongs su rtog las skyes pa ste/ /rmi lam dga' bar rtse ba bzhin/ /smra mchog khyod la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu yongs su rtog pa zhi bar byed pas gsol pa/ yongs su rtog pa rab zhi bas / /nyon mongs zad par rab bstan te/ /rmi lam na ni sprin med ltar/ /mi mchog khyod kyis rab tu mkhyen / /lha'i bu zag pa la rtog pas gsol pa/rmi lam char chen 'bab pa ltar/ /de bzhin zag pa rnams 'byung bar/ /zag pa 'byung la 9mkhas pa po/ /dpa' bo chen po khyod kyis bstan/ /lha'i bu rmi lam rtog gis gsol pa/ rmi lam char chen 'bab pa ltar/ /de bzhin zag pa rnams 'byung ste/ /nor ba rnams la zag 'byung bar/ /dpa' bo chen po khyod 42—264

kyis bstan/ /lha'i bu ji lta brdzo〉bzhin du rtog 5pas gsol pa/ ji ltar bu mo'i mi lam na/ /bu zhig byung la shi 'phos na/ /dga' dang sdug bsngal tshor 'gyur ba4)/ /de bzhin 'gro ba khyod kyis gzigs/ /lha'i bu mi lam rtogs 5pas gsol pa/ rmi lam dag na mgo bcad bzhin/ /khyod kyis zag pa zad pa gzigs / /de ni mkhas pa rnams la bstan/ /thams cad gzigs la phyag kyang 'tshal / /lha'i bu blo gros nges par brtags phyokyis gsol pa/ chos kun mkhyen pa khyod kyis ni/ /ji ltar rmi lam mdza' phrad dang / /bral ba yang dag ma mchis gzigs/ /'gro ba ji bzhin tshim par mdzad/ /lha'i bu ye shes yid kyis zegasol pa/ khyod kyi dam pa'i chos ston 9pa/ /thos na —yid ni dgar 'gyur te/ /rmi lam dag na 7mi bstan bzhin/ /de ltar rgyal bas bstan pa snyemadzad/ /lha'i bu yongs su lidaga' ba'i yid kyis gsol pa/ me long gzugs brnyan snang ba bzhin/ /'gro ba mtha' dag gzigs pas na/ /bsam gtan mnga'atsha8ba khyod la ni/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten yid kyang dga'/ /lha'i bu blo gros nges pas gsol pa/ thub pa pi bang sasgra sko'adra ba'i/ /khyod kyi dam chos thos gyur na/ /lha /8bu rnams kyang the tshom bor/ /rgyal ba mchog la phyag kyang 'tshal / /lha'i bu sgyu mas tshim gyis gsol pa/ sgyu ma'i mkhan pos sgyu ma dag /gyis pa rmongs byed yongs bstan rten/ /mi mkhas de la rmongs par 'gyur/ /sgyu ma bzhin du khyod kyis bstan/ /lha'i bu sprul pa la sems pas gsol pa/ ji ltar rmi lam sgyu mthong ba/ /de ltar khyod kyis 'gro ba gzigs/ /mgon po'i bstan pa de thos na / /bdag cag the tshom ma mchis so/ /lha'i bu sgyu ma las nges par byung gis gsol pa/ sgyu ma'i mkhan pos sgyu sprul kyang / /sgyu ma lags 42—265

par 'tshal bas na/ /de la /rmongs par 'gyur ma mchis/ /de bzhin khyod kyis 'gro ba gzigs/ /lha'i bu rtogs pa'i rjes su rtog pas rigasol pa/ ji ltar brtson pas mi lam na/ /sangs rgyas sku gzugs 4brtags pa bzhin/ /de ltar rtog pas 'jig rten bskyed/ /rnam par 'dren pa khyod kyis gzigs/ /lha'i bu kun tu rtog pa 'joms kyis migasol pa/ kun rtog 'dod chags rgyu lagasa'i te//'dod chags dngos pos bskyed ma lags/ /rtog pa ngan las 'dod chags byung ske/ /de ni rnam 'dren khyod kyis gzigs/ /lha'i bu yongs su shes pa dang ldan pas nagasol pa/ ri sul dag na /sgra byung ba/ /brag ca khosems can sgra ma lags/ /de bzhin 'jig rten khyod kyis gzigs/ /de slad 'jig rten chags mi mnga'/ /lha'i bu ston pa la mkhas pas gsol pa/ sgra ni gang yang ma mchis te / /sgra ni brag ca 1'dra ba lags/ /'on kyang mi dbang khyod kyis bstan/ /byis pa mang po rab tu btsud/ /lha'i bu nan tan la mkhas pas gsol pa/ chos rnams don ni gzhan lags kyang / /gyis pa rnams kyis gzhan dumatshabartags/ /nan tan chos las shes par bgyi / /de la bdag ni the tshom chad/ /lha'i bu don gyi rjes su 'brang bas gsol pa/ chos don yang dag gang lags pa/ /de ni sus kyang ma rtogs shing d+ku/ /sus kyang ma bstan 'tshal ma gyur/ /de skad thub pa'i mchog gis gsungs/ /lha'i bu chos kyi brda rtogs tshapas gsol pa/zag dang dri ma nyon mongs dang / /bag chags dang ni rtog tshodang rtog /kun nas nyon mongs rnam dag pa/ /thub pa brda yi tshig kyang lags/ /lha'i bu kun tu rtog pa la mkhas pas gsol pa/ kun nas nyon mongs rnam dag dang / /zag pa dag dang nyon mongs dang / /dag dang bshad dang nye du dang / /ston 42—266

pa 'di kun ming tsam lags/ /lha'i bu mi gnas pa'i blo gros kyis gsol pa/khams gsum rnams la ma chags te/ /nam mkha' 'dra ba'i thugs mnga' ba/ /bral bar gyur cing sbyin pa'i gnas/ /zhi ba'i sems la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu ma gos pas gsol pa/ thub pa khyod kyi 〉thugs yid ni/ /gzugs dang gzugs med mi gnas shing / /'dod dang mya ngan 'das pa la/ /gnas pa ma mchis bar snang 'dra/ /lha'i bu re ba med pas gsol pa/ 'dod pa'i khams la re ba spangs/ /gzugs dang gzugs med gnyi rigar min/ /'du 'dzi dag dang bral gyur pa/ /sred zad khyod la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu sred pa phyung bas gsol pa/ 'byung ba dag dang 'jig pa la/ /khyod kyi sred pa yang dag chad/ /khams gsum kun la chags mi mnga'/ /rnam par 'dren la phyag kyang 'tshal / /lha'i bu sred pas zil gyis gnon gigyis gsol pa/ 'jig rten 'di dag zil mnan nas/ /khyu mchog dam pa spyod mdzad cing / /sems can 'jig rten sgrol mdzad pa/ /thugs brtse khyod la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu sred pa dang bral bas pa gsol pa/ kun tu sbyor dang bral ba ste/ /yang srid bas pas zhi po gyur pa/ /dag pa'i bdag nyid dag pa'i sems/ /dus dang bral la phyag kyang 'tshal / /lha'i bu ji lta ba bzhin du rig pas gsol pa/ chos rnams thams cad dngos med pa/ /ji bzhin dpa' bo khyod kyis mkhyen/ /bcings pa ma mchis grol ma mchis/ /yang dag gzigs la phyag kyang 'tshalan /lha'i bu 'dam las rgal 9bas gsol pa/ 'dod pa'i 'dam las rgal tshab ste/ /srid pa'i 'dam las de bzhin rgal / /gzigs pa mi mnga' len mi mnga'/ /yang srid zad tshal phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu zang zing spangs kyis gsol pa/42—267

zang zing spangs shing dri ma spangs/ /re ba spangs shing sdig pa'ang ②spangs/ /sangs rgyas sgrib pa rnam 5spangs pa/ /don rtogs khyod la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu re ba spangs pas rigasol pa/ don dang don ma lags pa spangs/ /chags pa mi mnga' nges rtogs pa/ /bdud kyi zhags palas rnam 'das pa/ /len med khyod la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu phan par 'dod pas gsol pa/bdag nyid dang ni gzhan rnams kyi/ /lam gang nyon mongs rims 5med pa/ /sgrib pa med par gzigs pa 5po/ /dpa' chen khyod kyis de yang gzigs/ /lha'i bu grags pa thob pas 7gsol pa/ 'dren pa 'jig rten rnam grags pa/ /khyod kyi namakhyen la brtson pa rnams/ /ji skad bstan bzhin rab rtog na/ /nyon mongs rnams ni nub par 'gyur/ /lha'i bu 9'jigs pa med pas gsol pa/chos rnams kun la nges pas na/ /sngo lab gang yang yong ma gzigs/ /ye shes rgya mtsho mi bstengs par 1/ /seng ge'i sgra ni sgrog pa tshamadzad/ /lha'i bu gang nas kyang 'jigs pa med pas gsol pa/ 'jigs pa kun las payang dag rgalar+sha//zug rngu thams cad kun tu btonas/ /bsnyengs pa mi mnga' zhum mi mnga'/ /thams cad zil gnon phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu gnas med kyis gsol pa/lha rnams dang ni dri za dang / /bdud dang tshangs par bcas pa yis/ /khyod kyi chos la rgal lami nus/ /de bas khyod la bsnyengs mi mnga'/ /lha'i bu seng ge'i 7rtsal gyis gsol pa/ chos rnams thams cad yongs mkhyen pas/ /sangs rgyas gyur la 'jigs mi mnga'/ /bdag la chos kyis su ’ rgol zhes/ /bde gshegs khyod la dogs rtemi mnga'/ /lha'i bu skrag med kyis gsol pa/ seng ge ri sul gnas pa ni / /'jigs pa ma mchis skrag ma mchis/ /ri dgasam phra mo yongs 42wa 268

btul te/ / spa bkong nags smon nga ro sgrog /de bzhin thams cad mkhyen pa yang ske/ /mu stegs can rnams yongs skrag riste/ /lha klu dri za'i 'jig rten na/ /mtshungs med gzigs nas gsung yang sgrog /lha'i bu thams cad zil 5gnon gyis gsol pa/ 'jig rten rnam 'dren 'jig rten na/ /sangs rgyas nyid la sngo phyobagyid pa/ /'jig rten gsum na ma mchis te/ /des na rgyal ba bdag gi skyabs / /lha'i bu seng ge blo gros kyis gsol pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa thams cad gzigs/ /chos rnams kun la 'jigs mi mnga'/ /khyod 'dra 'jig rten ma mchis te/ /cis mi bsnyengs la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu rjes su 'thun par skyes kyis gsol pa/ sangs rgyas nyid du dam bcas na/ /'di 9na khyod la rgol khom mchis/ /'jig rten 'dren pa chos kyis ni/ /khyod la gang rgol de ma mchis/ /lha'i bu mdzod 'dzin gyis gsol pa/ seng ge'i nga ro gsung bsgrags te/ /khyod kyi 1 chos kyi mdzod bzung bas/ /srog chags bye ba stong dag gis/ /byang chub mchog tu sems kyang bskyedam/ /lha'i bu brtul zhugs rjes su 'thun gyis gsol pa/ sangs rgyas rjes 'thun brtul zhugs : can / /dpa' 5chen de dag thob chen thob/ /byang chub mchog tu sems btud cing / /gang zag mchog tu de dag 'gyur/ /lha'i bu rjes su 'thun pa'i chos la dga' bas gsol pa/ khyod kyi bstan pa sus thos te/ /byang chub mchog tu sems btud 5pa/ /de dag 'jig rten sems can che/ /gang zag mchog tu de dag 'gyur/ /lha'i bu sems dag pas gsol pa/ 'jig rten dag na rgol med pa'i / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gsung lathos nas/ /srog chags bye ba stong dag gis / /byang chub mchog tu sems kyang bskyed/ /lha'i bu sems rgyud yongs su 42—269

dag pas gsol pa/ yun ring dus nas 1mi dbang gis/ /sangs rgyas bslabartso la legs bslabs cigs/ /de slad khyod ni thugs rgyud dag /mtshan rab sum cu gnyis dang ldan/ /lha'i bu zag pa med pa'i yid kyis gsol pa/ zag pa zad pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /seng ge'i cing ro bsgrags zimadzad de/ /dam bcas pa nel mngon bzhugs 7na/ /rgol ba 'di ni kyiyong ma mchis/ /lha'i bu de kho na'i 9rjes su song bas gsol pa/ khyod kyi tshagasung la smra 'gyur ba'i/ /lha dang lha bu mi dag ni/ /'jig rten gsum na ma mchis te/ /des na thub pa stobs dang ldan/ /lha'i bu zag pa zad pa la mkhas pas gsol pa/ dge sbyong dam pa'i zag pa ni/ /ma lus yongs su bas pa ste / /'di na khyod la rgol ma mchis/ /des na sangs rgyas bdag gi pha/ /lha'i bu rtag tu brtson pas bogasol pa/ khyod la nyon mongs lus so zhes/ /mi dbang khyod la gang rgol ba/ /rnam pa kun tu mi dmigs te/ /des na sangs rgyas bsnyengs mi mnga'/ /lha'i bu sems zhi bas gsol pa/ 'dod chags zhe sdang zhi ba stesku/ /gti mug bag chags bcas pa zhicho/ /nyes spyod las kyang zhi bas na/ /sems zhi khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha'i bu rnal 'byor spyod pas gsol pa/ rnal 'byor gang gis nyon mongs gang / /bas par 'gyur bar blta ba'i tshe/ /de la khyod kyi lamakhyen kun 'jug /des na khyod la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu rnal 'byor la mkhas pas gsol pa/ 'dren pa —gang la bslabs pa yi 8/ /rnal 'byor tshogs ni mtha' yas te/ /thams cad mkhyen pa de slad du/ /nyon mongs thams cad ma lus pas 9 / /lha'i bu rnal 'byor blo gros kyis gsol pa/ 'jig rten sgron ma khyod kyi blo / /rnal 'byor las ni nyams ma mchis/ /des na khyod kyis nyon mongs kun/ /42—270

bag chags bcas par yongs su bsal / /lha'i bu zhi ba rig pas gsol pa/nyon mongs thams cad zhi 5gyur nas / /bag chags ma lus yongs su bsal / /bsnyengs pa mi mnga' rgyal sras dang / /cis kyang mi bsnyengs spyod pa mdzad/ /lha'i bu zad pa la rtoga'i pas gsol pa/ thub pa thams cad mkhyen pa khyod/ /nyon mongs bag chags bcas par bas/ /'jig rten sgron ma khyod la ni/ /mtshungs pa gang yang mi dmigs so/ /lha'i bu bag la nyal phyung negis gsol pa/khyod kyis bag chags ma lus bsal / /khyod la skyon dri yong nam mchis de slad sangs rgyas thams cad mkhyen/ /lha rnams kun gyi thub pa'i thub/ /lha'i bu mtha' na tshoganas pas gsol pa/ zag pa rnams ni spangs pas na/ /skye ba'ang skye ba :lham lags te/ /thub pa 2khyod skye me tha ma pa/ /des na mgon po bsnyengs mi mnga'/ /lha'i bu tshad srung chogis gsol pa/ dpa' bo khyod kyis sa bon spangs/ /sdug bsngal myu gu tshig par gyurapa/ /mya ngan 'khri 4shing rnam par bskams / /gdung ba med la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu shing btags bton gyis gsol pa/ thub pa thams cad mkhyen pa khyod/ /ma rig shing btags 18rnams kyang bsal rte/ /sangs rgyas spyod pa rnam par sbyangs/ /de bas ston pa bsnyengs mi mnga'/ /lha'i bu srid pa'i pha rol tu song bas gsol pa/ srid pa'i mtsho las yang dag rgal / /rnam par 'dren pa bya ba byas/ /khyod kyis snang ba yang dag phyung / /'jigasang med khyod ni don kyang grub/ /lha'i bu mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gro bas gsol pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa zhir gyur pa/ /nyon mongs thams cad rab tu bshig /bag chags rdul tsam yong mi mnga'/ /mgon po khyod la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis gsol pa/42—271

khyod kyis chos kyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng rmo/ /nga rgyal rgyal mtshan rab tu bsnyal / /chos kyi lam srang mtha' yas pa/ /dpa' bo chen po khyod kyis bstan/ /lha'i bu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis gsol pa/ sangs rgyas chos kyi 'byung gnas so/ /thub pa chos rnams kun mkhyen pa/ /sems can kun gyi dge bshes gnyen/ /ye shes mtsho la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu chos kyi gos can gyis gsol pa/ khyod kyi sras po 'jigs med pa / /seng ge'i nga ro rnam sgrog kyang / /rgyal sras de dag chog med cing / /sangs rgyas chos kyi don gyis skom / /lha'i bu chos don du gnyer bas gsol pa/ sangs rgyas chos rnams don gnyer bar/ /khyod kyi ga sras rnams sems bskyed cing / /khyod kyi 9mi 'jigs thos gyur nas/ /mkhas pa de dag byang chub tshol/ /lha'i bu chos kyis skom gyis gsol pa/ khyod kyis tshami 'jigs thos 'gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams btsal ba'i tsophyir/ /srog chags bye ba skom gyur te/ /brtson 'grus brtan pa rab tu rtsomatsha// //bam po bcu gcig pa/ lha'i bu chos kyis la'aphags kyis gsol pa/ sangs rgyas chos kyis mngon 'phags shing / /'jigs pa med par 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /gsung pa'i mchog gyur khyod mthong nas/ /brtul 7zhugs mchog can byang chub tshol / /lha'i bu chos 'dzin gyis gsol pa/ thub pa zab cing blta snyedaka' ba'i / /chos ni khyod kyis rab bstan pa/ /khyod kyi 9sras kyis thos gyur nas/ /de dag bla med byang chub tshol/ /lha'i bu lta ba med pas gsol pa/ khyod kyi seng ge'i gsung thos nas/ /khyod kyi sras po dpa' des pa/ /lus dang srog la mi lta bar/ /byang chub don du gnyer ba bgyid / /lha'i bu gzhan du mi sems pa'i blo gros kyis gsol pa/ thub pa bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba/ /khyod kyi 2242—272

dam chos 'di 1thos nas/ /gzhan du sems pa ma mchis par/ /brtul zhugs mchog can byang chub tshol/ /lha'i bu gzhan du mi 'gro bas gsol pa/ mi dbang khyod kyi gsung thos nas/ /theg pa gnyis po spang dbagyis shing / /lam gzhan du ni mi mchi ribar/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub tshol/ /lha'i bu nye bar gnas kyis gsol pa/ seng ge'i nga ro 'di bsgrags pa/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyis thos gyur na / /byang chub mchog la nyer gyur cing / /de dag rkang gnyis dam par 'gyur/ /lha'i bu spobs pa nye bar gyur pas gsol pa/ grags chen khyod kyis gsung brjod pa'i/ /spobs pa de ni thos gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas chos la khyod kyi pasras/ /kun kyang dga' ba phyirab tu bskyed / /lha'i bu spobs pa thob pas gsol pa/ 'jigs med khyod kyis gsung bsgrags pa/ /ma smad sras kyis thos gyur na/ /de dag spobs pa nam nadu yang / /sangs rgyas nyid las phyir mi ldog /lha'i bu rtag tu rab dgas gsol pa/ 'jigs med khyod kyis gsung bsgrags pas/ /stobs chen khyod kyi sras kyi rnams/ /rtag tu rab tu dga' 'gyur 9cing / /ma smad de dag byang chub tshol/ /lha'i bu yid zhum pa med pas gsol pa/ khyod kyis lagasung bsgrags thos gyur nas/ /rkang gnyis dam pa khyod kyi sras/ /dga' zhing zhum pa ma mchis par/ /byang chub mchog ni tshol bar bgyid/ /lha'i bu thogs med yid kyis gsol pa/ khyod kyis gsung bsgrags thos pas na/ /sems rangs ’ gyur cing yid dga' ste/ /de dag yid ni nam du yang / /byang chub nyid du thogs ma mchis/ /lha'i bu chos la bar chad med la mkhas pas gsol pa/ chos rnams gang la bsten dbagyis kyang / /dkar po'i phyogs dag mi 'grib cing / /de yi bar chad mi 'gyur ba'i/ /42—273

gnas ni thub pa khyod kyis nyamakhyen/ /lha'i bu chos nges par bstan pa la mkhas pas gsol pa/ dkar po'i phyogs la spyod pa la/ /bar chad 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing / /gnas kyang med par thub pas mkhyen/ /des na ston pa bsnyengs mi mnga'/ /lha'i bu chos kyi ngo bo nyid la mkhas pas gsol pa/ dge ba kun nas nyon mongs pa/ /nag po'i phyogs kyi rang bzhin te/ /khyod kyi thugs ni des mi gos/ /gnas kyang med par thub pas mkhyen/ /lha'i bu rigasapa la mkhas pas gsol pa/ nag po'i chos ni nam du yang / /dkar po'i chos dang mi 'grogs par/ /rigs par bcom ldan khyod kyis gsungs/ /des na bcom ldan bdag gi bla/ /lha'i bu dge ba dang mi dge ba rig pas gsol pa/chos rnams thams cad ma 'dres par / /dpa' bo chen po khyod kyis mkhyen/ /kun nas nyon mongs brtags pas na/ / dkar po'i 5phyogs las 'grib par 'gyur / /lha'i bu lam la mkhas pas gsol pa/ kun nas nyon mongs spyod pa la/ /dkar po'i phyogs ni mi 'byung ste/ /de ltar 'tshal bar ma gyur la/ /bar chad du ni 'gyur bar gsungs/ /lha'i bu thar pa 'dod kyis gsol pa/nag po'i phyogs la sten 7bgyid na/ /thar par 'dod pa mang po yi/ /bar du gcod par 'gyur zhes gsungs/ /des na rgyal khyod thams cad mkhyen/ /lha'i bu dag pa'i sems kyis gsol pa/ sems grol bgyi bar gang 'tshal bas/ /kun nas nyon mongs shes bya zhes/ /dpa' bo chen po khyod kyis gsungs/ /de rtekhyod 'jig rten mchod rten lags/ /lha'i bu nyon mongs mthong gis gsol pa/ kun nas nyon mongs spyod bgyid cing / /7kun nas nyon mongs ma 'tshal na/ /dam pa'i chos ni shes mi nus/ /de skad bde bar gshegs pas gsungs/ /42—274

lha'i bu sdig mthong gis gsol pa/ sdig pa rnams la bsten 1byas kyang / /dge ba mi 'grib gegang smra ba/ /de ni thar chos skal med ces/ /rkang gnyis dam pa khyod kyis gsungs / /lha'i bu gdul bar bya bas gsol pa/ chags pa gdul bar gang 'dod dang / /zhe sdang gti mug 'dul 'dod pas/ /thub pa'i spobs pa ci 'dra ba/ /de lta bur 5ni nan tan bgyi/ /lha'i bu kun nas nyon mongs pa dag 0pas gsol pa/ dag dang kun nas nyon mongs pa/ /mi mkhas gang rnams mi shes pa/ /de dag ston pa sangs rgyas min / /de skad drang srong mchog gis gsungs / /lha'i bu thar pa la brtson gyis 9gsol pa/ nyon mongs 'grib par 'gyur ba'i chos/ /rgyal ba yis ni gang bstan pa/ /de bsten 11nyon mongs mi zad ces/ /khyod la rgol ba yong ma mchis/ /lha'i bu thar pa la mngon par phyogs pas gsol pa/ chos gang nyon mongs gang gi 12rnams/ /zad 'gyur thub papas bstan pa la/ /yang dag brtson byas mi zad ces/ /rgol ba 'di ni meyong mi dmigs/ /lha'i bu rnal 'byor la mngon par skabartson pas gsol pa/ rgyal ba khyod kyis nyan thos la/ /gang gi don du chos bstan pa/ /de brtson bgyis pas mi 'thob laces/ /'di na khyod la rgol ma mchis/ /lha'i bu mi 'jigs dpal gyis gsol pa/ 'dod chags spang phyir mi sdug pa/ /bstan la yang dag brtson bgyis na/ /'dod chags zad par mi 'gyur zhes/ /khyod la rgol ba yong ma mchis/ /lha'i bu 'gro ba med pa rab tu shes kyis gsol pa/ shin tu bsnyengs pa mi mnga' bas / /zhe sdang spang phyir byams gsungs pa//de bsgrubs sel bar mi 'gyur zhes/ /dgra 'joms khyod la rgol ma mchis/ /lha'i bu mig rnam par dag gis gsol pa/ shes rab gti mug spang ba'i phyir/ /42—275

gsungs pa de la bston 1bgyis kyang / /gti mug sel bar mi 'gyur zhes/ /'di na khyod la rgol ma mchis/ /lha'i bu rnam par rtog pa 'joms kyis rigasol pa / rnam par rtog pa'i gnyen dpor ni/ /dbugs dbyung cikhub pa dran gsungs pa/ /de la brtson bgyis ma 5zhi zhes/ /'di na khyod la rgol ma mchis/ /lha'i bu mtshan ma med pa lhur len pas phyogasol pa/ nga'o snyam pa spang slad du/ /stong nyid khyod kyis bka' stsal te/ /des ni de 7zhi mi 'gyur zhes/ /'di na khyod la rgol ma mchis/ /lha'i bu nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal spangs kyis gsol pa/nga snyam nga rgyal spang slad du/ /mtshan ma med pa khyod kyis gsungs/ /bsten kyang zhi bar mi 'gyur zhes/ /'di na khyod la rgol ma mchis/ /lha'i bu sems rgyun 9rnam par dag pas gsol pa/ lhag pa'i bsam pa dge ba yisal/ /nyon mongs thams cad 'jig par 'gyur/ / des ni ’ nyon mongs mi zad ces/ /'di na khyod la rgol ma mchis/ /lha'i bu 'du shes rnam par bshig gis gsol pa/phyogs gang mganyen po'i rnam pa dang / /nyon mongs lam dang lam 'jug la snye/ /'jigs pa med par rgol ba ni / /thub pa chen po ma mthong ngo / /lha'i bu tha snyad shin tu shes pas gsol pa/ bcom ldan phyogs dang phyogs min dang / /zad dang ma gzad tha snyad tsam/ /'jigs pa ma mchis rgol labagyid pa/ /thub pa de ni ming tsam mo/ /lha'i bu lus kyi las dul bas gsol pa/ mkhyen pas yongs 7su mkhyen gyur nas/ /khyod kyi sku yi phrin las 'jug /thams cad ma lus mkhyen pas na/ /des na 'dren pa thams cad mkhyen/ /lha'i bu lus kyi las yongs su shes pas gsol pa/ sems can rnams la thugs brtse 19bas/ /dpa' bo khyod sku'i phrin las ni/ /mtha' dag shin tu nges pa lags/ /42—276

'jig rten mgon la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu lus kyi las shin tu nges pas gsol pa/ sku yi phrin 1las rab nges par / /lus can kun la sman slad du/ /'jig rten sgron ma khyod mdzad de/ /des na khyod ni gang zag mchog /lha'i bu lus kyi las kyi mtha' shin tu mthong bas gsol pa/ sems can kun la sman slad du/ /'dren pa thams cad mkhyen pa ni/ /sku yi phrin cilas dag pa dang / /legs par yongs su brtags dang ldan/ /lha'i bu lus kyi las kyi mtha' shin tu mnyam par bzhag 5pas gsol pa/ shin tu mnyam par bzhag 6sku dang / /sku yi phrin las rnam dag 7dang / /ldan par sems can bde don du/ /gang zag mchog ni spyod par namadzad/ /lha'i bu tshig 9grub kyis gsol pa/ snyan 4cing yon tan ldan pa dang / /rtsub pa yongs su spangs pa'i gsung / /mkhyen pas shin tu yongs brtags shing / /mgon po khyod ni gsung ba mdzad/ /lha'i bu dus su smra bas gsol pa/ dus su don dang ldan pa dang / /don med yongs su spangs pa'i gsung / /gsung skabar 'os dang blang 'os pa / /'dren pa khyod ni gsung pa mdzad/ /lha'i bu sdums byed blo gros kyis gsol pa/ dbyen du 'gyur ba yongs spangs te/ /'dum par gyur k+ṣidang yid 'ong ba/ /dbyin med 'bras bu rnam par smin/ /sngon chad khyod kyis gsung du brjod/ /lha'i bu mi slu bas gsol pa/ srog gi don du'ang khyod kyis ni/ /srid pa rnams su brdzun skum gsungs / /de bas khyod kyi grags pa kun/ /'jig rten dag na thogs ma mchis / /lha'i bu yang dag par smra bas gsol pa/ 'di ltar 'gro ba thams cad kyang / /sangs rgyas chos rnams btsal slad du/ /thub pa'i gsung la bstod lapa ni/ /yang dag gsungs pa'i rgyu 'thun lags/ /lha'i bu yang dag 42—277

pa'i mtha' las nges par byung gis gsol pa/ mi mchog khyod kyis 1bden pa yis / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'di bsgrubs te/ /chos kyi yang dag rang bzhin yang —/ /rkang gnyis dam pa khyod kyis mkhyen/ /lha'i bu yang dag pa la rtul mibs gsol pa/ 'dus byas dag gi 5chos kyi rnams/ /yang dag ji bzhin blta 4ba dang / /chos rnams yang dag mtshan nyid kyang / /mi yi dbang pos rab tu mkhyen/ /lha'i bu las la rtog pas gsol pa/ ye shes yongs su dag pa yis/ /bdag nyid dang ni gzhan dag gi / /tshig gi las kyang porab tu mkhyen/ /des na rgyal ba mnyam ma mchis/ /lha'i bu yid la rtog pas gsol pa/ mi yi dbang po'i 7thugs kyi las / /ji snyed gang dag 'jug pa ni/ /de dag 'gro la sgyu thugs rjes 'jug /'gro phan khyod la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu yid kyi rnam par rtog pa la mkhas pas gsol pa/ 'gro la thugs rje mabaskyed nas ni/ /gang la khyod ni spyod mdzad pa/ /de la thugs ni dul bar byung : / /'gro phan khyod la phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lha'i bu thabs la mkhas pas gsol pa/ 'gro ba'i bsam pa rnam dpyad nas/ /rnam 'dren thugs kyi phrin palas 'jug /thub pa ye shes sna tshogs ni/ /mkhyen bzhin kun tu rab tu 'jug sto /lha'i bu yid rnam par bshig gis gsol pa/ sangs rgyas sa khudang yid kyi tshalas/ /sems can thugs rjes gzigs pas 'byung / /sangs rgyas nyid la ye shes thabs/ /rang bzhin med par rab tu mkhyen/ /lha'i bu 'das pa la mkhas pas gsol pa/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa dang / /brtson 'grus bsam gtan dag la yang / /gang gis gang la sngon spyad 7pa/ /sngon gyi dus kyang rab tu mkhyen/ /lha'i bu 'das pa la rtog 7pas gsol pa/ byang chub mchog ni tshol mdzad cing / /gang 42—278

du0)khyod kyis sngon spyad pa/ /sngon gyi spyod pa yongs brtags nas/ /sangs rgyas bye ba rab tu mkhyen/ /lha'i bu sngon gyi tshul phun sum tshogs pas gsol pa/bskal pa bye ba grangs med du/ /gang du khyod kyis sngon spyad pa/ /sngon gyi tshul ni dgongs mdzad kyang 5/ /khyod kyi thugs yid thogs mi mnga'/ /lha'i bu sngon gyi tshul la yongs su rtog pas gsol pa/ sangs rgyas mang las byung ba yi/ /ting 'dzin mngon par bsgrub bya ba/ /sangs rgyas bye ba grangs med la/ /rnam par su'adren pa khyod kyis zhus/ /lha'i bu sngon gyi sbyor ba las nges par byung gis gsol pa/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas drung dag tu/ /grangs med dpag tu med pa yi/ /ting 'dzin sgo dag 'dren pa yis/ /zhus shing bsgom 4pa mdzad par gyur / /lha'i bu sngon gyi gnas la portog pas gsol pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes pa rab mang dang ske/ /bkur ste 7rnam pa sna tshogs dag /gzigs pas 8sems can rnams la ston / /sems can long ba rnams kyang 'grel / /lha'i bu sngon gyi dus na 'phrul pas gsol pa/ gzhan dang gzhan dag zos shing 'tshal/ /rtse zhing rab tu dga' ba bgyis/ /gnod pa mi bzad /nyabagyis pa dag /gzhan dang gzhan yang khyod kyis gzigs/ /lha'i bu sngon gyi spyod pas yang dag par byung bas skagasol pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa 'gro rtogs pa/ /khyod kyi ye shes 'das dus kyi/ /las dang bsam gtan snyoms 'jug dang / /'gro ba rnams la thogs ma mchis / /lha'i bu phyi ma'i mtha' la mkhas pas gsol pa/ 'dren pa khyod kyi mkhyen pa ni/ /ma 'ongs dus kyi 'chi 'pho dang / /skye dang las kyi rnam smin la/ /thogs par 'gyur ba ma mchis so/ /lha'i bu ma 'ongs pa'i spyod yul gyis gsol pa/ brten 7pa 'gro ba mkhas khyod kyi/ /mkhyen pa phyi dus sems can gyi/ /42—279

bsam dang las kyi 'bras bu dang / /'gro ba rnams la thogs ma mchis/ /lha'i bu srid pa las bskyod 1kyis gsol pa/ khams rnams gsum po 'di dag dang / /dus gsum kun la mkhas khyod kyi/ /ye shes mchog ni mi chags 5te/ /srid pa'i spyod yul khyod kyis mkhyen/ /lha'i bu tha snyad la spyod pas gsol pa/ las dang sems can 'gro ba dang / /rnam par smin pa myong ba dag /de dag thams cad ming tsam du/ /rkang gnyis dam pa bstan pa mdzad/ /lha'i bu da galtar byung ba la yang dag par rtog pas gsol pa/ dpa' bo khyod kyi mkhyen pa ni/ /da ltar byung la 5thogs ma mchis/ /grangs med sangs rgyas zhing rnams ni/ /'jig rten mgon pos gyurab tu mkhyen/ /lha'i bu da 7ltar byung ba la rnam par nadapyod pas gsol pa/ mi yi dbang pos rnam dpyad nas/ /byis pa'i blo gros rmongs bgyid 9pa/ /dus gsum dngos po ma 7mchis par/ /nges par mnyam pa nyid du gzigs/ /lha'i bu mi gnas pa'i blo gros kyis gsol pa/ dus gsum gnas pa ma mchis shing / /ngo bo nyid la mi gnas te/ /dngos po thams cad dngos med par/ /rnam par 'dren pa khyod kyis 12gzigs/ /lha'i bu dus gsum mngon par bskul 1 bas gsol pa/ 'das pa dag dang ma 'ongs dang —/ /da ltar byung ba'i phung po rnams/ /ma mchis dngos po ma mchis par/ /skyes bu dam pas —bstan pa mdzad/ /lha'i bu chags med yid kyis gsol pa/dus gsum sems can thams cad la/ /snying po mchis par ma bstan te/ /sgyu ma smig rgyu mig yor dang / /brag ca 5lta bur khyod kyis bstan/ /lha'i bu dus gsum dpog gis lagasol pa/ 'dren pa khyod kyi 7mkhyen pa ni/ /dus gsum po dag kun du yang / /sgyu ma lta bur mkhyen pas na snye/ /khyod kyi dbang po 42—280

chags mi mnga'/ /lha'i bu mos pa yongs su rig par byed kyis gsol pa/gang gi nub mo dpa' khyod kyis/ /byang chub mngon du bgyis gyur pa/ /de dus tshun chad mos pa la/ /bri bar gyur par yong mi gda'/ /lha'i bu mos pa yang dag thob kyis gsol pa/ 'jig rten sgron ma'i mos pa ni/ / bar du 1rgyun chad mi 'gyur te/ /rtag par khyod kyi mos pa des/ /khyod kyi sras rnams mos pa che/ /lha'i bu mos pas mngon 'phags kyis gsol pa/ chab las pad ma ji bzhin du/ /khyod ni mos pas mngon du 'phags/ /'jig rten dag gis mi gos te/ /pad ma chab kyis ji bzhin no/ /lha'i bu mos pas yongs su grol gyis gsol pa/ 'jig rten mgon dang mos pa ni/ /chos kyi dbyings zhes brjod pa ste/ /gnyis med gnyis su bgyid ma mchis/ /smad pa med pa khyod kyis gzigs / /lha'i bu brtson 'grus yang dag thob kyis gsol pa/ gzi brjid chen po brtson 'grus kyis/ /byang chub yang dag brnyes par gyur / /mdzad pa mdzad kyang mgon po khyod/ /brtson 'grus btang ba yong ma mdzad/ /lha'i bu dran pa phun sum tshogs pas gsol pa/ dpa' bo chen po'i dgongs pa ni/ /thams cad kun gyi 0rjes su 'jug /mdzad pa mdzad kyang mgon po khyod/ /dgongs pa bri ba yong ma mchis/ /lha'i bu sems mnyam par bzhag pas gsol pa / mgon po rtag tu mnyam bzhag 8ste/ /sems can rnams kyi spyod pa mkhyen//'dren pa spyod pa'i dbang gis ni/ /sems can rnams la chos kyang ston/ /lha'i bu shes rab (lhur len gyis gsol pa/ 'jig rten sgron mar 7gyur khyod kyi —/ /ye shes rgya mtsho'i mtha' ma ni/ /bskal pa bye bar brjod bgyis dkyang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyis bshad mi spyod/ /lha'i bu rnam par grol ba la mkhas pas 42—281

gsol pa/ rnam par grol dang mnyegrol ba/ /gang slad khyod kyis ma brnyes pas(kye/ /mtshungs pa med pa khyod la ni/ /rnam grol yongs su nyams mi mnga'/ /lha'i bu rnam par grol ba'i ye shes la brtson pas gsol pa/ thub pa khyod ni rnam grol nasami/ /ngo bo nyid med mkhyen pas na/ /rnam grol ye shes gzigs par ni/ /yang dag mkhyen pa nyams mi mnga'/ /lha'i bu sngon gyi srid pa rnam par dpyod5gekyis gsol pa/ mar me mdzad pa tshun chad du/ /dpa' bo yang dag gzigs khyod kyi0/ /spyod la 'khrul pa mi mnga' ste/ /desashen sangs rgyas legs zhes bstod/ /lha'i bu zab mo la spyod pas gsol pa/ srog chags gzhan dag ji bzhin du/ /bde gshegs khyod la chags7mi mnga'/ /chos kyi rang bzhin mkhyen pas na/ /rang bzhin de la rmongs mi mnga'/ /lha'i bu blo gros yangs pas gsol pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa khyod la ni/ /rnam pa kun du bsnyel mi mnga'/ /mgon po'i7dgongs pa nyer gzhag pas/ /thub pa 'bru mar snod dang 'dra/ /lha'i bu sems g.yeng ba med kyis gsol pa/ 'jig rten sgron ma /2khyod la ni/ /mnyam par ma bzhag rte/snyesems mi mnga'/ /ma 'dres sangs rgyas chos kyi rnams/ /srog chags kun gyis shes par dka'/ /lha'i bu ye /2shes la rab tu gnas kyis gsol pa/ bde bar gshegs pa khyod 'a ni/ /ma brtags cibatang snyoms mi mnga' ste/ /mi 8yi dbang po'i sangs rgyas chos/ /ma 'dres pa ni bsam mi khyab/ /lha'i bu thams cad zil gnon gyis gsol pa/skyes bu khyu mchog khyod la ni/ /'jig rten gsum na mtshungs ma mchis/ /thams cad mkhyen pa ma pham pa/ /khyod kyis chos rnams thams cad mkhyen/ /lha'i bu snying po blangs pas gsol pa/ sems can snying po bla na med/ /chos 42—282

rnams kun la 'jigs mi mnga'/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam brnyes pa/ /sangs rgyas byang chub phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnas gtsang ma pa'i 1le'u ste nyi shu rtsa t+t+waṃbazhi pa'o// //de nas de'i tshe gzhan mu stegs can spyod pa can dang / kun tu rgyu drug khris lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / klu'i bu mo dang / klu dang / grul bum dang / dri za dang / gnod sbyin dang / mi'am ci dang / phreng ldan riglang po cican dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i ris dang / sum cu rtsa gsum dang /'thab bral dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang / tshangs pa dang / 'od gsal dang / dge rgyas dang /'bras bu che ba'i lha dag gis rimachod pa yang mthong / lung phyobastan pa yang thos/ gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha dag gis bstod pa brjod pa yang thos nas ngo mtshar thob par gyur thote chos kyi tshul la 'jug pa 'di thos nas 'di ltar sngon 8chad ma thos pa'i chos kyi tshul thos pas tsho yid gnyis su gyur/ nem nur dang /the tshom za bar gyur nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye go ta ma sngan khochad ma thos pa'i chos bstan pa 'di thos nas bdag cag ni kun du rgyu'i gnas kyang mi 'tshal/ khyim gyi gnas kyang mi 'tshal bar gyur cing 'di ltar sngon /nyachad ma thos pa'i chos kyi tshul 'di thos nas chos 'di la nem nur dang the tshom du gyur te/ sems dang bar yang ma gyur mod kyi/ 'on kyang dge sbyong go ta ma khyod la bdag cag skuyid ches pa mchis so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar dge sbyong gi ta ma khyod kyis rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba 'di lta bu mngon par 42—283

mdzad de/ rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba ji lta bu mngon par nyamadzad pas bdag cag gis lha'i 'khor rgya chen po 'di dag 5dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor phal cher go ta ma khyod kyi legs par gsungs pa 'tshal zhing yi 4rangs par gyur pa mthong ste/ des na sgrubadag cag dge sbyong go ta ma khyod la dad pa mchis par gyur to/ /kye gi ta ma gang 'bras bu che ba'i lha phyornams kyis chos thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa'o zhes smras pa de la ji ltar chos thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa snyam du bdag cag the tshom cher 'tshal lo/ /dge sbyong go ta ma khyod ni ci nas bdag cag legs par bshad pa'i don de rtogs tshanas mun pa med par gyur te/ stan 'di las ldang bar 'gyur ba de ltar bdag cag la chos ston spyod do snyam ste / bdag cag dge sbyong go ta ma khyod la de ltar mngon par dad 9par gyur to/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis gzhan mu stegs can spyod pa can dang / kun tu rgyu rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kun tu rgyu dag de'i phyir khyed 7nyid la dris/ khyed kyis ji ltar bzod 2pa de ltar lan thob shig ri /dge stong go ta ma legs so zhes gsol te/ kun tu rgyu de dag bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar nyan pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kun tu rgyu dag khyed 5kyis ji ltar mngal du 'jug pa shes sam/ de dag gis cigasol pa/ kye gi ta ma bdag cag skogis bstan bcos ’ las thos na gsum 'dus nas mngal du 'jug par 'gyur nate/ gang 'di pha dang ma gnyis kyang tshogs pa dang /chags par yang gyur pa dang / chags nas kyang 'dod pa'i rnam par rtog pa rnams kyis rnam par brtags 9pas 'dod chags kyang byung ba de'i tshe mngal du 42—284

'jug par 'gyur ro zhe'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun tu rgyu dag 1 'di la ji snyam du sems/ pha dang ma gnyis rnam par rtog pa'i tshe 'dod chags de nama'i sems las byung ngam gsol pa/ kye gau ta ma ma lags so/ /ma'i rnam par rtog pa las byung ngam/ kye go ta ma ma lags so/ /de pa'i sems las byung ngam/ kye gi ta ma ma lags so/ /pa'i rnam par rtog 5pa las byung ngam/ kye go ta ma ma lags so/ /kun tu rgyu dag 'di la ji snyam du sems/pha'i 'dod chags gang yin pa de ma'i mngal du zhugs sam/ kye gi ta ma de ni ma phyolags so/ /kun tu rgyu dag 'di sgyuji snyam du sems/ pa'i sems gang yin pa de ma'i mngal du zhugs sam/ kye gi ta ma de ni ma lags so/ /kun tu rgyu dag 'di la ji snyam du sems/ pa'i kun tu rtog pa de ma'i mngal du zhugs sam / kye gau ta ma de ni ma lags so/ /kun tu rgyu dag cha'adi la ji snyam du sems / mngal na gnas pa de lha las shi lha'aphos te ma'i mngal du zhugs sam/kye go ta ma ma 'tshal to/ /kun tu rgyu dag 'di la ji snyam du sems/ mngal na gnas pa de pami dang / lha ma yin dang / sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten nas shi 'phos r+sāte ma'i mngal du zhugs sam/ kye gi ta ma ma 'tshal to/ /kun tu rgyu dag 'di la ji snyam du sems / mngal na gnas pa de gzugs yod pa'am/ gzugs med pa zhig ma'i mngal du zhugs sam/ kye go ta ma ma 'tshal to/ /kun tu rgyu dag da'adi la ji snyam du sems/ gzugs dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam tshapar shes pa ma'i mngal du zhugs sam/ kye go ta ma ma 'tshal to/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis gzhan mu 42—285

stegs can 1kun tu rgyu de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kun tu rgyu dag chos 'di ni zab cing phra 5ste/ mkhas pa shes pa blo dang ldan pasalarig par bya ba yin te/ brtag tu med cing brtag pa'i yul ma yin la/ blta dka' zhing shes par dka' bas de ni khyed yun ring por gzhan du bltas mipa/ gzhan du mos pa/ gzhan du dad pa/ gzhan du brtson pa/ gzhan dum kyilta ba'i gnas la gnas pa rnams kyis shes par mi nus mod kyi/ kun tu rgyu dag 'on kyang rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dag tshul dang 'dra ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten nas chos zab mo rnams la mig skye bar 'gyur te/ kun tu rgyu dag 'di lta ste/ dper na mi mig nagi dbang po nyams pa ni de'i tshul dang 'dra ba'i gsomatsho ba byed pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten na tshe 'di nyid la mig yongs su dag par 'gyur te/ mig des kyang tshe 'di nyid la gzugs rnams tshamathong bar 'gyur ro/ /kun tu rgyu dag de bzhin du rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi mig nyams par gyur pas kyang tshul dang 'dra ba'i dge ba'ichabashes gnyen 2la brten na shes rab kyi mig rnam par dag par ge'agyur te/ des kyang chos zab mo rnams mthong bar 'gyur ro'i/ /kun tu rgyu dag mkhyed kyang yun ring po nas gzhan du bltas 7pa/ sngon log pa'i gdams tsho snyengag gis bslus pa/chos ma yin pa la chos su 'du shes pa/ thar pa ma yin pa la thar par 'du shes pa / 'byung ba ma yin pa la 'byung bar 'du shes pa/ chud zos pa rnams kyis chud gzan 1 pa yin te/ kun tu rgyu dag 'di lta ste/ dper na long ba'i dmigs bu long bas byas na / gang 'di bkri 2 ba dang / khrid pa de gnyir ga yang tshul ma yin par sdug bsngal thob par 'gyur bar shes par bya'o/ /kun tu 42—286

rgyu dag de bzhin du dge stong ngamatsho/ bram ze gang la la ston pa ma yin par bdag cag ni ston pa 5yin no zhes khas 'che ba dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma yin par bdag cag ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin no zhes khas 'che ba dang / 'byung ba la mkhas pa ma yin par bdag cag ni 'byung ba la mkhas pa'o zhes khas 'che ba dang 5/ 'byung ba mthong ba ma yin par bdag cag ni 'byung ba mthong ba phyiyin no zhes khas 'che ba dang / mu stegs byed pa ma yin par bdag cag ni mu stegs 7byed pa yin no zhes khas 'che ba yin te/ de dag ston pa ma yin par ston pa'o zhes khas 'che zhing gang rjes su ston pa de ni log par rjes su ston 9)par 'gyur/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma yin par gang khong du chud par byed pa de 7ni log par khong du chud par byed par 'gyur/ gang 'byung ba la mkhas pa ma yin par gang 'byin pa de ni log par 'byin par 'gyur/ 'byung ba mthong ba ma yin par gang 'byung ba ston pa de ni log par ston par tshi'agyur/ mu stegs byed pa ma yin par gang sgrol tshab de ni log par sgrol bar 'gyur te/ de dag ni tshul ma yin par sdug bsngal thob par 'gyur ro/ /kun tu rgyu dag 'di lta ste/ dper na ba lang ji rab ka la mkhas pa ma yin pas rab ka ma yin par ba lang bsgral na/de'i ba lang de dag gis pha rol dang tshu rol gyi 'gram ma rnyed nas : 'khyil te/de nyid du tshul ma yin par sdug bsngal thob par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/'di ltar ba lang rdzi de skarab ka la mi mkhas pa'i phyir ro/ /kun tu rgyu dag de bzhin du gang la la mu stegs byed pa ma yin par mu stegs byed par khas sa'ache zhing gang sgrol ba de ni tshul ma yin par sdug bsngal thob par 'gyur ro/ /kun tu 42—287

rgyu dag nga 1ni ston pa nyid yin la ston par khas 2'che bas nga rigang rjes su ston pa de yang dag par rjes su ston pa yin/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid yin la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su khas 'che bas/ nga lagang khong du chud par byed pa de yang dag par khong du chud par byed pa yin/ 'byung ba la mkhas pa nyid yin la 'byung ba la mkhas par 5khas 'che dzibs nga phyagang 'byin pa de dag yang dag par 'byin pa yin/ 'byung ba mthong ba nyid yin la 'byung ba ston par khas 'che bas nga 9gang 'byung ba ston pa de yang dag par ston pa yin/ mu stegs byed pa yin la —mu stegs byed ’ par khas 'che bas nga gang sgrol ba de yang : dag par sgrol ba yin te/ ston pa'i chos rab tu shes nas ni rjes su 5ston/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rab tu shes nas ni khong du chud par byed/'byung ba rab tu shes nas ni 'byind/ yang dag par mthong nas ni ston/ mu stegs rab tu shes nas ni lasgrol te/ gang sgrol ba de yang mu stegs pa de bas rab tu sgrol ba yin no/ /'di 7lta ste/ kun tu rgyu dag khyed kyang thar par ’ 'dod pa yin la/ nga 9yang ston pa mngon du bzhugs pa yin te/ yang dag par ston pa/ yang dag par khong du chud par byed pa/ 'byung ba phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba mthong ba/ yang dag pa'i mu stegs byed pa yin gyis 22de'i phyir rna ba lhogs rite mos pa skyed la dran pa nye bar zhog ste/ yid 'dun par gyis la ma thob pa'i chos rnams thob par bya ba dang / sngon ma phyin pa'i lam du 'gro bar bya ba dang / sngon ma song ba'i phyogs su 'gro bar bya ba dang / sngon ma 'grogs pa'i lam grogs dang pa'agrogs par bya ba dang / sngon ma btsal ba'i lam 4btsal bar bya ba dang / sngon ma ri thob pa'i chos kyi mdzod thob par 42wa 288

bya ba'i phyir/ brtson 'grus yang dag par rtsoms 1shig /kun tu rgyu dag chos gsum mngon du gyur 5pas mngal du 'jug ces gang smras pa de legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung shig dang / mngal du 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs pa'adi khyed la ngas bshad do/ /kun tu rgyu dag de la ma zhes gang smras pa de ni sngon gyi las bsags phyopa'i rkyen du gsungs so/ /pha zhes bya ba de ni sngon gyi las bsags 7pa'i rgyur gsungs so/ /dri za zhes bya ba de ni rnam par shes pa las kyis 'phangs pa'i tshig bla dgas naso/ /mer mer po zhes bya ba /de ni las kyis 'phangs pa'i rnam par shes pa'i gnas dang gzhi'o / /ma'i mngal zhes bya ba de ni rnam par shes pa rta las kyis 'phangs pa'i gzhi ste/ 'di ltar ma'i mngal na gnas pa'i rnam par shes pa ni skye ba dang / 'phel ba dang / rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /kun tu rgyu dag 'di lta ste dper na/ sa chen po la gnas na rtswa dang 12/ shing gel pa dang / sman dang / nags tshal dag skye zhing 'phel ba dang rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du ma'i mngal na gnas pa'i rnam par shes pa yang skye ba dang / 'phel ba dang / rgyas par 'gyur te/ 'phel nas skye bar 'gyur ro/ /btsas nas rnam par 'phel lo/ /'phel nas spyod pa snang bar 'gyur te snye/ 'gro ba gang dang gang nas shi 'phos nas de dang der skyes nas cide dang tsha'adra ba'i spyod pa de dag de laspyod par 'gyur te/ de dag kyang mkhas pas shes par bya ba yin gyi/ glen pas ni ma yin no/ /yun ring po nas 'grogs 'grogs pas shes par bya ba yin gyis yun thung ngus ma yin no/ /yang dag par sems pas shes par bya ba yin gyi/ mi brtson pas ma yin no/ /kun tu rgyu dag de la sems can dmyal ba nas shi 'phos pa'i gang zag gi rtags 42—289

mkhas pas shes par bya ba ni 'di dag yin te/ 'di lta ste/ skad sha sha po yin/skad gyo dum gyi sgra lta bu yin/ skad brtag 1dgos pa yin/ skad che ba yin/skad lhang lhang po yin/ rtag tu dngangs pa yin/ rtag tu 'dar ba yin/rtag tu spu zing zhes byed pa yin/ rmi lam na me'i phung po 'bar ba ༷mthong ba yin / ri rgyug par mthong ba yin/ me mdag 'bar bar cimathong ba yin/lcags zangs kyi nang du btso ba mthong ba 5yin lag na dbyug nepa thogs pa'i mi dag mthong ba yin/ srin po dag gis bdag 'phang bar 7mthong ba yin/bdag nyid gson por gsal shing gis gzugs par mthong ba yin/ khyi dag gis bdag dbang 8bar mthong ba yin/ khyi dag gis 9bdag bskor bar mthong ba yin/ bdag nyid glang po che tshadang sbrul gyis gtses par mthong ba yin/phyogs bzhir bros nas 1phyogs mi shes pa yin/ sems can kun la yid mi rton pa yin nod/ /kun tu rgyu dag rnam pa nyi shu po de dag gis sems can dmyal ba nas shi 'phos pa'i gang zag tu rig par bya'o/ /kun tu rgyu dag de la tshadud 'gro'i skye gnas nas shi 'phos pa'i gang zag gi mtshan ma ni 'di dag yin te/'di lta ste/ rmugs shing gnyid che ba yin/ le lo che ba yin/ mang du za ba yin / sa la 'drud pa yin/ mi 'jigs pa med pa yin/ mi gsal bar smra ba yin / glen pa la dga' ba yin/ mun pa la dga' ba yin/ 'dam rdzab la dga' ba yin/ yang dang yang sos r+sharna gcod pa yin/ rgyun du rkang 8pa'i mthe bos sa rko ba yin/ yang dang yang mgo la sbrang ma 'du ba yin/ yang dang yang nam mkha' la sos la'adebs pa yin/ kun tu bskums te nyal ba yin/sa la nyal ba yin/ mi gtsang bas mi 'dog 7pa yin/ yang dang yang nam 42—290

mkha' la mnom pa yin/17 yang dang yang ma smin par 5za ba yin/ gzhan du smra zhing gzhan du byed de g.yo byed pa yin/ bab bab ritu spyod pa yin/ rmi lam na bdag rdzab kyis gos par rmi ba yin / rmi lam na bdag nags su song ste 3)rtswa za bar rmi 45ba yin/ sbrul gdug pas bdag bskor bar mthong ba yin/bdag nyid ri khrod du zhugs par mthong ba yin te/ kun tu rgyu dag de dag la sogs 77pa dud 'gro'i skye gnas nas shi na'aphos pa'i gang zag gi mtshan ma rnam pa du mar shes par bya ste/ de dag ni bskal pa'am/ bskal rte pa las lhag par brjod kyang zad par mi nus so/ /kun tu rgyu dag de la gshin rje'i 'jig rten nas shi 'phos pa'i gang zag gi mtshan ma ni 'di dag yin te/ 'di lta ste/ skra ser ba yin/ mig wa'i mig lta bu 7yin/ rtag par bkres pa yin/ rtag tu skom pa yin/:rmo ser sna che ba yin/ 'dod chen che ba dang zlo/ 'thob pa mi rnyed pa yin/ gzhan gyi la re ba yin/ khro ba yin/ mig dmar ba yin/bza' ba thams cad la sred pa yin/ bdog pa thams cad la chags pa yin sbyin pa'i gnas dag mthong bar mi 'dod pa yin/ dngos po kun la yang de brku0ba'i sems yod pa yin/ dngos po ngan pa rnams la yang dga' ba yin/'thob 6pa la mos pa yin/ zas sgom mi gtsang ba la dga' ba yin/ gzhan gyi phun sum tshogs pa la phrag dog byed pa yin/ gzhan gyi longs spyod la sred pa skyed pa yin/ gzhan gyi longs spyod gang yin pa de dag la bdag gi snyam du sems pa yin/ zas gtor na 7sems mi dga' ba yin/ tshong 'dus kyi srang dag nas kyang shing thog /8len pa yin te/ kun tu rgyu dag gshin rje'i 'jig rten nas shi 'phos pa'i gang zag gi rtags kyi bye brag ni de dag la sogs sna pa 42—291

mtha' yas par shes par bya'o/ /kun tu rgyu dag de la lha ma yin las shi 'phos pa'i gang zag gi mtshan ma ni 'di dag yin te/ 'di lta ste/ khengs pa yin/'thab krol 1che ba yin/ 'khon du 'dzin pa yin/ nga rgyal che ba yin/ lus che ba yin/ mig che ba yin/ mig dkar ba yin/ mche ba snang ba yin/mthu dang ldan pa yin/ thab mo'i blo can yin/ dbyin la dga' ba yin /bya ba thams cad la nga rgyal che ba yin/ so snang ba yin/ 'jig rten thams cad la brnyas pa'i 'du shes can yin/ mtshon cha 5rno ba yin/ tshig na ba yin/bdag gzengs stod phyopa can yin/ mi shes pa'i stobs can yin/ nyon mongs pa'i stobs can yin te/ kun tu rgyu dag de dag la sogs 7pa ni lha ma yin las shi 'phos pa'i gang zag gi mtshan mar shes par bya'o/ /kun tu rgyu dag de la mi las shi 'phos pa'i gang zag gi mtshan ma ni 'di dag yin te/ 'di lta ste/ ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa can yin/ 'phags pa dang sten 9pa yin/ 'phags pa ma yin pa la smod pa yin/ dge ba byed pa yin/ mngon rtags 'dod pa yin/grags pa 'dod pa yin/ snyan pa 'dod pa yin/ bzo 7la dga' ba yin/shes pa la dga' ba yin/ nyon mongs pa chung ba yin/ khrel yod cing ngo tsha shes pa yin/ rigs kyi bu'i tshul phun sum tshogs pa yin/ byas pa gzo ba yin / mdza' bo la gdung lha ba yin/ yongs su gtong ba dang ldan pa yin/bye brag shes pa yin/ byas pa dang ma byas pa la rtog pa yin/ tshig gi mthu yod pa yin/ gros gzung lobar bya ba'i mthu yod pa yin/ 'dum par bya ba dang /'thab 2mo bya ba la mngon par mkhas pa yin/ pho nya nus pa yin/ skad thams cad 'dzin pa'i mthu yod pa yin/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mngon par 42—292

shes pa yin te/ kun tu rgyu dag de dag la sogs 1pa ni mi las shi 'phos pa'i gang zag gi rtags yin no/ /kun tu rgyu dag de la lha las shi 'phos pa'i gang zag gi rtags ni 'di dag yin te/ 'di lta ste/ mdzes pa yin/ gtsang sbra che ba yin/ phreng ba la dga' ba yin/ spos la dga' ba yin/ bdug 5pa la dga' ba yin/ glu len pa'i ngang tshul can yin/ byug pa la dga' ba yin /'dod pa'i yon tan ngan ngon gyis mi mgu zhing rgya chen po la cadaga' ba yin/rol mo'i sgra thams cad la dga' ba yin/ glu thams cad la dga' ba yin/skye bo rgya chen po dang 'grogs par dga' ba yin/ khang pa dang / khang pa brtsegs 5pa dang / khyim dang / longs spyod rgya chen po la dga' ba yin/de'i sems byams pa sngon du 'gro ba yin/ rgod pa'i ngang tshul can yin/'jam par smra ba yin/ dga' ba la mkhas pa yin/ rgyan la dga' ba yin/che 7ba'i ngang tshul can yin/ 'gro ba'i ngang tshul can yin/ lus kyi shugs 'byin pa'i ngang tshul can yin/ chags pa'i mtshan ma dang mi chags pa'i mtshan ma shes pa yin/ phan par bya ba la mkhas pa yin te/ kun tu rgyu dag mtshan ma de dag la sogs pas / mtho ris nas shi 'phos pa'i gang zag tu shes par bya'o / /kun tu rgyu dag de la mtshan ma de dag las yang dag par 'da' bar bya ba'i phyir 9rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dag gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen gang dag mtshan ma de dag las yang dag par 'da' bar bya ba'i phyir chos ston par byed pa de lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams bsten skopar bya/ bsnyen ’ par byari/ bsnyen bkur bar smubya'o/ /de la sems can dmyal ba nas shi 'phos pa'i gang zag gis ni sngon mir gyur pa'i tshe zhe sdang la layongs su bsten 1 42—293

pas des zhe snang las byung ba'i las mngon par 'du 1byas pas de las des sems can dmyal bar skyes te / de'i phyir de sems can dmyal bar gnas pa rnyed nas sems can dmyal ba'i spyod pa can du gyur pas de mi'i nang du skyes te/spyod pa'i rtags 'di dag thos nas bdag ni sems can dmyal ba nas shi 'phos pa'o zhes bdag nyid kyis shes par bya zhing / des sems can dmyal ba'i las kyi rgyu spang ba'i phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen btsal bar bya ste/ de la dge ba'i bshes gnyen de dag zhe snang gi gnyen por byams pa ston to/ /byams pa dang ldan pa'i byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams dang / byams pa dang ldan pa'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston to/ /des kyang de'i zhe snang gi bag la nyal spong bar 'gyur te/ de 5byams pa chen po bsgoms pas pha rol tu phyin pa drug po thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /kun tu rgyu dag de la dud 'gro'i skye gnas nas shi 'phos pa'i gang zag gis ni sngon mir gyur pa'i tshe/ gti mug la yongs su bsten phyopas des gti mug las byung ba'i las mngon par 'du 7byas pas / de las des dud 'gro'i skyes gnas su skyes te/ de'i phyir des dud 'gro'i skye gnas na gnas pa rnyed nas dud 'gro'i skye gnas kyi 7spyod pa can du gyur pas de dud 'gro'i skye gnas nas shi 'phos te/ mi'i nang du skyes kyang dud 'gro'i skye gnas kyi spyod pa de dag nyid spyod par 'gyur te/ des spyod pa de dag gis bdag ni dud 'gro'i gnas nas shi 'phos nas mi'i nang du skyes so zhes bdag nyid kyis shes par bya zhing / des dadud 'gro'i skye gnas kyi las de dag las yang ridag par 'da' bar bya ba'i phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen btsal bar bya ste / /de chol dge ba'i bshes gnyen de dag gti mug spang ba'i phyir rten cing 42—294

'brel par 'byung ba 17ston to/ /des kyang de'i gti mug gi bag la nyal spong ribar 'gyur ro/ /yang /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dus gsum mnyam pa nyid ston te/ des de gti mug de ni rang bzhin med pa'o zhes bya bar shes pa skye bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na de la chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid ston te/ des de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs shing thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur ro/ /kun tu rgyu dag de la gshin rje'i 'jig rten nas shi 'phos pa'i gang zag gis ni sngon mir gyur pa'i tshe ser sna la kun tu bsten 5cing bsgoms te mang du byas pas des der poser sna dang ldan pa chags pa las byung ba'i las 9mngon par 'du byas pas de las byas pa dang / bsags —pa dang / zin par byas pa dang / rdzogs par byas pa dang / blangs pa des gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skyes te/ de : gshin rje'i 'jig rten na gnas pa des gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa'i spyod pa can du gyur pas de : gshin rje'i 'jig rten nas shi 'phos te /snyemi'i nang du skyes kyang gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa'i laspyod pa de dag nyid spyod par 'gyur te/ des spyod pa de dag gis bdag ni gshin rje'i 'jig rten nas shi 'phos pa'o zhes bya bar bdag nyid kyis shes par bya zhing / des spyod pa de dag las skuyang dag par 'da' bar bya ba'i phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen btsal bar bya ste / de las tshadage ba'i bshes gnyen de dag ser sna spang ba'i phyir gtong ba ston to / /des kyang de'i ser sna'i bag la nyal spong bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na de la gtong ba dang ldan pa'i byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams ston/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ston te/ de bsgoms pas pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /kun tu rgyu dag de la lha ma yin las shi 'phos pa'i gang 42—295

zag gis 1sngon mir gyur pa'i tshe dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po ridag kyang mngon par 'du cibyas la nga rgyal la yang yongs su bsten 5pas de nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i las byas pa dang dzi/ bsags 7pa dang / zin par byas pa dang / rdzogs par byas pa dang / blangs pa des lha ma yin du skyes te9/ lha ma yin gyi nang 7na gnas pa des lha ma yin gyi spyod pa can du gyur pas de 1lha ma yin nas shi 'phos te mi'i nang du skyes kyang lha ma yin gyi spyod pa de dag nyid spyod par 'gyur te / des spyod pa de dag gis bdag ni lha ma yin las pashi 'phos pa'o zhes bya bar bdag nyid kyis shes par bya zhing / des spyod pa 5de dag las yang dag par 'da' chabar bya ba'i phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen btsal bar bya ste/ de la dge ba'i bshes gnyen de dag nga rgyal spang dab dang / nga'o 7snyam pa'i nga rgyal gzhom pa'i phyir skye mched rnams ston to/ /des kyang de'i nga rgyal spong bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na de la stong pa nyid ston te/ des de'i nga rgyal gyi bag la nyal spong ba dang / bdag rnam par 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /yang na ji ltar bya ba 'byung ba rnams tshogs pa las byung ba'i tshul 9ston te/ des de'i nga rgyal gyi bag la nyal spong bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na de la chos rnams kyi mtshan nyid gcig pa ston te/ des de'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur zhing de bsgoms pas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /kun tu rgyu dag de la mi las shi 'phos pa'i gang zag gis ni sngon mir gyur pa'i tshe yang 2 dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la kun tu bsten 2 cing bsgoms te mang du byas pas de las de byas pa dang / bsags pa dang / zin par byas pa dang / rdzogs par byas pa dang / blangs pas tshomir skyes te/ de 0mi'i nang na gnas pa des 42—296

mi'i spyod pa can du gyur pas de mi'i nang nas shi 'phos te mi'i nang du skyes kyang mi'i spyod pa de dag nyid spyod par 1'gyur te/ de spyod pa de dag gis bdag mi mi'i nang nas shi 'phos pa'o zhes bya bar bdag nyid kyis shes par bya zhing des mi'i spyod pa de dag las yang dag par 'da' bar bya ba'i phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen btsal bar bya ste/ de la dge ba'i bshes gnyen de dag mi rtag pa'i 'du shes ston to / /des kyang de'i spyod pa bag la nyal dang bcas par spong bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na de la 'khor ba'i mi bsngags 5pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsngags pa ston te/ des de 'khor ba la mi dga' zhing mya ngan las 'das pa 0don du gnyer bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na de la pha rol tu phyin pa drug ston te/ de thos pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /de la thabs mkhas pa yang ston to / /des de'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de dag shin tu bzung ba dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang myur du thob par 'gyur ro/ /kun tu rgyu dag de la mtho ris nas shi 'phos pa'i gang zag gis ni sngon mir gyur pa'i tshe tshangs par spyod pa mchog tu bzung ste spyad pa 9dang / sbyin pa mchog tu bzung ste byin pa dang / tshul khrims mchog tu bzung ste bsrungs pas de las de byas pa dang / bsags pa dang —/ zin par byas pa dang / rdzogs par byas pa dang / blangs pas lha'i nang du skyes te/ de lha'i nang na gnas pa de lha'i spyod pa can du gyur pas de lha las shi 'phos te/ mi'i nang du skyes kyang lha'i spyod pa de dag nyid spyod par 'gyur te/ des spyod pa de dag gis bdag ni lha'i nang nas dzishi 'phos pa'o zhes bdag nyid kyis rishes par bya zhing des spyod pa de dag las 5yang dag par 42—297

'da' bar bya ba'i phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen btsal bar bya ste/ de la dge ba'i bshes gnyen de dag tshangs par spyod pa mchog tu 'dzin pa'i nyes pa ston cing mi gnas pa'i tshangs par spyod pa'i yon tan brjod do/ /mchog tu 'dzin pa'i sbyin pa smod 1cing mchog tu 'dzin pa med pa'i sbyin pa bsngags par 'gyur ro/ /mchog tu 'dzin pa'i tshul khrims la dmod cing mchog tu 'dzin pa med pa'i tshul khrims ribasngags par 'gyur ro/ /des de'i tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog tu 'dzin pa bag la nyal dang bcas par spong bar la'agyur ro/ /yang na de la tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston te / de bsgoms pas pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /de la thabs la ri mkhas pa yang ston to / /de dang ldan pas myur du thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du nges par smyo'abyung bar nga'agyur ro/ /kun tu rgyu dag de la sems can dmyal ba nas shi 'phos 11pa'i gang zag gis ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten te/ dus gsum mnyam papa nyid mnyan par bya'o/ /thos nas kyang shas cher gnas par bya ste/grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / ljongs dang / yul 'khor dang —/ rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor dag na dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang /dge ’ bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dang / 'khor cibazhi po mang po tshayod pa dag tu gnas par bya zhing de dag dang 'grogs par 7bya'o/ /des 'gro ba 7byas te goms pa'i mi rjes su 'gro bas chos thams cad ni dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid do zhes dus gsum mnyam pa nyid mngon du 'gyur ro/ /kun tu rgyu dag de la dud 'gro'i skye gnas nas shi 'phos pa'i gang zag gis ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten te/ gti mug gi gnyen por bstan bcos 19la mkhas pa'i skye bo dang 42—298

lhan cig dga' bar gnas par bya'o/ /des de'i gti mug spong bar 'gyur te/des bstan bcos de dang bstan bcos 1shes pa de dag rang bzhin gyis yang dag par brtag par ri bya'o/ /de'i phyir de la bstan bcos dang bstan bcos rishes pa rnams kyang rang bzhin med do no/ / rang bzhin med do 5zhes bya bar snang bar gyur gyete/ des de la dus gsum mnyam pa nyid mngon du 'gyur zhing myur du thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /kun tu rgyu dag de la gshin rje'i 'jig rten nas shi 'phos pa'i gang zag gis ni gang la rten 7na de'i sbyin pa'i blo skye bar 'gyur ba dang / gang gis de la dus gsum mnyam pa nyid dang / gang 'di mtshan nyid med par mtshan nyid gcig pa 9mngon du 'gyur ba dang / de bsgoms pas myur du thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshal bsten par bya/ yon tan la bsten par bya'o// //bam po bcu gnyis pa/ kun tu rgyu dag de la lha ma yin las shi 'phos pa'i gang zag gis ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten sna te/ nyon mongs —pa'i bdud dang 'thab mapar bya'o/ /'di lta 7ste/ nga rgyal zhes bya ba'i chos de ni gang zhig /de ni ci zhig gis yongs su bzung / de ni su la 7kun nas langs/ su zhig de spong nyi bar byed ces 3 yang dag par btsal na nga rgyal de mi dmigs so/ /gang gis de yongs su bzung ba dang / gang la de kun nas langs pa dang /gang de spang ba'i phyir rtsol ba de yang mi dmigs te / de ni yang dag pa ma yin par yongs su bzung bas bdag dang 'jig rten bslus par yang dag par rjes su mthong ngo 2/ /des chos thams cad rang bzhin med par yang dag par 2snye42wa 299

rjes su mthong zhing chos gang la rang bzhin med pa de ni dngos po med pa'o zhes bya bar rab tu shes so/ /dngos po med pas yongs su ma grub bo zhes bya bar rab tu shes so/ /yongs su ma grub pas mi skye ba ste/ gang mi skye ba de ni mi 'gag go/ /gang mi skye mi 1'gag pa de ni gdags su med pa'o zhes bya bar rab tu shes so/ /gang gdags su med pa de ni 'das pa yang ma yin/ ma 'ongs pa yang ma yin/ da ltar byung 2ba yang ma yin no/ /gang dus gsum du mi dmigs pa de ni thob pa yang ma yin/ chud zos pa yang ma yin no zhes bya bar rab tu shes so/ /kun tu rgyu cadag de ltar na de ni chos thams cad kyi chos nyid dopa / /chos nyid phyogang gis chos thams cad de bzhin nyid ma nor ba de bzhin nyid / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid de/ de bzhin gshegs pa yang de bzhin nyid / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid/ gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid pas de'i phyir chos thams cad ni 8de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /kun tu rgyu dag ngas ni sngon 9chad dang da ltar yang 'jig rten btags pa ni nga rgyal gyi rang bzhin no zhes bshad do / /nga rgyal gyis ni mi las shi 'phos pa tshagadags par 'gyur ro/ /nga rgyal gyis ni mtho ris nas shi 'phos pa gdags par 'gyur ro / /nga rgyal gyis ni 5sems can dmyal ba'i bar du shi 'phos pa gdags par 'gyur ro/ /nga rgyal med na gdags pa med dod/ /kun tu rgyu dag de lani nga rgyal med pa'i ye shes shes bya'o/ /de yang thabs mkhas pa dang ldan zhing shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su zin pas shes par nus so//de nas kun tu rgyu drug khri po de dag gis bstan pa 'di thos nas mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur te/ de dag mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob nas 942—300
