sangs rgyas 'gyur bar lung ston pas/ /de phyir byang chub sems dpa' de/ /sems ni dga' ba thob par 'gyur/ /shin tu phangs ①pa'i nor rnams dang / /phyi nang 2kun la chags med pas/ /de phyir dga' ba chen po yis/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas 'grub par shes/ / sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsngags pa yi/ /bzod pa gya rnam thob pas na/ /de phyir dga' ba chen po yis/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas 'grub par shes/ /sbyo/chos rnams phyisakun la mi gnas shing / /chos brtan 5mi rung rig pas na/ /de 'dra'i meshes rab thob gyur dunas/ /lus ni mkha' la 'phags par 'gyur/ / de yilo)sems ni nang mi gnas/ /phyi rol na yang mi gnas te/ /'du shes thams cad 'das pas min/ /de phyir bzod pa bla med thob/ /yun ring /7byams dang snying rje yis/ /sems can kun la sems pas na / /de phyir bsod nams de yi /snyedabang / /sangs rgyas tshad med mthong bar 'gyur/ / de yi lus ni thams cad kun/ /sangs rgyas sku dang khyad par med/ /de 'dra'i bzod pa thob pas ni / /chos kyi bdag nyid 'phel bar byed/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed /snyel/ /su zhig rjes su slob mi byed / /rab brtan dam chos gang gnas pa/ /'di /tsho 'dra'i yon tan thob par 'gyur/ /de phyir lam ni gnyer ba dag /rtag par nan tan chos gnyer 7bya/ /chos kyisang bdag gi khe btsal nas/ /byang chub la ni phan gdags bya/ /brgal rteba'i lan gdabs pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa byams ma'i bu gang pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bcom ldan 'das kyis 'das pa'i dus na 42—638

byang chub sems dpa'i 3)spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe dge ba'i chos rnam pa sna tshogs la shin tu brtan par gnas par gyur pa ni ngo mtshar che lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gang po de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ nga ni yun ring po nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe dge ba'i chos la shin du brtan par gnas par gyur to/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis don 'di nyid rab tu gsal bar bstan pa'i phyir tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal ripa/chos gnyer chos ni gang thob pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas lam gzhi yin / /rtag tu chos la gang brtson pa/ /chos ma yin pa spong bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu yang dag lam spyod pa/ /log pa'i lam ni spong bar byedang/ /sangs rgyas chos la rtag bsten⑧pa/ /de ni lam la bstenashepar 'gyur/ /des na mi khom rnams na spangs nas/ /khom ldan dag ni thob par 'gyur/ /khom ldan gnas ni thob gyurashen/ /brtson 'grus brtsams pa chud mi za/ /gnas gnyis su ni mchog tu btsun⑩/ /kha dog gzugs ni mchog tu 'gyur/ /g.yog 'khor dag ni phun tshogs 7shing / /thams cad kun gyi mchog tu 'gyur/ /brtan pa'i sems kyis rtag tu ni/ /tshul khrims bzod pa'i phyogs la gnas/ /brtson 'grus phyogs la rab gnas shing / /bsam gtan 8shes rab 'phel bar byed/ /rtag tu sems can thams cad kyi / /gtso mchog dag ni byed par 'gyur/ /yon tan kun gyi —mchog gyur pas/ /don rig 'jigs pa ci yang med/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa gang pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta bu'i chos gya rnam pa dag la su zhig slob par mi tshabagyid de/ bdag cag ni sngon dang po nas le lo can du gyur pas sangs rgyas kyi tshamakhyen pa la re ba ma 42—639

mchis shing bdag cag sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa 'di lta bu thob par 'gyur bar 17mngon par yid ches pa ma namachis pa na / 'di ltar nyan thos kyi theg pas bdag nyid nges par byung bar gyur pa cilags so snyam du risemasasngo riso bcom ldan 'das bdag ni deng slan chad byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gzengs stod 7cing / spro ba bskyed nas sangs rgyas kyi chos la dgod par bgyid lags so/ /de'i slad du zhe na/ sangs rgyas 9bcom ldan 'das rnams ni shin tu dka' ba mdzad pa lags pas tshabacom ldan 'das sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe sems can gyi ched du rtag par de lta bu'i shin tu dka' /stoba'i dngos po sha stag mdzad de/ de lta bu'i dngos po de ni dgra bcom pa dang /rang sangs rgyas thams cad la yang ma mchis na/ sems can gzhan la malta smos kyang ci 'tshal bas so/ /bcom ldan 'das de lta bu'i shin tu dka' skuba'i dngos po chen po tshade dag ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen por gyur pa 'ba' zhig gis sems can thams cad la snying brtse ba'i slad du/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe shin tu dka' ba'i bedangos po chen po tshade lta bu tshad ma mchis/ dpag tu ma mchis/ grangs ma mchis pa dag spyad 7pas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' de dag de lta bu'i shin tu dka' ba'i dngos po chen po spyad /de bla na med pa 9yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas / chos kyi 'khor lo yongs su bskor te/sems can sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba rnams yongs su bzla bar bgyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang po de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te / khyod kyis ji skad smras pa de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems 42wa 640

dpa' chen po rnams ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed /nas/ sems can thams cad kyi phan pa dang / bde ba yongs su gnyer ba'i phyir/ sems can thams cad la byams pa dang / snying rje chen po dang ldan pa yin pas/ sems can thams cad kyi ched du byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ de lta bu'i smon lam chen po dang / dka' ba'i dngos po chen po shin tu zab pa/ shin tu dka' ba/ tshad med/ dpag tu med/grangs med pa dang ldan par gyur pa yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces ci bka' stsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa gang po dang / 'khor bzhi po rnams dang / lha dang / mi dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang /lha ma yin du bcas pa thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la rab tu dga' zhing yid ches pas mngon par bstod 5do// // tshe dang ldan pa gang po'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// // 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs le'u stong phrag brgya pa las gang pos zhus pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa rdzogs so// //742—641

dkon ba gas/(17)42—682

༄ga /'phags pa yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/3༄tshog / 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs le'u stong phrag brgya pa las le'u bcwa brgyad pa ste/ yul 'khor skyong gis zhus patshi/ bam po dang po/ri rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya rā pā la pa ri kra nā ma ma hā yā na sru citra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/5 sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na bya rgod kyi ne phung po'i ri la dge slong stong nyis ri brgya lnga bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' lnga stong thams cad kyang spobs pa thogs pa med 9pa/ bzod pa thob pa/bdud 7phyir rgol ba bcom pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la shin tu nye bar gyur pa/ skye ba gcig gis thogs pa/ gzungs thob pa/ ting nge 'dzin 42—683

thob pa/ spobs pa mtha' yas pa thob pa/ mi 'jigs pa thogs pa med pa thob pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs dang / dbang dam pa'i pha rol du son pa nas3/yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad zad mi shes pa sha stag la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po dang / kun tu mig dang /kun tu lta ba dang / kun tu 'od zer dang / kun tu 'od dang / blo gros mchog dang / blo gros 'phel dang / blo gros mtha' yas dang / blo gros rgya chen dang / blo gros mi zad pa dang / sa 'dzin dang / 'gro ba 'dzin dang /rgyal ba'i blo gros dang / khyad par blo gros dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzungs kyi dbang phyug gi rgyal po dang / 'jam dpal la sogs capa byang chub 5sems dpa' dpe med pa 7drug cu nadang / bzang skyong la sogs 9pa skyes bu dam pa bcu drug dang / mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang —/ lha yi ladabang po brgya byin dang / 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi dang /lha'i bu mtshan bzangs dang / lha'i bu blo gros legs gnas dang / lha yi ⑫dbang po thams cad dang / klu yi tshadabang po thams cad chidang / mi'am dici'i dbang po dang / dri za'i dbang po dang / gnod sbyin gyi dbang po dang /lha ma yin gyi dbang po dang / nam mkha' lding gi dbang po pa'akhor brgya stong du ma yod pa thams cad dang / 'khor de nyid du 'dus te 'khod pa rnams dang thabs cig tu bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal gyi snying po'i seng ge'i khri la bzhugs te/ lhun po ltar 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad las ni mngon par 'phags/ nyi ma ltar 'jig rten thams cad la ni snang / zla ba ltar 'gro ba thams cad la dzosnang ba ni mdzad/ tshangs pa ltar rab tu zhi bar 42wa 684

ni bzhugs/ brgya byin ltar sku ni bsnyen par dka'/ 'khor los sgyur zu ba ltar byang chub kyi yan lag gi rin po che bdun dang ni ldan/ seng ge ltar chos thams cad bdag med pa dang stong par ni sgrogs ni/ me'i phung po chen po ltar 'gro ba thams cad la snang ba'i sku dang ni ldan / lha thams cad snang ba'i 5cinor bu rin po che kun nas bsdus pa'i nor bu rin po che'i porgyal po ltar gzi brjid kyis ni (7shin tu 'bar zhing stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bas khyab par mdzad nas/ don shin tu rnam par nges paṇa/chos thams cad kyi dam pa'i pha rol du byon pa/ 'khor gyi nang na bzhugs shing tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs bsgrags pas dzisems can 1thams cad dgo bar byed pa dang ldan pa'i dbyangs kyis chos ston te/ tshangs par spyod pa/ thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po/ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pas/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba yang dag par rab tu ston to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po zhes bya ba 'khor de nyid du 'dus par gyur te 'dug pa des bcom ldan 'das seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa/ nyi chom stong bas dzo/2lhag pa'i 'od kyis 'khor gyi 15dkyil 'khor thams cad zil du brlag ’ par mdzad nas shin tu lhang nanger bzhugs pa mthong ste/ dga' ba dang /mgu ba dang / dad pas 'dun pa'i sems kyis stan las langs nas thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das la tshul dang 'thun 19pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /lha tshogs lha ma yin dang mi 'am ci/ /klu dang nyan thos dag dang sangs rgyas sras/ /'gro ba 'di dag rgyal bas gzi yangs kyis/ /42—685

zil mnan 1khyod ni gser gyi ri ltar gsal/ /rgya mtsho'i dbus na gnas 2kyang rnam mdzes pa/ /lhun po lha yi tshogs kyi gnas lta bur/ /thugs rje'i ngargya mtsho'i 5dbus su de bzhugs te/ /'od zer tshistong phrag brgya dag 'gyed par mdzad / /tshangs pa'i gnas la gnas pa'i tshangs pa de/ /tshangs pa'i mdun na gnas te mngon mdzes ltar/ /bsam gtan rnam thar ting nge 'dzin bzhugs pa//sems can dam pa 'gro ba kun la gsal/ /brgya byin sum cu nartsa gsum lha nang du / /gnas nas gzi brjid yangs pas mdzes pa ltar/ /mtshan gyis spras pa ye shes yon tan phyug /thub pa'i rgyal po 'gro ba kun la gsal/ /gling bzhi mi yi 9bdag po snang ldan pa/ /'jig rten 7'di la ston pa mdzes pa 1ltar/ /'phags pa'i lam du 'dzud par parab mdzad cing / /thugs rje'i skadagongs pa'i thugs mnga' 'di yang mdzes/ /mkha' la nyi ma lam sgome thal tshale ba/ /nor bu me 'od mog mog byed 'di laltar/ /nyi ma stong bas khyad par 'phags pa'i 'od/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma 'gro ba 'di na gsal/ /dri med zla ba nam gyi gung gsal ltar/ /shin tu rnam dag 'gro ba kun la gsal/ /rgyal ba'i zhal ras 7zla ba nya ba 'dra/ /kun 'od zil gyis mnan nas rnam par mdzes ji ltar ri bo'i zom la me 'bar ba/ /mtshan mo mi nyal tsam na kun snang ltar/ /gti mug mun pa ma lus bcom nas ni/ /drang srong chen po'i ye shes 'od kyang gsal / seng ge ’ ri sul brten 19pa'i sgra sgrog cing / /sa la ri dgas sa tshogs rnams skrag bgyid ltar/ /mi dbang stong 2pa bdag med gsung sgrog cing / /pha rol mu stegs 2can rnams skrag 4par mdzad/ /nor bu'i rgyal po bzang po gzi brjid 'bar/ /nor bu thams cad zil mnan lam 5me ltar/ /rgyal ba'i 42wa 686

sku ni gser gyi mdog 'dra ba/ /'gro kun zil gyis mnan nas lam 1mer bzhugs / /'jig rten gang na'ang khyod dang mtshungs ma mchis/ /lhag pa'i sems can mchis par ga la 'gyur/ /bsod nams ye shes brtson 'grus thabs rnams dang / /yon tan kun gyis khyod dang mtshungs ma mchis/ /mi yi dpa' bo 'gro la lam ri me ba/ /mgon po yon tan rgya mtsho bdag gis mthong / /gus pa skyes shing dga' ba rnam par 'phel/ /rgyal ba'i zhabs kyi mthil cal bdag gis gtugs / /yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas 'jig rten sgron/ /grags pa dam pa rgya chen thugs mnga' la / /bdag gis bstod de bsod nams 'dir thob des/ /'gro ba thams cad byang chub mchog reg shog /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal pos bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod nas thal mo sbyar te / mig gnyis mi 'dzums 7par de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la ni lta / chos kyi dbyings nyid pal ni rnam par dpyod/ zab pa dang gting dpag dka' ba dang ske/ mthong bar dka' ba dang / khong du chud par dka' ba dang / brtag par 7mi nus pa dang rtog ge'i spyod pa ma yin pa dang / zhi ba dang / phra —ba la ni 'jug /sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa la ni rjes su rnam par dpyod / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes chos kyi dbyings thams cad du zhugs pa la ni rjes su rnam par sems/ sangs rgyas kyi yul mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa la ni yang dag par lta'i/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i thabs kyi yul gyi spyod yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa la ni 'jug /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos kyi dbyings gcig gi tshul gyi ngo bo nyid la 'jug pa la ni rtog /sangs rgyas bcom 42—687

ldan 'das rnams ni 3gnas 2med pa nam mkha'i spyod yul du ni yang dag par lta / chos thams cad yang dag pa'i mtha' mtha' rlom yin pa'i rang bzhin la 'jug pa la ni mos/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar pa sgrib pa med pa la ni mngon par 'dod/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gekyi sku rtag /pa dang / zhi ba dang /ther zug pa la ni 'jug /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku zhing rab 'byam thams cad kyi rjes su song ba dang / sems can thams cad la mngon du phyogs ⑧pa la ni 'jug /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi yon tanamakhaphyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa'i mur pathug pa med pa ni rjes su dran par byed/ chos kyi dbyings nyid la ni : rnam par dpyod cing byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po 7cang mi smra bar 'dug par 7gyur to/ /de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong mnyan yod du dbyar zla ba gsum gnas par dam bcas te/ de zla ba gsum 'das nas chos gos byas te/ chos gos zin nas de lhung bzod dang chos gos thogs te/ dge slong gi dge 'dun dang / gsar bu las dang po pa sgorab tu byung nas ring po ma lon pa dag dang lhan cig 8tu mthar gyis yul rgyu ba rgyu zhing rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po ga la ba dang /bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri ga la ba der song ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas kyang tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gis thal mo sbyar te tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod do/ /mi mchog 'od mdzad pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /42—688

nam mkha' mtshungs pa'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba yid gnyis gcod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid gsum mthar byon thub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhing rnams bye ba rab 'byamanyekun tu yang / /'dren pa dag ni khyod kyi bsngags pa gsung / /rgyal ba'i sras kyis thos nas rab dga' zhing / /yon tan rgya mtsho thub pa mchod du mchi/ /bde gshegs tshul dang 'thun pas mchod bgyis te/ /thub pa che las rdul bral chos thos nas/ /de dag khyod kyi 5yon tan phreng rjod 5cing / /yid rab dga' nas rang gi zhing du mchi/ /byang chub dam pa mchog ni tshol ba na/ / khyod kyi mthugs ni skyo ba mi mnga' bar/ /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig bsam yas su/ /sems can rnams kyi ched du spyod pa spyad/ /'dren pa khyod kyi 5sbyin dang tshul khrims spyad/ /bzod dang brtson 'grus dang ni bsam gtan bslabs6/ /shes rab thabs dang dbang gi pha rol gshegs/ /des na rnam 'dren che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang dang mngon shes mchog la mkhas/ /dbang po stobs dang rnam par thar pa bslabasang rme/ /sems can kun gyi spyod pa thugs chud rtogs/ /mnyam med ye shes mtsho thol phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba rnams kyi sems rgyud rab tu mkhyen/ /spyod pa gang dang ji ltar las 'byung dang //tshul sgo gang gis rnam par grol 'gyur ba/ /de ni bcom ldan mi yi mchog gis mkhyen/ /'dod chags zhe snang gti mug 'byung ba spong / /gang gis sems can ngan song gsum mchi dang / /gang gis bde 'gror mchi bar 'gyur ba'i las/ /'gro bas legs par bgyis tshadang nongs bgyis mkhyen/ /'gro la / phan mdzad gang dag 'das rnams dang / /da paltar lha dang mi yis skamachod rnams dang / /gang dag lam byon yon tan mchog mthar phyin/ /bde gshegs 42—689

de dag thams cad rab tu mkhyen/ /dag pa'i zhing dang phun sum tshogs 'khor dang —/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang nyan thos dang / /drang srong chen po rnams kyi sku tshe'i tshad/ /rnam pa kun tu ma lus rnam par mkhyen/ /mya ngan 'das nas 1chos gnas ci 'dra dang / /rgyal ba'i ring bsrel mchod pa ci 'dra dang —/ /der ni chos mdzod 'dzin pa ci 'dra ba/ /de dag ma lus mi yi dam pas mkhyen/ /dus gsum rnams su rtag par stobs bcu yi/ /ye shes mkhyen pa sgrib pa mi mnga' 'jug /chos rnams kun la thugs ni chags mi mnga'/ /phyag 'tshal rgyal ba ye shes mtsho khyod la/ /khyod dang mtshungs mnyam ma mchis ga la lhag /skar ma rnams kyis nam mkhar spras pa ltar/ /mtshan rnams kyis kyang sku ni rab spras pa/ /mi mchog thub pa mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzugs kyang mtshungs pa ma mchis yid du mchi/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba zil du rlag par bgyid / /tshangs pa brgya byin 'og min lha yi 5rnams/ /khyod kyi spyan snga stso/de dag mdzes ma lags/ /khyod ni gser gyi ri ltar dri mi mnga'/ /dbu ༷snum 'jam zhing g.yas su 'khyil napar gnas/ /lhun po'i /rgyal po 7lta bur spyi gtsug 'phags/ /bsod nams rgya chen byung ba lam pamer bzhugs/ /'od zer 1 bye ba khrag khrig rab 'gyed cing / /khyod kyi smin ma'i mtshams kyi mdzod spu mdzes / /'gro la ngathugs rje bodagongs pas gang gzigs pa/ /spyan ni ud pal 'dra zhing yid du mchi/ /zla nya ladri med mkha' la ji lta ba / /rnam 'dren khyod kyi zhal ni lam name ste/ /lta 19ba'i skye bo ngoms par mi 'gyur ba/ /zhal bzangs mi yi mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngang pa rma bya ri dgas rgyal gyi stabs//glang po dregs pa dal gyis mchi stabs kyis/ /sa rnams g.yo bar mdzad cing 42wa 690

rab gshegs pa/ /stobs bcu brtul zhugs brtan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag gi sor mo ring zhing skum la mdzes/ /sen mo zangs mdog dag cing dra bas spras/ /bzhengs kyang pus mo'i lha ngar 1reg cing sleb / /sku mdog gser mdog 'dra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor lo dra bas khyab pa'i zhabs 'dor bas / /sa steng ri moralamadzad cing rab tu gshegs/ /zhabs kyi 'od zer 5gyis ni yongs smin pa'i / /mi rnams gum nas lha yi 0'jig rten mchi/ /chos kyi rgyal po nor bdun sbyin pa po/ /chos kyi sbyin bdag dul ba'i thugs mnga' ba chos kyi spyad 0pas 'gro ba rjes ston pa / /'dren pa chos kyi rje 9la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byams pa'i go cha dran pa'i ral gri lamachog /tshul khrims gzhu dang shes rab thabs kyi mda'/ /de yis skye 'chi srid ha sred da'aphel bgyid pa/ /nyon mongs dgra dag rnam par bcom par gyur/ /rgal snyenas sems can khrag khrig rnams kyang sgrol/ /grol nas 'ching chab las ni 'gro ba 'grelas/ /bde gshegs gang gi tshazhi ba'i gnas ’ mchi ba/ /bde ba rims nad ma mchis lam yang ston/ /gang na skye dang 'chi ba ma mchis shing / /'bral ba'i sdug bsngal 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba/ /gnas mchog zhi ba 'dus ma bgyis pa de/ /thugs rjes ’ brnyes nas khyod 19kyis bstan pa mdzad/ /chos kun dbang gi pha rol gshegs pa'i rgyal / /thub pa chen po 'jig rten mchog bstod pas/ /bdag gis 'dir ni bsod nams gang bsags des/ /'gro ba byang chub mngon par 'tshang rgya shog /de nas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gi 2mngon par bstod nas thal mo sbyar te stan las langs nas bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar rite pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas/42—691

bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gal te zhus nas zhu ba lung bstan pa'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyi nyu1bdag la skabs phye na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la bdag phyogs 'ga' zhig zhu lags so na/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /yul 'khor skyong khyod ci dang cici 'dod pa dris 4shig dang / ngas dris pa de dang de nyid kyi lung bstan pas ri khyod kyi sems rangs par bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos du phyodang ldan na chos thams cad kyi yon tan gyi khyad par thob par 'gyur ske/ gzhan la rag ma las pa'i shes pa 'thob1)/ myur ba'i shes rab 'thobatso / spobs pa rnam par nges pa 'thobasna / snang ba 'thobage/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la 'jug pa dang / sems can yongs su smin par bgyid pa dang /yid gnyis spong ba dang / som nyi spong ba dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du rnam par nges pa 'thobang/ sems can 'dzud pa la mkhas pa dang / ji skad smras pa de bzhin du bgyid pa dang / ldem po dag r+shayang dag pa dang / sems can gyi khams la mkhas pa dang / sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa 'thob pa dang /zhu ba thams cad zhu ba dang / chos thams cad 'dzin pa dang / myur dushethams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'thob lapar 'gyur/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong gis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsol to/ /byang chub 42—692

sems dpa'i spyod pa rab nges pa/ /yang dag nyid du ji ltar de 'byungashedang / /ye shes rgya ma66) bka' mchid rnam nges pa/ /mi mchog rgyal bas chibadag la bshad du gsol/ /shin tu sbyangs pa'i gser gyi gzugs lta bu/ /sems can dam pa bsod nams mchog ri bsags pa/ci /khyod ni skyabs dang gnas dang dpung gnyen lags/ /byang chub spyod mchog dri med deng bdag gsungs/ /gzungs dang bdud rtsi byang chub 'byung ba yi/ /ye shes mi zad ji ltar 'thob par 'gyur/ /gang gis skye bo'i dogs chog gcod 'gyur ba/ /shes rab rgya mtsho ji ltar rnam par dag /'khor bar rigemobaskal pa bye ba mang por ni/ /'jig rten sdug bsngal nyen la lta /bgyid kyang / /skyo ba'i blo ni nam yang mi skyed 7cing / /de dag don dge ston 87par 'gyur ba dang / /dag pa'i zhing dang phun sum tshogs 'khor dang / /tshe mchog dang ni phun sum tshogs zhing dang / /sems can ched byu1 kyi bka' mchid bla med dang / /byang chub spyod pa dri med bshad du gsol/ /bdud 'joms tshamadzad pa lta ngan /stostong ba potsha/ /sred pa skems skyopa rnam grol reg tshamadzad pas / /chos kyi tshul yang bskyud par mi 'gyur b.ras//sems can rin chen spyod mchog bstan du gsol/ /gzugs dang longs spyod spobs 7pa phun sum tshogs/ /snum nyi pa'i gsung gis 'khor rnams tshim mdzad pa/zhe / /bde gshegs sprin ltar 'gro ba tshim rtsomadzad pa/ /sangs rgyas spyod yul legs par bstan du gsol/ /ka la ping ku'i sgra snyan gsung 'byin pa/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis blo ngan rab 'jig pa/ /chos 'tshal 27gyur pa'i 'khor rnams lhags lags kyis 2/ /gtso bo bdud rtsi'i ro yis tshim par mdzod/ /byang chub dam pa 22mchog la 'dunang pa mchis/ /chos la 'dun 25pa bzlog pa 442—693

mi rigs te/ /'dren pa bstan pa mdzad pa'i dus 'di lags/ /rin chen dam pa bsgrag pa'i dus la bab/ /thub pa bdag 1ni byang chub re ba mchis/ /bdag gi bsam napa rgyal bas rab tu mkhyen/ /rgyal ba co 'dri rim lags don du gnyer/ /spyod pa dam pa legs par bshad du gsol/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /yul 'khor skyong khyod legs so/ /5yul 'khor skyong khyod ne skye bo mang po la phan pa'i phyir zhugs pa dang / yul 'khor skyong khyod skye bo mang po la bde ba dang / lha dang mi rnams kyi don dang / phan pa dang / da ltar dang / ma 'ongs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams yongs su gzung sgyuba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa la don 'di 'dri na bar sems pa ni legs so/ /yul 'khor skyong khyod /de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung 7shig dang ngas khyod la bshad do/ /bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes gsol te / /tshe tshadang ldan pa yul 'khor skyong 1 bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar nyan lngapa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /yul 'khor skyong byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na yongs su dag pa 'di dag 'thob cipo/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bsam pa dang lhag pa'i bsam pas nan tan byed pa dang / sems can thams cad la sems mnyam pa dang / stong pa nyid sgom tshepa dang / ji skad smras pa de bzhin byed pa ste yul 'khor skyong byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi po de dag dang ldan na yongs su dag pa 'di dag 'thob bo/ /'di 7la 'di ni chos nyid yin te/ de la 'di skad ces bya'o/ /bsam pa thag pas rtag tu 42—694

mngon brtson pa/ /byang chub lam las mi ldog yid ldan pa/ /g.yo med tha ba med cing sgyu med pa/ /ye shes mtha' yas 1ldan la de dag yod/ / skye dang snyen dang rga dang 'chisaphugazir ba/ /sems can mgon med sdug bsngal mthong nas ni / /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol caba'i phyir/ /de dag chos kyi gru ni yang dag sbyor3ri/ /des pa sems can kun la sems mnyam pa/ /bu gcig 7pa bzhin 'gro ba rnams la ltarin/ /'di dag thams cad bdag gis dgrol 95lo zhes / /gang zag mchog gi bsam pa de 'dra'o/ /stong nyid rtag tu rtogs par khong du chud/ /bdag yod ma yin sems can yod ma yin/ /'dus byas sgyu ma rmi lam 'dra ba la/ /byis pa mi mkhas 'di la rnam par rmongs/ /mkhas pa de dag 7ji skad tshig smras pa/ /de la nan tan byed cing kun tu gnas/ /dul zhing zhi la rtag tu skyon rnams spangs/ /rgyal ba'i sras rnams byang chub lam la dga' / /yul 'khor skyong bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi /1dbugs 'byin pa 'thob tshapa ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ gzungs thob pa bodang /dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnyed pa dang / chos zab mo la bzod sgopa thob pa dang /tshul khrims yongs su dag pa yang bodag par spyod pa ste/ yul 'khor skyong bzhi po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dbugs 'byin pa 'thob pa'o/ /'di la 'di ni chos nyid yin te/ de la 'di skad ces bya'o/ /gang gis sangs rgyas kun gyis gsungs pa'i chos mchog 'dzin 'gyur ba/ /gzungs rnams grags pa chen po de dag gis ni rtag tu thob / /nam yang chud zar mi 'gyur phyir zhing blo gros rab tu 'phel/ /de dag ye shes chags pa med cing chos kun pha rol phyin/ /byang chub yan lag 'phel bar byed pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen 42—695

rnyed/ /de dag 'dren pa rnams ni gang nas bzhud pa'i lam mchog ston/ /de dag sdig pa'i grogs po dag la sten0)pa ma yin te/ /tshig byed bdag nyid mesaltar de dgashering du rnam par spong / /dpa' bo stong pa nyid dang ldan pa'i zab mo'i chos thos nas/ /de dag bdag dang sems can srog tu lta ba kun mi 'byung / /de dag tshul khrims skyon med dul zhing zhi ba'i yid dang ldan/ /sangs rgyas tshul khrims bla na med la sems can rnams kyang sbyor/ /yul 'khor skyong bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' 'khor ba na 'khod pa rnams dga' bar byed pa'i chos te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ yul 'khor skyong sangs rgyas mthong ba ༅byang chub sems dpa' 'khor ba na 'khod pa rnams dga' bar byed pa'i chos dang / yul 'khor skyong rjes su 'thun pa'i chos gethos pa byang chub sems dpa' 'khor ba na 'khod pa rnams dga' bar byed pa'i chos dang / yul 'khor skyong bdog pa thams cad yongs su gtong ba byang chub sems dpa' 'khor ba na 'khod pa rnams dga' bar byed pa'i chos dang / yul 'khor skyong dmigs su med pa'i chos la bzod pa byang chub sems dpa' 'khor ba na 'khod pa rnams dga' bar byed pa'i chos te/ yul 'khor skyong bzhi po de 47dag ni byang chub sems dpa' 'khor ba na 'khod pa rnams dga' bar byed pa'i chos so 'di la 'di ni chos nyid tshoyin te/ de la 'di skad ces bya'o/ /gzi brjid kyis ni 'jig rten thams cad kun nas snang mdzad pa'i ri/ /rdzogs nyu)pa'i sangs rgyas mi mchog tshe rabs kun du de dag mthong / /byang chub dam pa mchog mtshol tshe na sems can dgrol ba'i phyir/ /dga' zhing gus par gnas nas /7de ltar mi dbang rgyal po mchod/ /'dren pa rnams las zhi ba rjes su 'thun pa'i chos kyang 42—696

nyan/ /thos nas bsam pa thag pas brtan pa tshul bzhin rab tu sbyor/ /dmigs med chos thos chos 'di thams cad sems can med pa dang / /'di la bdag med par ni chos la som nyi07de mi skyed mi/ /de ni bdog pa thams cad yongs gtong rtag tu kun 'dzin med/ /slong ba nye b.radza 'ongs pa mthong na sems ni rab tu dga'/ /grong dang yul 'khor sa dang srog dang bu dang chung ma dang / /thams cad gtong zhing de yi sems ni gang du'ang gegayo ba med/ /yul 'khor skyong byang chub sems dpasasnyichos bzhi la blta bar mi bya ste/ bzhi gang zhe na yul 'khor skyong byang chub sems dpas khyim gyisheganas la blta bar mi bya ba dang / yul 'khor skyong byang chub sems dpas rab tu byung nas rnyed pa dang / bkur sti la blta bar mi bya ba dang / yul 'khor skyong byang chub sems dpas khyim la 'dris par bya ba la blta bar mi bya ba dang / yul 'khor skyong byang chub sems dpas lus dang srog la blta bar mi bya ba lke )ste/ yul 'khor skyong byang chub sems dpas chos bzhi po de dag la blta bar mi bya'o/ /'di la 'di ni chos nyid yin te/ de la 'di skad ces bya'o/ /skyon gyis gzings pa mtha' yas ldan pa'i khyim spangs rtag tu nor mi blta / /yon tan ldan pa des pa de dag dgon par dga' zhing dbang po dul/ /de dag gang du'ang bud med rnams dang skyes pa dag dang 'dris mi byed/ /bse ltar gcig pur /nyaganas shing bsam pa dri med dag la dri ma bral/ /de dag rnyed pa rnams kyis dga' bar mi 'gyur ma thob 8yid zhum med/ /'dod pa chung ste mngan ngon tsam la dga' zhing sgyu dang tshul 'chos spangs/ /sems can don phyir brtson 'grus yid ldan sbyin dang dul la rab tu gnas/ /sangs rgyas ye shes don 42wa 697

gnyer bsam gtan brtson 'grus yon tan pha rol phyin/ /lus dang de bzhin srog la mi lta sdug pa'i rtsa lag rnam spangs te/ /bsam pa rdo rje lta bur rab brtan rtag tu byang chub lam la sbyor/ /lus ni dum bu dum bur bcad kyang de dag sems la g.yo ba med/ /thams cad mkhyen 17nyid re ba /phyir zhing brtson 'grus shin tu brtan ri'adir rtsom/ /yul 'khor skyong bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gdung ba med par byed pa'i chos te/ bzhi gang zhe na / yul 'khor skyong tshul khrims skyon med pa 4byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gdung ba med par byed pa'i chos dang / yul 'khor skyong dgon pa la gnas pa mi gtong sgrub byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gdung ba med par byed pa'i chos dang —/ yul 'khor skyong 'phags pa'i rigs bzhi dang 'thun par byed pa byang chub sems dga' rnams kyi gdung ba med par byed pa'i chos dang / yul 'bo/ ra skyong mang du thos pa thob par byed pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gdung ba med par byed pa'i chos tephyo/ yul 'khor skyong bzhi po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gdung ba med par byed pa'i chos so/ /'di la 'di ni chos nyid yin te/ de la 'di skad ces bya'o/ /sangs rgyas tshul khrims dam pa 'di la 'dod byed cing / /tshul khrims dri med nor bur 7rin chen 'dra ba srung 8/ /de dag nga ni khrims ldan legs sdom yin mi sems/ /tshul khrims de nyid la ni rtag tu sems can sbyor/ /de dag stong pa dgon par rtag tu gnas par byed/ /de dag bdag gi 'du shes srog gi 'du shes med/ /gzugs kun rtswa dang shing dang rtsig tshopa 'dra bar mthong / /'di la skyes pa bud med bdag gi 7med par mthong / /'phags rigs bzhi la dga' zhing g.yo med tshul 'chos 42—698

med / /bag yod de dag bsam pa thag pas rab tu sbyor/ /thos dang nyu yon tan rnams la rtag tu brtson par byed/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan mthu chen don du gnyer/ /skye rga 5'chi bas bcom zhing nad kyis cagazir gyur pa5//'gro ba mgon med srid pa'i brtson phyir 'dir bltas nasari / /zhi ba dam pa mchog gi chos kyi gru sbyar te/ /srid pa'i rgya mcho1re chu rtelas skye bo sgrol bar byed/ /'dus byas gyur par 'jig rten 'khyams sna pas skyabs mgon dang / /dpung gnyen byed pa gzhan ni gang yang yod min gyis 1/ /bdag gis sems can 'di dag thams cad yongs dgrol zhes/ /de phyir byang chub mchog tu bdag gis smon lam btab / /yul 'khor skyong byang chub sems dpas bzhi po 'di dag ni cang shes kyi 'gros su shes par bya ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ bde 'gro thob 2ste/ de mu yang sangs rgyas 'byung ba dang phrad dpa dang / bla ma la sri lazhu byed de / de yang zang zing med pa'i sems kyis bsten ’ pa dang / bas mtha'i gnas mal la mngon par dga' ste/ de yang rnyed pa dang bkur ste 19la mi lta ba dang /spobs pa thob ste/ de yang zab mo la bzod pa dang ldan pa ste/ yul 'khor skyong byang chub sems dpas chos bzhi po de dag ni cang shes kyi 'gros su shes par bya'o/ /'di la 'di ni chos nyid yin te/ de la 'di skad ces bya'o/ /brtan 1pa nags dang 2sul na rtag tu gnas par byed/ /de dag rtag tu khor mor 2rnyed pa don gnyer min/ /chags med blo can rtag tu spobs 24dang ldan pa yin / /zab mo'i chos la mkhas shing spros pa rnams dang bral/ /rtag tu khor skumor bla ma rnams la sri zhu byed/ /de dag ji skad smras pa de bzhin de dag sbyor/ /bde gshegs dpag tu med pa mang po mnyes par byed/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes ched 42wa 699

du mchod pa rgya chen byed/ /grags pa chen po rnams kyi 'gro ba gtso bor 'gyur/ /lha mi rnams kyi nang na spyi bor phyin pa yin/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub lam la rtag tu sems can 'dzud/ /dge ba bcu po dag la'ang yang dag sbyor bar byed/ /sangs rgyas yon tan thos nas de dag dgar tsho1'gyur te/ /de dag ring por mi thogs nga dzodang nye bar gyur no/ /de dag byangatswachub rdul bral dam pa sangs rgyas nas / /sems can khrag khrig sdug bsngal mtha' yas rnams las 'gre'akha/ /yul 'khor skyong bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i yispyod pa yongs su sbyong ba'i chos te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ khong khro ba med pa'i semasam byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang / tshul 'chos pa dang /kha gsag 9dang / thob kyis 'jal ba yongs su spangs te dgon par gnas pa dang ske/ bdog pa thams cad yongs su gtong zhing rnam par smin pa la re ba med pa dang / nyin mtshan du chos 'dod cing chos smra ba rnams la 'khrul pa mi tshol ba ste / yul 'khor skyong bzhi po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su sbyong ba'i pachos so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub 'dod pa na/ /tha ba dri ma med cing khro sems med/ /de ni su la'ang skyon tshol byed ma yin/ /g.yo med tshul 'chos med cing spros sems med/ /khyim gyi blo gros ya nga / mya ngan rtsa/ /skye bo ngan 'grogs tshul bzhin ring 'gyur ba / /spangs te de la mi lta rab byung nas/ /thar pa 'dod pa ri khrod gnas par byed/ /dgon pa bas mtha'i rnam dpa bsten pas 3 na/ /shes khe 'thob ḍipa kun la mi rton mazhing / /lus dang srog la'ang lta tebar mi byed la/ /seng ge 42—700

lta bur gnas shing dgra las rgyal/ /byang chub lam phyir ye shes tshol ba na/ /ngan ngon tsam gyis chog par 'dzin byed cing / /rtag tu bya ltar sogs pa spangs nas ni/ /'jig rten kun la gnas pa ma yin no/ /dper na bse ltar gcig pu 3)gnas byed cing / /seng ge lta bur 'jigs pa yod ma yin/ /ri dgas lta bur sar mi'ajigs yid mi rton/ /de ni mchod pas khengs par 'gyur ba med/ /g.yang sar lhung geba'i 'gro ba 'di bltas nas/ /rab tu thar bar bya phyir 5'bad par byed/ /gal te bag 6yod dge ba'i chos spyod na/ /bdag kyang 'gro ba 'di yi thodapung gnyen 'gyur/ /mi mchog spyod pa 'di dag 'dod pa na/ /'dzum pa'i bzhin gyis rab bstan na tshig smras zhing / /sdug dang mi sdug brtag tu rtog /7sems med/ /rlung dang 'dra bar chags pa med par gnas/ /stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med la mos/ /'dus byas kun la sgyu ma lta sna bur rtog /yangs pa'i blo can zhi dang dul la dga'/ /de ni rtag tu bdud rtsi'i ro yis mgu/ /ci nas byang chub lam ni sgrub byed pacing / /de ni rtag tu bsam pa yongs su sbyong / /gzungs dang spobs pa tshol bar byed pa na/ /yon tan 'dod pa sdug bsngal brgya dag bzod/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 'di bltas nas/ /gang zhig don mdu gnyer pade dgar 7'gyur ro snye/ /gang zhig byang chub 'di la ma mos pa19/ /blo chung de ni nyes pa brgya yang skyed / /yul 'khor skyong bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa'i g.yang sa ste / bzhi gang zhe na/ yul 'khor skyong ma gus pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi g.yang sa dang ske/ yul 'khor skyong byas pa mi gzong zhing g.yo la sten 2 pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi g.yang sa dang / yul 'khor skyong rnyed pa dang bkur ste cil 42—701

chags pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi g.yang sa dang / yul 'khor skyong tshul 'chos pa dang kha gsag tsho1gis rnyed pa dang bkur sti sgrub ri pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi g.yang sa ste / yul 'khor skyong bzhi po de padag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi g.yang sa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i satshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /'phags pa pobla ma rnams ri dang pha ma la/ /de dag rtag tu gus napa med pa yin/ /de dag byas pa mi gzo g.yon 9can te/ /rtag tu kun tu ma bsdams spyod cing rmongs/ /rnyed la rtag tu chags shing zhen pa ste/ /de dag tshul 'chos pa dang g.yo sbyor dga'/ /kha cig tshul khrims brtul zhugs ji ltas 7kyang / /'di na bdag dang mtshungs pa med ces smra/ /de dag phan tshun snang 1bar sems pa paste/ /glags tshol ba la rtag tu brtson pa yin/ /de dag zhing gi las dang tshong la dga'/ /de dag skudage sbyong yon tan shin tu ring / /phyi ma'i dus na 'di ltar ma bsdams pa'i/ /dge slong tshul khrims yon tan rab ring ba/ /de dag mtshang 'dru bab dang 'thab pa dang / /phrag dog dbang gis chos 'di nub dpar byed/ /byang chub lam las rtag par shin du ring / /'phags pa'i nor las de dag shin tu ring / /'phags lam gya rnam larnam par spangs nas ni/ /de dag 'gro ba lngar ni 'khyam stupar 'gyur/ /yul 'khor skyong bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub la bgegs byed pa'i chos te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ yul 'khor skyong le lo byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub la bgegs byed snyepa'i chos dang /yul 'khor skyong ma dad pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub la bgegs byed pa'i chos dang / yul 'khor skyong nga rgyal byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 42—702

byang chub la bgegs byed pa'i chos dang / yul 'khor skyong pha rol gyi mchod pa la phrag dog dang ser sna'i sems dang ldan pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 3byang chub la bgegs byed pa'i chos te/ yul 'khor skyong bzhi po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub la tshabagegs byed pa'i chos so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /ma dad le lo rtag tu rmongs pa'i sems/ /de dag mngon pa'i nga can rtag tu khro/ /bzod ldan rtagakhubartson dge slong mthong nas ni/ /gtsug lag khang nas 'gro tshe dbyug pas deg /pha rol mchod phyir 'di 2ni phrag dog skye/ /de dag sems ni gnas pa yod ma yin/ /glags lta byed cing 'khrul popa tshol ba can/ /su la 'khrul 7yod gang la gleng — ribya snyam/ /de dag nga yis bstan pa 'di las ring / /de dag yon tan dngang 7zhing ngan song gzhol/ /de dag rgyal ba'i bstan pa bor nas ni/ /ngan song shin tu mi bzad 'bar /nyabar 'gro/ /de dag rnams kyi sdig pa'i spyod pa dang / /chos min ldan 'gro rab sdig 'di 12thos nas/ /rtag tu 'khor 7mor byang chub lam la sbyor/ /ngan 'gror skyes shing gdung bar gyur ta re/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten phan pa drang srong che/ /bskal pa bye mang brgya lamasa'abyung bar 'gyur/ /da daltar dal ba dam pa rnyed pa la/ /gal te thar 'dod bag med spong tshabar gyis/ /yul 'khor skyong gang zag bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpas 7bsten par mi bya ba ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ yul 'khor skyong byang chub sems dpas sdig pa'i bshes gnyen gyi gang zag bsten par mi bya ba dang / yul 'khor skyong byang chub sems dpas dmigs par lta ba can gyi gang zag bsten par mi bya ba dang / yul 'khor skyong byang chub sems dpas 42—703

dam pa'i chos spong ba'i gang zag bsten par mi bya ba dang // yul 'khor skyong byang chub sems dpas zang zing la brkam pa'i gang zag bsten par mi bya ba ste/yul 'khor skyong gang zag bzhi po de tshadag ni byang chub sems dpas bsten par mi bya ba'o / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /gang dag sdig pa'i bshes gnyen rnam spong zhing / /gang dag dge ba'i bshes gnyen sten 5byed pa/ /de dag rtag tu byang chub lam la 'phel / /dper na mkha' las 0zla ba yar ngo bzhin/ /dmigs par lta la rtag tu zhen pa dang / /bdag dang srog dang gso bar zhen pa dag /de dag dug phyis bzhin du rtag tu spong / /gang dag sangs rgyas ye shes don mi gnyer/ /gang dag mi mchog rnams kyi zhi ba'i chos/ /'dod chags bral ba 9bdud rtsi 'thung 4spong ba/ / de dag dper na ngan skyugs rdzab bzhin spong pa/ /gang zhig byang chub dam pa 'tshang rgyar pa'adod/ /zang zing dag dang chos gos lhung bzed chags/ /rtag tu khyim la 'dris par byed brtson pa/ /de dag rnams dang 'dris —par mi bya ste/ /de dag me yi pa'obs bzhin spang bar bya/ /gang zhig bdud ni gdul bar bya ba dang / /'khor lo dam pa bla med bskor ba dang //de ltar sems can don yang labyed 'dod pa/ /des ni sdig pa'i bshes 7gnyen spang bar bya/ /gang zhig byang chub dam pa 'tshang rgyar 'dod/ /de yis snyernyed dang sdug dang mi sdug dang / /grags dang mtshang 'dru 9phrag dog da spangs te/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rtag tu btsal bar bya/ /yul 'khor skyong bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sdug bsngal rnam par smin pa'i chos te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ yul 'khor skyong shes pas mngon par rlom sems su byed pa byang 42—704

chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sdug bsngal rnam par smin pa'i chos dang / yul 'khor skyong phrag dog dang ser sna dang ldan pa'i sems byang chub sems medapa' rnams kyi sdug bsngal rnam 5par smin pa'i chos dang / yul 'khor skyong ma mos pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sdug bsngal rnam par smin pa'i chos dang /yul 'khor skyong yongs su ma dag pa'i shes pa dang / bzod pa'i longs spyod yongs su tshol ba byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sdug bsngal rnam par smin pa'i chos te/ yul 'khor skyong bzhi po 'di cadag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sdug bsngal rnam par smin pa'i chos so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /gang dag sa la chos ni 'dzin gyur zhing 5/ /'gro ba thams cad kyis kyang mchod 'gyur ba/ /de la mi shes pas ni brnyas tshobyed na/ /des na de ni 7sdug bsngal mtha' yas rnyed/ /ya nga bas nani gang zhig longs spyod tshol9/ /shes pa ma dag rtag tu 'dun cing 'dod/ /gang zhig rtag tu nga rgyal khengs gyur la/ /bla ma 'phags pa'i skye bo mi 'dud cing / /sangs rgyas la yang mos pa yod min la 1/ /chos dang tshogs la de ni mos pa med/ /bslab dang sbyangs pa rnams la de mi mos/ /sdig pa'i blo can ngan song gsum phyogs pa/ /de ni mi nang 'di nas shi 'phos nas/ /las kyi dbang gis 2mi mkhas rnam par rmongs/ /dmyal ba'am 'on te dud 'gro'i 'gro rnams sam//yi dgas tsha'agro ba rnams su sdug bsngal rnyed/ /gang zhig 'jig rten sgron 'gyur blo bldan zhing / / mi yi tshadapa' bo sdug bsngal mthar phyin 7pa/ /de yis ngan song lam rnams rab spangs te/ /byang chub lam ni rtag tu bsten 1 par bya// //bam po gnyis pa/ yul 'khor skyong bzhi po 'di dag ni byang chub sems 42—705

dpa' rnams kyi 'ching ba ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ཿ pha rol la brnyas②pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'ching ba dang / 'jig rten pa'i thabs kyis bsgom pa la sbyor ba dang / mtshan ma'i 'du shes byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'ching ba dang / kun 'dzin pa'i sems dang ldan pa dang / ye shes dang bral ba dang / bag med pa la sten par byed ripa byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'ching ba dang / phyir 'brang ba'i sems kyis khyim la 'dris par byed pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'ching ba ste/ yul 'khor skyong bzhi po de dag gi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'ching ba'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /rtag tu gzhan dag la ni brnyas byed cing / /rtag tu 'jig rten pa yi 5bsam gtan sgom / /ltar gyur 'di dag gis ni de bcings te/ /glang po lus ring 'dam du song ba bzhin/ /khyim la 'dris byed 'ching dang ldan pa dang / /gang zhig bag 75med rtag tu kun 'dzin sems/ /ye shes spangs shing blo gros rmongs gyur pa/ /mi rigs spyod pa 'di dag rnams kyis bcings/ /gang zhig sdug bsngal 'jigs na pa 'di dag dang ske/ /skye rga rte'achi la sogs dzilas grol 'dod pa nya/ /brnyas par byed dang rlom sems bor nas ni/ /byang chub lam la rtag tu brtson par 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal mtha' yas ma lus bzod byas tetsha/ /bde ba kun la chags pa med gyur nas / /sdug dang mi sdug gnyen pa ma lus btang / /brtan pa dag ni sdig bral sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /pha rol phyin lodrug sa dang yon tan dang / /stobs dang dbang po dag dang shes la sbyor/ /yon tan kun bdang rtag rkye ldan gyur nas8/ /rga 4ba'i dra ba grol ba'i sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /bskal pa bsam gyis mi khyab sngon 12—706

spyad /tshe/ /sems can phan phyir byang chub mchog don du/ /sbyin dang dul dang des tshal rtag tu spyad/ /gnyen pa spangs nas bde bar gnas par gyur / /bas mtha' mchinags su rtag par nga dga' 5ste/ /byang chub ched du bsam pa rnam par sbyangs / /brgya lam na yang brtson 'grus nyams ma gyur/ /skyes chen rnams kyi ci ye shes de 'dra'o/ /srid pa'i brtson rar 'gro ba lnga 'khyams 9pas//sems can 'khyam 7pa'i 'gro ba mthong nas ni/ /sngon chad 'dir ni snying rje rgya chen bskyed/ / /'gro ba'i don du byang chub dam pa bsgrubs/ /bskal pa mang por byang chub mchog tshol zhing / /rang gi bu pho bu mo chung ma sdug /phangs pa'i srog dang shin tu 'byor sa shadang / /grong khyer nor dang 'bru rnams mang po btang / /me tog 'bras bu chu 'byor nyams dga' ba'i/ /nags su thub pa nga ni bzod dgar gyur/ / ka ling borgyal pos lag khupa rkang pa bcad/ /de tshe nga ni sdang ba'i yid ma gyur/ /nags dang sul na sngo dbasangs zhes bya ba'i/ /thub pas bla ma rgas 4pa gso 7ba na/ /mi yi dbang pos sra ba'i mdas bsnun kyang ske/ /yid ni yongs su gnod par sems ma gyur/ /legs par gsungs pa'i ched du g.yang sa nas/ /lus la ma bltas rab tu mchongs par gyur lha/ /ngas ཿ9ni byang chub mchog gi rgyu yis phyir/ /lus dang srog la bltas par ma gyur to/ /stag mo bu dang bcas pa'i srog gi phyir/ /lus btang nas ni stag mo tshim par byas/ /nam mkha' las ni lha yi 2tshogs rnams kyi snye/ /skyes chen brtson 'grus brten pa 2 legs shes cibasgrags/ /gang tshe sngon chad srid par spyod pa nas/ /sbyin la rab dga' bram ze khye'ur gyur tshe / /rin chen ched du rgya mtsho bskams sngonas ni/ /nor bu rnyed nas sems can bde bar byas/ /42—707

rgyal po zla ba'i bu zhes byar 17gyur te/ /rjod 5pa grags shing nga ni spyod pa'i tshe/ /nga yis bden pa'i tshul gyis rgyal po brgya/ /bsad cipar byas pa myur du thar bar byas/ /dbul zhing sdug bsngal ba yi mi mthong nas/ /nga 5yis phangs pa'i lus ni btang 0byas te/ /nga yis nor rnyed de ni phyug por byas/ /de tshe nga ni kun sbyin rgyal por gyur/ /nga sgyu'adir mi yi 8rgyal por gyur pa'i tshe/ /skyabs su 'ongs pa'i phug ron mthong nas ni/ /rang gi lus las sha yang bcad byas te//rang lus ngas btang 'jigs pas phongs 9ma btang / /rgyal po ral pa can zhes sngon gyur tshe/ /sman pa mchog gis nga yi ched du ni/ /mtshungs med sman rnams ma 7lus sbyar 11ba yang / /srog btang nas pani de dag gzhan la byin/ /'gro ba'i don phyir sngon chad spyod pa na/ /rgyal bu mche ba bzang zhes bya pagyur tshe / /chung ma ma dri 5khyo las mi 'phyo ba/ /bur bcas bu mo ma chags ma bltas btang ske/ /gang tshe brtson 'grus 'bar zhes byar 'gyur tshe/ /nga sngon lo ni stong du tshang bar yang / /bya dka' brgyad cu lam bzhi bzod par byas/ /nor dang dpal yang sngan 7chad ngas btang ngo / /rgyal bu gzi brjid dri ma med gyur tshe/ /nga yis rgyal ba'i ring bsrel mchod rten mdun / /mchog tu gus pas lus la me btang ste/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba rnams la mchod pa byas/ /nga ni rgyal po zla 'od gyur pa'i tshe/ /mi bzad mig can khros par gyur nas ni/ /de yis nga yi /rtomago bo bslangs pa na/ /de tshe nga yis mgo bo bcad de byin/ /nga ni bsod nams mnyam zhes byar 2gyur tshe/ /grong dang grong khyer dag dang lam srang sgo / /thams cad du yang rgya che sman gyi rnams/ /de dag sems can don phyir ngas bzhag go/ /srid pa rnams la suspyod pa gang gi tshe/ /nga sngon rgyal po dge bar 42—708

gyur pa na/ /bud med gzugs bzang gser dang mu tig gis/ /lus brgyan stong dag ngas ni btang 1ba byas/ /gang tshe nga sngon mi yi rgyal po ni/ /rin chen gtsug phud 0gyur tshe me tog dang / /spos mchog rnams dang gser gyis brgyan pa yi/ /cod pan dpal ldan dam pa ngas btang cingo / /nga sngon 5rgyal po mos ldan gyur pa'i tshe/ /shing bal 'da' ba ca'ajam pa lta bu dang / /pad ma'i 'dab mnyen lta bur 'jam gzhon pa'i/ /lag pa rkang pa dag kyang ngas btang ngo ske/ /ded dpon seng ge 'dzin du gyur pa na/ /snying rje med cing mi bzad rab gtum pa'i / /srin mo brgya dag shin tu tshar bcad nas/ /rgya shug gling du mi rnams bkod 9par gyur/ /gang tshe mig bzangs zhes 7byar gyur pa na/ /byis pa 1'dod dang ldan zhing yid rmongs pa/ /srin mo dag la na chung 'du shes pa / /tshong pa lnga brgya de dag thar bar byas/ /gang tshe bsod nams 'od zer pagyur pa na/ / lha yi skabu mo lta bu'i gzugs ldan pa'isgo/ /bud med bye ba phrag bzhi spangs nas su/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa la ni rab tu byung / /sems can don phyir nga ni spyod pa na/ /dri med dag pa'i gser gyi mdog can gyi/ /rgyal por gang tshe nga ni gyur pa na/ /sor mo dra bas 'brel skab rgya chen btang / /rgyal po ud pal mig ces byar 7gyur tshe/ /pad ma sngon po bzang po'i mdog 'dra'i mig /yid du 'ong zhing snying du sdug gyur pa/ /'gro ba'i don du nga yis btang ba byas/ /sman pa'i rgyal po skra 'drar gyur pa'i tshe/ /sdug dang bral bas nyen pa mthong nas ni/ /bud med cha byad gzugs la 7blo nyams pa/ /ngas ni snying rjes yongs su thar bar ’ byas/ /sngon gyi srid par kun mthong gyur pa na/ /nad kyis btab pa'i 19nad pa'i mi mthong nas/ /nga yis rang gi khrag kyang byin 42—709

gyur 1te/ /mi de ngas ni nad dang bral bar byas/ /rgyal po 5me tog bzang zhes byar gyur tshe/ /nga yis lus las rus pa phyung nas ni/ /nad kyis ring bar gyur la rkang byin te/ /ngas ni nam yang sems can ma btang ngo / /rgyal po don grub ces byar 5sngon gyur tshe/ /rang gi mdzod rnams thams cad ngas btang zhing / /phangs 5shing yid du 'ong ba'i srog btang ste/ /phongs par gyur pa'i mi ni thar bar byas/ /rgyal po phyogs kyi tog du gyur pa'i tshe/ /byang chub 'dod nas 'gro ba'i don gyi phyir/ /'khor lo'i mtshan can pad ma lta bu yi/ /lag pa phrugs kyang ma bltas 9rab tu byin/ /rgyal po thams cad mthong chos gyur pa'i tshe/ /snying rje ldan zhing 'gro don phan 'dod do / /skyes pa bud med dag gis rgyas pa yi/ /gling bzhi pa yang ngas ni btang ba rta byas/ /rgyal po'i bu mo ye shes ldan gyur tshe/ /'jam zhing mnyen la dri med dkar ba'i brlam/ /dga' zhing mgu ba'i yid kyis bcad nas ni/ /rang gi sha dang khrag kyang ngas byin no/ /bud med gzugs ldan zhes ni byar 'gyur tshe/ /bud med bkres d+kusgom nyam thag ngas mthong nas/ /gser ltar ser zhing shin tu gzhon pa yis/ /nu ma snying du sdug pa gnyi sngag btang na/ /rgyal po dpal grags zhes sna byar gyur pa na/ /shin tu nyams dga' ba yi rgyan mchog dang / /rin chen du ma gos dang shing rta bzhon/ /gtang 0bar dka' ba rnam pa du ma gtangang / /rgyal bu byas pa gzo bar gyur pa'i tshe/ /rgya mtsho las ni byas pa mi gzo bsgral/ /rin chen phyir ni de byuyis nga mig phyung / /'on kyang nga la khros pa'i sems med do/ /srog chags go dhar sasngon srid gyur pa'i tshe/ /grog 4sbur dag ni 'chi bar 'gyur dogs nas/ /lus kyi dam pa ma bltas btang ba nabyas/ /de tshe nga yi sems ni 42—710

g.yo ba med/ /spyad pa spyod tshe bya sreg gyur pa na1/ /rgan la bsnyen bkur bya bar rtag dga' ste/ /nga ni rim gro gus la rab tu dga'/ /nga rgyal ldan pa ma yin khengs pa med/ /skyabs su 'ongs pa'i don phyir nga yis ni/ /snying rje bskyed pa byas nas lus btang ste/ /gdol pa'i nami yis mda' rnams bsnun kyang ni/ /spre'ur gyur ngas cani: de ma btang ngo / /rgyal po dbang du gyur tshe nga yis ni/ /glang po bla ma rgan dran lus bskams te/ /shin tu yid 'ong 5zas kyang ngas ma zos/ /de tshe glang po bdag nyid thar bar 'gyur / /bgrod dka' gangs can ri la dred dbang gyur / /nga yis zhag bdun bar du bsrungs pa'i mi/ /de ri yis gsod pa nga la btang byas kyang / /ngas 9ni de tshe khong khro byas pa med / /kha ba kun da pa'adra ba'i glang por gyur/ /byang chub mchod rten sangs rgyas yon tan tshol/ /dug dang bcas pa'i mda' yis bsnun kyang ni/ /mche ba dam pa byin gyi khros pa med/ /dum bu'i gling du nags tshal spyod yul ba/ /sreg pa'i phrug gu byams la gnas gyur tshe/ /mthong ba tsam gyis me ni me zhi gyur nas / /lha tshogs dag gis me tog rnams kyang gtor/ /ri dgas gyur tshe gang gā'i rlabs pashugs kyis/ /khyer ba zhig ni nga yis bsgral byas pa/ /de yis gsod pa mang gan 7khrid de 'ongs/ /'on kyang de la nga ni 7yid ma khros/ /rgya mtsho'i dbus su son ste tshamagon med pa/ /tshong pa lnga brgya dag ni bsgral byas nas / /bkres pa de dag rnams kyis bsad 7gyur tshe/ /ru 1/sbal skye 19gnas gyur kyangam byams dang ldan/ /nga ni byang chub spyad pa spyod pa na/ /sngon chad chu na rgyu ba'i nyar gyur tshe/ /sems can phan phyir nga yis lus btang ste/ /srog chags brgya stong dag gis zos par gyur/ /srog chags des par gang tshe gyur pa 42—711

na/ /nad brgyas gzir ba'i 'gro ba mthong nas su༅/ /lus ni sman lta bur yang bsgyur byas te/ /sems can bde zhing nad kyang med par byas/ /ri dgas rgyal po seng ger gyur pa'i tshe/ /mthu stobs ldan par gyur cing snying rjer0ldan/ /mda' yis bsnun kyang khros pa'i sems med de/ /de tshe gsod la nga yis byams pa byas/ /dung dang ba mo lta bu'i rta rgyal du/ /nga sngon rgya mtsho'i ngogs su gyur pa'i7tshe/ /srin mo'i nang du son pa'i༄tshong pa rnams/ /nga yis snying brtse snying rje bskyed nas bsgral/ /'gro ba'i don du byang chub spyad spyod tshe/ /'dab bachags ku na lar ni nga gyur tshe/ /'dod pa'i yon tan nyes pa mang ༅spangs nas/ /bud med dbang du nga ni thosong ma gyuradu / /gel ba'i ḍānags gnas ri bong gyur pa'i tshe/ /legs spyod pari bong tshogs gyur de la bstan/ /thub pa gnas la gnas pa bkres phongs pa/nya/ / de yi 8ched du ngas ni lusam kyang btang / /sdong po me tog 'bras rgyas ne tso'i༄tshe/ /sdong po skams 8kyang ngas ni de ma btang / /de tshe brgya byin byas gzos nga mthong nas//sdong po de ni lo 'bras rgyas par byas/ /nga ni spra yi rgyal por gyur pa'i tshe/ /mi yi rgyal popha/)klu yis yul bcom ste/ / spra yi lha tshogs la gnod pa byung mthong nas / /rgyal po'i 'jigs las de dag ngas bton to rme/ /nga sngon ne tsor gyur te pha ma'i phyir/ /sā༄1lu blangs tshe mi yis bzung nas ni/ /ne tso ci phyir nga yi sā stelu len/ /lo tog smin 'di ma rung ci byar sems sam/ /ne tso des smras bzang po gsan du gsol/ /bdag ni rku bas khyod kyi 'bras mi len/ /pha ma rgan rgon gnyis ni gso ba'i phyir/ /de la snying rjesamachubadag gis snga lu blangs/ /gang tshe thogasam sa bon 'debs pa'i tshe tsho/ /'gro ba kun la cha du nyeshas sbyin no 42—712

zhes/ /de skad tshig smras de ni bdag thos te/ /des na bdag ni rku bar 3)gzhar mi 'gyur/ /ne tso legs so sā〈 lu ci dgar khyer/ /srid skezhu 'di ni mi yi nang na'angasadakon/ /khyod ni mi yin nga 'dir sa dud 'gro yin/ /legs so khyod ni dul zhing50 yang dag bsngams/ /byang chub rdul bral dam pa tshol ba na/ /sngon chad spyod pa de la sogasasnyopa rnams/ /spyadapopa'i tshe na dka'apo ba brgya bol yang ske/ /nga yi yid ni skyo bar gyur pa med/ /nang gi dag gam 'on te phyir rtsi yang rung / /nga yis dngos po ma btang ngagang yang med/ /tshul khrims bzod dang de bzhin brtson 'grus dang / /bsam gtan thabs dang shes rab ngas spyad do/ /sha dang pagasas pa de bzhin rkang dang khrag /de dag rang gi 8lus las sbyin pa byas/ /bas mtha' dag dang phug na rgyu ba'i tshe/ /ngas ni de 8tshe lus ni skams 8par byas/ /gang tshal sbyar na rgyal bar 'gyur ba yi/ /sbyangs / pa gang dag rgyal bas bstan mdzad pa/ /sbyangs pa de la rtag tu rab brtson te/ /sngon spyod tshe na nga ni rtag tu 'jug /spyod pa'i tshe na nga yis gang bsten pa/ /brtul zhugs rgya chen de 'dra de dag dang / /spyod pa 'di thos nas ni de dag rnams/ /tshig gcig la yang 'dun par mi 'gyur ro/ /'di /9thos gyur nas de yi0 7tshe na ni/ /bstan pa 'di nyid la ni 'phya bar 'gyur/ /de dag zas dang 'khrig pa lhur len cing / /rtag tu gnyid non khub ltar g.yo ngan 'gyur/ /rtag tu 'phags pa ma yin chos la sdang ri 2/ /bstan pa sun 'byinas byed cing yon tan nyams/ /zhi ba'i chos ni 24thos par gyur pa na/ /'di ni rgyal bas gsungs pa min zhes zer / /nga yi slobasadapon thos pa rgya mtshor gyur/ /mang du thos pa smra ba'itha tshogatso bo yin/ /de yis 'di ni rnam pa ji ltar yang / /sangs rgyas 42—713

bka' ma yin zhes dgagapha3pa byas/ /pha rol las kyang rgan par gyur de yi/ /bla ma de ni dpag med yon tan chung / /des kyang 'di ni blang ba ma byas kyi②/ /'di la ma 'jug ri'adi ni nor ba yin/ /gang la bdag yod ma yin srog med dang ske/ /rnam pa cis 4kyang gang zag med bstan pa/ /tshul khrims sbyor dang sdom pa'i bya ba la/ /gang 'bad de yi ngal ba 45don med 'gyur/ /gal te thegasaskupa chen po yod na ni/ /'di la bdag dang sems can shedamacho skyes med/ /gang la bdag dang sems can mi dmigs pa/ /de la bdag gis ngal byas don med 'gyur / /sdig pa'i blo dang mu stegs ngan mtshungs pas/ /rang gi blo yis rang bzor nabyed pa ste/ /dge slong 'khor gyi nang du rgyal ba ni/ /tshig 'di gsung bar nam yang mi 'gyur ro / /ngo tsha khrel dang 'dzem dang bral ba dang / /khu ltar spyi brtol 0che la rgod :nyagatum zhing / /phrag dog nga rgyal rgyags pasapha tshig pa yi/ /dge slong dag ni nga yi bstan la 'byung / /lag pa dang ni rkang pa rdob byed cing / /chos gos grwa parnams kyang ni skyog 7par byed/ /chos gos thogs shing chad dang rgyags myos nas/ /grong dang khyim dag tu ni rnam par rgyu/ /de dag sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan thogs nas ni/ /khyim na gnas pa'i skye bo sten 8par byed/ /bstan lapa yon tan phung po 'di spangs nas/ /de dag rtag tu phrin 7yig khyer bar /byed/ /de dag ba lang rta dang bong bu dang / /de dag phyugs dang bran pho bran mo srel/rte/ /zhing rtsogi las dang tshong gi sbyor ba la/ /brtson yid ldan zhing rtag tu 'phags ma yin/ /de dag 'phags min tshig 7kyang mi smra med/ /bya ba ma yin pa yang gang yang med/ /de dag rnams la mchod rten nor dang ni/ /dge 'dun gyi dang gang zag nor deng mtshungs/ /dge slong 42—714

yon tan 'byor pa mthong nas ni/ /de dag la yang mi snyan rjod byed 1de/ /tshul khrims 'chal pa paslu ba zhugs nas ni/ /bud med 'jigs 5byed mi bzad rab ces rjodang/ /rab tu byung ba de dag brkam 5pa ltar/ /khyim pa 'dod pas brkam 0pa de ltar min/ /khyim pa mtshungs par de dag chung ma dang / /bu dang bu mo dag kyang yod par 'gyur/ /gang gi khyim du de dag chos gos dang / / lus dang 9longs spyod dag gis bsnyen bkur ba/ / de yi 7chung ma la ni yongs chags shing / /nyon mongs dbang 'gro rtag tu 'phags pa min/ /'dod pa 'di dag bsten bya ma yin te/ /dud 'gro yi dgas dmyal bar ltung pabyed ces/ /de dag khyim pa rnams la rtag smra zhing / /de dag bdag nyid ma dul nyer bozhi min/ /ji ltar de dag bdag nyid ma dul ba/ /de dag slob ma tshogs kyang rab ma dul/ /kha zas dag dang 'khrig pa'i gtam k+ṣirnams la/ /de dag nyin bodang mtshan du 'gro bar byed/ /bsten lapa'i phyir gyi yon tan phyir min te / /de dag la ni de dag bsdu ba sbyin/ /'gro las rtag 'dir mchod pa thob snyam nas/ /rang gi slob ma'i tshogs kyis bdag kyang bskor/ /de dag skye bo rnams la smra ba ni/ /bdag gis snying rjes 'di dag sdud byed kyi/ /slob ma'i tshogs de dag las nam yang ni/ /rim gro don du gnyer ba med ces smra/ /de la nad kyis non dang mdze snyecan mang / /lus la sha bkra can dang gzugs mi sdug /rtag tu 'phags min mi dag kha cig kyang / /'ongs zhing lhags 9pa rab tu 'byin par 'gyur/ /lung nod pa dang sdom pa rnam par nyams/ /de dag dge slong yon tan rtag mi brtson/ /de dag khyim pa ma yin dge slong 2 min//de dag spangs pa dur khrod shing dang mtshungs/ /de dag so sor thar dang bslab 42—715

pa dang / /'dul ba la yang gus par byed mi 'gyur/ /de dag rang nyams 3rang dbang 'gro ba ste/ /lcags kyo btang ba'i glang po'i dbang po 'dra/ /de dag nags su gnas par gyur kyang ni/ /sems ni grong du 'gro bar 'gyur ba ste//nyon mongs me yis rtag tu rab gdungs la/ /de dag sems kyang gnas pa med par 'gyur/ /de dag sangs rgyas yon tan thams cad dang ri/ /bslabs ri dang sbyangs dang 5thabs kyang brjed yinas ni/ /rgyags dang nga rgyal dregs pa yongs rgyas te/ /de dag mi bzad 9mnar med ltung tshabar 'gyur/ /de dag rgyal po'i gtam la rtag dga' zhing / /rkun po'i gtam brjod 7pa la'ang rab 8tu dga'/ /nye du gnyen 7la'ang rab tu dga' ba ste/ /de dag nyin tshadang mtshan du sems par byed/ /bsam gtan dang ni kha ton tshabatang nas su/ /rtag tu gtsug lag khang gi las la brtson/ /gnas la brkam 9zhing khro gnyer 'byin par byed/ /de dag slob ma 'khor kyang ma dul ba/ /nga ni gtsug lag khang gi lag gi bla/ /bdag gi ched du 'di ni ngas byas te/ /dge slong gang dag nga yi 9rjes 'thun pa/ /gtsug lag khang 'dir de dag gnas yod do/ /gang dag tshul khrims ldan zhing yon tan ldan/ /chos 'dzin skye ci bo'i don la mngon brtson pa / /dul zhing yang dag sdom la rtag brtson pa/ /de dag rnams ni sdud par mi 22byed do/ /'di ni nga yi snyeganas su bskos napa ste/ /'di ni nga yi lhan cig naganas pa'i yinas/ /'di ni nga yi dga' bar byed pa'i yin/ /khyod kyi gnas ni gang yang med kyis nasong / / 'dir ni dge slong dag kyang mang bkod de/ /mal cha rnams kyang ma lus bgos zin la/ /'di na rnyed pa 'byung ba yod ma yin/ /'dir ni ci zhig spyad kyis dge slong song snyo/ /de dag la ni 42—716

mal stan bgomo/)bya ba/ /nam du'ang srid par 'gyur rib ma yin te/ /de dag khyim pa lta bur sogasangaga'agyur zhing / / 'tshog chas rdo rnams dang g.yog 'khor mang bar 'gyur/ /phyi ma'i dus na nga yi bu de dag /kun tu smad par pobyas par gyur nas ni/ /de dag nga yi tshig ni dran gyur /te/ /bas mtha' dag dang nags su de tshe gnas/ /kyi /hud rnyed pas zil gnon 7lon tan sdang / /dge slong mang po gang du byung gyur pa/ /rgyal ba dam pa yi ni bstan pa dag /ring por mi thogs par yang 'jig par 'gyur/ /phyis sna dus tshul khrims yon tan ldan pa dag /rtag par yongs su brnyas 8par 'gyur ba ste/ /de dag grong dang yul 'khor grong khyer rnams/ /spangs nas dgon pa nags su gnas par gyur / /'byed gedang zur 7zer thab 7mo dga' 9ba dang / /yon tan nyams la rtag tu bsti //stang byed/ /de dag skye bo'i ston par tsho grags 'gyur te/ /de dag nga rgyal rgyags pas tshig par 'gyur/ /'dir ni nga yi bstan pa yon tan gter/ /yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas mchog dga' ba/ /'di ni tshul khrims nyams dang phrag dog dang / /rgyags pa'i skyon rnams kyis ni 'jig par 'gyur/ /ji ltar rin chen 'byung gnas subasaphu pa dang / /pad ma'i rdzing bu yongs su skamasam pa dang / /rin chen mchod sdong chagam par gnas pa ltar/ /phyi ma'i dus na bstan pa 'jig par 'gyur/ /phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe na dam pa'i chos/ /rnam par 'jig 'gyur shin tu mi bzad tshe snye/ /dge slong dul ba ma yin de 'dra ba/ /de dag nga yi bstan 'di 'jig pa yin/ /spyod pa 'di la sten sapar dga' ba rnams/ /de dag bzang 'gro ga la yong de ring / /'di nas shi 'phos yi dgasam 'gro ba dang / /dud 'gro'i 'gro dang sems can dmyal bar gnas/ /42—717

lo brgya du mar sdug bsngal mtha' yas pa/ /mi bzad drag po nyams su0 myong bar 'gyur/ /ci geste de yis mi yi 5lus rnyed kyang / /rtag tu sdug bsngal mya ngan ldan par 'gyur/ /sdig pa'i spyod pa 'di la chortag sten 5pa/ / long ba'am 'on pa'am phyogar bar skye bar 'gyur/ /lus la rtag tu sha bkra 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can mthong na 'jigs par 'gyur/ /gang zhig ya nga'i spyod pa sten napa ni/ / de la su yang yid rton mi 'gyur te/ /3de yi tshig la yid ches mi 'gyur zhing / /de ni rtag tu sma 'bab par yang 'gyur/ /de dag nad dang sdug bsngal brgya yis gdungs / /mtshon dang shing /dzodang bong ba rnams kyis bsnun/ /bkres dang skom pa'i 'jigs pas yongs su gdungs/ /yang na de ni rtag par rab tu brnyas/ /sdug bsngal mtha' yas pa tshadag thos nas ni/ /des pa rnams kyi pasdig pa'i spyod 'or lak+ṣa/ / legs par 8spyod la rtag tu bsten lapar gyis/ /'di nas phyin chad 'gyod par gyur ta re/ /gang zhig sangs rgyas dang ni 7'phags tshogs dang / /bslab dang sbyangs pa'i //chos la dga' 9gyur pa/ /gnyen dang rnyed dang grags rjod ri spang byos la/ /de ltar rtag tu mngon par brtson par gyis/ /'dus byas 'di ni sgyu ma lta bu dang / /'jig par 'gyur dang mi lam lta bu dang / /sdug pa kun dang mi ring 'bral 'gyur zhing / /'di la rtag pa gang yang med rtog la/ /pha rol phyin dang sa dang stobs rnams la/ /rtag tu rab tu sbyor zhing 'bad par gyis/ /ji srid byang chub mchog nasangs ma rirgyas par byu/ /de srid brtson 'grus nam yang nyams mi bya lha/ /gleng gzhi'i le'u zhes bya ste dang po'o// //12—718

yul 'khor skyong byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i gang zag phal cher la skyon de dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ mi brtson pa dag ni mi brtson pa dag tshol mchod par 'gyur/ g.yo dang ldan pa dag ni g.yo dang ldan pa dag la mchod par 'gyur/ mi shes pa dag ni mi shes pa dag la bste ri stang byed par sems par 'gyur la7/ zang zing la dga' bar 5'gyur zhing chags pa mang ba dang /khyim la ser sna byed pa dang / g.yo nodang ldan pa dang / bya khu ltar mu cor smra ba dang / tshul 'chos pa dang / nye du lhur len par 'gyur/ phan tshun bsngags pa smra bas rnyed pa sgrub /par 'gyur/ rnyed pa yongs su btsal ba'i phyir de dag grong du 'jug gi na sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir ma yin/sems can la snying brtse ba'i phyir ma 9yin par 'gyur/ de dag mi shes bzhin du ji ltar na bdag la pha rol gyis mang du thos pa dang / dge ba'i chos dang ldan par shes par 'gyur/ snyam du bdag shes pa dang ldan par khas 'che 7bar 'gyur/ ji ltar 'dir mi brtson pa de bzhin du zhes med par 'gyur/ snod chag pa bzhin du 'gyur/ gcig la gcig 'khrul pa tshol ba ha dang / sbyor ba panyams pa dang / mi shes pa dang / le lo can dang / phan tshun mi snye'athun pa'i chos bgro ba byed pa dang geyi shes la mi rtog pa mang ba dang / rang dgar byed pa dang / shar gnyer ba dam pa dang / gnod sems kyis rgyas pa dang /rigs pa tham yin pa'i 'khor gyi skye bo dang bgro 7ba byed pas bstan pa 'di la spyod par 'gyur/ yongs su mi 'dri ba'i ngang tshul can dang / chos mnyan pa don du mi gnyer bar 'gyur/ mi rigs pa'i spyod pas dbul po'i khyim rnams su skye ba yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur/ de dag dbul po'i khyim nas rab tu byung 42—719

nas rnyed pa tsam gyis bstan pa 'di la dga' ba skyed 37par 'gyur ro/ /de dag la nyes pa bshags pa yang med par 'gyur na ye shes mngon par rtogs pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de dag ni gusangs rgyas rikyi yon tan rnams bor nas shes kyi khe dang rnyed pa tsam gyis bdag dge sbyong ngo zhes bdag 4nyid khas 'che557bar 'gyur te / yul 'khor skyong nga ni gang zag de lta bu de dag la rjes su 'thun pa'i bzod pa 5yang mi smra na sangs rgyas kyi ye shes lta ga la zhig sgyu de dag la ni bde 'gro yang ring na byang chub lta smos kyang ci nadagos/ yul 'khor skyong gang zag de lta bu de dag la byang chub kyi bar chad byed pa'i chos brgyad yod par smra ste/ brgyad gang zhe na/ ngan song gsum du skye ba dang / mtha' khob nyu)pa'i mi'ikhunang du skye ba dang / dbul ba'i me khyim du skye ba dang / rigs dma' bar skye ba dang /mdog ngan cing rtogs pa zhan tshapa dang / sdig pa'i bshes gnyen dang phrad skupa dang —/ nad mang ba dang / ya nga ba ma spangs pas 'chi ba'i dus byed pa ra 'gyur ba ste/ yul 'khor skyong chos brgyad po de dag ni byang chub kyi bar chad byed par brjod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ yul 'khor skyong tshig gis khas 'che ba la 'byang chub ces nga 5mi smra'o/ /tshul 'chos pa la spyod pa yongs su dag pa zhes nga tshemi smra'o/ /g.yo byed ’ pa la byang chub kyi spyod pa zhes nga hu)mi smra'o/ /zang zing lhur len pa la sangs rgyas la mchod pa zhes nga lha mi smra'o — / /mngon pa'i nga rgyal can la shes rab yongs su dag pa zhes nga 1mi smra'o/ /shes rab 'chal pa da la the tshom snyegacod pa zhes nga mi smra'o/ /ser sna can la bsam pa yongs su dag pa zhes nga mi smra'o/ /mi brtson pa mang ba la gzungs thob pa zhes nga mi smra'o/ /yang dag pa'i yon tan ma yin pa yongs su tshol ba la bde 'gro 42—720

'thob /༷ces nga mi smra'o/ /khyim la ser sna byed pa la lus yongs su dag pa zhes nga mi smra'o/ /spyod lam bcos ma can la sangs rgyas dang phrad pa zhes nga mi smra'o/ /khyim la chags pa la ngag yongs su dag pa zhes nga mi smra'o/ /ma gus pa la sems yongs su dag pa zhes nga mi smra'o/ /tshod mi shes pa la chos 'dod pa zhes nga mi smra'o/ /lus dang srog la rilta ba dang bcas pa la chos yongs su tshol ba zhes nga mi smra'o/ /yul 'khor skyong ji ltar skyes bu blun po de dag la smad pa ltar ston pa drug la de ltar nga mi smod gido/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de dag ni gzhan su)smra ri la gzhan du byed pa'o/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten la slu ba'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad mupa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /yang dag ma bsdams rgod cing khengs pa can/ /ma gus nga rgyal ldan zhing chags shas che/ /nyon mongs zil non tha ba nyon mongs bcas/ /de 'dra dag la byang chub mchog rab ring / /chags pas zil gyis non na le lo 'phel le los zil gyis non na dad pa nyams/ /dad pa nyams na tshul khrims rab tu nyams/ /tshul khrims 'chal ri bar gyur na bzang 'gro nyams/ /dbul por gyur pas rab tu byung gyur te/ /mchod pa rnyed nas dbul las grol tshobar 'gyurang/ /de dag gser gyi khur ni bor nas su/ /gso ma'i khur ni len par byed dang mtshungs/ /rnyed pa don du gnyer bas dgon par 'gro/ /der song nas kyang /77gos dang nye padu tshol/ /mngon shes rig dang spobs pa phun sum tshogs/ /bor nas de ni phyir yang nye skudu 'dzin/ /rmongs nas nga rgyal dbang gis ngan song sa / /mi khom 'gro ba rnams dang dbul po dang / /dma' ba'i rigs su skye dang long ba dang / /mdog ngan pa dang mthu chung de dag 'dzin/ /42—721

de dag tshul dang spyod pa yongs nyams dngos/ /bag med rnyed nas dran pa rab tu nyams/ /g.yang sa chen po mi bzad ltung bar 'gyur/ /de nas bskal pa0bye bar thar pa med/ /gal te 'dir ni 'thob pas byang chub na/ /de phyir lhas byin gegyis kyang byang chub 'thob/ /rnam par 'thor rlung gis ni bya ltung ltar/ /chags pas kyang ni de ltar mi rigs so/ /bsod nams nyams shing gzhan gyi chung ma 4chags/ /tshul khrims ma dag dge ba rnams las nyams/ /byang chub sems kyis ye shes gang ma thob/ /de dag bstan la mi dgos lidur shing bzhin/ /byang chub don gnyer sangs rgyas chos tshol ba/ /dper na thar pa de bzhin mi gnas so/ /de ni rnyong gis spre'u la dam byas 0ltar/ /nga rgyal zil non byang chub de 'dra'o/ /byang chub don du gnyer bas chos tshig phyir/ /nga yis gerang gi phangs pa'i srog kyangamu btang / /chos de btang nas brtson dang mi ldan pa/ /don med gyur nas bstan las ltung bar 'gyur/ /ngas0)ni sngon chad legs par bshad don 7phyir/ /g.yang sa chen po me lce 'bar b.ratshwa mchongs/ /de thos nas ni sdug dang mi sdug pa/ /thams cad rnam par spangs te nan tan gnas/ /bstan pa sna tshogs yon tan 'byor thos la/ /de dag nam 8yang 'dod pa mi skyed tshan/ /chos min 'dod la byang chub ga la yod/ /dper na long ba lam gsal 6med dang mtshungs/ /yul 'khor skyong sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa grangs med pa'i yang ches 'grangs med pa/ rgya che ba/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ mtshungs pa med pa/ dpag tu med pa/ tshad med par gyur pa de'i tshe lade'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig 7pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig 42—722

rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ci ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das don grub blo zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ngo / /yul 'khor skyong de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po 'od zer saldan zhes bya bsho zhig byung ngo / /yul 'khor skyong rgyal po 'od zer 4ldan ni 'dzam bu'i gling dpag tshad khri drug stong la rgyal srid byed do/ /yul 'khor skyong de'i tshe de'i dus na 'dzam bu'i /gling de na grong 5khyer nyi khri dang / khyim bye ba phrag stong yod do/ /yul 'khor skyong rgyal po 'od zer lhaldan de rgyal po'i 'pho brang gang tshon gnas pa rgyal po 'od zer paldan de'i 1grong khyer rin po che tshasnang ba zhes bya ba shar 8nub tu chur tshadapag tshad bcu gnyis 8pa/ lho byang du skargyar dpag tshad bdun yod pa rin po che sna bdun gyi phyir ra ba 7rim pa bdun dang / mig mangs : ris su bris / pas mdzes par byas pa yod do/ /de'i tshe sems can rnams kyi che'i tshad ni lo bye ba phrag bcu thub par gyur to/ /yul 'khor skyong rgyal po 'od zer ldan gyi bu bsod nams kyi 'od zer 1zhes bya ba gzugs bzang ba/mdzes pa/ blta na sdug pa/ kha dog bzang po rgyas pa mchog dang ldan pa zhig yod de/ de btsas ma thag tu rin po che sna bdun gyi gter stong byung bar gyur to / /rgyal po'i khang bzangs kyi ri snyenang du yang snyerin po che sna bdun gyi 2 gter 5mi bcu'i tshad tsam byung bar gyur tel/ yul 'khor skyong rgyal bu gzhon nu bsod nams kyi 'od zer /de btsas ma thag tu 'dzam bu'i 0gling pa'i sems can thams cad yis rangs par gyur to/ /sems can gang dag btson ra na 'khod pa de dag kyang btson ra nas thar bar gyur to/ /yul 'khor skyong rgyal bu gzhon nu bsod nams kyi 'od zer des nyi ma bdun gyis 'jig rten pa'i sgyu 42—723

rtsal ji snyed pa de dag thams cad rtogs par gyur to/ /yul 'khor skyong de nas gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha rnams kyis nam gyi gung gi dus la bab pa dang /rgyal bu gzhon nu bsod nams kyi 'od zer 3tshol gzhon nu khyod chabag yod par gyis shig /mi rtag par so sor brtag pa la mkhas d+ngha par gyis shig /gzhon nu mi rnams kyi srog ni chen po med pa ste/ tshe 'pho bar ④'gro ba yin gyis⑤/'jig rten pha rol la 'jigs par blta bar bya zhing las dang bya ba dang mi 'gal bar gyis shig ces bskul te/ de'i tshe lha'i bu de dag gis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag kyang smras so/ /gzhon nu bag med par ni gyur ta re/ /bag med dbang du song bar gyur ta re/ /bde bar gshegs pas bag yod rab bstod cing / /bde gshegs rnams kyis bag med rnams kyang dmad ba/ /des pa gang dag 'di na bag yod cing / /legs sdom dga' la ser sna med〈 pa dang / /sems can kun la snying rje byams yid ldan/ /de dag ring porake mi thogs mi mchog 'gyur/ /bde bar gshegs pa gang dag 'das pa dang / /'di na da ltar dag dang gang ma byon/ /de dag thams cad dge ba rnams kyis 'phags/ /bag yod lam nyid la yang shin tu gnas/ /bza' dang btung dang gos dang kha zas dang / /gser dang dngul dang nor bu mu tig rgyan / /bskal pa bye bar〈rtede dag rnams kyis btang / /byang chub dam pa 'di 7ni don du gnyer/ /rkang pa lag pa de bzhin rna dang 8sna/ /slong geb rnams la rab tu bgosapha byin na/ /byang chub yon tan kun gyis tshabasam rdzogs nas/ /de dag ring por mi thogs mi mchog 'gyur/ /rgyal srid bde dang sdug pa'i bud med dang / /nor rnams thams cad du yang rnam spangs te / /'dus byas gar la lta //dang sgyu tsho tshem 42—724

'dras①/ /'dod pa med par dgon par gnas par gyis/ /srog ni brtan pa med de rtag tu g.yo/ /'jimadza pa'i bum pa lta bur 'jig pa can/ /brnyan ma 'dra zhing rtag tu ther zug min/ /gzhon nu 'di la rtag med dge ma yin/ /ngan 'gror lhung ba'i tshe na 'di na ni/ /pha dang ma yang sne'adzin par byed pa med/ /mi yis dge dang mi dge gang byas pa/ /de ni rtag tu phyi bzhin 'brang bar 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i rgyu yis bskal ngamang rgya mtshor ni/ /don med par yang gcig gis gcig bsad de/ /khyod kyis mi phan ma byas ci yang med/ /don med nyid du ngal ba bsten ri /par gyuragyi/ /da ltar khyod kyis 'gro phan byang chub zhi/ /mtshungs med go 'phang dam pa btsal ba'i phyir/ /rkang dang sha dang pags pa de bskams kyang / /de lta na yang khyod ni ngal ma sems/ /bde bar gshegs pa 'byung ba burnyed par dka'1/ /zhi ba'i chos thos pa yang shin tu dka'/ /bsgrim par 7byas te bdud kyi phyogs bsalam na/ /sangs rgyas ye shes ring por mi thogs 'thob8/ /bshes gnyen bzang la rtag tu yongs bsten cigaci /sdig pa'i bshes gnyen yongs su spang bar gyis/ /de dag rtag tu bzang lam khrid par byed/ /lam gol las kyang rtag tu zlog par byed/ /brtson 'grus shin tu brtan pa legs byos te/ /lus dang srog la 'dod pa rnam 8spangs nas/ /rdo rje lta bu snying gi bsam gtan 7par/ /sangs rgyas lam 'di nyid la gnas par gyis/ /sngon gyi mi mchog dam pa 'od byed pa/ /kun kyang go 'phang dam pa bla med pa'i/ /tshol ba'i tshe na spyod yul dgon par dga'/ /khyod kyang de dag spyod pa'i lam du phyogs/ /dgon par gnas la rtag tu dga' bar gyis/ /pha dang ma dang bu dang sdug pa'i gnyen/ /skye bo snying du sdug pa 42—725

kun spongs la/ /lus dang srog la sred par0)ma byed par/ /bde gshegs ye shes rgya chen btsal bar gyis/ /yul 'khor skyong de nas rgyal bu gzhon nu bsod nams kyi 'od zer gegyis de ni ribazung ste/ lo bcu'i bar du nam yangs)rmugs pa dang gnyid kyis non par ma gyur/ nam yang rgod 5par ma gyur/ rtses par ma gyur/ dga' ba byed par ma gyur/ yongs su spyad gnopar ma gyur/ nam yang skyed mos tshal du ma song / nam yang grogs po tremathong nas ngo mtshar du mi 'dzin/ nam yang glu la dga' bar ma gyur/ rgyal srid dang / nor dang /khyim dang / grong khyer rnams la ('dod pa bskyed par ma gyur te/ de ltar dngos po thams cad la mi lta bar gcig pur pasems shing gnas par gyur to/ /nang du yang dag 'jog lhur len cing 'jig rten la snying po med pa dang /'jig pa dang / dbugs 'byin pa med pa dang / mi sdug pa dang phrad 31pa dang —/ sdug pa dang 'bral tshab dang / byis pa 'drid 7pa dang / 'khor ba la dga' ba ro bro ba med pa dang / rgyal srid kyi bde ba slu ba'i chos can dang /srid pa la mngon par dga' bas chog chomi shes pa dang / so so'i skye bo nyid rtag tu mi 'thun par rnam par sems shing bdag ni byis pa'i skye bo mi brtson pa'i nang na gnas kyis tshabadag gis cang mi smra bar 'da' 7bar bya'o snyam nas de phyogs gcig tu cang mi smra bar gyur te/ bag yod pa la sems shing sdug pa dang bral bar gcig pu gnas par gyur to/ /yul 'khor skyong de nas rgyal po 'od zer 7ldan gyis gzhon nu'i longs spyod kyi phyir sa phyogs shig 8tu grong khyer dga' mchog ces 9bya ba byas te/ lho dang byang gi ngos su lam srang bdun brgya bdun brgya byas so/ /rin po che sna bdun gyi phyir dril bu g.yer ma'i dra bas bres pa/ mu 42—726

tig gi dra ba dang / rin po che'i srog shing dang nyu)/ bla re dang ldan pa rim ri 5skubadun gyis kun nas bskor to/ /lam srang thams cad kyi sgor yang rin po che'i srog shing stong btsugs so/ /rin po che'i srog shing thams cad kyang rin po che'i skud pa drug khris thel to/ /rin po che'i skud pa thams cad kyang phyogs bzhi nas shing ta la'i phrengasab bye bas sgril to/ /de dag rlung gis bskyod de bskul can 'di lta ste dper na rol mo 3nasil snyan brgya stong gi sgra snyan pa lta bu'i sgra 'byung ngo ske/ /lam srang gi sgo thams cad na bu mo glu mkhas pa/ gar mkhas pa/ lang tsosadar la bab pa/ skye bo thams cad kyis spyad pa'i 'os su gyur pa lnga brgya lnga brgya bkod do/ /de dag thams cad la rgyal po 'od zer 0ldan gyis khyed nyin mtshan du glu dang / gar dang / rol mo'i sgras gang dag phyogs bzhi nas lhags pa'i sems can rnams yang dag par dga' bar bya zhing ci nas gzhon nu dga' bar bya ba'i sems bskyed pa zhe ma gtogs par gtam gzhan ma byed cig /sems can gang la yang yid du mi 'ong ba ma smra shig /ces bsgo'o/ /lam srang de dag thams cad kyi sgor yang bza' ba 'dod pa rnams la ni bza' ba/ btung ba 'dod77pa rnams la ni btung ba/ bzhon 1pa 'dod pa rnams la ni bzhon pa nasam/ gos dang / spos dang / phreng skab dang / byug pa dang / mal k+ṣadang ske/ rgyab rten dang / 'tsho ba'i yo byad rnams tshadang / gser dang /dngul dang / nor bu dang / mu tig dang / be+e drur+ya tshadang / dung dang /man shel dang / byi ru dang / sa le sbram dang / dngul sil ma dang / glang po che dang / rta dang / shing rta dang / ba lang dang / nor dang / rgyan thams cad byin zhing skye bo thams cad kyis 7yongs su spyod tsho/8pa'i phyir rin po 42—727

che'i phung po yang bzhag par gyur to/ /de'i tshe grong khyer gyi dbus su gzhon nu'i longs spyod kyi phyir khyim khor yug tu dpag tshad tsam yod pa rin po che sna bdun mig mangs kyi ris su bris gepa/ rta babs brgyas rab tu brgyan pa byas so/ /de'i nang du khang bzangs zhig ci byas te/ der gzhon nu'i longs spyod kyi phyir mal bye ba phrag bzhi bshams so/ /de'i dbus su skyed rtsomos tshal byas te/ me tog gi shing ljon pa thams cad dang / su'abras bu'i shing ljon pa thams cad dang ske/ rin po che'i shing ljon pa thams cad kyis khyab par bkang ngo ⑥/ /yul 'khor skyong skyed 3mos tshal de'i dbus su rin po che thams cad kyi rdzing rin po che sna bzhi'i 8them skas dang ldan pa byas pa la tsho)'di lta ste/ gser dang / dngul dang / be+e drur+ya tshadang / shel lo/ /gang nas spos chu 'bab pa'i seng ge'i kha brgya nyam brgyad btsugs skuso/ /rdzing de'i seng ge'i kha brgya rtsa brgyad po de nas kyang chu 'bab bo/ /me tog ud pa la dang / ku mu da tshadang / pad ma dang /'ipad ma dkar po rnams rtag par rgyun du rgyas so/ /khor yug tu 8rin po che'i shing ljon pas yongs su bskor to/ /dus thams cad pa'i me tog dang /'bras bu'i shing ljon pa rnams kyis kyang yongs su rgyas so/ /rdzing de'i 'gram du rin po che'i shing ljon pa brgyad brgya bskyed de/ rin po che'i shing ljon pa thams cad kyang rin po che'i skud pa rnams kyis thel cing thams cad du yang shing ta la'i phreng ba 7bye bas thel to/ /de dag kyang rlung gis bskyod cing rlung gis bsgul na 'di lta ste dper na rol mo rnyisil snyan brgya stong blangs pa lta bu'i sgra 'byung ngo / /gzhon nu'i58lus la sa dang rdul gyis reg tu 'ong5)zhes rdzing de'i steng rin po che'i dra bas bkab par gyur to/ /de'i tshe khang bzangasab tshoder rin 42—728
